ched brjod/༄༅༅/ /lo mang sngon mkhas dbang thub bstan mchog sgrub lags ngo mjal gyi dus skabs shig la/ sngar gyi lo rgyus thog bod dang rgya gar gnyis chos dang rig gzhung gi 'brel ba thun mong ma yin pa yod pa'i khyim mtshos yin pa'i khar/ deng sang bod mi stong phrag brgya skor rgya gar nang gnas sdod byed mus la brten/ bod mi tshos rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul zhes che brjod byed ga'i yul 'di'i rgyal rabs kyi byung ba cha tshang nga tshos shes rtogs dgos gnad shin tu che na yang / da phan bod yig thog rgya gar gyi lo rgyus thor bu ji snyed las/ cha tshang 'khod pa med stabs/ gang nyid chos srid shes bya'i gnas la gzigs rgya che zhing / rgya gar mtho rim slob gnyer khang che khag gi mkhas dbang mang po thugs ngo mkhyen pa/ dpe mdzod khag nang skad yig sna mang gi yig rigs thugs rgyus yod pa bcas gang ci'i cha rkyen 'dzoms pas sku nyid nas rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs cha lag yongs su tshang ba zhig rtsom sgrig gnang rogs zhes re 'dun zhus par dgyes bzhin zhal bzhes gnang byung/ da lam mkhas dbang thub bstan mchog sgrub lags nas brtsams bsgrigs gnang ba/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung ba brjod pa legs bshad rla 'od gsar pa zhes pa'i dpe deb stod cha dang / smad cha gnyis mig sngar son pa zhib tu mjal bar/ shar phyogs yeshiya'i khongs su rgya gar yul zhes 'dzam gling yongs su grags pa'i rgyal khams chen po 'dir snga dus mi sde'i spyi tshogs ji ltar byung tshul dang / s+t+waṃ tshogs de dag gi bde sdug 'phel 'grib/ mang bkur rgyal rigs dang / rgyal phran sna mang byung ba/ de dag so sor mnga' ris rgya khyon ji yod/ de dag so so'i chab srid skyong stangs kyi khyad chos dang / chab srid la dar rgyud ji byung / rig byed dang / ho(/ gcer bu pa/ sangs rgyas pa/ kha che/ ye shu la sogs pa'i chos dang / lta grub 'dra min sna tshogs dar tshul/ de
1 tha 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/dag la brten nas rma sde'i spyo tshogs la phan 'bras dge mtshan dang / brdabs gsegs dka' tshigs ji byung / sulhan dang / mugal/ yuropa pas rgya gar nang dpung shed kyi btsan 'dzul dbang sgyur ji ltar byas tshul/ mthar thug rgya gar mi mang gi snying stobs chen pos 'thab rtsod lo mang byas te rgya gar rgyal phran yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsgril ba'i rang dbang mang gtso'i rgyal khab chen po 'di nyid gsar 'dzugs byas pa bcas gsal bar 'khod pas/ mdor na mi lo lnga stong brgal ba'i ring rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nang chos srid bde sdug dar rgyud kyi byung ba yongs rdzogs gsal por mthong thub pa'i legs bshad zla 'od gsar pa ming don mthun nges shig brtsams bsgrigs gnang 'dug pa yid spro'i gsos su gyur/ bsngags 'os kyi mdzad bzang la dga' sdus yi rangs chen pos snying nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu/'phags pa'i yul gyi byung ba brjod pa legs bshad zu 'od gsar pa 'di dagbod yig thog 'khod pa'i rgyal rabs/ chos 'byung / lo rgyus kyi deb ther rin chen sna mang gi gral stegs thog grags snyan yid 'ong gi dpal dang ldan par yun du gnas rgyu dang / legs bshad 'di dag la brten nas bod yig spyod mkhan spyi dang / bye brag rang rigs blo gsar na gzhon tsho'i rnam dpyod blo gros kau sgo 'phang yangs por phye ste/chos srid bya ba'i 'jug ldog gi gnad tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i mig dpe lam ston bzang por 'gyur ba'i re 'dun che/ldi li bod khang dbu 'dzin rdo bum rin po che nas yig cha 'dir thugs snang chen po'i sgo nas par bskrun gnang ba la yang ched du thugs rje che zhu lags/bzhugs sgar dha ram sa la nas/ dge slong bstan 'dzin chos nyid kyis/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu rta bod zla 2 ches 3 la//
par skrun sngon brjod/༄༅༅/ /rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs 'di'i rtsom pa po mkhas dbang thub bstan mchog sgrub lags sku gshegs nas nyin bco lnga tag tag phyin pa'i nyin khong gi sku ñtsha tha mar phyag las gnang yul lngarwalngar+sā dbus bod kyi mtho rim slob gnyer khang du par skrun sngon brjod thung ngu 'di 'bri skabs yid la skyo snang dang yi rangs 'gran pa zhig byung / de ni khong nas phyag deb 'di 'bri rgyu'i dbu 'dzugs gnang nas ma dpe yongs rdzogs zhu dag ma grub bar lo bcu tsam ring mkhas pa'i bgyi ba gzhan dang gzhan dag ji snyed ru 'dzing pa'i khrod du sku ngal khyad du bsad de 'bad brtson rgyun mar gnang zhing / tha ma'i zhu dag gtan 'bebs gshegs rkyen gyi bstun gzhis ma gtses gong tsam du grub par gnang ste grub 'bras deb thog dngos su thon pa spyan gyis gzigs rgyu'i go skabs ma byung ba dang /khong nyid kyi sngon gleng nang zur tsam spros 'dug par ltar rgya gar gyi klog deb tshad ldan la gzhi bcol thog zhib rgyas su btang ste mthar chags su bsgrigs pa'i deb 'dis bod yig thog de lta'i rgya gar lo rgyus tshang la grung 'grigs pa zhig med pa'i stong cha bkang thub pa byung ba red/deb 'di ldi liṃ bod khang nas par skrun bya dgos sku sger drung che sku ngo rta ra ba mchog nas skul ma gnang don bzhin da lam leḍa grub byung ba spro dga' 'phel/ 'di'i nang sgra yig 'bri stangs hoX'i nang 'bri srol bya rgyu sogs gnad don 'ga' zhig phran tshos mnyam du go bsdur byung ba ltar bzhag gnang mdzad 'dug cing / mi sde yar rgyas (0171112'a/1 05)zhes pa don la 'byor tshab che min sogs tha snyad 'ga' zhig skor gleng bsdur zab tsam byung yang mthar ya rabs spyod tshul zhes pa lta bu rtsom pa po'i bzhed pa dbang btsan par byas te rang sor bzhagthog ma'i zhu dag dang / kha skong lhan thabs bzhi pa phyogs bsgrigs/ gzhan
61 par sgrun sngonabarjod/yang sgra yig rnams hi:'i nang 'bri stangs ltar zhib 'jug bcas sku zhabs pad+ma bstan 'dzin lags nas gnang zhing / bod yig nang gi gdam nga can rnams gcig gyur du 'bri 'god a+yau 'gan gso rig slob gnyer ba ngag dbang thar 'dod nas gnang ba dang /par rtsa rdzaluṭar nang 'jug sgrig nyams zhib pa blo bzang rdo rje rab gling gis 'khur len gnang / rtsom po de nyid kyi sku zla bsod nams lha 'dzoms lags nas rgyun du gang ci'i mthun 'gyur bla na med pa zhus pa/ rgya gar gna' shul rig gnas 'tshol zhib khang dang / rgyal yongs shes yon nyams zhib dang sbyong bdar lhan tshogs gnyis nas par ris khag bed spyod bya 'thus kyi chog mchan gnang ba/ 'di ga bod khang gi rtsom sgrig las don 'gan 'khur ba ñtsha ring dbang rgyal lags kyis 'go nas mjug bar las don tshang ma 'brel 'thud dang zhib rtog gnang ba bcas la brten nas da lam deb ther 'di par skrun legs par grub pa 'brel yod tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas/ldi li bod khang 'gan 'dzin rdo bum sprul skus thub pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas mchog lngarāk+ṣar+sār phyi lo 2002 zla 8 ches 25 la bris pa'o//
rtsom pa po'i sngon gleng /༄༅༅/ /snying rje'i gter chen 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol pa 'dza sha gling zhi bde'i ded dpon chen po 7gong sa rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gi sku sger drung che mi rje sku ngo rta ra ba shākya'i dge sbyong chen po bstan 'dzin chos nyid mchog gis lo mang po'i gong phran la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung rabs shig bod skad du 'bri dgos tshul gyi bka' spyo bor phebs pa de lta na yang /rang nyid spyir thos bsam sgom gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'bad rtson dman zhing / lhag par du so sos nang don lta grub rig pa'i gnas la thos bsam cung zad byas pa ma gtogs byung rabs la thos bsam sogs rgya cher byas med par brten/gnas 'di la 'jug pa'i spobs pa re zhig bral yang / mi rje mchog gi bka' gyen ldog ma nus pas rgya gar gyi byung rabs kyu skor shar nub kyi mkhas dbang khag gis bris pa'i dpe deb rgyas bsdus sna tshogs la bsam gzhig rgyun ring byas mthar/ byung rabs spyi dang khyad par du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung rabs kyi don spyi lam tsam zhig rang gi rnam par rtog pa'i blo ngor 'char thub pa byung rjes/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung ba brjod pa legs par bshad pa zla ba gsar pa'i 'od zer zhes pa khyon dpe deb stod smad gnyis dka' tshog cher ma byung bar 'bri thub pa byung ba 'di ni dge ba'i gshes gnyen bka' drin gzhal du med pa rnams kyi byin mthu yin par gdon mi za'o//rang re yul gangs can pa'i skad du spyir btang 'dzam gling gi byung rabs dkon zhing / lhag par du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul byung ba nas bzung dbyin ji'i 'og nas rang dbang rang btsan ma byung bar gyi byung rabs tshad ldan cha tshang ba zhig da bar ma byung ba dang / de'i rkyen gyis gangs can pa dang / gangs can pa'i skad kyis khyab pa'i shes ldan tshos rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung rabs ji
41 1 1 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/lta ba bzhin shes thub kyi med pa dang / gal te shes 'dod byung na skad gzhan zhig la skyabs bcol ba las bya thabs gzhan med par mthong bas kyang snying nas ma bzod pa sogs la brten bod gangs can pa'i skad du byung rabs 'bri ba'i 'bad pa byas pa 'dis gong gsal dka' ngal de dag nyung du 'gro ba'i re ba dang yid ches yod/'phags pa'i yul zhes pa 'di'i tshog dod du legs sbyar skad du āruwarta zhes yod cing / tshog 'di rgya gar gyi yul tshang ma la mi 'jug par byang phyogs kyi mnga' khul rgya che ba zhig la 'phags pa'i yul zhes brjod pa yin te/ legs sbyar gyi gzhung lugs khag tu 'phags pa'i yul gyi shar lho nub byang gi sa mtshams gsal por bshad pa byas yod pa'i nang du lho phyogs khul sogs sa khul mang po zhig tshud yod pa ma red/de lta mod kyang bod du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul zhes 'phags yul zhes pa'i ming tshog 'di rgya gar spyi ming du bed spyod byas dang byed bzhin pa dang / 'phags pa'i yul zhes pa'i skabs kyi 'phags pa zhes pa'i tshog don de rgya chen po zhig la go rgyu yod pa'i dbang du btang nas dpe deb 'dir 'phags pa'i yul zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di rgya gar spyi yi ming du bed spyod byas yod par mkhas pa tsho'i dgongs par 'jags par zhu/byung rabs la rgya gar skad du itihās zhes bya zhing / 'di ni itibṛtaka zhes pa las byung ba yin/ irta ni de ltar dang / bṛtaka m+pi byung ba zhes pa yin la/itihās zhes pa'i don yang de ga rang yin/ iti dang hās bsdoms pas de ltar byung ba zhes pa yin/de ltar byung ba zhes pa ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang nas gcig yin zhing / de ni 'das pa'i dus sam sngon dus kyi byung ba khag rjes su bstan pa la rga dgos par sems/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan de ltar byung ba ni
rtsom pa po'i sngon cheng / 1 5'phags pa'i dri med ye shes kyis sngon gyi byung ba mngon sum du gzigs pa rnams phyis 'byung gdul bya'i ched du bshad pa mdzad pa lta bu zhig yin yang / tshog de ga rang bed spyod byas te deng dus kyi byung rabs la yang de ltar byung ba zhis 'phags yul du yongs su grags/ des na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi skabs kyi de ltar byung ba dang / deng dus rgya gar du yongs su grags pa'i de ltar byung ba gnyis tshog 'dra yang don rgya che chung dang zab los mi 'dra ba yin te/ deng dus kyi de ltar byung ba ni gtso bor 'jig rten pa'i don la 'jug cing / de yang dngos rnying brtag dpyad rig pa dang / yig cha sogs 'jig rten tshu rol mthong ba'i khungs tshad ma zhig gis grub pa'i 'das pa'i byung ba ston byed yin/ khungs de dag gis khungs skyel rgyu med na de ltar byung bar mi 'gro ba yin/ gcig byas na bsam tshul 'di nub phyogs pa'i bsam blo gtong tshul yin srid kyang / khungs bskyel sa byung na shar nub su'i bsam blo gtong tshul yin yang khas len pa las 'os med/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas deng dus kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i de ltar byung ba'am sngon gyi byung ba brjod pa 'di la byung rabs sam byung ba brjod pa zhes bris na go bde zhing phan tshun ma 'dzing par don dang mthun par sems/ 'di'i skor byung rabs kyi 'dor gleng gzhi'i nang zhib par bkod yod/byung rabs khag nang skabs re gnas tshul 'ga' shas phan tshun mi mthun zhing rtsod pa can yang 'dug pa 'di chos nyid yin te/ rig pa'i gnas gang la yang mi mthun pa'i rtsod pa 'ga' shas rtag tu 'byung bzhin pa yin par brten dgag bzhag spong gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'di byung ba red/ dper na bdag cag gi thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs lo sogs la byung rabs mkhan tsho'i bzhed pa mi mthun pa yod dang yod bzhin pa yin zhing / 'on kyang so so'i rigs pas dpyad nas rigs pa
5 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjodapa/dang khungs gang btsan pa zhig la cha 'jog bya dgos pa las thabs gzhan med/ de lta na yang spyir btang deng dus shar nub kyi mkhas dbang dpyod ldan phal mo ches bzhed pa'i gnas gcig la gtan 'bebs byas te spyi mtshungs kyi bshad pa la gzhi bya dges pa las/ dad pa dag snang dang / grub thob kyi nyams snang sogs la gzhi byas te byung rabs 'god mi thub pa yin/byung rabs shes pa ni rig pa'i gnas gzhan gyi ched du'ang shin tu dgos pa che ste/ dper na dbu sems kau lta ba'i skor tshul bzhin shes pa la dpal mdon klu sgrub dang / dbyig gnyen sogs mkhas dbang rnams kyi byung rabs tshul bzhin shes pa dang /de dang de'i skabs su rgya gar du lta ba dang grub mtha' gzhan khag ji ltar byung ba shes gal che/ tha na dbu ma thal rang gi khyad par shes pa la byung rabs shes pa med du mi rung ba yin te/ rje rin po ches legs bshad snying po sogs las byung rabs kyi 'gro stangs gzhir bzhag gi bshad pa mdzad 'dug pa des blo la 'char bde po yod pa de myong bas grub pa red/ de bzhin rig pa'i gnas ga 'dra zhig yin rung byung rabs shes pa med du mi rung ba yin zhes mgrin pa gzengs bstod nas smra bar bya'o//blo pham pa zhig la 'ga' shas kyis nang don rig pa'i thos bsam la brda sprod soḍa kyi dgos pa med pa dang / tha snyad rig pa dor nas don dam mam nang don rig pa 'ba' zhig la thos bsam bya dgos pa'i 'chal gtam smra mkhan yod/ tha snyad rig pa tsam la mgo 'khor nas nang don rig pa la thos bsam ma byas na nor 'khrul yin pa bden pa yin na ji 5 nga nang don rig pa la tha snyad rig pas phan mi thogs par 'dod pa ni nor ba chen po ste/ tha snyad bden pa thabs dang / don dam bden pa thabs byung du gyur par gsungs pa dang / rje btsun byams pa mgon pos theg pa chen po
rtsom papo'i sngonacheng / 51 mdo sde rgyan las/rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid 'thob mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phyir/ /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyang dgos par gsungs shing / rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslabs pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhis rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' yin na des rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la bslabs dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byung rabs kyi dgos pa dang / nying dgos sogs rgyas par dpe deb kyi 'gor gleng gzhi'i nang rgyas par bkod zin pa lags pas skabs 'dir par skrun skabs ched du brjod pa tsam zhig yin/skabs su babs pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung rabs shes pa de ni rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa spyi dang / lhag par gangs can pa rnams la shin tu nas gal che ste/ rang cag sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs 'di yin pas chos kyi cha nas rgya gar gyi byung rabs shes pa gal che/ der ma zad rgyal khab kyi mnga' thang dang gcig gyur gyi cha nas rgya gar gyi byung rabs shes pa gal gnad che ste gcig gyur dang chab srid legs po'i skabs rgyal khab kyi mnga' thang rgyas shing / gcig gyur ma byung bas phyo rgyal ba'i drag spyod dbang shugs 'og tu tshud tshul shes thub/ rang dbang rtsod len gyi cha nas bltas na yang 'phags yul gyi byung rabs shes pa gal che ste/ don dam
51 1 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/gyi shes yon thob nas rgyal khams ring lugs pa dag dang yul zhen ldan pa tshos zhi drag sna tshogs kyis rang dbang las 'gul spel nas mthar 'che med zhi ba'i lam nas rang dbang gtsang ma thob tshul ji bzhin go nus/ 'byung 'gyur gyi dus skabs su dmangs gtso'i 'dzin skyong gi cha gang thad nas kyang rgya gar gyi byung rabs shes pa gal che ba yin par som nyi phra mo yang med/de lta bu'i dgos pa dang dmigs yul de dag blo yul du bzhag ste mi rje rta ra ba mchog gi bka' yi bdud rtsi spyi bor blangs te phran gyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung ba brjod pa leḍa bshad zla ba gsar pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di nyid gangs can pa'i skad du bris pa lags/ 'di la glegs bam gyi cha nas stod cha dang smad cha gnyis dang / brjod bya'i cha nas le'u gsum du bsdus yod pa'i dang po ni sngon dus kyi byung ba brjod pa yin zhing / 'di'i nang sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul nas bzung ste 3 lo 1206 lor kha che'i dbang 'dzin pa mutasmad lhari yi rjes 'dzin pa tshos dbang 'dzin ma byas bar gyi byung rabs bkod yod/ gnyis pa ni dus rabs bar pa'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa yin zhing / 'di'i nang phroṃ lo 1206 lor di'i'i kha che'i sulhan thog ma kutu6)na ebaka nas 1757 lor dbyin jis rgya gar la dbang 'dzin ma byas bar gyi byung ba rnams bkod yod/ de dag dang dus mtshungs rgya gar lho khul 9 byung ba khag kyang skabs dang mtshungs par bkod yod/ gsum pa deng dus sam dus rabs gsar pa'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa yin zhing 'di'i nang dbyin jis dbang sgyur byas pa nas bzung 1947 lor rang dbang gtsang ma ma thob bar gyi gnas lugs khag bkod yod/ de lta na yang byung rabs 'di tsho shin tu mdor bsdus shing ngo sprod tsam zhig yin pa las rgyas par bshad na ni re re yang shin tu rgyas pa yod pas re zhig

gleng gzhi/ 3byung rabs rgyas par bshad na go bde bas thog mar sngon du gleng bar bya ba ni/gleng gzhi/byung rabs kyi tshog don/gangs can pa'i skad du rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung dang / lo rgyus dang /rtogs brjod dang / gtam rgyud dang / byung rabs sogs tshog du ma zhig yod pa de rnams don gcig ma yin par don tha dad yin par shes dgos shing / rgyal rabs zhes pa ni rgyal po'am rgyal srid dang 'brel ba'i byung rabs yin la/ chos kyi byung rabs la chos 'byung zer/ lo rgyus zhes pa bden 'brel yin dgos kyang bden pa yin min ci rigs snang / rtogs brjod ces pa ni gang zag gcig gam mang po'i mdzad pa'i rnam thar lta bu zhig yin zhing / gtam rgyud la yang bden pa dang mi bden pa sna tshogs yod/ byung rabs zhes pa ni don dang mthun pa'i 'das pa'i lo rgyus khungs dang rgyu mtshan ldan la rtog pas bzos pa tsam ma yin pa'i bden par bshad pa zhig dgos/ 'di la legs sbyar skad du itihās zhes brjod pa de lo tsā ba tshos bod skad du de ltar byung ba zhes bsgyur yod pa de yin/ legs sbyar gyi skad du yod pa'i sngon gyi tshog de ga rang deng dus rgya gar gyi skad du rang sor gnas yod kyang / rang re bod skad du/ de ltar byung ba zhes pa'i tshog de bstan bcos tsam las 'char can bed spyod mi byed/ de ltar byung ba zhes bed spyod ma byas na yang / de mtshungs byung rabs zhes brjod na stabs bde zhing don dang mthun par sems/ dbyin skad du (5136075) zhes pa dang / legs sbyar skad du itihāg zhes pa gnyis don gcig yin zhing / de la bod skad du de ltar byung ba zhis brjod na rab dang / de min
4 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/byung rabs zhes brjod chog par go dgos/ dbyin skad kyi (5181075) zhes pa de bod skad du rgyal rabs zhis bsgyur na ni don log par 'gyur te/ tshog de'i don rgyal po'am rgyal srid kyi byung rabs tsam min par sa gzhi'i byung rabs dang / 'gro ba mi'i byung rabs dang / dud 'gro'i byung rabs dang / nad kyi byung rabs sogs mtha' yas pa zhig la sbyor dgos/ rgyu mtshan des na legs sbyar kyi skad du etihās dang /dbyin skad du (51 36075) dang / bod skad du byung rabs zhes pa rnams don gcig tu bzung nas go ba len par rigag so//byung rabs kyi dgos pa/byung rabs ni 'gro ba mi'i spyi tshogs kyi dar rgud kyi skor gsal bar ston byed yin zhing / 'gro ba mi'i yar rgyas kyi rnam pa 'don pa'i nus shugs spyi dang lhag par spyi tshogs dang / srid don dang / dpal 'byor dang / sems kyi gnas stangs sogs dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pas 'gro ba mi rigs la shin twā gal chen po zhig yin/lo rgyus dang byung rabs la brten nas sngar gyi nyams myong thog slob gso 'thob thub pa dang / legs pa gang yin pa de len rgyu dang / nyes pa gang yin pa de 'dor dgos pa'i bslab bya yang len thub/ byung rabs la slob sbyong byas na nga tshos dka' ngal khag bsal ba'i lam ston bzang po zhig brnyed thub pa yin te/ dka' ngal gyi gzhi rtsa yongs rdzogs gsal por ma shes par da lta'i dka' ngal gang yang sel mi thub pa dper na nad kyi lo rgyus sam byung rabs legs par ma shes par sman pas nad ngos 'dzin byed mi thub cing / de bsal mi nus pa bzhin no//byung rabs dang lo rgyus la slob sbyong byas na nga tsho'i blo gros rgya che ru 'gro zhing /
gleng gzhi/ 5mi che don ldan du 'gyur bar phan thogs che ba dang / shes rig yar ldan du 'gyur bar dgos gal che ba zhig yin/ lag len gyi thog nas bltas na yang / byung rabs dang / rgyal rabs lo rgyus sbyong ba la dgos pa chen po yod de/ dper na rgyal dmangs kau sri zhu sgrub pa dang / srid don gyi las ka byed pa dang / 'bri rtsom gyi las ka sogs mi che'i las don mang po zhig la byung rabs dang lo rgyus shes pa med du mi rung ba yin zhing / las don de dag gi ched du sbyong brdar dang / gra sgrig ji lta ba zhig ni byung rabs lo rgyus kyi slob sbyong 'ba' zhig las yong thub pa yin/byung rabs dang sa cha'i chags stangs/byung rabar/ lo rgyus dang sa cha'i chags stangs gnyis phan tshun 'brel thag nye ba zhig yin pas yul gcig gi byung rabs shes pa la yul de'i sa cha'i chags stangs shes pa gal che/ des na sa cha'i chags stangs ni byung rabs lo rgyus kyi mig ya gcig lta bu yin zhes mkhas pa tsho la grags pa red/ yul gcig gi mtsho 'gram gyi gnas stangs dang / gtsang po dang / ri bo dang / gnam gshis sogs phyi snod kyi grub stangs dang /khor yug gi gnas stangs las yul de yi byung rabs spyi dang / rgyal rabs dang / mi rnams kyi spyod tshul la khyad par chen po 'byung thub pa yin pa ni/ nyis dang / khriṭagrwa dang / dbyin yul dang / nyi hong dang / rgya gar sogs yul mang rba la dpe bzhag na shes thub/sa gzhi thon skyed che ba dang / gtsang po'i chu'i mthun rkyen bzang ba dang /gnam gshis tsha grang snyoms pa sogs rang bzhin gyis phyi snod chags stangs legs pa'i yul rnams la ya rabs spyod tshul gyi gar rgyas chen po 'byung ba yin zhing / 'tsho ba'i
6 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/dka' ngal chen po med par ma zad thon skyed legs pas mi che skyed po dang / 'dod pa khengs pa yong /mthun rkyen 'dzom ga'i mi rnams la sgyu rtsal dang / rig gzhung dang / mtshan nyid rig pa sogs kyo gnas tshad mthon po dang / mi che'i gnas tshad mthon po dag la longs su spyod pa'i go skabs mang ba thob thub kyi yod pa red/ des na 'jig rten gyi ya rabs spyod tshul ches mtho ba rnams ni/ in+d+ras dang / mesoposamiX/ (sngon dus kyi parashilā deng dus ṅgārān dang / ināka sa khul )dang / rgya nag dang / rgya gar sogs sa cha'i chags stangs yag sa dang / rang bzhin gyis mthun rkyen bzang sa rnams la byung ba yin/ 'jig rten 'di'i lho byang gi mtha' gnyis lta bu 'khyag rom can gyi sa khul khag dang / bye thang skam po dang tsha ba'i gnas rnams dang / nags tshal 'ba' zhig gis sangs pa'i sa khul rnams su shes rig ches bzang po nam yang byung med de/ sa khul de 'dra'i mi tsho'i nus shugs gang yod pa de mi che'i 'tsho ba sgrub pa la rdzogs nas/ shes rig gi bya spyod sogs la bed spyod byed rgyu'i nus shugs lhag mi thub pa red/ der brten sa gnas de lta bu la shes rig ches bzang po 'byung mi thub pa red/'on kyang lo rgyus la mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyi dgongs tshul ni/ sa cha'i chags stangs legs po med na yang / der mi rigs 'ga' shas kyis shes rig ches bzang po yar rgyas gtong thub pa byung ba yin te/ gtsang po dang / ri bo dang / gnam gshis sogs 'gro ba mi'i yar rgyas la 'dog rkyen byed mkhan de dag las kyang / las ka hur brtson che ba dang / yar rgyas gtong ba'i ngar shugs skye ba yin zhes kyang 'dod/yul gyi sa cha'i go babs las/ yul de'i byung rabs lo rgyus la khyad par
gling gzhi/ 7chen po 'byung thub pa dper na/ 'tsho 'gram gyi sa thig drang po med par 'khyag 'khyog can gyi yul rnams la mtsho dmag dang / tshong 'brel gyi stobs shugs shin tu chen po yong ba yin la/ mtsho 'gram gyi sa thig 'khyag 'khyog can des rang byung (bcos min )gyi gru kha khag gi rgyu byed par ma zad rgya mtsho yang mi rnams dang thag nye zhing 'dris po lta bu bzo ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na yul de lta bu la gnas mkhan gyi mi tshos rgya mtsho la dbang sgyur byed thub cing tshong 'brel gyi bya spyod la mkhas pa yin/ de la brten nas khong tsho nus shugs che ba dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung thub pa yin/mtsho 'gram gyi sa thig gis yul gyi byung rabs la khyad par ji ltar yong ba'i dper brjod khyad du 'phags pa ni/ sngon dus su nus (ku13306) dang / deng dus su dbyin yul dang / nyi hong yul sogs red/ i〈rlu (1 lnga15) dang rgya gar lta bu la mtsho 'gram gyi sa thig 'khyag 'khyog med pas yul de rnams la rang bzhin gyi gru kha med pa dang / mtsho dmag gi nus shugs byung med pa red/ de bzhin sa gter gyis phyug pa'i yul khag la bzo las gyi yar rgyas chen po byung yod pa red/phyi yi sa cha sogs kyi chags stangs las yul mi tsho'i spyod lam la shugs rkyen thebs pa yin te/ mtsho 'gram gyi sa thig drang po min par 'khyag 'khyog can ② mi tshos ya yud che ba'i las don mang po byed thub pa dang / yul gzhan khag dang rang shugs kyis tshong 'brel byed thub pa byung yod/ ri khul gyi sa gshis skyo po'i lung pa rnams su mi rnams dka' las rgyag pa'i nus pa dang / bzod sran che ba yong sred la/sa gshin po dang / chu 'bel po yod pa'i yul khag tu mi rnams 'dod yon rgyas spros la dga' ba dang / sgyu rtsal dang gzhung lugs dang / rig gnas la do snang dang /gar rgyas che ba byung yod pa red/
8 'phags yul9 byung babarjod pa/'on kyang deng dus tshan rig dang / 'phrul las kyi yar rgyas che bar brten phyi yi sa cha'i chags stangs de ha cang gal chen po yin zhes u tshugs bya mi dgos te/ tshan rig gi yar rgyas mu mthud phyin pa las rang bzhin gyi 'gog rkyen mang po zhig thog dbang sgyur byed thub pa dper na/ gtsang po rnams mgo mnan pa dang / bye thang rnams zhing kha sngon por bzos pa dang / gnam gshig rtsub po dag kyang dbang du bsdus yod pa red/de lta na yang 'byung khams kyai rang bzhin 'di dag las rnam par rgyal te/ de rnams 'gro ba mi'i mthun pa'i cha rkyen du sgyur ba 'di la tshad gcig yod par shes dgos/phyo yi sa cha'i chags stangs 'ba' zhig byung rabs dang lo rgyus la shugs rkyen gtong mkhan yin par mi smra zhing / de dang mnyam shugs rkyen gtong mkhan gzhan mang po zhig yod pa yin yang / phyi'i sa cha'i chags stangs 'di tshang ma'i nang nas gal che shos yin zhes phal cher brjod chog par sems/'gro ba mi'i rigs rim gyis byung tshul/lo sa ya 'ga' shas kyi sngon sa gzhi'i bkod pa byung zhing / ri bo rnams dang /gtsang po khag dang / rgya mtsho sogs dal bus gsal bar dod pa dang / de nas rim bzhin srog chags kyi rigs dper na/ 'bu dang / lto 'gro'am/ brang 'gro rnams dang / sgal tshogs can gyi srog chags dang / 'o 'thung srog chags sogs rim gyis byung nas/ mthar 'gro ba mi'i gzugs su gyur pa yin par deng dus kyi rig gsar tshan rig smra ba rnams kyis bzhed/ sa gzhi 'di yi steng du 'gro ba mi'i rigs thog mar gang du byung min sus kyang shes par dka' zhing / 'on kyang al+līkā'i dbus kyi lho phyogs sam/ yang na dbus yeshiga'i lho phyogs su phal cher 'gro ba mi yi rigs
thog mar byung med dam snyam/ spyir btang byas na gnas tshad dma' ba'i sems can spre'u lta bu zhig las yar rgyas su phyin nas 'gro ba mi'i ngo bor gyur pa yin pa'i yid ches byed pa yin/'gro ba mi'i lo rgyus 'di rags pa tsam byas na rdo ba'i dus skabs dang / khams rigs sam lcags rigs kyi dus skabs gnyis su dbye ba byed thub/ rdo ba'i dus skabs 'di la yi ge 'bri klog ma byung sngon gyi dus skabs zhes brjod pa yin zhing / de skabs kyi shes rig la yi ge 'bri klog ma byung gong gi shes rig ces 'bod pa yin te/ de dus mi sus kyang yi ge 'bri klog mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de skabs kyi shes rig gi skor rtogs pa'i che da du lo rgyus bris ma gang yang nga tshos mthong rgyu med la/ de skabs kyi shes rig gi skor nga tshog gang shes pa de ni de skabs kyi mig bzos pa'i lag cha dang /yo byad dang / dngos rdzas gzhan khag la brten pa yin/rdo ba'i dus skabs de la yang dbye na rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa dang / rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa gnyis su dbye chog rdo ba'i dus skabs su sa gzhi 'di'i steng la mi rigs khra 'dra ba bzhi byung yod par cha 'jog byed srol yod cing / de tsho ni dzālā'i (ya ba'i )mi ste 'gru rlang gi mi rigs dang / pekoṅga gi mi dang /ninaḍarathal (70357lnga7(khri'i/) mi rigs dang / 5meganon (070 lo'iḥs07) mi rigs bcas bzhi red/ so so'i gnas yul gyi cha nas de tsho la ming de ltar btags pa yin zhing / sa yul de rnams las de tsho'i geng rus dang / rus pa'i lhag ma dag brnyed pa la gzhi byas pa zhig red/ gong gsal mi rigs bzhi po de yi nang nas spru ma gnyis deng dus kyi mi dang thag nye 'dra mtshungs che ba yod par bshad/ mi rigs de tshang mas smra brjod nus shing / rgyu mtshan la bsam blo gtong thub pa dang / gsar
10 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/gtod byed pa'i rig pa dang ldan pa yod pa red/ sngon dus kyi mi tshang ma sa cha dro sa 'ba' zhig la 'dzul yod pa dang / rim gyis sa cha rgya che sar 'phel rgyas byung yod pa yin te/ de tshos rim bzhin rang byung khor yug gi 'gyur ba dang mnyam goms 'dris ji ltar byed dgos min shes thub pa byung yod pa red/ dus skabs 'di'i 'gro ba mi'i lo rgyus ni/ 'gro ba mis rang bzhin 'byung ba'i khams dang mnyam du 'thab 'dzing byas pa'i lo rgyus sheg red/ der brten rdo ba'i dus skabs kyi shes rig de cung zad zhib par shes gal che/ rdo ba'i dus rabs gsar rnying gnyis a+yau shes rig gi khyad par gsal por rtogs pa'i don du de gnyis kyi rnam pa so sor bshad na legs par sems pas de ltar bshad par bya'o//rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa'i shes rigrdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa'i skabs kyi mi rnams 'brog pa dang /— ngon pa lta bu yin zhing / 'byung ba'i rang bzhin 'jigs su rung ba dang / nags tshal gyi gcan gzan 'jigs su rung ba rnams la gdong len dus rtag tu byed dgos byung ba red/thog mar khong tshos rdo yi lag cha dang / mtshon cha sprug dag po med pa khag bzos pa dang / rdo rnams bcag nas gcod byed so snon po yod pa bzos yod pa red/ der brten thog mar lag bzung sta re bzos pa des ṅka ba dang / gcod pa dang / 'brad pa'am gzhar ba'i ched du bed spyod byas/ rjes su khong tshos yar rgyas gtong tshul shes te rdo gcog pa'i tshul legs su phyin pa dang / lag cha sogs spus ka sngar las legs pa bzo thub pa byung ba red/ sprug ka legs su phyin par ma zad sna kha yang mang du gtong thub pa dang / rim bzhin rdo dang rus pa tsam ma yin par ri dwags kyi rwa co
cheng gzhi/ 11dang / ba so sogs rgyu cha gzhan dag kyang lag cha bzo bar bed spyod byas yod pa red/dper na rus pa'i khab dang / nya 'dzin byed kyi lcags kyu dang / nya gsod byed mdung thung dang / gri gug sogs yod 'dug lag cha 'di rnams mang che ba gtsang po'i 'gram dang / gtsang chu'i shul rnams las brnyed yod pas rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa'i mi rnams gtsang po'i nye 'gram du gnas yod par bstan pa red/ de ni khong tshor chu dgos pa tsam du ma zad chu 'thung du yong ba'i dud 'gro rnams ngon byed par sla ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang red/rdo ba'i dus rabs rnying pa'i mi rnams spyir btang brag phug khag tu sdod kyi yod pa dang / de tshos gos gyon 9 yod kyang gos 'thag las byed shes kyu yod pa ma red/der brten khong tshos bsad pa'i dud 'gro sogs kyi pags pa'i gos gyon gyi yod pa red/de skabs rus pa dang / nya phyos dang / ba so sogs las bzos pa'i rgyan cha yang 'dogs kyi yod tshod/ dus skabs 'di mjug rdzogs nyer yod skabs khong tshos shing gi dum bu gnyis sam/ yang na rdo yi dum bu gnyis brdar ba las me 'byung bar shes shing / me'i bed spyod shes pa de las sha sreg pa'i me thab chen po rnams gsar gtod byas pa red/ me gsar gtod byung ba des khong tsho'i mi 3 la gsar brje chen po zhig byung ba dper na khong tshos sha rjen pa za rgyu'i tshab la sha btsos te za ba dang / de ni sha rjen pa las bro ba che ba dang / nags tshal gyi gcan gzan rnams la 'jigs snang skul ched me la bed spyod byed thub pa byung ba red/ mdor na me'i bed spyod las khong tsho'i mi 3 sngar las skyid pa byung ba red/rdo ba'i dus skabs 'di'i mi rnams sgrig 'dzug gag po yod pa'i tsho khag nang mi 3 skyel rgyur goms yod cing / mnyam 'brel gyis ngon chen po byed rgyu'i gra sgrig byed
