srol yod pa red/ lag cha gag po bzo ba'i nus pa dang / bzo rig la bltas na/de skabs las rtsol ba'i gral rim 'ga' shas yod par mngon/de skabs kyi mi tsho la gshin po'i phung po la chags sems dang / gal che ba'i bsam tshul zhig yod tshod/ de tshos gshin po'i phung po rnams dur khung gting ring po min par sbas pa dang / phung po'i mnyam du gshin po de'i lag cha dang / dngos po gzhan 'jog srol yod 'dug byed stangs 'dis shi ba'i rjes su yang 'gro sa zhig yod pa'i yid ches yod pa do thub/ 'on kyang skye ba phyi ma yod par tshul bzhin yid ches byed kyi yod min kha tshon gcod par dka'/rdo ba'i dus rabs rnying pa'i skabs gar thon gyi grub 'bras che shos ni khong tsho'i lag rtsal yin zhing / de yang khong tsho'i ri mo'i lag rtsal de red/ khang bzo dang /snod chag bzo ba'i lag rtsal gzhan ni de dus byung med/ ri mo'i lag rtsal ni khong tsho'i sdod gnas kyi brag ngos dang / thog g.yab la bris pa'i ri mo sna tshogs mthong rgyu yod cing / khong tsho tshog sam/ sa tshon lta bu'i bed spyod byed shes kyi yod pa red/ri mo tshang ma shin tu do snang chen pos zhib rgyas su bris yod par ma zad/ de tsho rang bzhin nam don dang mthun pa lta bu bris yod 'dug ri mo de tsho'i nang mi de tsho'i nye skor du mthong ba'i rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul khag bstan yod cing / rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa'i ri mo mkhan de tsho ni sems can gyi g.yo 'gul gyi bya ba ston pa la lhag par mkhas po yod pa red/ g.yo 'gul gyi bya ba ston ched thabs tshul sna tshogs bed spyod byas yod tshod 'dug cing / dud 'gro rgyug bzhin pa dang / mchong bzhin pa dang / rtsa za bzhin pa sogs bstan yod 'dug ri mo 'ga' shas ni yi ge 'dra po yod kyang / de dag la brten nas de tshos yi ge 'bri shes kyi yod ces lab mi thub/
14 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/de tshos rus pa dang / rwa co dang / ba so sogs la rkos kyang brgyab 'dug cing /de tsho ni rkos snga shos red/ rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa'i shes rig de yishu'i sngon gyi lo 10000 tsam la nges par du mjug rdzogs par snang / lo rgyus mang por rdo ba'i dus skabs la snga ma dang bar ma dang / tha ma bcas gsum du dbye ba yang gnang 'dug kyang / spyir btang snga phyi gnyis sam/ gsar rnying gnyis su grags che bas de bzhin byas pa yin/rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i shes rigrdo ba'i dus skabs 'di ni 'jig rten gyi cha shas 'dra min khag la dus skabs 'dra min khag khag la 'do tshugs pa dang / mjug sdud kyang dus skabs sna tshogs su byas yod pa red/ rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa zhes pa'i tshog 'di las skabs der bzos pa'i rdo'i lag cha dang / mtshon cha sogs sngar las spus legs pa yod pa de go nus pa dgos shing / skabs der dus skabs rnying pa dang mi 'dra bar lag cha rnams kyi ngos 'jam zhing / bzo lta legs pa dang / ñtsa btang yod pa red/ rdo yi sta re shing gi yu ba can dang / mdung gi rtse mo dang / 9 dang / mda' dang gzhu/phang dang / thag khri dang / thag 'dren 'khor lo dang / skas 'dzig sogs ni lag cha gtso che shos red/ dus skabs 'di'i yar rgyas kyi grub 'bras mtho zhing / phyi'i 'byung ba'i khor yug thog la dbang sgyur che ru btang thub yod pa red/ rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa dang gsar pa gnyis kyi khyad par gtso che shos ni/ snga ma'i skabs kyi mi rnams zas sdud mkhan dang / phyi ma'i skabs kyi mi rnams zas bzo 'don byed mkhan yin pa de red/ de'i don ni rdo ba'i dus skabs rnying pa'i mi rnams kyis zas bzo
'don byed shes kyai med par ri dwags sogs bsad de 'phral 'phral du za ba dang /rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i shing 'bras sogs za ba tsam las so nam gyi las ka byed shes kyi med pa dang / rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i mi rnams kyis zas bzo 'don byed shes kyi yod pa dang / de yang so nam gyi las ka byed shes kyi yod pa de red/ de tshos gro dang / nas dang / tshal dang / shing tog bcas 'debs las byed kyi yod pa red/ der ma zad khong tshos sgo phyugs dud 'gro yang nyar gyi yod pa dang /khyi ni mi de tsho'i rogs pa snga shos yin zhing / zhus khong tsho la ngon byed par rogs ram byed kyi yod pa dang / ca lag srung skyob sogs byed kyi yod pa red/ de'i rjes su rim bzhin ba glang dang / lug dang / phag pa dang / rta sogs gso skyong byas yod pa red/so nam gyi bya ba dang / sgo phyugs gso skyong byas pa las khong tshos gzhan ltos kyi zas sgrub thub pa byung bar ma zad/ 'tsho thabs 'di gnyis kyis khong tsho'i mi che brtan po bzos pa dang / 'khyam nyul byed mkhan ma yin par gyur pa red/rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i mi tshos skud pa 'khel ba dang / thag 'thag pa'i las ka shes kyai yod pas/ bal dang rtsa skud kyi gos bzos pa dang / khang bzo'i bya ba yang shes kyi yod pa de yang snya skam byas pa'i sa 'dam dang / shing gi khang pa bzo gi yod pa red/ sudzaraleṇ+ḍa la byung ba'i rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i mi tshos mtsho 'gram khag tu shing gi steg bu'i steng du khang pa bzos yod skad 'dug cing /nya 'dzin gsod byed pa ni de tsho'i 'tsho ba gtso bo yin pa dang / de tshog shing bzo byed shes kyi yod pa red/rdo ba'i dus rabs gsar pa'i ring lag rtsal la gar rgyas che shos ni snod bzo
16 'phags yul9 byung babarjodapa/ba'i lag rtsal yin zhing / sa 'dam 'bel po yod pas de las bum pa dang / bum ring bcas bzos te chu gsog pa dang / 'bru rigs gsog par bed spyod byas pa red/thog mar khong tshos bzos pa'i snod chas rigs spus ka mi legs pa'am ma smin pa lta bu yin yang rjes su rim bzhin spus ka legs su phyin yod pa red/ de skabs mi de tshos snod chas sam rdza ma bzo byed 'khor lo'i bed spyod byed shes kyi med kyang rang gi lag pas sa 'dam la bzo lta yag po bzos te mdzes po dang mkho chen po bzos yod pa red/rdza snod de dag mer bsregs te mkhregs po dang / brtan po bzos yod pa red/der ma zad snod chas sogs la ri mo'am spros mdzes shing stabs bde pos brgyan te bzos yod pa red/ de skabs gru bzos ti gtsang po dang mtsho la gtong gi yod 'dugmi shi ba'i phung po rnams sa la sbas te dur khung gi steng sa 'dam gyis g.yog pa dang / dur sa de'i steng la/ ṇ+ḍalamesga (20/7654) zhes pa'i rdo yi ka ba gcig gam ka ba mang po 'dzug srol yod pa de tsho'i nang nas 'ga' shas mchod pa'i rten gyi tshul du yang bed spyod yod skad/mi tsho brtan po byung ba la brten nas grong gseb khag dang / spyo tshogs kyi rnam pa bzhan rnams kyang dar rgyas byung yod pa red/ rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i skabs su sgrig 'dzug gam/ tshogs sde gal che ba khag 'phel rgyas byung ba ni dper na bza' mi'am yang na bza' tshang dang / chos dang / srid gzhung bcas dar 'ato tshugs yod pa red/bza' mi'am bza' tshang gi skor/ de skabs chung ma mang po 'jog pa'i lugs srol dang / chung ma gcig 'ba' zhig 'jog pa'i lugs srol gnyis ka yod par ma zad/ khyo ga mang po 'jog pa'i lugs srol yang skabs re mthong rgyu yod pa red/
tshengagazhi/ 17(1 475 rjes (lha/smi /((lha4 5 6 7//snyi // lta// 4 (skyo8 9 10 11 12ldo ba'i dus skabs su zad sbyod byas pa'i sto lag cha 'ga' shas/chos kyi skor/ rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i skabs su dar ba'i rnam pa gal che shos ni chos yin zhing / de yang thog mar 'jig snang ngam/ zhed snang las byung yod tshod/ glog 'khyug pa dang / 'brug sgra grags pa dang / char pa dang /rlung dang / gzhan yang rang bzhin gyi snang ba mang po zhig las mi rnams la zhed snang skyes shing / zhed snang de mthar dad pa'i ngo bor gyur nas khong tshos dbang sgyur ma nus pa'i stobs shugs shig yod pa dang / de la khong tsho brten dados pa bcas kyi yid ches byung ba red/ de skabs dar ba'i chos de rim gro dang / cho ga sogs kyi
18 'phagasayul: byung ba brjod pa/rnam pa 'dra po zhig yod pa dang / rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i mi tshos nam dus kyi 'gyur ba dang / char pa 'bab pa sogs rang bzhin gyi snang ba 'di dag rim gro'am zhabs brtan ma byas na yag po khra 'byung bar yid ches byed cing / der brten cho ga dang / las rim mang po zhig rim bzhin dar rgyas byung ba red/ de bzhin mu ge dang /than pa dang / ser ba sogs 'jigs pa khag las skyob pa'i ched du de dag gi rgyur gyur pa'i gdug pa can rnams zhi bar byed dgos pa de'i phyir sngags dang srung 'khor sogs dang du blangs yod par snang / de skabs mi de tshos 'jig rten 'di ni dge ba'am legs pa'i bdag snyad dang / gdug pa can gyi bdag nyid gnyis kyis khengs yod par yid ches byed/ 'di ni snang srid lha 'dre gnyis kyis khengs zhes pa dang 'dra/shi ba'i rjes su 'jig rten pha rol yod par yang yod ches byed de/ phung po dang mnyam du skye ba gzhan du mkho ba'i gshin po de'i lag cha rnams dang / za chas sogs sbas srol yod 'dugsrid gzhung gi skor/ rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i skabs srid gzhung dar yod 'dug cing / de'i rgyu rkyen ni/ dper na so nam la yar rgyas phyin pa la brten nas spyo tshogs nang dka' rnyog 'ga' shas byung ba bsal ba dang / rgyu nor bgo 'grems tshul bzhin bya rgyu dang / so so'i khe phan ched 'khrug 'dzing med pa bzo rgyu bcas yin pa red/ de dag la brten nas spyi tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzug gcig dgos gal chen por gyur pa dang / srid gzhung zhig gis las don de bsgrubs thub pa byung ba red/dmag 'khrug gam/ g.yul gyi bya ba dang / phyi'i dgra las rang gi mi rigs kyi srung skyob bya dgos byung ba de yang srid gzhung dar ba'i gzhi rtsa gcig yin 'dug gdod ma'i spyi tshogs sam/ thog ma'i spyi tshogs rnams su chos kyi 'go 'khrid rnams la
gleng thi/ 19dngos 'brel gyi dpung stobs gang yang med kyang srid gzhung gi dbang cha gang mtshams yod pa red/ der brten bza' mi'am nang mi dang / chos dang / srid gzhung gi sgrig 'dzug gsum po 'di ni dza drag gam gal gnad chen po byung ba des rdo ba'i dus rabs gsar pa'i yar rgyas gyi rim pa gal che shos de bstan pa red/ sgrig 'dzug gsum po 'di'i dza gal la brten nas mi che'i sgrig 'dzug bzang du phyin pa dang / 'gro ba mi'i bya spyod rnams tshul dang go rim ldan pa zhig dang / dam drag can zhig tu'ang gyur pa red/ rdo ba'i dus rabs gsar pa'i mi rnams kyis snod bzo ba'i lag rtsal ma gtogs lag rtsal gzhan khag la yar rgyas btang yod pa'i khungs skyel gang yang yod mdog mi 'dug rdo ba'i dus rabs rnying pa'i mi rnams dang 'dra bar re mo dang /brkos pa'i gzuḍa brnyan sogs kyi lag rtsal khag rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i skabs su byung mi 'dug rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar pa'i lag rtsal gyi dpe deng dus bsdad yod pa ni ṇ+ḍalamerla (20/7308) zer ba'i rdo las grub pa'i lhag ma khag 'ba' zhig lus yod pa 'di yin zhing / 'di rnams ni de tsho'i lha khang ngam/ mchod khang gi cha shas lhag lus yin par ngos 'dzin byed srol yod/lcags rigs gsar brnyed/yishu'i sngon gyi mi lo stong phrag bzhi tsam (4000 20) la lcags rigs gsar brnyed byung ba dang mnyam du rdo ba'i dus rabs gsar pa de mjug sdom byas pa dang /rdo ba'i dus skabs nas lcags rigs kyi dus skabs su 'phos pa red/ de ni 'gro ba mi'i yar rgyas kyi rim pa gal che shos kyi sa tshogs shig red/ 'gro ba mis brnyed pa'i lcags rigs rnying shos ni zangs yin zhing / de las khong tshog lag cha dang / sdod
20 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/chas khag bzos pa red/ de lta na yang zangs ni 'jam la mnyen pas lag cha mkhregs po khag dang / lhag par dmag la mkho ba'i mtshon cha bzo bar phan thogs po rang ma byung zhing / der brten zangs de mkhrebs po bzo ched lcags rigs mnyam bsres byas pa zhig dgos mkho byung ba red/ de nas rim bzhin mig lcags rigs sra mkhregs can bzo bskrun ched lcags rigs phan tshun mnyam bsre byed pa'i thabs tshul gsar brnyed byung ste/ li dang / rag gan sogs mkhregs po bzo thub pa byung ba red/ mthar lcags dngos gnas pa gsar brnyed byung ba dang / 'gro ba mi'i mi 3 la gsar brje chen po byung ba red/ sngon dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul che shos tshang ma lcags rigs kyi dus skabs su byung ba sha stag yin 'dugya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul rnying shos/gtsang po'am chu klung chen po yod sa'i lung pa rnams ni ya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul dar sa lte ba lta bur gyur cing / sngon dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul lam/ yar thon spyi tshogs tshang ma gtsang po yod ga'i lung pa khag la dar 'dug pa de la rgyu mtshan mang po yod de/ lung pa de dag la chu 'bel po yod pa dang / sa gzhi gshin pa dang /gter khas phyug pa dang / spyil bu sogs bzo bar rgyu cha las sla por thob cing / 'bel po yod pa dang / gnam gshis kyang dro zhing / skyid pa bcas la brten nas chu klung dang ldan pa'i lung pa khag sngon dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul gyi bsto gnas su gyur pa red/chu klung can gyi lung pa chen po tsho'i nang nas gtso che ba khag ni/ nile (smo1/0)cagris 'phrashes (113313—26957lnga(38) dang / yangatse giyang (tshomasaḥ(36451803)34ho (54lngas6 50) dang / sirnyu bcas red/
gleng gzhi/ 21nil lung pa'i ya rabs spyod tshul lam 'jisna'i ya rabs spyod tshul/nil zhes pa'i gtsang po de yijilha pa tsho'i ya rabs spyod tshul lam shes rig dar sa'i lte ba de yin pas/ i'isna'i ya rabs spyod tshul 'di la nil gyis gnang sbyin zhes 'bod srol byung 'dug yo rgyus mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis ya rabs spyod tshul 'di 'jig rten 'dir ya rabs spyod tshul lam shes rig rnying shos yin par bzhed pa dang / de ni lo chig khri tsam 9 sngon nas dar bar bzhed pa yin/ de lta na yang /ya rabs spyod tshul 'di'i skor yig cha ni ye shu'i 'das lo ma byung ba'i sngon lo sum stong drug brgya tsam 'ba' zhig las brnyed son byung med/6jig pa tsho'i lo rgyus dngos 'brel ni/ merjes (50533) zer ba'i rgyal po nas byung ba yin zhing / khong ni ye shu'i 'das lo'i sngon gyi lo sum stong bzhi brgya tsam la byung yod pa red/ rgyal po de ni yijisna pa'i rgyal po che shos dang po yin zhing / des yul de chig bsgril gyis stobs chen zhig tu bzos te rgyal khab chen po zhig tu bsgyur yod tshod/ khong gis mema'is (5079518) zer ba'i grong khyer mdzes po zhig bzos pa de 'jig rten 'dir grong khyer gyi thog ma yin par ngos 'dzin byed/ rgyal rgyud de'i mi rabs bzhi'i bar du yijisna yul de 'byor ldan stobs chen zhig yod 'dug par ma zad dus skabs de'i ring b.rāmiḍa (2777717) zer ba'i rtsig pa dbyibs gru gsum la rtsa ba sbom zhing rtso mo phra ba can tu mang po bzhengs yod pa de ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa zhig red/ de'i rjes kyi rgyal rgyud tsho dbang 'dzin pa legs po rang byung med tshod/ de tsho'i skabs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa rnams dbang che ru phyin te brtan po rang ma byung ba red/skabs der rgyal po de dbang che shos dang / mi mang gi bde don dang / rgyal
22 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjodapa/khab kyi bde don tshang ma gzigs rtogs gnang srol yod 'dug spyi tshogs nang gral rim gsum yod pa ni/ rgyal po dang / sku drag tsho dang / chos ston pa po rnams gral rim mtho shos yin zhing / de tsho ni phyug cing dbang cha dang / thob thang cha tshang la longs su spyod mkhan yin pa red/ sa zhing gi bdag po rnams dang / lag shes can khag dang / tshong pa khag ni gral rim bar pa yin zhing / dbang 'dzin pa bzang po tsho'i dus skabs su gral rim 'di skyed po yin tshod/ zhing pa rnams dang / bran g.yog rnams ni gral rim dma' shos red/ bud med tsho rang gi bdag po dang 'dra mnyam thob dbang yod cing skyid po yod pa red/dpal 'byor 'tsho thabs ni so nam yin pa dang / rdo bzo dang / lcags bzo dang / shing bzo dang / so phag bzo ba sogs dang / bal 'thag las bcas bzo las kyang dar yod pa yin/ chos m+pi khong tsho'i mi che'i gzhi rtsa ngo ma de yin zhing /lha dang lha mo mang po la mchod pa byed srol yod cing / nyi ma ni lha thams cad kyi nang nas mtho shos lta bur ngos 'dzin byed/ der ma zad grang dang / seng ge dang / zhi mi dang / sbrul bcas la yang mchod pa byed srol yod 'dug shi ba'i rjes su yang 'jig rten gzhan yod par yid ches byed de/ shi ba'i rjes su bdag des che gnyis skyel dgos pa ni mtho ris lha yul gyi che dang / sa steng mi'i che gnyis ka skyel dgos pa lta bu'i yid ches byed srol yod/ der brten gshin po'i phung po rnams gzab gzab byas te nyar yod pa dang / de tshor sa steng gi 'jig rten tu skyed po yong ched kha zas dang / btung ba dang / yo byad gzhan rnams ro khang ngam dur khang du gra sgrig byas yod pa red/'jisna pa rnams ni khang bzo'i rig rtsal gyi ded dpon lta bu yin par ngos
'dzin byed de/ khang bzang khyad du 'phags pa khag dang / porāmiḍa dang / bang so ngo mtshar che ba mang po deng dus kyang mthong rgyu yod pa red/ mirāmiḍa che shos ni mirāmiḍa chen po (670'i( 2777717) zer ba de yin zhing / de la mtho tshad skum khru 484 dang / ring thung skum khu 755 yod pa de ni 'dzam gling gi ngo mtshar che ba bdun gyi nang nas gcig yin par ngos 'dzin byed/ der ma zad ka ba can gyi tshoms chen (21//lnga737 5lnga//) zhes pa de yang sngon dus kyi khang bzo'i mig dpe chen po zhig yin tshod/ de skabs su bzos pa'i mi dang dud 'gro bsres pa'i rdo yi sku 'dra rnams kyang shin tu ya mtshan che ste/ de tsho'i nang nas grags che shos ni skum khru 160 ring po dang / mtho dman skum khu 70 tsam yod pa'i rdo sku gzugs po seng ge dang /mgo bo mi yin pa sogs yod 'dug 6jig mi rnams yi ge 'bri ba la mkhas po yod cing / khong tsho'i yi ge de ri mo'i yi ge'am/ gzugs brnyan gyi yi ge'i srol las byung ba zhig red/྅gris dang yumoces lung pa'i ya rabs spyod tshul/69ga dang / paphrashes lung pa la yang sngon dus su ya rabs spyod tshul chen po dag dar ba yin zhing / cagris dang / 'uphrashes gtsang po gang du 'bab pa'i khul de la sngon mesopo9miX (5 3090(7718) zer ba yin zhing / de ni deng dus ṅgārān dang / ṅgārāka sogs kyi sa khul du 'khel ba yin la/ sa khul der byung ba'i mi rigs snga shos ni sumerigadra (357071803) rnams yin/ de ni ye shu'i 'das lo'i sngon gyi lo lnga stong tsam dong du byung zhing ya rabs spyod tshul la yar rgyas phyin yod par bshad/ yul de la sngon stag gzig gi yul dang / parashilā sogs kyang 'bod pa'i
24 'phagasayulagyi byung ba bajed pa/skabs byung yod/ sumerigan rnams rgyal khab chen po'i bdag po min zhing / de tshog rgyal khab chen po khag bzos med la/ de tshos grong khyer gyi rgyal khab (01(5 bya(lnga(33)khag la dbang bsgyur byas 'dug bla ma'am chos ston pa'i rgyal po rnams kyis dkon mchog gi sku tshab byas te grong khyer gyi rgyal khab dag la dbang bsgyur byas yod pa red/spyi tshogs nang rgyal po dang / sku drag dang / chos ston pa rnams ni gral rim mtho shos dang / sa zhing bdag po rnams dang / tshong pa khag dang / lag shes pa rnams ni gral rim bar pa dang / zhing 6 rnams dang bran g.yog pa rnams ni gral rim dma' shos yin pa dang / bud med rnams la ñtsa mthong shin tu chen po yod par grags/ sa gzhi gshin po yod pas khong tsho'i mi che skyid po yod 'dug so nam gyi las ka ni de tsho'i 'tsho ba'i brten gzhi lte ba yin la/ gro dang / nas dang / tshal sogs 'debs las byed srol yod 'dug khong tsho lag shes la mkhas po yod pa dang /de tsho ni 'khor lo'i srol thog mar gtod mkhan yin par grags/yul gzhan spyi mtshungs ltar khong tshog kyang lha dang lha mo mang po la mchod pa byed srol yod pa dang / de yang nyi ma dang / chu log gi lha dang / sa gzhi'i lha dang / rlung gi lha mo sogs la mchod pa byed srol byung yod 'dugsumerigan tsho'i byas rjes che shos m+pi yi ge 'bri ba'i sgyu rtsal de yin zhing / khong tshog bris pa'i yi ge de la kuniphon (05513017) zhes bya la yi ge zur yod pa sha stag yin 'dug ang rtsis dang / skar rtsis sogs la gar rgyas chen po btang yod pa dang / lo gcig de zla ba bcu gnyis su bgos nas lo tho bzo mkhan thog ma de de tsho yin par grags/ gang ltar dus skabs der snga dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul gi tshul chen po bsngags par 'os pa zhig byung 'dug mesopo9miX las ya rabs kyai spyod
tshul gzhan yang byung ste/ de yang sumerigan rnams rgyud pa'i rjes su bebaloniyas zer ba tshos mesopo9milta'i thog dbang bsgyur bus te/ de tshos be'iloniyasga (28671001803) zer ba'i ya rabs spyod tshul gar rgyas su btang ba red/ skabs der rla ba'i 'gros la gzhi byas pa'i lo tho la gar rgyas btang ba dang / nyi ma bdun la bdun phrag bzos pa dang / snya ma dang / zla ba sogs gza' rnams kyi rgyu tshul dang / sman bcos sam gso ba rig pa'i skor bcas la yar rgyas chen po byung yod pa red/ bebaloniyan gyi khra tsho ni sa bon gyi rtsis (8/8367lnga) dang / dbyibs tshad cas (6607644) la gar rgyas gtong mkhan dang po de yin zhes yongs grags yin/cagris lung pa las ya rabs spyod tshul gzhan zhig kyang byung yod pa de la aserigan (48877180) ga rabs spyod tshul zer/ mi rigs de ni lcags kyi mtshon cha thog mar bed spyod byed mkhan yin par tshang mas khas len byed cing / de'i skabs khang bzo rig pa dang / sku 'dra bzo ba'i rig pa bcas la mkhas pa mang po byung bas khang bzang dang / lha khang yag po mang po bzos 'dug cing / ya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul 'di ni yishu'i 'das lo'i gong lo 1600 tsam gyi sngon du dar yod pa red/chu bo yangatse dang hār+sharta'i rgyud kyi lung pa'i ya rabs spyod tshul/rgya nag gi sngon dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul thog mar dar sa ni yangatse giyang (tsholnga lnga(30 51802) gtsang po dang / rgyugaho (57776 50) gtsang po gnyis kyi lung pa yin la/ bod shar phyoḍa nas 'bab pa'i 'bri chu de rgya nag tu bslebs skabs yangatsekagang zhes 'bod la/ rma khog nas 'bab pa'i rma chu de rgya nag skad du hār+shato 'am yang na yen
26 'phagasayul gyi grang babarjodapa/ribar ste ser chu zhes grags/ gtsang po de gnyis kyi rgyud kyi lung pa de tsho sa gshis bzang zhing gnam gshis skyid pa la brten nas dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang /mi che brtan po byung thub pas lung pa de gnyis su rgya nag gi ya rabs spyod tshul dar ba yin tshod/rgya nag gi gtam rgyud ltar na khong tsho'i yul gyi lo rgyus ni yishu'i sngon gyi lo stong phrag gsum tsam gyi skabs byung bar bshad pa dang / rgyal rgyud mang po zhig gi mtshan 'khod yod kyang / byung rabs yig cha'i nang 'khod pa ltar na ni/ rgya nag gi lo rgyus de shang rgyal rabs nas 'go tshugs yod cing / de ni yishu'i sngon lo 1766 nas 1122 bar du byung yod par mkhas pa tshos bzhed/ de nas rgyal rabs rim par byung yod pa red/thog mar rgya nag tu rgyal srid byung zhing / rgyal po la dbang cha tshang ma ldan pa yin zhing / mi mang la gzigs rtogs gnang ba khong gi las 'gan yin pa red/rgyal po tsho chab srid la do snang che bas 'dzin skyong tshags tshud po dang / khrims legs po yod par grags/ spyi tshogs nang zhing pa dang / lag shes pa dang / tshong pa dang / sku drag khag dang / shes yon can bcas gral rim bzhi yod cing / sku drag dang shes yon can rnams la : mthong chen po yod kyang / zhing pa tsho'i gnas stangs skyo po byung yod pa dang / bran g.yog gi lugs srol yang byung 'dug skabs re bran g.yog rnams so so'i dpon po dang mnyam sa 'og tu sbas te che phyi mar yang de'i g.yog byed thub pa'i yid ches byed/ bud med tsho la gnas stangs dang thob dbang yag po sprad med pa red/so nam ni 'tsho ba'i gzhi rtsa yin zhing / gro dang 'bras ni ston thog gtso bo
theng gzhi/ 27yin la/ zhing chu 'dren tshul la yar rgyas chen po phyin yod 'dug dar dang gos chen sogs ras cha'i bzo las la skad grags che bar ma zad dkar yol sogs snod bzo rig pa la shin tu mkhas shing / shel dang / sho gu dang / par khang / me mda'i rdzas sogs bzo bar mkhas po byung yod pa red/rgya gar dang / stag gzig (23331lnga) dang / rom dang / r+sāriX sogs dang mnyam rgya nag gi tshong 'brel yag po yod cing / phyir 'tshong gi dngos zog ni lcags rigs las bzos pa'i dngos po dang / sem ste dar zab dang / zangs dang liṃ bcas yin pa red/chos kyi cha nas byas na/ sngon dus kyi rgya nag pa tshos phyi 'byung ba'i dngos po mang po zhig la mchod pa byed cing / shangati zhes gnam la mchod pa byed tshul de rgya khyab tu dar yod pa red/ 7gong ma ni gnam gyi lha de'i sras yin par ngos 'dzin byed/rgya nag pa tshos so so'i pha mes gshin po rnams la yang mchod pa byed kyi yod skad/la'o3 (670 133) dang / 16shiyas (007950103) gnyis rgya nag gi chos kyi ston pa chen po yon zhing / rgya nag gi shes rig gi gzhi rtsa lta bu red/ rgya nag tu bon gyi lugs srol yang dar khyab byung yod tshod/ 'ashu'i 'das lo brgya phrag dang po'i nang rgya nag tu nang pa'i chos dar khyab byung zhing / rgya nag gi shes rig dang / ya rabs spyod tshul la nang chos las khi phan chen po byung yod pa red/sgyu rtsal dang khang bzo rig pa'i cha nas rgya nag pa rnams skad grags che zhing /rgya nag gi lcags ri ni khong tsho'i lag bzo'i dpe ngo mtshar ba zhig yin zhing / 'di ni 'jig rten gyi nang ngo mtshar che shos khag gi nang nas gcig red/ gso ba rig pa dang /tshan rig gi skor la'ang khong tshog yar rgyas chen po btang yod pa red/ shog bu gsar
28 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/gtod byas pa des shes yon la 'gyur ba chen po byung yod cing / snag tsha dang / par skrun gyi bya ba byed mkhan thog ma rgya nag pa rnams yin par ma zad shog dngul thog mar gsar gtod byed mkhan yin par grags/ de ltar rgya nag pa tshos 'dzam gling nang gi ya rabs spyod tshul la byas rjes chen po bzhag yod/gar klung gtsang po'i rgyud kyi ya rabs spyod tshul/'jig rten spyi mtshungs ltar 'gro ba mi'i ya rabs spyod tshul ni yul so sor gtsang po gal che ba zhig gi rgyud lung pa zhig la thog mar byung bas/ bod yul du yang de ltar byung bar rig pas grub pa yin la/ 'on kyang gtsang po ga 'dra zhig gi rgyud du thog mar dar ba yin min skor da bar bod kyi mkhas pa tshos deng dus dang mthun par zhib tu dpyad pa gnang med tshod/ der brten nges pa brnyed par brjod dka'/bod du gtsang po ches mang po dang / lung pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba mang po yod rkyen mtha' gcig tu ngos 'dzin dka' yang / gtsang po gal chen zhig gi rgyud sa yul gshin po dang / skyid sa zhig la bod kyu ya rabs spyod tshul de thog mar dar yod par gdon mi za ba red/mdo dang bstan bcos rnams su phyi smod 'jig rten mas nas yar chags/nang bcud sems can yas nas mar babs/ zhes pa'i dgongs don ltar/ 'jig rten chags pa'i rjes dpal 'od gsal lha las lha zhig sa gzhi'i steng du babs pa des sa zhag 'dam bu zos rkyen lus kyai 'od nyams/ mkha' la 'gro ba'i nus pa sogs med par gyur te ngur lus te 'gro ba mi thog mar byung zhes 'chad srol yod pa de la gzhi byas te/ sde dge yig tshang sogs su/ lha yul nas thog mar babs sa de
zang gzhi/ 29sde dge lha thog zer ba'i sa gnas de yin zhing des na de la lha thog ces 'bod pa yin zhes gsungs pa la bltas na bod kyi ya rabs spyod bzang de ñdzi dge 'bri chu'i rgyud du thog mar dar ba yin srid/de lta na yang spyir btang bod kyi shes rig dang srid dbang yar rgyas 'gro tshul sogs la dpyad na yar chab gtsang po'i rgyud yul gar klung du bod kyi ya rabs spyod tshul de dang por dar yod par snang / gang lags zer na sa gnas 'dir bod kyi rgyal po thog mar byung ba dang / sa gnas de sngar bod kyi rgyal sa yin pa sogs sa gnas de ga nas thon pa rgyal po tsho'i bang so dang / pho brang zhig shul sogs yod pa las shes/ der brten bod kyi ya rabs spyod tshul dar sa snga shos ni chu bo tshangs pa'i bu'am yar chab gtsang po'i rgyud yul yar klung zer ba de yin zhes ngos 'dzin byas na rigs pa'i rgyab skyor mang bar mngon/ 'on kyang gnad don 'di ni tshan rig dang /dngos rdzas rnying rigs brtag pa'i rig pa soḍa kyis bsgrub dgos pa las rang 'dod kyis gtam rgyud smra ba tsam gyis byung rabs su mi 'gro/bod kyi spyi tshogs su bram ze'i rigs sogs rigs rgyud mtho dman gyi dbye ba med par 'dra snyom du gnas pa'i srol yod/ sngon dus kyi rgyal po rnams kyis 'bangs mi ser la brtse zhing byams po gnang ba las yul gzhan gyi rgyal po tsho ltar mi mang la gnya' gnon bshu gzhog chen po gnang med pa'i bzo 'dugbod yul du chos dar snga shos bon gyi bstan pa yin zhing / yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag bdun pa'i nang du rgya gar nas sangs rgyas kyi chos dar ba red/ lag rtsal dang / khang bzo'i rig pa'i cha nas bod mi rnams kyis gar rgyas chen po btang yod cing / gru 'dzin pho brang chen po dang / dgon pa khag gi khang bzang yid du 'ong ba
30 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjodapa/rnams las bod kyi lag rtsal gyi mtho tshad shes nus/ rig pa'i gnas lnga spyo dang /lhag par nang don rig pa'i skor bod mi tshos shin tu yar rgyas chen po btang yod/gangs can gyi ljongs 'di la bod ces bya zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gang ltar yang don la bod skad kyi tha snyad yin/ bod la phyi rgyal ba mang che bas 6beta yang na caboṭa zhes spyir btang 'bod pa 'di'i skor 'ga' shas kyis sngon dus rgya nag pa rnams kyis bod la hu'u phan zhes 'bod pa de las byung zhes dang / 'ga' shas kyis/ sog po'i skad du bod la thulhad 'bod pa de zur chag pa zhig yin zhes dang / 'ga' shas kyis kha che tsho la dwags phyogs dang 'brel ba che bas bod yul la stod bod ces 'bod pa zur chag pa yir par 'dod pa sogs byung rgyal byis pa'i gtam sna tshogs smras kyang blun po dga' ba tsam yin/ de dag tshang mas thog ma'i 'byung khungs ngos ma zin tshod/tibita zhes pa'i tshogs 'di ni tre'i4par zhes pa'i legs sbyar gyi tshog de rim bzhin zur chag pa yin par rigs pas grub ste/ sngar rgya gar ba tshos ri bo gangs can te homyalaya'i steng gi gnas de la mtho ris dang lha yul zhes 'bod srol 'dug pa ni rgya gar gyi sngar gyi sgrung gtam mahā:rata ste rgya gar chen po zhes pa'i nang gsal por yod/de yang skya seng bu lnga dang sgra ngan dpung tshoḍa bar dmag 'khrug byung ste skya seng bu lnga la rgyal kha thob kyang mi mang po bsad rmas sogs gnas tshul ya nga bas yid pham nas skya seng bu lngas rgyal srid rang gi sras la gtad nas mtho ris lha yul du phyin pa'i lo rgyus gsal 'khod yod la/ lo rgyus 'di bden pa min par sgrung gtam tsam yin srid mod kyang / tshig gi sbyor tshul dang / rgya gar gyi mi'i shes rig dang bsam blo sogs mang po shes thub pas dpe deb 'di byung rabs mkhan tshos gal cher brtsos yod pa yin/rgya gar chen po'i gtam rgyud la cha shas bco brgyad yod pa'i tha ma ni mtho ris
gleng gzhi/ 31lha yul du 'dzegs pa'i cha shas yin zhing / de'i le'u dang po drang srong mis byin gyi bu dang g.yul ngor brtan pa gnyis kyi gleng gtam du/yul skyong bu dang skya seng bu/ /bdag gi pha mes sngon ma tshos// /mtho ris gsum rtsen thob byas te/ /gnas rnams gang dang gang thob gyur/ /zhes dre ba byas pa na/ lan du/khyod kyi pha mes sngon rnams dang / /g.yul ngor brtan pa la sogs pas/ /mtho ris gsum rtsen thob byas te/ /gang zhig byas pa de dag nyond/ /zhes sogs bshad nas/mtho ris gsum rtson thob byas te/ /chos rgyal g.yul ngor brtan pa yis/ /dpal ldan phun sum gyis tshogs nas/ /'thab dka' khri la bzhugs pa mthong / /zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa'i tshogs bcad 'di tsho'i nang gsum rtson zhes lha yul la 9wi4pa zhes yod pa dang / skya seng bu lnga mtho ris lha yul lam gsu ma rtson du phyin pa'i lam de yang ri bo gangs can te lharmālaya la 'dzegs nas phyin yod tshul gsal bas khong tsho 'gro sa'i gsum rtsen gyi yul de bod yul la go ba gsal por yod/ de ni spyir btang lha dang mi gnyis kyi nang gi lha yi yul yin par 'dod kyi yod min ji ltar
32 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/yang bod yul la gsum rtson zhes de dus rgya gar bas 'bod tshul yod par nges/ yu la lung shin tu skyid pas lha yul zhes 'bod pa yang yin chogde ltar byas na/ 9wi4pa de tibisapa dang / de nas tibiṭa dang /de nas rtablata zhes rim bzhin zur chag pa yin par grub/ dbyin ji sogs nub phyogs pa rnams rgya gar du bslebs nas bod yul ngo sprod byung ba na de tshos gathiṭa(11 636) zhes bris pa yin par las sla por shes nus/sngar gyi legs sbyar skad kyi ming tshog du ma rim bzhin zur chag nas deng sang yang rgya gar ba'i skad nang bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i ming tshog ches mang po yod la zur chag stangs kyang gsal zhing 'chad bde ba yod/ mang du bshad rgyu yod kyang gnas skabs de tsam gyis 'thug pas ma spros/ der ma zad bod kyi lo rgyus rnying pa 'ga' shas su bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po de rgyal po skya seng gi bu dang 'brel ba yod par bshad 'dug pa la'ang go rgyu chen po yod par mngon pas bshad tshul 'di gal che ba lags/chu bo siṅgā'i lung pa'i ya rabs spyod tshul/chu bo siṅgā'i (15753) lung pa'i nang du dar ba'i ya rabs spyod tshul ni 'dzam gling du sngon dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul che khag nang nas gal che ba zhig yin zhing / 'di ni yishu'i sngon gyi lo sum stong nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam du dar yod/ ya rabs spyod tshul 'di ni 'phags yul gyi ya rabs spyod tshul gyi thog ma yin zhing / rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung rabs ni 'di nas 'go tshugs pa yin/ 'di'i skor rgyas par 'og tu 'chad par bya ba yin pas skabs 'dir ming smos tsam las ma byas so//de ltar rgyal rabs dang / byung rabs lo rgyus dang / sngon gyi byung rabs la
slob sbyong byed pa'i dgos pa dang / 'gro ba mi rigs byung tshul dang / rdo ba'i dus skabs gsar rnying lag dang / sngon dus kyi ya rabs spyod tshul che khag gi skor mdo tsam zhig sngon du gleng bar byas te/ rtsa ba'i bshad bya 'phags yul gyi byung rabs dngos 'chad pa la 'jug par bya zhing / de yang 'phags yul gyi sngon gyi dus rabs dang /dus rabs bar ma dang / deng dus bcas gsum du phyes nas 'chad srol yod pa ltar go bde bas de ltar bshad par bya'o//'phags yul gyi sngon dus kyi byung rabs/yongs su grags pa'i lo rgyus smra ba tshang mas rgya gar gyi byung rabs la dus rabs snga phyi bar gsum du dbye ba byed/ 'on kyang dus rabs gsum po de'i mtsham sa 'dzin tshul la mi mthun pa cung zad yod de/ de yang deng dus yongs su grags pa ni/chu bo siṅgā'i ya rabs spyod bzung dar ba nas bzung ste yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag bdun pa rdzogs 6 'i bar gyi dus rabs de la sngon gyi dus rabs dang / yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag brgyad pa nas brgya phrag bco brgyad ma zin bar gyi dus rabs de la dus rabs bar ma dang / brgya phrag bco brgyad pa nas rang dbang ma thob kyi bar gyi dus rabs de la deng dus kyi dus rabs zhes bya zhing / dus rabs bar pa de la yang gnyis su dbye ste/ yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag brgyad pa nas brgya phrag bcu gsum pa'i bar la dus rabs bar ma snga ma dang / bcu gsum pa'i rjes nas brgya phrag bco brgyad 'go ma tshugs pa'i bar la dus rabs bar ma phyi ma ngos 'dzin byed/'on kyang bzhed tshul gzhan zhig ni/ yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag bcu gsum pa'i 'gor rgya gar du ba che'i dbang sgyur dzi bzhin ma byas pa'i bar sngon dus dang / brgya phrag
34 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/bcu gsum pa'i 'gor kha ches srid dbang bsgyur ba nas bzung yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag bco brgyad 'gor dbyin jig rgya gar la 'dzin skyong byed 'go ma tshugs bar dus rabs bar ma dang / de rjes da bar deng dus su 'jog pa de go bde zhing dngos don dang mthun che bar snang bas de bzhin byed/ spyir btang ga 'dra byas kyang sa tshogs 'dzin stangs tsam las don dngos gnas byung rabs la khyad par med/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi sngon dus kyi byung rabs shes pa la thog mar sngon dus kyi lo rgyus kyi khungs tshad ma gang yin shes dgos shing / khungs tshad ma la ma gtugs par byung rabs lo rgyus tshul bzhin shes mi thub pa yin/ des na 'phags yul gyi byung rabs kyi khungs sam/ tshad ma la bsam gzhig bya rgyu de gal chen po yin/khungs sam tshad ma/gong gsal rgya gar gyi byung rabs kyi dus rabs gsum po de'i khungs sam tshad ma khag gi rnam pa mi 'dra zhing / dus rabs dang po ste sngon dus kyi byung rabs kyi khungs sam tshad ma 'dzin sa rnams la mi 'dra ba mang zhing mgo rnyogs che ba yod pas de'i skabs kyi byung rabs la bzhed pa mi mthum pa mang ba yod/ sngon dus kyi lo rgyus kyi khungs mi 'dra ba mang ba des phyis 'byung dag gi ched du dka' ngal che gzhir gyur yod red/ dus rabs phye ma gnyis kyi khungs sam tshad ma la mi mthun pa de tsam med pas shes sla/ sngon dus kyi khungs de tsho ni skad rigs 'dra min mang po dang / yig rigs sna tshogs nang yod par ma zad rgya gar las gzhan pa'i skad rigs nang du yang yod pa red/ der brten sngon dus kyi byung rabs la mkhas pa dag gis skad yig mang po shes dgos pa dang / rdo ring gi yi ge dang / sgor mo'am dong tse sogs kyi skor la
nyams zhib bya dgos pa sogs dka' ngal dmigs bsal mang por gdong len bya dgos/ dka' ngal 'di dag gi rkyen pas sngon dus kyi byung rabs lo rgyus skor skabsre bzhed pa mi mthun pa yong gi yod pa red/khungs sam tshad ma'i dbye ba/rgya gar gyi byung rabs lo rgyus kyi khungs sam tshad ma rnams dbye ba bzhi ru 'dus pa yin te/1 bstan bcos sam gzhung 09gas kyi khungs/ 61(31lngakha5 bya0570 82 dngos po rnying rigs khag dang 'brel ba'i khungs/ 8705361081381 80570333 phyi rgyal gyi yig cha'i khungs/ ga073135 80005ma(34 phal pa'i ngag rgyun sgrung gtam/ 771681 jikhu66773gzhung lugs sam/ bstan bcos kyi khungs/gzhung dang bstan bcos te yig cha'i khungs 'di la spyir btang rgya gar ba'i gzhung dang / phyi rgyal gyi yig cha bcas khag gnyis yod kyang / skabs 'dir rgya gar ba'i gzhung lugs bstan bcos kyi khungs de khungs dang por byed/ spyir btang rgya gar rang yul du byung ba'i gzhung rnams kyi rtsom pa po rnams yul 'di ga rang du skyes shing 'brel ba yin pas/ khong tshos rgya gar gyi skor mang ba shes kyai yod pa de lta na yang skabs re khong tsho'i rang yul la zhin pa che ba dang / gling gzhan gyi gnas tshul ma shes pa'i dbang gis phyogs gcig kho na'i gnas tshul bshad pa dang / gnad don 'ga' shas gsal por thag ma bcad pa sogs kyang yod/ phye rgyal ba tshos kyang skabs re
36 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/bsam tshul nor ba dang / bcos ma'i bshad pa byas nas hi bag bshad pa sogs kyang byung 'dug 'on kyang spru rgyal ba'i yig cha de tsho rgya gar gyi gzhung lugs rnams la dag ther dang / tshad ldan yong ched gal chen po yin par shes dgos/rgya gar gyi gzhung gi khungs 'di la yang chos dang 'brel ba'i gzhung dang / chos dang ma 'brel ba'i gzhung gnyis su phye srol yod pa dang / chos phyogs kyi gzhung de yang bram ze'i chos dang 'brel ba dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / rgyal ba pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i gzhung bcas gsum du nges pa yin/bram ze'i chos dang 'brel ba'i gzhung / bram ze'i chos kyi gzhung rnams spre nang nas gtso che shos dang snga shos ni rig byed kyi gzhung yin zhing / de'i nang nas kyang nges brjod kyi rig byed ni snga shos dang gal che shos yin/ lha rnams la bstod pa'i glu dbyangs tshog stong brgya med nyi shu rtsa brgyad 1028 phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa sanyihā zhes pa de nges brjod kyi rig byed kyi rtsa ba'i cha shas gal che shos red/nges brjod kyi rig byed las gzhan pa'i rig byed gzhan gsum po ni snyan ngag gi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig byed dang / srid srung gi rig byed bcas yin pa dang / snyan ngag gi rig byed ni mchod gnas pa tsho'i cho ga phyag len gyi 'don dpe lta bu yin/ som zhes pa'i mchod sbyin bya tshul rgyas par ston pa yin/ mchod sbyin gyi rig byed kyang sbyin sreg dang mchod sbyin bya tshul lam lag len bstar phyogs skor gsal bar ston pa yin/ sred srung gi rig byed ni rig byed snga ma gsum las khyad par chen po yod pa zhig yin par ma zad rig byed gzhan gsum las ches phyi ba'am de tsho'i rjes su bris pa yin/ 'di ni tshogs bcad du bris yod cing dngos grub bam med pa zhi bar bya ba'i ched klog rgyu yin tshod/
le'udang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 37tshangs pa'i mdo dang nye bar gus pa zhes pa gnyis kyang rig byed la brten pa'i gzhung gal che shos gnyis pa lta bu yin zhing / 'di gnyis kyang rim bzhin byung ba yin tshod/ tshangs pa'i mdo de gtso bor rig byed kyi sngags rnams kyi bshad pa byed pas gtismi'i 'grel ba lta bu zhig red/ nye bar grus pa'am upaniṣad ni rig byed las khyad par che ba zhig ste lta ba'am grub mtha' ston byed yin pas sahiṅgā dang 'brel ba ches chung bar mngon/sngon rabs ni bco brgyad yod cing de rnams ni skye bo mkhas pa tsho'i don du bris pa min pa lta bu zhig yod/ 'on kyang 'di ni zags bam mang zhing / lha'i sgrung dang / lo rgyus dang / lta ba dang / gsang ba'i khrims sam dam tshog sogs brjod bya sna tshogs pa ston par byed/ de tsho'i nang nas rlung lha'i sngon rabs dang /khyab 'jug gi sngon rabs dang / nya yi sngon rabs ni gtso che shos yin par grags/mnus dran pa'i mdo zhes pa'i gzhung 'di la mnu'i bcas khrims zhes kyang brjod pa yin/ 'di'i nang spyi tshogs kyi khrims dang lugs srol dang cho ga ches shin hūṃ mang po yod cing / 'di ni dus phyis su byung ba'i gzhung yin/rgya gar 9 dpa' bo'i gtam rgyud chen mo zhes pa gong gsal 9 gzhung rnams las gzhan pa'i gna' bo'i sgrung gtam gnyis yod pa ni nang don rig pa dang 'brel ba ches chung ba yin yang hi( chos byed pa tshos de la rtsa cher 'dzin/ de gnyis ni mahā:rata dang / rumāyaṇa zhes pa gnyis red/ lagāṅgārata zhes pa de drang srong rgyas pas bris pa yin zhing ār+yan gyi rgyal rigs nang khul 'khrug 'dzing gi gtam rgyud yin/'di'i nang skya seng bu lnga dang sgra ngan dpung tshogs kyi dmag 'khrug gi bshad pa gtso bor bris yod/ rumāyaṇa zhes pa 'di rgyal po dga' byed zla ba'i rtogs brjod yin zhing 'di
38 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/nyid drang srong grog mkhar bas bris pa yin/ 'di m+pi rgyal po dga' byed zla ba'i rnam thar lta bu yin zhing 'di la sho lo ka nyi khri bzhi stong tsam yod/ 'dis ār+yan mi rigs kyis rgya skyed byas tshul yang shugs la bstan yod ces lo rgyus mkhas pa tshos bzhed/ rgyal po skya seng bu lnga dang dga' byed zla ba zhes pa de dag dngos gnas byung yod pa'i khungs ma brnyed cing gzhung de dag gi nang du gang bris pa tshang ma bden pa yin pa'i nges pa 4/nga med/ de lta na yang gzhung lugs de dag las sngon gyi gnas tshul mang po zhig shes thub par brten de dag byung rabs lo rgyus kyi khungs su phan thogs po yod/ byung rabs lo rgyus kyi khungs sam tshad mar 'jog pa'i gzhung lugs zhes pa'i skabs 'dir gzhung de dang de'i nang gang bshad pa tshang ma bden pa yin mi dgos par shes par bya ba gal che/nang pa'i gzhung lugs/ ye'u'i sngon gyi brgya phrag drug pa'i nang rgya gar la gzhung lugs gsar pa zhig byung ba de ni nang pa'i gzhung lugs khag yin zhing / sangs rgyas sku mya ngan las 'das rjes bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad de dgra bcom pa tshos phyogs bsdu gnang ste sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnams mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / mngon pa gsum du bsdus pa yin/ skyes rabs rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi sku che sngon ma'i lo rgyus yin pa dang / rgyal rabs dang byung rabs kyi nyams zhib la shin tu gal chen po yin zhis deng dus lo rgyus smra ba tshos bzhed pa yin/ rgyal po milin+da yi dri ba zhes pa zhig pāli'i skad du bzhugs yod pa de dge slong nāgasen te klu yi sde dang / grika gi rgyal po mi.in+da 'am mnin+d+ra gnyis bar gyi chos kyo skor dri ba dri lan gnang ba zhig yin/ mya ngan med kyi snga rol du srid don dang chos don gyi las 'gul skor zhib 'jug byed par shin tu mkho che ba yin zhes tshang mas bzhed/
le'udang po/ sngon dus gyisung rabs/ 39rgyal ba pa'i gzhung 09gas/ rgyal ba pa'i gzhung lugs yan lag bcu gnyis par grags pa de'i nang du/ drang srong rgyal ba pa'i skabs kyi rgyal po rnams dang /byung rabs skor 'khod yod pa dang / der ma zad khong tsho'i gzhung dbung bzang (2527776755) gi dpag bsam mdo (5lnga1983khu(78) sogs kyang rgyal rabs zhib 'jug la mkho che bar 'dod/chos dang ma 'brel ba'i gzhung lugs kyang mang rabs zhig yod pa dper na ko3lus mdzad pa'i bstan bcos arlaXsta ni mor+sha'i rgyal rgyud kyi spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor sogs kyi skor gsal bar ston byed cig yin/ 'di la bod du 〈9kya lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes grags/bram ze 5྅ṇi'i legs sbyar gyi brda sprod dang / nag mo khol gyis mdzad pa sprin gyi pho nya sogs dang / dpal ldan dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sogs kyang lo rgyus byung rabs slob sbyong la phan thogs dang gal che ba yin/gong gsal gzhung lugs de rnams ni legs sbyar skad dang / pāli skad dang /rang bzhin pa'i skad nang du yod cing / skad rigs de rnams las gzhan pa'i yul lho phyogs pa'i skad rnams kyi nang du'ang gzhung lugs sam yig cha'i khungs gal gnad che ba mang po yod pa dper na 'gro lding ba'i yul/ (ga7711 7775) gyi sagam gzhung zhes pa rnams ni yul de ga'i skad nang bris yod/ de tsho'i nang nas tolaXtragam dang /maṇimaṇ+ḍalam sogs ni yul lho phyogs kyi byung rabs lo rgyus la mkho gal che ba yin par mkhas pa tshos bzhed/dngos po rnying rigs khag dang 'brel ba'i khungs/dngos po rnying rigs brtag pa zhes pa ni sngon dus kyi dngos po shul lus skor
40 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/zhib 'jug brtag dpyad byed pa zhig yin zhing / 'di ni gzhung lugs sam bstan bcos spi khungs la rgyab skyor byed mkhan yin/ gdod ma'i lo rgyus dang / lo rgyus sam byung rabs ma dar ba'i dong gi gnas tshul shes pa ni dngos po rnying rigs brtag pa 'di rang la gtso bor rag lus pa yin/dngos po rnying rigs dang 'brel ba'i khungs 'di yang rnam pa bzhi ru dbye ba yon te/ brkos yig brtag pa dang / dong tse brtag pa dang / rdza smod sogs brtag pa dang / dran rten brtag pa bcas bzhi yod/ 'di rnams las byung rabs sam lo rgyus tshod dpag byed thub pa yin/brkos khrag brtag pa/ 'de ni sngon dus su bskos bris byas pa'i yi ge la zhib 'jug byed pa yin zhing / 'di ni dngos rigs rnying pa brtag pa'i rig pa'i yan lag gtso che shos zhig yin/ rdo'am/ zangs dang / rag gan dang / dngul dang / rdza ma dang / shel sogs la brkos pa'i yig brjod rnams ni byung rabs lo rgyus kyi nyams zhib la phan thogs po yod/ rgya gar gyi byung rabs nang / btog yig ni/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi brkos khrag bka' khyab khag nas 'go tshugs pa dang /mya ngan med kyi brkos yig bka' khyab rnams la brten nas nga tshos mya ngan med kyi rgyal khab kyi sa mtshams rgya che chung dang / khyim mches yul khag dang mnyam khong gi 'brel lam ji yod shes par nus/ mya ngan med kyi rjes su byung ba'i brkos yig rnams ni gzhung 'brel lam yang na sger gyi yig cha lta bu yin tshod la/ gzhung 'brel yin pa rnams ni yang na bstod tshog dang / yang na sa zhing dang gzhis ku'i chog mchan skor yin 'duggup+ta'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sbas pa (samudragup+ta)yi rdo brkos i.āhāhād la yod pa
le'udang po/ sngonadus7byung rabs/ 41dang / rgyal po mja yi brkos yig 〉legar la yod pa dang / lho phyogs 3 rgyal po bulamasan dang / pamawa dang / cer sogs kyi brkos yig mang che ba ni dgon pa khag dang / 'dzug bskrun gzhan khag la sbyin pa gnang ba'i skor yin zhing / gang ltar brkos yig rnams rgyal rabs lo tshigs gtan 'bebs byed pa dang / skabs de dang de'i sgyu rtsal dang chos lugs skor gsal shes yong bar phan thogs chen po yod//dong tse'am ṭam sgor/ bskos yig gi rjes la dong tse'am ṭam sgor khag ni byung rabs zhib 'jub ched gal che ba yin zhing / dong tse'i steng rgyal po rnams kyi mtshan ridang dus ches 'khod yod par ma zad rgyal khab de dang de'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs kyang gsal thub kyi yod pa red/ rgya gar 9 srid don gyi byung rabs skor dong tse rnams las nga tsho'i blo gros dang shes rgya che ru 'gro gi red/ sngon dus kyi phyi rgyal ba'i rgyal rgyud dper na iṇ+ḍa'i〉rigan dang / ku69 dang / ñtsatrapa sogs kyi byung rabs skor dong tse'am ṭam ga rnams las gzhan pa'i khungs btsan po med pa lta bu red/ rgya gar lho phyogs su roman gyi dong tse mang po zhig brnyed pa rnams las 'das pa'i dus su rgya gar dang rom bar tshong 'brel gyi skor shes thub pa red/rdza ma'i snod/ rdza ma'i snod chas bzo ba ni 'gro ba mi'i lago rtsal snga shos shig yin pa dang / 'dis ya rabs spyod tshul gyi lo tshogs gtan 'bebs byed par phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ tshan rig gi sgo nas brtag dpyad nan tan byas pa la brten nas snod chas 'di rnams bzo mkhan gyi mi de tsho'i mi che'i gnas tshul gal che ba mang po shes thub kyi yod pa red/dran rten khag sngon dus kyi dngos rdzas rnying pa shul lus khag gi dran rten shul lus yin zhing / dper na ma/bar dang / khang pa khag dang / lcags rigs sna
42 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/tshogs las bzos pa'i snod chas khag dang / lag cha khag ngang / sku 'dra khag dang /rdo sku dang / ri mo sogs yin zhing / rdo ba'i dus rabs gsar rnying gnyis kyi khyad par yang dus thag ring po de tsho'i skabs kyi lag cha khag gis 'byed pa yin/ chu bo siṅgā'i ya rabs spyod tshul gi tshul de yang siṅgā'i lung gshong du bskos shing bsdogs pa las thon pa'i zhig shul rnams las ha go thub pa byung ba red/ de bzhin yul rdo 'jog(ga'i51 18) dang sngaranātha dang / skya nar bu'i grong khyer dang / r+sāgārdzun ko: dang kā:phuram dang / 'berā sprum patinam dang / 'dicalur dang / korakayi sogs su brkos te grus pa las sngon dus kau gnas tshul skor phan brlabs che ba'i shes rtogs mang po byung yod pa red/ angagā'i ldeb ris dang / cisan nalalngayil gyi ri mo sogs kyang byung rabs zhib 'jug la phan thogs chen po yod/phyi rgyal gyi yig cha'i khungs/'phags yul gyi 'dod yon longs spyod dang / chos kyi rig gzhung sogs kyis yid 'phrogs te phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs mang po dus skabs sna tshogs su rgya gar la yong ba dang / khong tshog gang mthong ba dang bsam pa rnams yig thog tu bkod yod pa de tsho gal gnad che zhing / rgya gar gyi sngon gyi gnas tshul shes pa'i cha rkyen du 'gro ba yin na yang de tshos skad rigs tshul bzhin ma shes pa dang / goms gshis dang / lugs srol rnams la go rtogs mthil phyin ma byung bas/ skabs rer go ldog tu bshad pa'ang yod/ des na phyi rgyal bas bris pa'i yig cha tshang ma la gzab gzab bya dgos zhes rgya gar gyi mkhas pa tshos gsungs/shrīka mi rigs sekaleka (30smi/lnga5) zer ba de rgya gar gyi skor 'bri mkhan phyi
rgyal ba thog ma de yin pa dang / khong ni (ka gi chos dang 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rtsom pa po grags can zhig kyang red/ herogaṭas (537070(53) zhes pas kyang rgya gar gyi skor gang 'tshams bris yod 'dug tsan+d+ragup+ta smar+sha'i rgyal sa paṭanā la :ka gi gzhung tshab pa medasaXji (sa lngatha'i khri'i 03) yis bris pa'i iṇ+ḍaka (15715'i) zhes pa de ni skya nar bu'i grong khyer (2lnga lnga1195(18) gyi chab srid 'dzin skyong skor gsal ston byed mkhan khungs gcig pā de yin/rgya nag gi lta skor ba ྅nasārla (51530 73lngas3) dang / 5hen (kha'i 5130)dang iti saṅga (173108) bcas kyis so so'i lam yig gam/ rgya gar du smin pa'i mthong tshul bris pa rnams su de skabs kyi rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs dang / chos dang 'brel ba'i gnad don khag 'khod yod pa red/ yishu'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang arab kyi mi rnams rgya gar du yong ba dang / de tsho'i nang nas ibanakhubabaha (1ngas555358565) dang / sdo/le'agran (3khu131 ba1lngar+sā) dang / labudzayid (86khu2817)sogs ni rgya gar gyi skor 'bri mkhan yin/ mānapolo (507009010) zer ba de dus rabs bar pa'i nang rgya gar du lta skor du yong mkhan nub gling yuropa gi mi rigs dang po dang ya mtshan che shos de yin pa red/ khong rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul gcu'i rgyal khab tu phebs yod pa red/phal pa'i ngag rgyun sgrung gtam/mi rigs kyi sgrung gtam mam/ yang na phal pa'i ngag rgyun la grags pa'i sgrung gtam khag dang / gtam brjod 'khrab ston byed pa rnams ni yig thog tu 'khod pa'i gzhung min na yang mi rabs nas mi rabs su ma nyams par yong ba yin zhing / 'di
44 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/dag kyang byung rabs lo rgyus la zhib 'jug ched dgos gal chen po yin/ sgrung gtam 'di tsho'i nang rtog pas btags pa tsam las don la mi gnas ‘] mang po yod kyang go rgyu chen po dang / mkho chen po yod/ dper na rgya gar gyi sa gnas choṭanāgapur zer ba 'di'i byung rabs lo rgyus ni de lta bu'i phal pa'i sgrung gtam 'ba' zhig las 'tshol thub pa byung ba red/ de bzhin deng dus kyi rā4sdun gyi sa gnas melhar gyi rgyal po rla(prat+napa siha gis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rnams kyang phal pa'i ngag rgyun du yod/gong du bshad pa'i khungs de rnams la brten nas sngar gyi byung ba'am lo rgyus 'tshol thub pa yin zhing / de dag gi rogs ram lta bu las lo rgyus dang byung rabs 'bri rtsom byed thub pa yin/ byung rabs lo rgyus gang la brten pa'i khungs de dag las 'phags yul gyi byung ba shes dgos par ma zad lo rgyus de dag byung sa'i phyi snod sa cha'i chags stangs kyang lo rgyus shes par gal gnad chen po yin pase 'phaḍa yul gyi bkod pa'am chags tshul mdo tsam byung rabs shes pa'i ched du 'god par rigs so//byung rabs dang 'brel ba'i rgya gar gyi sa cha'i chags stangs/mi'i mi che dang rgyal khab kyi byung rabs kyang nye skor gyi 'byung ba'i change stangs la rag lus pa yin pas 'phags yul gyi byung rabs shes pa la de'i sa cha'i chags stangs dang bkod pa ji ltar yin min shes pa gal che ba yin/'phags yul gyi sa cha'i dbyibs ni zur gsum phyed gling gi rang bzhin la byang phyogs su ri bo gangs can gyi rgyud phyi nang gnyis rgyugs yod pa dang phyogs gzhan gsum rgya mtsho chen po gsum gyis bskor yod/ sa gnas 'di ni shar gling yeshilā'i lho yi sa khul phyed gling gi tshul du gnas yod pa red/
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 45rgya gar gyi sa cha'i rgya khyon ni lo rgyus gyi cha nas byas na deng sang gi skabs kyi rgya gar 'di dang / pānalhan dang gapha5nilhan gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig dang /ba:khādesha bcas bsdoms pa la 'phags yul zhes bya la/ spru lo 1947 lor pāṇ+ḍastun zur du thon pa dang / 1971 ba6lngadesha yangazur du rang dbang rang btsan du gyur pa yin pa las de'i sngon yul de rnams gcig gyur red/ der brten byung rabs kyi cha nas de tsho bsdoms nas bshad yod pa dang / sa cha'i rgya kyon ni u ru su phud pa'i nub gling yuropa dang mnyam pa yod/sa mtshams/ rgya gar gling phran 'di bzhin rags cas byas na shar gyi gzhung thig gi tshad gzhi 61 nas 96 bar dang / byang gi 'phred thig 8 dang 37 bar tsam du gnas yod cing / rgya khyon ni le dbar gru bzhi sa ya gcig dang lnga 'bum bdun khri lnga stong 1575000 la khyab yod/ yul rgya chen po 'di'i sa mtshams rnams ni rang bzhin 'byung ba'i chags stangs las grub pa zhig ste/ byang phyogs su dkar gsal dwangs shel lta bu'i ri bo gangs can gyi sprug zhus mdzes shing /phyogs gzhan gsum nas gting zab rgya rma tsho chen pos bsrung zhing bskor yod/ stes dbang zhig la 'phags yul gyi phyi snod sa cha'i sa mtshams de dang byung rabs lo rgyus kyi sa mtshams gnyis mthun pa zhig red/sa cha'i dbye ba/ sa cha'i chags stangs kyi cha nas rgya gar gyi sa khul gtso che ba gsum du dbye bar bya sne/ dang po rgya gar byang phyogs khul dang / gnyis pa tekanapaletsu ste/ dbus kyi sa cha mthon po'i thang dang / gsum pa rgya gar lho phyogs bcas gsum yod/ de tsho'i nang nas dang po rgya gar byang phyogs ni ri bo gangs can gyi sa khul dang / chu mo gaṅgā'i thang chen nam rgya thang dang / rā45྅nu'i bye thang
46 'phags yul: byung babarjod pa/bcas bsdoms pa la zer/ gnyis pa ni ri bo 'big byed dang / chu bo namadu dang hā: nas bzung chu bo hra: bar gyi sa mtho'i sa khul de la gakanapaletsu 'am yang na dbur/ kyi sa mtho'i thang khul zhes brjod pa yin/ chu bo ṅgārmā nas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar gyi sa khul la rgya gar hra phyogs zhes zer zhing sa khul 'dir ām3 dang kurmā9ka dang keral dang tamilaXḍū bcas bzhi chags yod/der ma zad shar nub gnyis su rong gzar po gnyis yod cing / de gnyis las nub kyi rong de gzar zhing mtho la shar phyogs de dma' la gzar po yang de tsam med/ rong gzar las babs te rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du thang chung nar mo ring po de shar nub gnyis khur yod pa de la mtsho 'gram gyi thang zhes brjod pa yin/ dbye tshul 'di gsum ni spyir btang yin la dbye ba drug tu 'byed tshul yang yod/ de ni/1 homyalaya ste ri bo gangs can gyi sa khul dang /2 byang gi rgya thang gshin po dang /3 dbus kyi sa mtho'i thang khul dang /4 ḍakan sa mtho'i thang khul dang /5 rgya gar lho phyogs dang /6 shar nub mtsho 'gram gyi thang bcas drug go/'phags yul gyi sa gzhi'i chags stangs zhib tu bshad na shin tu rgyas par bshad du yod cing / ches ngo mtshar ba'i gnas tshul zhig yod mod kyang skabs 'dir ming smos tsam zhig byas pa 'di 'phags yul gyi byung rabs la mkho ba'i cha rkyen tsam yin pa las sa khra'i rgyas bshad byed pa'i skabs ma yin pas zhib bshad ma byas so//gnam gshis/ 'phags yul la spyir btang dbyar dus dang / tsha ba'i
le'udang po/ sngonadusakyibyung rabs/ 47dus dang / char pa'i dus dang / ston ka dang / grang ba'i dus dang / gangs dus bcas nam dus drug yod kyang / nam dus gtso che ba gsum yod pa ni dbyar ka tsha ba'i dus dang / char dus dang / dgun kha grang ba'i dus bcas gsum yin/dbyar ka ni phal cher phyi zla gsum pa tsam nas phyi zla drug pa bar yin la ri khul gyi sa gnas khag ma gtogs rgya gar gyi yul phal cher la tsha ba chen po rgyas/ 'di'i skabs ri khul khag tu char pa mi 'babs shing gnam gshis skam po lta bur chags la rgya thang gi sa khul khag tu yang skam zhing tsha ba chen po yod/ 'on kyang mtsho 'gram gyi sa khul khag tu rgya mtsho nas lhags rlung bsil po yong ba'i rkyen gyis ha cang tsha po med/phyi zla drug pa'i zla mjug tsam nas lho nub kyi rgya mtsho las rlon shed che ba'i lhags rlung grang mo bslebs pa las char dus 'go tshugs te rgya gar gyi sa cha phal cher la char pa 'babs/phyi zla dgu pa'i dkyil tsam nas gnyis pa'i zla mjug bar du dgun kha yin te nam dus grang ba'i skabs yin/ ri bo gangs can sogs byang phyogs ri khul sa gnas rnams su grang ngad che zhing 'ga' shas su gangs ha cang chen po 'babs yong / spyir btang rgya gar lho phyogs su dgun dus ha cang grang ngad mi che zhing / mtsho 'gram sa khul du rgya mtsho las chu drod can gyi lhags rlung yong gi yod par brten nam dus dro po yong /tamilaXḍū ma gtogs rgya gar la spyir btang dgun dus su char pa dkon zhing / char zhod che shos yod sa ni nub phyogs a+yau mtsho 'gram thang dang / bramoputra'i lung gshong dang / byang shar gyi sa khul khag yin zhing / me〉laya'i mnga' khongs cirāpāX zer ba de 'dzam gling nang char zhod che shos kau sa gnas yin/ de ltar 'phags yul gyi gnam gshis dang nam dus ni yul de'i sa gzhi'i chags stangs dang 'brel ba yin/
48 'phagasayul 'a byung babarjod pa/sa gzhi'i chags stangs las byung rabs la shugs rkyen thebs tshul/sngar bshad pa ltar phyi snod sa gzhi'i chags stangs 'di yul gyi byung rabs dang 'brel ba zhig yin la/ sa cha'i sa mtshams de byung rabs kyi sa mtshams dang mthun pa lta bu yin/ ri bo gangs can gyis rgya gar gyi yul de shar gling elaga'i yul byings las zur du phyes pa lta bu zhig yin la/ de lta na'ang des rgya gar yul de yul gzhan dang 'brel mtshams gcod byed min te/ sngon gyi dus su mi rigs gzhan dag 'phags yul du 'dzul ba rnams ri bo gangs can gyi brgyud nas 'ongs par nga tshos shes gsal ltar red/ rgya gar gyi sa rgya ni shin tu nas che zhing rang byung gi mthun rkyen gter kha mang ba sogs ni lo rgyus byung rabs phyug po yong ba'i cha rkyen yin/ sngon gyi rgyal po rnams phal cher gyis rgya gar rang gi sa mtshams las brgal nas rgya skyed gnang med cing / yul khams gzhan du mi ser spel thabs byas med la de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni rang yul rgya gar de shin tu rgya chen po yin pa de yin zhis rgya gar ba tshos smra/ rgya gar gyis phyi logs su rgya skyed ma byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang yod de rgya gar la rang byung gi gru kha legs po med pa sogs yin/ gcig byas na rgya gar du mi che'i mthun rkyen gang thad nas 'dzoms po yod pa de la brten nas yul gzhan du mi ser spel yul bzo dgos pa'i dgos pa ma byung bas rgya bskyed ma byas pa yin srid/ sa yul shin tu rgya che bas 'phags yul gyi dbang 'dzin pa khrag btsan rgyal ring lugs pa nam yang chags med par ma zad dbyin ji'i sngon du 'phags yul yongs rdzogs rgyal po gcig gi 'og tu gnas pa nam yang byung med/sa yul rgya shin tu che ba de las skyon cha yang mang po byung yod pa dper na/ rgya che ba de la brten nas rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams kyis phye rgyal gzhan gyi skor mkhyen ma
le'udang po/ sngonadus gyi byung rabs/ 49thub cing / phyi rgyal yul gzhan gyi lag cha dang 'phrul chas ji yod shes ma thub/ de la brten nas 3 rgyal bas btsan 'dzul byas skabs pham nyes byung ba dper na kha che'i rgyal po bābar gyis rgya gar la btsan 'dzul byas skabs rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams la dmag sde mang po yod bzhin du yang pham nyes byung ba ni/ me mda' dang 'phrul chas gzhan rnams kyi skor rgyus med pas lan pa yin/byang phyogs kyi ri bo gangs can de ni rgya gar gyi lo rgyus thad shin tu nas gal che ste rgya gar gyi chos dang rig gzhung ngam gtsug lag rnams ri bo 'di la gzhi byas pa zhig yon/ ri brgyud 'dis byang phyogs kyi rlung grang mo 'gog par byed pas 'phags yul gyi gnam gshis snyom po bzo byed yin par ma zad/ ri brgyud 'dis phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul ba 'gog srung byed mkhan rang byung gi lcags ri lta bu yin zhes rgya gar ba tshos yid ches byed srol yod/ 'on kyang ri brgyud 'dis phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul ba rtag tu srung 'dog byed ma thub/ nub byang gi sa khul nas btsan 'dzul pa yong ste pa6ba bar du thengs mang po bslebs rin pa red/ ri bo gangs can gyis 'phags yul de yul gzhan las zur du phyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgya gar gyis sngon dus su rgyal spyi'i 'brel lam ji lta ba bzhin yar rgyas btang ma thub pa yin zhes lo rgyus la mkhas pa tshos bzhed/ri bo gangs can gyi rjes la garwayorlu ri rnams gal che ste ri brgyud 'dis sngon dus su arab pa rnams sasnu'i tshur phyogs su bde bgrod byed pa bkag pa dang / ri brgyud 'di dang / bye thang rnams ni rā4sdun gyi rā46ta zer ba'i rgyal rigs kyi mnga' thang yar rgyas su can pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin par grags/ri bo 'big byed kyis rgya gar byang phyogs dang / lho phyogs gnyis bar 'brel ba nye po yong bar 'dog rkyen byas pa dang / des rkyen gyis byang phyogs dang lho phyogs
50 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/yul gnyis kyi skad dang / shes rig sogs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po byung ba yin zhing / byang phyogs sa khul las lho phyogs su phyi rgyal gyi dbang shugs nyung ba'am chung ba bslebs yod/ deng sang lta bu'i tshan rig dang 'phrul chas ma dar ba'i sngon gyi dus su ri brgyud dang gtsang po sogs kyis 'grul skyod sogs la 'gog rkyen byas yod par rigs pas grub/ ri bo gangs can gyi byang nub brgyud nas phyi rgyal ba mang po rgya gar du 'dzul ba gong du bshad pa ltar yin yang de tsho la dka' ngal chen po nges par byung yod par gdon mi za/spyir btang rgya gar gyi ri khul sa gnas rnams las/ rang dbang la dga' zhing stobs shugs can gyi dpa' bo mang po byung yod pa dper na/ bal yul gyi mi rigs rnams rgya gar gyi dmag mi'i nang dpa' che shos su brtsi ba dang / mañtsamā tshos rgya gar lho phyogs de mugal kha che tshos dmar gsod byed pa las bskyabs thub pa byung ba dang / byang nub kyi ri khul mi rigs paglan tsho yang dmag mi yag shos yin pa dang /himalaga'i ri khul gyi mi rigs rnams ni shrīka dpa' bo melekaṇ+ḍar la thog mar ngo rgol byed mkhan yin 'dugrgya gar gyi byung rabs lo rgyus nang gtsang po rnams ni shin tu nas gal che ste/chu bo sirnyu'i lung gshong khag tu ches snga ba'i sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul zhes pa'i snyan grags can de dar ba yin zhing / chu mo gaṅgā'i thang chen rang byung gi mthun rkyen phyug shos dang / mi tshogs mang shos kyi sa khul yin par ma zad sngar phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul ba tsho'i dgra gas yul lte ba yang yin/ sa khul de gcig sgyur byas te 'dzin bzung byed mkhan kyi rgyal rabs tshos rgya thang 'di'i brgyud nas rgya gar byang phyogs yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur byed thub pa byung zhing / mor+sha'i rgyal rgyud nas mnāsmyu'i rgyal po tsho'i bar
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyibyung rabs/ 51gyi rgyal rgyud tshang ma'i mnga' thang rgyas sa yang gaṅgā thang chen ring mo 'di yin/de bzhin lho phyogs kyi gtsang po chu bo bas sbyin nam goduwan+d+ra (607lnga lnga11)dang / gro: (5713khrima'i) dang / tu5lha'i (gakhur+sāḥlngangalnga'adzo'i) dang / kubarī (0lnga55695) sogs kyi nye 'gram du drabiṇ+ḍayan te 'gro lding ba'i yul gyi ya rabs spyod tshul dar ba yin/ rgya gar byang phyogs dang mi 'dra bar lho phyogs 'di rgyal po gcig gi 'og tu nam yang gcig gyur byung med cing / lho phyogs kyi gtsang po de dag gis srid don gyi chig sgril la 'gog rkyen byas yod pa dang / lho phyogs kyo skye bo'i ljongs de la dbang ba'i ched du 'thab rtsod rtag tu byung yod pa yin/rgya gar 9 rgya mtsho'i mtha' mtshams ring tshad spyi le lnga stong tsam yod kyang mtsho mtha' 'khyag 'khyog can min pas rang byung gi gru kha med/ der brten mtsho 'grul gyi nus shugs thad rgya gar skad grags can nam yang byung med/ de lta na yang sngon dus kyi lho phyogs kyi rgyal rgyud sātashāhan dang / col dang thingayanagar sogs —la mtsho dmag stobs chen po yod par ma zad nub gling yuropa dang / rgya nag sogs dang tshong 'brel byung yod 'dug/mi mang ngam mi rigs kyi byung rabs la yul de'i gnam gshis dang nam dus sogs gal gnad chen po yin te/ rgya gar gyi gnam gshis tsha bo des mi rnams ngar shugs can gyi 'bad rtsol byed mi thub par bzos pa yon zhing / char chu dus su ma babs pa dang / yang na char zhod ches skyon gyis chu log byung ba las zhing pa tsho la dka' ngal byung ba dang / mi zog la gnod skyon tshab che byung yod pa red/ char chul nges med dang / gtsang po sogs dbang sgyur byed ma thub pa'i gnas tshul de la brten nas me tshos bsod nams bzang ngan la yid ches byed pa de byung ba yin zhes mkhas pa
52 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/tshos bzhed/spyir btang sa cha gu yangs shing mthun rkyen bzang po yod pa dang / gnam gshis skyid po yod pa'i rkyen gyis 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal cher med par skyid po dang / dal pos mi che skyel thub par brten phyi dngos po'i skor la rtsad 'tshol ma byas par nang don rig pa la gtsor 'don byas yod/ nub phyogs pa rnams ltar rtag tu 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen rtsad 'tshol ched ga sa ga la rgyugs dgos byung med pa dang / tshan rig dang 'phrul las rig pa'i gar rgyas kyang byung med/ spyir btang mi tsho'i nang nas mtshan nyid dam lta grub kyi phyogs su blo kha phyogs shing snyan ngag sogs la bsam blo gtong ba'i mkhas pa mang po byung yod pa yin/ 3 nang gi ston pa dang / drang srong rnams dang /mkhas dbang grangs med pa rim par byung zhing / shes rig dang / gzhung lugs 'gran rla med pa rgya gar la byung ba nang bzhin 'jig rten 'di'i yul gzhan la byung med pa 'di ni 'phags yul gyi byung rabs kyi khyad chos ngo mtshar ba zhig red/mdor na rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi phyi snod kyi bkod pa de yul 'di'i srid kyi yar rgyas dang blo gros kyi gar rgyas sogs dmigs bsal khyad chos gal che ba rnams kyi gzhi rtsa lta bur chags yod pa yin zhing / 'jig rten 'dir ches shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i 'phags yul gyi sngon gyi ya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul snga shos ni chu bo siṅgā'i rgyud du dar ba las rim gyis yul 'di'i chos srid kyi mnga' thang rgyas pa yin par shes dgos/chu bo siṅgā'am seng ge kha babs kyi ya rabs spyod tshul/'dzam gling 'dir yar thon can gyi ya rabs spyod tshul gtso che ba tshang ma gtsang po'am chu klung chen po khag gi nye 'gram lung pa'i nang du byung ba sha stag yin zhing /
i༄sna'i ya rabs spyod tshul de chu bo nil gyi nye 'gram lung pa'i nang dang / mesopoḍi migana'i ya rabs spyod tshul de chu bo cagris dang paphrashes 'gram du byung ba dang / rgya nag gi ya rabs spyod tshul de ser chu'am rma chu dang / 'bri chu'am yangatse chu bo'i nye 'gram du byung ba dang / bod kyi ya rabs spyod tshul de yar klung gtsang po'i nye 'gram du byung ba sngar ltar yin zhing / rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi ya rabs spyod tshul ni chu bo siṅgā'am seng ge kha babs kyi lung pa'i brgyud du byung ba yin/nye dus yishu'i dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go stod bar du byung rabs lo rgyus la mkhas pa tshos rgya gar gyi ya rabs spyod tshul de ārlan mi rigs las 'go 〈tshe pa yin par bzhed kyang / chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gi skor shes pa nas bzung bsam tshul lam/ grub mtha' de 'gyur ba dang / deng dus byung rabs smra ba tshang mas siṅgā'i ya rabs spyod tshul de rgya gar gyi ya rabs spyod tshul gi thog ma yin pa dang 'dzam gling gi ya rabs spyod tshul chen mo gzhan dang mnyam du spobs pa byed 'os pa'i gnas yin par 'dod/ chu bo sirnyu'i nye 'gram du sngon dus kyi grong khyer chen po khag gi zhig shul brnyed pa las ya rabs spyod tshul 'di'i skor gsal shes byung zhing / 'di ni dngos rdzas rnying rigs brtag dpyad byed mkhan tshog 'bad brtson mthar phyin gnang ba'i grub 'bras rmad du byung ba zhig red/dngos rdzas dang sa khang rnying pa khag gsar brnyed byung ba/phyi lo 1922 lor sar jon mār+shal (313 305sa 618335lnga/1) gyi slob ston 'og ār ḍi banaX (50 2203731) dang / ār bi da.ārlam (2 2 2872774)gyis sngon dus kyi grong khyer rnying pa mohanajodaro(50535)0740)dang haraspru (5234992)
54 'phags yul9 byung babarjod pa/zhes pa gnyis kyai chags shul chu bo sirnyu'i nye 'gram du brnyed pa dang / de'i rjes da dung de mtshungs kyi sa gnas khag mang por brkos te bsngogs pa las de'i skabs gyi khang shul snod chas sogs rnying rigs mang po thob brnyed byung ba dang / brtag dpyad byas pa na sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul dar rgyas byung ba'i skor gsal por gsar du shes pa'i go skabs ngo mtshar ba de byung ba red/'di'i skor yig cha'am/ gzhung lugs thog nas khungs gang yang med cing / dngos rdzas rnying lus gsar brnyed byung ba 'ba' zhig la gtso bor byas pa yin pas/ sngon dus kyi shes rig 'di la lo rgyus ma dar ba'i sngon gyi shes rig yin par 'dod/ sa brkos rdo slog byas pa las brnyed pa'i shul shin tu gal che shos gnyis ni mohanajodaro dang / haraspru gnyis yin zhing / 'di gnyis ni phal cher mi lo stong phrag lnga lhag gi sngon du dar ba'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi shul yin/ gong du bshad pa ltar 1922 lor dngos rdzas rnying riḍa brtag dpyad mkhan tshos chu bo siṅgā'i 'gram sidha mnga' sde'i rdzong larakhānu'i sa khongs mohanajodaro dang pajub mnga' sde'i rdzong mochogomeri (140746047 75) sa khongs haraspru'i sa khul du bskos bsngogs byas pa red/ bskos bsngogs byas sa'i kha gnas khag drug rtsu lhag tsam pya(da blardod 'dug gong gsal sa gnas khag gnyes ni deng sang 5gistun du yod pa de yang larakhyanu sidha mnga' sde'i nang dang / mo(gomeri nub pajub mnga' khongs su yod/gong gsal sa gnas rnams kyi nang nas mohanajodaro'i lho phyogs le dbar (711/03) brgyad cu'i gar canahudar (khikhri'i5557777) dang / lha kār (3khrikhu6lnga7)khaṅgār (6575887) bcas sidha mnga' khul dang / am+bhalā'i rdzong khongs ropar dang /sorāpa'i nang gi ra45ra dang / lo:la dang / merat+ta'i (yu pi mnga' khongs )

62 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi dus tshod/de lta bu'i chu bo sasnu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gi tshul de ga dus byung ba yin zhe na/dri ba 'di ni shin tu khag cing mtha' gcig tu thag chod pa dka' na yang / sar jon mar shal lta bu'i mkhas pa rnams kyis sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul 'di ni ye shu'i sngon gyi lo stong phrag gsum pa'i nang du byung bar bzhed/sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi dus tshod gtan 'bebs byed pa la nges brjod kyi rig byed la bsam blo rtsung zad gtong chog pa zhig ste/ nges brjod kyi rig byed la gzhigs na ār+shan gyi mi rigs tshos mtha' lcags ris bskor ba'i grong khyer gyi mi rnams dang 'thab rtsod byed dgos byung yod tshod la/ de dag siṅgā'i mi rnams yin pa'ang sred/ nges brjod kyai rig byed ni yishu'i sngon du lo 1500 tsam la bris pa yin/de la brten nas sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de tshod dpag byas na ye shu'i sngon gyi lo sum stong nas chig stong lnga brgya'i bar du dar yod par cha 'jog byed dgos sam snyam/de lta na yang siṅgā'i ya rabs spyod tshul de grong khyer gyi shes rig yin la/ ār+shan gyi shes rig ni grong gseb kyi shes rig yin pa dang / ārlan mi rigs tsho la thog mar grong khyer gyi ya rabs spyod tshul gyi skor rgyus med pa gsal por yod/ des na ār+shan tsho la tsistu'i grong khyer skor rgyus gang yang med/ rgya gar la sirnyu'i grong khyer khag stong pa'i rjes phal cher lo stong phrag gcig tsam rjes grong khyer gsar chags byung yod pa red/rgyu mtshan 'di dag la brten nas sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de yishu'i sngon gyi lo 1500la mjug rdzogs pa yin par nges/mnga' sde rā4sgyun nang )rlubaswān sa gnas su brnyed pa'i haraspru tsho'i sa khang zhig shul dang / dngos rdzas khag la glog shugs nus rdzas kyi nag rdzas (khu2710 0lnga1505)
le'u dang po/ sngonadusakyi byung rabs/ 63la brtag dpyad byas pa na de dag yishu'i sngon gyi lo 3252 nas 3002 bar du byung yod par shes pa red/gong gsal rgyu mtshan rnams gung bsgrigs nas zhib tu brtags pa na chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de yishu'i sngon gyi lo stong phrag gsum pa'i 'go stod du shin tu dar rgyas che ba'i sgang yin par mkhas pa tshos bzhed pa ltar yin la/ yishu'i sngon gyi lo stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya tsam la mjug rdzogs pa yin/chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de'i 'byung khungs dang rgya che chung /sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul de'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs skor da bar ji lta ba bzhin shes ma thub cing / 'on kyang byung rabs la mkhas pa mang pos/ sumerigan 〈rān dang / ṅgārāka gi mi rigs 'ga' shas yong nas chu bo sirnyu'i rgyud du gnas chags pa de tsho las sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul lam shes rig de byung ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ 'ga' shas kyis bakhucisgyun gyi mi rigs 'ga' shas chu bo sirnyu'i lung par gzhis chags te/ rjes su rim bzhin grong khyer chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa yin zhes zer/yang mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis drabiṇ+ḍayan te 'gro ldeng ba'i yul gyi mi rigs rnams rgya gar yul yongs rdzogs la gnas pa yin zhing / dus gcig la khong tsho 'ga' shas mesoposamiX (533090(7718) la phyin pa yin/ de dag las sirnyu'i shes rig byung ba yin zhes bshad/ yang bshad srol gcig la ni/ chu bo siṅgā'i mi rigs de ār+shan gyi mi rigs yin zhing mohanajodaro dang / haranya'i grong khyer de yang ārlan gyi gar rgyas kyi cha shas gcig yin zhes kyang zer/dgongs tshul de tsho'i nang nas ga re 'thad pa yin min mtha' gcig tu kha tshon
64 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/gcod par dka' na yang 'gro lding ba'i drabistugan mi rigs rnams kyis chu bo siṅgā'i phar phyogs su rgya skyed byas pa las chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de dar ba yin pa'i bzhed tshul 'di la mos mthun mang shog byed/ sumeriyan gyi mi rigs 'ga' shag chu bo girgyu'i lung par gzhis chags pa yang yin sred/ sirnyu'i mi rigs de ār+shan gyi mi rigs gtan nas ma yin te/ de gnyis kyi shes rig dang goms gshis sogs cha gang thad nas 'dra mtshungs gtan nas med/ gang ltar sasnu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyis khyab pa'i sa yul der de skabs 'tsho ba sogs kyi cha nas gar rgyas ldan zhing mi ñtsha skyid po yod 'dug pas de tsho'i mi che dang 'brel ba'i skor bsam blo mdor bsdus shig gtong dgos pa yin/srid don dang 'brel ba'i mi che/dngos khang sogs rnying pa thon brnyed byung ba khag dang / khungs gzhan rnams la brten nas sirnyu'i lung pa'i mi tsho'i mi che'i skor byung rabs smra ba tshos bshad pa gnang yod cing / thog mar srid don dang 'brel ba'i mi che'i skor ni srid gzhung zhig gi skor bsam blo gtong dgos/ chu bo siṅgā'i mi rigs tsho'i srid gzhung ga 'dra zhig yod min da bar gtan gtan ma shes kyang de skabs de gar dbus gzhung ngam/ grong sde lhan khang lta bu'i chab srid tshags chud po zhig nges par du byung yod 'dug 'o na de 'dra'i gzhung de rgyal pos bskyangs pa'i rgyal srid dam/ yang na mtho rim mi drag tsho'i gzhung yin nam/ yang na grangs nyung mi rigs kyis bskyangs pa'i gzhung ga 'dra zhig yin nam zhe na/ haraspru zhes pa'i siṅgā'i rgyal khab de rgyal sa grong khyer gnyis nas dbang bsgyur ba zhig yin la/ mkhar rdzong dang / khrug khang chen mo dang / 'bru
le'u dang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 65mdzod khang sogs yod stangs la bltas na thun mong gi srid gzhung zhig yod 'dug cing de yang rgyal po zhig byung yod dam snyam/ in+d+rapashigan dang / sumerigan gyi skor dang mi 'dra bar sirnyu'i lung pa 'dir brnyed pa'i dngos rdzas dang / sa khang mang che ba mi mang dkyus ma tsho'i dpal 'byor dang / de tsho'i mi che dang 'brel ba sha stag yin 'dug ka ring can gyi tshoms chen yod pa la dpags na de skabs grong sde'i lhan tshogs sam/ tshong ra lta bu zhig yod nges/ dbang cha'i 'byung khungs sam/ lte ba gang yin yang rung gzhung de sgrig tshugs can brtan po zhig dang / dpal 'byor bgo 'grem legs po byed mkhan dang / srung skyob byed mkhan zhig yod par gdon mi za zhes byung rabs pa tshos bzhed/dpal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i mi che/so nam/ chu bo sirnyu'i lung pa'i mi rnams kyis shes rig phun sum tshogs pa zhig la longs su spyad pa yin pa ni/ thag nyer chags pa'i grong khyer gnyis kyi zhig shul rnyed son byung ba las gsal zhing / de tshog grong khyer gyi shes rig la longs su spyad pa yin/ de tshos glang dang / ba phyugs dang / lug dang / rnga mong sogs 'tsho skyong byed kyi yod kyang rta gso ltar byed kyi med tshod/ mi tsho'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gal che shos ni so nam gyi bya ba yin la/ mi mang dkyus ma tsho'i mi tsho la gzhi rgya che ba'i so nam gyi las ka des phan thogs shin tu chen po byung yod/ sirnyu'i sa gshong ngam lung pa de la mi tshos gro dang 'bru dang / shing bal bcas sa cha gshin po dang chu 'bal sar 'debs las byed cing / de tshos nam dus dang bstun pa'i so nam byed phyogs shes kyi yod par ma zad zhing chu 'dren sa'i yur ba bzo gi yod pa red/
66 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/sgyu rtsal lag shes/ siṅgā'i mi tshos so nam gyi bya ba tsam ma yin par bzo las dang / lag shes sna tshogs kyang byed kyi yod pa dper na snod bzo ba dang /thag mkhan pa dang / shing bzo ba dang / khang bzo ba dang / gser bzo ba dang /rdo bzo ba dang / ba so'i las ka byed mkhan bcas yod pa red/ lhag par du snod bzo rig pa la yar rgyas chen po yod cing rdza ma bzo byed kyi 'khor lo yang bed spyod byas te rdza yi bum pa spus legs khag bzo bskrun byas/ rdza snod de dag ni : yod med sna tshogs yod cing / zangs dang 'khar ba dang / dngul las bzos pa'i bum pa yang bed spyod byed srol yod/ skud pa 'khel byed 'phang sna kha mang po brnyed pa dang /dam phrug khag dang sku brnyan khag la brtags zhib byas pa las ras cha bzo gi yod pa spyi mtshungs ltar dang / bal gos snam bu sogs kyang bzo gi yod pa red/rgyan cha dang / lag cha dang / mtshon cha dang / rtsed chas/ sirnyu'i mi rnams rgyan cha la dga' po yod cing pho mo gnyis kus rgyan cha sna tshoḍa 'dog srol dang /gyon srol yod/ gser dang / dngul dang / ba so dang / zangs dang / rdo rtsa chen po dang / rdo dkyus ma las 'jam mnyen dod la khyad du 'phags pa'i rgyan cha'i rigs bzo gi yod pa red/ de dag nang du ske rgyan dang / dpung gdub dang / a long / ṣ+ṭi rag dang / sna rgyan dang / rna rgyan dang / rkang gdub sogs shin tu dar khyab chen po yod pa red/ shing bzo ba tsho dang / lag shes pa gzhan dag tshos 'then 'khor dang / lag cha dang / mtshon cha dang / nyin rer mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bzo gi yod pa dang / mdung dang / gri gug dang / dbyug to dang / 'ur thag bcas bed spyod byed srol yod 'dug cing / mtshon cha de dag ni spyir btang zangs dang / liṃ las bzos pa yin zhing / skabs re rdo las bzos pa yang yod
