68 'phagasayul: byung ba brjod pa/phru gu'i rtsed chas 'dra min sna tshogs bzo gi yod pa'i nang / 'khor lo can gyi 'then 'khor ram shing rta dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi gzugs brnyan dper na khri dang / ba phyugs dang / glang chen sogs kyi gzugs brnyan yod pa red/ rtsod chas ba phyugs kyi gzugs la mgo bo 'grul skyod byed pa dang / dbyug pa'i ñtsa la sgre'u yar 'dzeg mar 'babs byed mkhan de tsho ni rtsed chas bzo ba'i lag rtsal rmad du byung ba'i dpe lta bu red/tshong dang tshong las/ siṅgā'i mi rigs tsho'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa de ni nang khul dang / phyi rgyal khag la tshong las rgyugs po yod pa de'i grub 'bras yin par gdon mi za ste/ rgya gar nang khul gyi cha shas tsam du ma zad phyo rgyal yul khag tu'ang sa thog dang mtsho thog gnyis brgyud nas tshong las chen po yod pa'i khungs skyel gsal po yod 'duggrong khyer haraspru'i mi tsho la deng dus kyi mnga' sde rā4lhan nas zangs dang /grong khyer ajamer nas zha nye thob kyi yod pa dang / khong tshos ḍamin khul nas nor bu sngon po'i rigs dang / lho phyogs nas gser dang mu tig sogs len gyi yod pa red/siṅgā'i mi rigs kyi tshong pa rnams kyis mesoposamiX dang mnyam du tshong 'brel byas pa'i khungs skyel gsal por yod par ma zad/ rgya gar gyi tshong pa rnams tshong las ched du sumerigan gyi grong khyer khag tu gnas sdod byas te de tshos gtso bor shing bal gyi ras cha'i rigs kyi tshong las byas pa red/ chu bo sirnyu'i 'gram la gru kha yang yod nges/mi de tshos ljid tshad 'jal byed kyi nya ga dang / che chung tshad 'jal byed kyi dbyug gu bcas bed spyod byed srol yod pa de tsho ni nang khul la tshong las byed rgyur phan thogs chen po yod tshod la/ tshong pa tshos phan tshun dngos zog gtong len skabs dam phrug
'dra min mang po bed spyod byed kyi yod nges/spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba'i mi che/tsistu'i mi rigs tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi mi che'i skor zhib gsal shes ma thub kyang /dam phrug khag dang dngos po gzhan khag brnyed son byung ba rnams brtag dpyad byas pa na de tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi lugs srol dang spyod lam 'ga' shas dpog thub kyi red/ de tsho'i spyi tshogs de mi rigs gcig rang nas yin tshod la/ de tsho'i nang zhing pa dang /nya pa dang / shing bzo ba dang / khang bzo ba dang / gser bzo ba dang / tshong pa khag dang / snod bzo ba dang / thag mkhan dang / ba so'i las ka byed mkhan dang / rdo bzo ba dang / dmag mi dang / chos byed pa bcas mnyam du gnas sdod byed kyi yod 'dug par ma zad/ de tsho phan tshun mnyam 'brel dang dga' po'i ngang nas sdod kyi yod pa red/ bram ze sogs rigs mtho dman gyi dbye ba yod pa'i khungs gang yang brnyed yod pa ma red/ de lta na'ang gral rim gyi dbye ba zhig yod par thag gcod byed chogza chas/ sirnyu'i mi tshos gro dang / 'bru dang / dkar zas rigs dang /nya sha dang / ra sha dang / glang sha dang / phag sha dang / bya sha bcas za gi yod pa dang / de tshos rdza snod nang du kha lag bzo gi yod cing / kha lag bzo byed kyi lag cha sna tshogs dang / rtsam thag la bed spyod byed kyi yod pa nges/ phyug po tshog sder ma dang / thur ma bcas kha lag za dus bed spyod byed kyi yod pa red/gyon chas/ de tsho'i gyon chas skor shes rtogs byung ba ni/ shing bal gyis bzos pa'i ras cha dang / bal gos gyon pa dang / gyon chas la me tog sogs kyi ri
70 'phagasayula' byung babarjodapa/mo yang rgyag gi yod srid/ dngos rdzas rnying khongs su khab mang po brnyed pa la bltas na de skabs mi tshos stod thung lta bu chems pa'i gos gyon gyi yod par dpog thub/ bud med tshog stod g.yog dang smad sham gyon gyi yod pa dang / skyes pa tshos smad dkris dang / stod la gzan lta bu zhig gyon gyi yod pa dang / mgo la mgo ras kyang gyon gyi yod srid/ pho mo gnyis ka rgyan cha la dga' po yod cing / gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / sa sreg gis bzos pa'i rgyan cha bcas rgyan cha'i rigs sna tshogs gyon gyi yod par nges/ skyes pa tshog yog tshom thung thung dang / rgya 'jog gi yod pa dang / skra dang kha spru 'breg pa'i lugs srol yang yod 'dug bud med tshos rgyug shad dang / skra pin dang / skra 'ching byed kyi thag gru dang / gdong pa la byug rgyu'i phye ma (204737) sogs bed spyod kyis mdzes par byed pa dang / skra bzo stangs 'dra min sna tshogs shes kyi yod 'dug sirnyu'i mi rigs rnams rang gi gzugs po la mdzes po bzo rgyur dga' po yod pa de ga nang bzhin so so'i gzugs po la gtsang sbra yag po byed rgyur do snang chen po yod 'dug khron pa dang / khrus khang dang /yur ba dang / khrug kyi rdzing bu chen po rnams la bltas na de tshos rang lus la gtsang sbra dang / nye skor sa khul rnams gtsang ma 'jog rgyur do snang chen po yod pa de legs par shes thub/rtsed 'jo dang spro seng / sirnyu'i mi rigs tsho khoms pa'i skabs su rngon byed pa dang / rtsed mo rtse ba dang / gzhas dang zhabs bro bcas kyis dus tshod skyel bar byed pa dang / sho rgyag pa de la dga' shos byed kyi yod pa red/ gzhas dang zhabs bro la tshang mas dga' po byed kyai yod pa dang / li las grub pa'i gar 'khrab bzhin pa'i bud med kyi gzugs brnyan brnyed pa la bltas na mi tsho sgyu rtsal la dga' po yod pa
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 71de dpog thub/ rol mo'i yo byad la bed spyod byed kyi yod pa dang / rtsed chas shin tu mang po brnyed pa las siṅgā'i mi tsho'i phru gu rnams rtsod chas la dga' po byed kyi yod par nges/gshin chog gam dur las/ de skabs phung po me la bsregs pa ni 'char can 9 lugs srol yin pa dang / sa la sbas pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma lta bu red/mi'i rus pa dang / gdung thal dang / bum pa dang / 'bru rigs dang / dngos po gzhan rdza snod du bcug ste sa la sbas par byed/ 'di dag gis skabs de'i mi de tshos skye ba phyi ma'am shi ba'i rjes su'ang gang zag gi dngos po yod par yid ches byed kyi yod pa dang / gshin po de la mchod pa byed pa'i lugs srol yod pa de bstan pa yin/chos dang 'brel ba'i mi che/siṅgā'i lung pa nas thon brnyed byung ba'i sa sreg gi gzugs brnyan khag dang /rdo sku dang / brkos brgyabs pa'i zangs kyi byang bu khag dang / dam phrug khag la brtag dpyad zhib nan byas pa'i grub 'bras su sa khul de'i de dus kyi mi tsho'i chos kyi skor tshod dpag byed thub/ 'on kyang da bar sa khul de nas khong tsho'i lha khang ngam mchod gsham sogs ni ma brnyed/ sirnyu'i mi rigs tshos lha mi'i gzugs su grub par 'dod pa'i chos lugs lta bu zhig yin srid/ lha mo la mchod pa'i lugs srol zhig rgya cher dar khyab yod par mngon te/ sirnyu'i lung pa'i sa 'og nas thon pa'i bsregs sa'am/ so btabs pa'i sa yis bzos pa'i bud med kyi gzugs brnyan mang po de rnams lha mo'i sku brnyan nam lha mo'i mtshon byed yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ de skabs kyi lha mo la mchod pa'i srol de dus phyis su yum la mchod pa'am ma
72 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/rgyud la mchod pa'i lugs srol dang 'dra po yod ces mkhas pa dag gis gsungs/dbang phyug la mchod pa/ lha mo dang mnyam du pho lha la mchod pa byed srol yang yod pa de ni lo rgyus nang gsal ba'i lha dbang phyug de yi thog ma'i rtsa ba'am yang na sa bon yin zhes ngos 'dzin byed/ 'di ni rgya gar nang dbang phyug la yid ches shin tu che bas de ltar 'dod pa yin las che/ rigs pas dpyad na pho lha de dbang phyug gi gdod ma'i rtsa ba yin dgos par bsgrub thub pa dka' zhing / lha gzhan gyi gdod ma'i rtsa ba yon mi chog pa med/sa 'og nas brnyed pa'i dam phrug gcig gi steng rnal 'byor pa lta bu zhal gsum pa bzhuḍa pa'i tshul can dud 'gro mang pos bskor ba zhig yod pa de la rwa co gnyis dang /mgo la ras dkris pa zhig yod/ khyad mtshar ba zhig la gzugs brnyan de dus phyis kyi lha dbang phyug phyugs bdag gi ngo bor gyur pa 'di dang mtshungs shing / rwa co gnyis dang mgo ras gsum gyis dbang phyug gi rtse gsum mam tishul mtshon gyi yod srid/sirnyu'i lung pa'i sa 'og nas rdo dbang phyug gi mtshan ma lta bu zhig brnyed pa las gong gi bsam tshul de la rgyab skyor yong gi yod ces rgya gar byung rabs pa rnams kyis gsungs/sirnyu'i mi rigs tshos glang rgod lta bu'i dud 'gro dang / sprupal byang chub rtson shing dang /〉ma zhes pa'i shing sdong lta bu la yang mchod pa byed kyi yod tshod/ der ma zad de tshog lha 'dre yod pa'i yid ches byed pa dang / klu dang gnod sbyin sogs la'ang bsnyen bkur byed/ srung 'khor dang gzhu yang bed spyod byed kyi yod tshod/ lha dang lha mo'i sku brnyan gdan drangs te rol dbyangs dang gar dang bcas gral bsgrigs nas chos kyi mdzad ston byed kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dug cing / shi ba'i rjes su yang 'jig rten pha rol yod pa'i yid ches yod par mngon/ mdor na sirnyu'i lung po'i mi tsho'i chos lugs
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyi byung rabs/ 73nang dus phyis kyi hinadu'am mu stegs pa'i chos lugs kyi cha shas mang po yod 'duglag rtsal dang khang bzo'i rig gnas/khang bzo'i rig pa/ 'char gzhi dang ldan pa'i grong khyer khag dang / ka ring can gyi tshoms chen khag dang / khrus kyi rdzing bu chen mo sogs kyis khang bzo'i rig pa de gar rgyas chen po yod par bstan pa yin/ de lta na yang sasnu'i lung pa'i mkhar rnams la ri mo mdzes po sogs med par stabs bde 'jam sang dang / mkhregs po dang / bed spyod byed bde po dang / mkho che ba yod pa red/ rgya lam khag dang /yur ba dang / khron pa sogs las siṅgā'i mi tsho'i 'phrul las khang bzo'i rig rtsal che ba de shes thub/sku brnyan bzo ba'i lag rtsal/ sirnyu'i mi rigs sam harabla'i mi rigs tsho'i sku brnyan bzo ba'i lag rtsal la yar rgyas chen po byung yod cing / mi'i mgo dang phrag pa'i gzugs brnyan rdo la brkos pa mtho tshad en ci bdun tsam zhig yod pa de la og tshom yod pa dang / skra la thor cog bcings pa mig phyed btsum pa gzan lta bu gyon pa zhig yod 'dug der ma zad pho'i gzugs brnyan lag sdum mtho tshad in ci bzhi tsam byas pa zhig yod 'dug pa de ni lag rtsal gyi cha nas shin tu spus ka legs shing /sngon dus shrīka yul 9 sku brnyan bzo ba'i lag rtsal rtser son skabs khong tsho'i lag shes nas dpe blangs pa yang yin srid ces mkhas pa tshos gsungs/sirnyu'i sku brnyan bzo ba'i lag rtsal mdzes shos kyi dpe mtshon ni li las grub pa'i bu mo gar 'khrab bzhin pa'i snang brnyan de yin zhing / de ni bud med gzhon nu ma lus phra la rkang pa phra zhing ring ba/ mig che ba/ mchu sgros dod pa/ skra su lu thod
74 'phags yul byung babarjod pa/du bcings pa zhig gi snang brnyan yin zhing / des gar gyi rnam 'gyur khyad par ba zhig ston par byed/ dam phrug tsho'i steng du dud 'gro'i gzugs brnyan brkos yod pa de tsho las kyang lag rtsal shin tu che ba de mtshon nus shing / sin+tu'i mi tsho'i snang brnyan bzo ba'i lag rtsal gyi khyad chos che shos ni gzugs brnyan tshang ma dngos gnas pa dang 'dra po yod pa de yin/ri mo/ siṅgā'i lung pa'i nang ri mo 'bri ba'i lag rtsal yang yag po yod de/smod chas tsho'i steng du bris pa'i ri mo mang po brnyed yod pa red/ de tshos ri mo sgor sgor dang / zur gsum dang / shing sdong dang / bya sogs dud 'gro'i ri mo mang po tshon sna sna tshogs kyis 'bri gi yod 'dug rgyan cha mang po brnyed pa las kyang khong tsho'i ri mo'i lag rtsal mtho ba shes nus/ yul mi rnams rol dbyangs dang / gar 'khrab pa la mkhas po yod par gsal zhing / pi wang dang / ting shag sogs rol mo'i bye brag 'dra min yang bed spyod byed kyi yod par mngon/ li'i snang brnyan dang /gzugs brnyan gzhan la bltas na gar 'khrab pa la mkhas po yod par gsal zhing /gar dang rol dbyangs de tsho chos dang 'brel ba yod pa'i bzo 'dugtshan rigsirnyu'i lung par phra ba'i sgru rtsal lag shes dong gsal ltar byung ba tsam du ma zad/ tshan rig dang 'brel ba'i las don la yang yar rgyas byung yod pa dper na/ljid tshad ji bzhin 'degs pa dang / ji bzhin tshad 'jal ba'i rig pa byung yod par shes shing / de la brten nas ang rtsis phra zhing phra ba yod pa de gsal por go thub/khang pa rgyag stangs dang / dam phrug rtags thel khag tu 'khod pa'i mtshon byed 'ga'
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 75shas la bltas na/ sirnyu'i lung pa'i mi tsho la skar cas m+pi shes yon yod par gsal bar ma zad gso ba rig pa'i skor la yang yar rgyas 'ga' zhig byung yod nges/skad dang yi gesirnyu'i lung pa'i sa 'og nas bsregs sas bzos pa'i dam phrug rtags thel brgya phrag mang por yi ge lta bu mang po bris 'dug pa de tsho gcig byas na ri mo'i yi ge lta bu zhig yin srid/ da bar ri mo 'dra min gyi brda mtshon nyis brgya bdun rtsu skor brnyed yod kyang / brkos yig ring po'am yang na skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi brkos bris gang yang de tsho'i nang yod pa ma red/ der brten sirnyu'i lung pa'i yi ge'i skor deng dus gsal shes ma byung bar lus yod pa red/ mi de tshos skad ga 'dra zhig rgyag gi yod med dang / yi ge ga 'dra zhig yod med ni dka' snyog che ba'i gnas lugs shig red/byung rabs la mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis sirnyu'i lung pa'i skad yig de sngon dus rgya gar lho phyogs su dar ba'i drabigayan gyi skad yig de yin par bzhed/ 'ga' shas kyis ni sumerigan gyi skad yig yin zhes gsungs/ gang ltar dzi'u'i lung pa'i ri mo'i yi ge de dang sngon dus kyi sumerigan gyi yi ge dang / khraXlca yul gyi yi ge gnyis 'dra po yod 'dug yang 'ga' shag kyis sirnyu'i lung pa'i yi ge rgya gar rang nas byung ba yin zhing /rgya gar nas phar sumerigan la dar ba yin zhes bzhed/ rgyu mtshan yang dag pa zhig ma brnyed pas siṅgā'i lung pa'i skad de ga 'dra yod med dang / yi ge'i 'byung khungs ga nas yin min da dung gsal rtogs byung med/ 'di ni ma 'ongs par nyams zhib la rag lus pa yin/ gang ltar yang siṅgā'i mi tshos yi ge 'bri stangs shes kyi yod par nges shing / de yang ri mo'i yi ge dang / tshog dbar can gyi yi ge gnyis ka dang cha
76 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/'dra ba zhig yin las che/skabs 'dir shes dgos gal che ba zhig ni/ 'jig rten 'dir yi ge'i rnam grangs mang po yod pa rnams gtso bor gnyes su 'dus te/ ri mo'i yi ge dang /tshog dbar can gyi yi ge gnyis yod/ dang po ri mo'i yi ge ni/ dngos po gang yin pa de'i gzugs brnyan nam ri mo lta bu zhig gi 'bri srol yod pa'i yi ge la zer zhing /dper na rgya nag gi yi ge dang / sumerigan yi ge dang / 'jisna sogs kyi sngon gyi yi ge lta bu red/ 'bri tshul 'di rnams la rim pas legs bcos dang 'gyur ba btang yod/ gnyis pa tshig dbar can gyi yi ge ni/ dngos po'i gzugs brnyan lta bu min par dbyangs dang gsal byed sogs yig 'bru yod pa dang / 3ga dbar re re'i bar tshog yod med gang ltar yang dngos po gang dang gang gi ngo bo sogs ston byed ming tshig yod cing / ming tshog tshang ma la yig 'bru yod la dag cha bcas yod pa zhig la to dgos/ dper na rgya gar gyi yi ge'i rigs thams cad dang / dbyin yig sogs dang / bod yig sogs yig rigs phal mo che rnams lta bu yin/da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ siṅgā'i yul gyi mi tshos mi che shin tu skyid po dang / mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang nas bskyal yod par nges shing / khong tsho'i mi tsho la gegs rkyen nam dgra yang mang po byung 'dug mohanajodaro dang haraspa'i ya rabs spyod tshul de lta bu rim bzhin nyams rgyud du phyin nas mthar brlags pa red/sirnyu lung pa'i ya rabs spyod tshul de nub pa'i rgyu mtshan/siṅgā'i mohanajodaro dang / haraspru'i ya rabs spyod tshul ngam shes rig de nyams pa'am nub pa'i rgyu rkyen ga re yin min gsal shes ma byung yang phal cher gsham
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyibyung rabs/ 77gsal rgyu rkyen gsum gyi nang nas gcig yin srid/ yar rgyas ma phyin par 'gags pa dang / chu log sogs 'byung ba'i gnod skyon dang / phyo rgyal gyis btsan 'dzul sogs byas pa gsum ga'am gang rung gcig la brten nas sirnyu'i shes rig de nub pa yin par nges/dang po yar rgyas med par 'gags pa/ ya rabs kyi spyod tshul ga 'dra zhig yin rung mu mthud yar rgyas su ma can par 'gags pa yin na de nub rgyu las 'os ma mches shing / sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de bzhin yishu'i sngon gyi lo nyis stong nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam thig tu yar rgyas kyi rtse mor bslebs nas de gar 'gags cing / de nas mar 'grib 'go tshugs pa yin tshod/ gang lags zer na siṅgā'i lung pa nas thon brnyed byung ba'i grong khyer khag gi zhig shul la brtag dpyad byas par/ phyis su grong khyer gyi 'char gzhi dang / khang bzo byed stangs dang / gtsang sbra sogs la nyams chags phyin yod par mngon/ rdza ma sreg sa'i thab rnams thog mar grong khyer gyi phyo rol du yod kyang / phyis su grong khyer gyi dkyil du bzos yod 'dug pa las de tsho'i gar rgyas sogs la nyams rgyud phyin yod par gsal/gnyis pa chu log sogs kyi 'jig pa/ mohanajodaro grong khyer stongs pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso che ba zhig ni/ 'byung ba'i gnod skyon yin par mngon zhing / chu log gis rkyen gyis sdod khang rnams chu'i nang du nub pa yin srid de/ mohanajodaro'i zhig shul de la bang rim bdun yod par gsal zhing / de la dpags na/ grong khyer la chu log byung skabs yul mi tsho sa cha btsan sar byol ba dang / chu log 'jags rjes slar log nas grong khyer de tsho bskyar du brgyabs pa lta bur mngon/ de ltar grong khyer mohanjodaro de thengs bdun bskyar brtsegs byas yod tshod/
78 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/spyir btang chu bo sirnyu de la 'gyur ba rim bzhin phyin yod pa dang / gtsang po de la dus kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba rim par byung ba las de la brten pa'i grong khyer khag dang / ya rabs kyi spyod bzang la yang 'gyur ba'am do phog byung yod cing / 'gyur ba de yang rnam pa gnyis byung yod srid de/ dang po ni gtsang po'i chu log gis grong khyer bcom nas med par bzos pa dang / gnyis pa gtsang po de grong khyer las thag ring por babs pa na gar rgyas 'gro ma thub pa yin srid/phye rgyal gyis btsan 'dzul/ yar rgyas 'gags pa dang / chu log sogs 'byung ba'i gnod skyon tsam du ma zad phyi log nas btsan 'dzul byung ba des kyang siṅgā'i ya rabs spyod tshul de nyams rgyud du phyin pa yang yin srid/ gang lags zer na khang bzang gi yang thog tu keng rus tsho khag gcig 'thor 'dug pa de la bltas na/ phyi logs nas glo bur du thog rgyag byas pa'am/ btsan 'dzul byung ba las lung pa de ga'i mi'i ya rabs spyod tshul de nyams pa yin par dpog par byed/ spyir btang nas rgya gar 'di bzhin phyi logs nas btsan 'dzul byed mkhan tshos btsan bzung byed sa lta bu zhig yin 'dugyang mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyi dgongs 'char ltar na/ ār+ya'i mi tshos ār+sha'i mi rigs min pa mkhar btsan po'am/ rdzong du gnas mkhan tsho'i steng du drag gnon dpung rgol byas pa yin te/ ār+sha'i mi rigs tshos rang gi dgra bo'i bshad pa byed skabs grong khyer gyi mi rigs rdzong btsan po yod pa'i grong khyer khag tu sdod cing skad rigs gzhan smra bar byed pa zhes bris 'dug pas yishu'i sngon gyi lo 1500 tsam la ār+sha'i mi rigs tshos btsan rgol byas pa dang / chu bo sasnu'i ya rabs spyod tshul nyams rgyud du phyin pa gnyis phal cher dus mnyam yin par mngon zhes bzhed/
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 79gang ltar yang chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de yishu'i sngon gyi lo 1800 rjes nas gegs rkyen byung ste rim bzhin nyams rgyud du phyin pa red/ 'on kyang de'i go don ni sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de rtsa ba nas brlags te med par gyur pa ma yin te/ grong khyer khag stongs pas grong khyer gyi shes rig rtsa brlag phyin pa ma gtogs grong gseb mang por de ga'i shes rig lus yod cing / de tsho'i rnam pa 'ga' zhig rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs dang mi mang nang chos dang dpal 'byor dang lag rtsal gyi mi che'i brten gzhir gyur yod pa red/sirnyu'i ga rabs spyod tshul dang / nub phyogs kyi bar 'brel ba/sirnyu'i shes rig dang / mesoposamilta dang elam (2/77) gyi shes rig spyir btang 'dra po yod pa yin te/ lo rgyus byung rabs ma dar ba'i sngon gyi ya rabs spyod tshul khag gsum po de'i thun mong gi rnam pa ni/ yar rgyas can gyi grong khyer gyi mi che dang / rdza snod bzo byed kyi 'khor lo bed spyod byas pa dang / zangs a+yau bum pa dang li'i bum pa khag dang / sa phag mer bsreg btang ba dang ri mo'i yi ge bcas yin/mesopostemiX la mohanajodaro'i dam phrug nang bzhin zhig brnyed yod pa de dang /mohanajodaro la gdeng ga'i dbyibs can gyi brkos bris brnyed yod pa 'di gnyis las yul 'di gnyis bar phan tshun 'brel ba zhig yo da par gsal por bstan pa yin/sirnyu'i mi rigs tsho dang / sumerigan mi rigs bar 'brel ba byung yod pa dang /ardzad zer ba'i sumerigan gyi sa gnas su rgya gar gyi tshong pa tsho'i sdod sgar yod pa'i khungs 'ga' shas yod pa red/dzistu'i mi tsho dang / nub phyogs kyi yul khag dbar tshong 'brel byung yod cing /
80 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/gru kha shin tu legs po bzos pa khag gis tshong 'brel de la nus shugs thon pa byung yod kyi red/ thog mar tshong 'brel dang / de nas shes rig gi 'brel ba byung yod srid/der brten siṅgā'i ya rabs spyod tshul dang / sumerilnga sogs nub phyogs pa'i yul gyi ya rabs spyod tshul bar mtshungs chos mang po nga tshos mthong rgyu yod pa red/ 'on kyang sumerigan gyi ya rabs spyod tshul de sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi yal ga lta bu yin nam/ yang na sumerega'i ya rabs spyod tshul la brten nas sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul byung ba yin nam zhes pa'i dri ba de la lan ji lta ba bzhin da bar 'debs thub med/siṅgā'i shes rig de nub phyogs pa'i shes rig las leḍa pa yin par gsal por mngon/sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de ni mi mang dkyus ma tsho'i ya rabs spyod tshul zhig yin pa dang / de yang grong khyer gyi shes rig yin zhing / de'i nang tshong pa phyug po mang po yod pa dang / de tshos las don yag po byas yod pa red/ ras cha'i gos dang / khrus 'a rdzing bu'am khron pa legs po khag bzos yod pa dang / gtsang sbra 'phrod bsnyen legs pa sogs ni sin+d+ra'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi rnam pa khyad du 'phags pa khag yin par the tshom med/siṅgā'i shes rig dang / rig byed kyi shes rig gnyis kyi 'dra sdur/sirnyu'i shes rig dang / rig byed dang 'brel ba'i ār+sha'i shes rig skor mkhas pa tshos nyams zhib byas 'bras su/ de gnyis bar mi 'dra ba'i khyad par che shos ni/rig byed dang 'brel ba'i ār+sha rnams ni grong gseb pa yin zhing / sirnyu'i mi rnams ni grong khyer ba yin pa de red/ sirnyu'i mi rnams ni grong khyer khag tu 'dus shing yar rgyas ldan pa'i grong khyer gyi mi che'i 'dod yon la longs su spyod mkhan yin pa dang /
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 81ār+sha'i mi tsho'i spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor gyi lte ba ni grong gseb yin pa red/ sirnyu'i mi tsho thog mar grong khyer ba yin pa tong bshad ltar la phyis su grong gseb la rgya skyed byung ba yin la/ ār+ya'i mi tsho thog mar 'brog pa yin la de nas rim bzhin grong gseb tu gyur pa dang / tha mar grong khyer yang bzos pa yin pas/ sistu dang ār+sha'i mi rigs gnyis kyai byung stangs rtsa ba nas mi 'dra/ sasnu'i mi tshos lcags la bed spyod ma shes la/ byas tsang de tshor khrab sogs yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang ārlan tshos lcags la bed spyod shes shing de tshor khrab rmog sogs yod 'dug rig byed kyi ār+sha'i me rnams ni dmag 'thab byed mkhan yin zhing / khong tsho'i mi che la rta gal chen po yod pa red/ 'on kyang sirnyu'i mi rnams rtsa ba zhi bde la dga' zhing dgra 'thab byed mkhan min la khong tshos rta la bed spyod mi byed cing byed mi shes pa red/siṅgā'i mi rnams kyi chos dang / ār+ya'i chos lugs kyang mi 'dra ste/ sirnyu'i mi tshos lha mo dang / dbang phyug dang / shing dang / dud 'gro 'ga' shas la mchod pa byed kyai yod par ma zad sku brnyan dang / mtshan ma la yang mchod pa byed/'on kyang rig byed ār+sha'i mi tshos rang bzhin gyis snang zhing srid pa dper na chu dang /rlung dang / nyi ma dang / drag po dang / brgya byin dang / thun mtshams sogs la'ang mchod pa byed kyi yod pa dang / lha dga' bar bya ba'i phyir mchod sbyin te sbyin sreg byed pa dang / 'o ma dang / 'bru dang / mar khu dang / sha khrag dang /som zer ba'i myos chu bcas 'bul bar byed/sirnyu'i mi tshos lha sku khyer te gral bsgrigs nas 'gro zhing sku la mchod pa byed/rig byed kyi ār+sha'i mi tshos sngags bgrangs nas cho ga byed/ de tshos ba phyugs la mchod pa byed pa yin/ sirnyu'i mi tshos glang la bkur bar byed/ siṅgā'i mi tshos rdza smod bzo
82 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pabyed 'khor lo la bed spyod byed cing / rdza snod la rtsi btang yod pa dang / 'ga' shag la 'od mdangs chen po yang yod 'dug 'on kyang rig byed kyi mi tsho'i smod ni 'jam sang red/ji sirnyu'i mi tshos yi ge 'bri stangs shes a+yau yod pa dang / rig byed kyi ār+shan tshos yi ge gang yang bris med/ mi rigs 'di gnyis kyi zas gos la yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod 'dugmi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos de dag la brten nas sirnyu'i lung pa'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi tshul de/ rig byed kyi ār+sha'i mi rigs kyi shes rig gam de tsho'i ya rabs spyod tshul las gzhan yin pa dang / de rig byed kyi ār+ya'i shes rig gi sngon du byung ba yin par gsal ba yin/ de ni ār+shan gyi sngon du byung ba ma zad/ rig byed kyi ār+shan dang 'brel ba min zhing / rgya gar ār+sha'i shes rig las legs pa yin par yang ngos 'dzin byed chogsiṅgā'i shes rig de 'gro ba mi yi mi che'i rnam gzhag shin tu mang po zhig gi dpe ston khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin pa dang / deng dus kyi rgya gar gyi shes rig gi gzhi rtsa lta bu zhig yin par sems/ de lta bu'i ya rabs spyod tshul chen po de stongs pa'i rjes su rig byed ār+sha'i dus rabs byung ba yin par shes/rig byed kyi dus rabs sam ār+sha'i dus rabs/gong du bshad pa'i chu bo sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul chen po de nyams pa'am stongs pa'i rjes su rgya gar du rig byed kyi dus rabs byung zhing de yang yishu'i sngon gyi lo 1500 tsam gyi rjes su rig byed kyi dus rabs 'do tshugs pa yin/ rig byed kyi dus
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9byung rabs/ 83skabs kyi mi rnams la iṇ+ḍa.ār+shan te/ rgya gar gyi ār+yā zhes pa de rnams yin zhing / de rnams ni yeshilā ste shar gling 'di'i dbus phyogs nas rgya gar tu bslebs pa yin par 'dod/ siṅgā'i lung par mohanajodaro'i zhig shul ma brnyed cing / sistu'i ya rabs spyod tshul rtsad ma chod gong byung rabs smra ba tshos ār+ya'i dus skabs nas rgya gar 9 byung rabs 'go tshugs par bzhed pa yin/ 'on kyang mohanajodaro'i skor rtsad chod pa nas bzung grub mtha' de 'gyur nas sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de rgya gar gyi shes rig dang byung rabs kyi 'go yin par grub pa red/ gal srid ma 'ongs par sirnyu las kyang sngaba'i ya rabs spyod tshul gi bsti gnas gzhan dag brnyed pa byung na/ rgya gar gyi byung rabs kyi 'go 'dzugs sa de 'gyur rgyu red/ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho'i thog ma'i byung rabs ni gar song med pa'am gsal po med/ de lta na yang nga tshos khungs byed sa btsan shos ni ār+ya'i mi tsho'i gzhung rig byed rnams yin/ de skabs kyi byung rabs lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul ni rig byed kyi gzhung rnams la gzhir byas pa yin pas dus rabs de la rig byed gyi dus rabs zhes brjod pa yin/rig byed la rnam pa bzhi yod de snga shos nges brjod kyi rig byed dang / snyan ngag dang mchod sbyin dang / srid srung gi rig byed bcas bzhi yod par sngar bshad zin pa ltar la/ rig byed kyi gzhung 'di dag gi grogs ram dang / de dag la dpyad pa byas te rig byed kyi dus skabs kyi byung rabs lo rgyus rnams shes thub pa yin/ rig byed kyi dus rabs ni nges brjod kyi rig byed byung ba nas bzung ste/ ye shu'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag drug pa tsam bar gyi dus rabs de yin zhing / de la yang rig byed kyi dus rabs snga ma dang / phyi ma gnyis su phyes nas bshad pa'ang yod/
84 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/rig byed kyi dus rabs kyi mi che/gong du bshad pa ltar sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul de grong khyer gyi shes rig gi tshul du nyams zin na yang / grong gseb khag tu shes rig de'i rgyun gson por gnas pa red/ yishu'i sngon gyi lo stong phrag gnyis pa'i nang gling phran 'di'i nang shes rig gam ya rabs spyod tshul 'dra min mang po byung 'dug de'i go don ni de skabs rgya gar yul gyi cha shas sna tshogs su mi rigs 'dra min mang po gnas chags yod pa red/ār+sha'i grong gseb khag de 'dra'i gcig la 'phags yul nub byang sa khul du rgya gar ār+shan gyi skad rgyag mkhan rnams byung yod pa red/ 'on kyang mi rigs de tsho ga nas yong min thag gcod byed pa dka'/ gcig byas na lngarān gyi shar rgyud dang /yang na masapigan (0839180 367) mtsho 'gram gyi sa khul dang / yang na shar gling yeshilā'i dbus phyogs nas yong ba yin srid/ de tsho nub yeshilā dang / nub gling yurob khul tu rim bzhin gnas chags pa dang / ār+ya'i skad rigs 'dra min rgyag mkhan gyi ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho'i nang nas logs su ngo shes pa'i ched du rgya gar du bslebs pa'i ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho la iṇ+ḍa.ārlan ste/ rgya gar gyi ār+shan zhes ming btags pa red/ de tsho'i 'byung khungs sa gnas ga re yin min da bar gsal shes ma byung bar ma zad/ de tsho ni rgya gar byang nub sa khul tu sngar nas gnas sdod byed mkhan tsho las rigs gzhan yin min yang rtsod pa yod/thog mar mkhas pa tshos bsam par/ ār+shan gyi skad rgyag mkhan mi rigs de tsho grangs 'bor chen po zhig rgya gar du 'byor te rgol 'dzing byas par 'dod kyang / de'i khungs btsan po med/ der brten deng dus byung rabs pa rnams kyis gsungs gsal/ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho dus rabs mang po'i ring tsho khag chung chung byas te rim bzhin rgya
gar du 'byor te tsho khag sngon ma khag dang mnyam du bsdad par skad dang / sdod stangs sogs mthun po byung yod pa red/ dus skabs 'di la 'phags yul gyi lo rgyus su rig byed kyi dus rabs zhes brjod de gong du bshad pa ltar skabs 'tha'i byung rabs rnams rig byed kyi bzhung 'ba' zhig la brten nas shes pa yin/ 'on kyang nye char lo bzhi bcu tsam ring rig byed kyi dus rabs la phan pa'i dngos rdzas rnying rigs kyi khungs 'ga' shas brnyed thon byung yod tshod/ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho thog mar panāb sa khul khag la gnas chags shing / de nas dal bus lho dang shar phyogs mdun skyod byas te/ deng dus kyi dolnga'i byang khul du gnas sdod byas yod pa red/ de skabs sa gnas der chu bo dbyangs can ma zhes bya ba zhig yod 'dug pa de deng sang gtsang po'i chu bskams nas med par gyur/ ār+sha'i mi rnams sa khul der lo mang po bsdad pa dang / der de tsho'i legs bshad phyogs bsdus nges brjod kyi rig byed bzos pa'am brtsams/ sa gnas de gar kurutratra ste sgra ngan gling zhes pa'i thang chen de yod cing / der rjes su skya seng bu lnga dang / sgra ngan dpung tshogs bar mahā:rata zhes pa'i dmag chen byung bar grags/de nas ārla'i mi rigs tsho shar phyogs su chu mo galha'i lung gshong khag tu rim bzhin bskyod nas gnas bzung / de yang nags tshal mthug po khag gtsang ma bzos te/ 'ga' shas kyis nags tshal mer bsregs te gtsang ma bzos shing / 'ga' shas kyis lcags kyi 'jor sogs gyis bcad de gtsang ma bzos pa red/ de skabs khong tshos lcags kyi lag cha dang mtshon cha bzo shes pa red/ār+sha'i mi rigs de tsho thog mar 'brog pa yin zhing sgo phyugs 'tsho skyong byed/de tshos sgo phyugs kyi khyu chen po khag 'tsho skyong byed pa dang / de snyad de tsho'i 'tsho ba'i
86 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/rten gzhi red/ de tsho sa gnas gcig nas gcig tu 'khyams nyul spo sdod byed kyi yod pa red/ yun ring rjes de tshos so nam gyi las ka byed 'go tshugs pa dang / grong gseb la gtan sdod byed 'go btsugs pa red/ thog mar 'brog pa yin pa dang /de nas grong gseb pa yin pas grong khyer gyi mi che'i skor rgyus yod pa ma red/ grong khyer dar ba la dus rabs mang po 'gor rkyen/ ārlan nam yang na ār+ya'i mi tsho'i thog ma'i gnas yul grong gseb 'ba' zhig yin/ sngar bshad zin pa ltar sirgyu'i shes rig dang mi 'dra bar ār+sha'i mi rigs skor khong tsho'i gzhung rig byed rnamar/ las shes dgos shing / khong tsho'i rig byed kyi gzhung de tsho blo la bzung nas mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud mi nyams rgyun skyong byas te/ mthar yig thog tu bkod pa yin/ de rnams ni gzhung ngam yig cha'i khungs yon/ de lta na'ang lo shas sngon rgya gar byang phyogs mnga' sde'i nub hastinubur dang / gtarajiṭa9 lta bu'i sa gnas 'ga' shas la bsngogs brkos byas par ār+sha'i skor gnad don 'ga' shas shes thub pa byung yod/ār+ya'i mi rigs tshos rang gi yi dam lha la bstod pa 'bul phyir suka ste legs par brjod pa khag brtsams shing rang gi chos nyams len dang / cho ga rnams dang /mchod pa sogs kyi skor sgrig khrims lta bu bzos yod pa de tsho nges brjod kyi rig byed sogs rig byed bzhi'i nang gsal yod/ de tshos rang gi rgyal po rnams dang / dpa' bo tsho'i mi che'i rnam thar dang / g.yul gyi lo rgyus sogs kyi skor snyan ngag ring po khag bris yod pa de tsho dus phyis phyogs bsgrigs byas par sngon dus kyi snyan ngag chen po gnyis byung ba ni/ rgyal po dga' byed kyi rtogs brjod dang / mahāXrata zhes pa gnyis red/rig byed kyi dus rabs 'di la rig byed kyi dus rabs snga ma dang / phyi ma gnyis su phyes nas dus rabs so so'i skabs kyi spyi tshogs dang / srid don sogs kyi gnas
stangs mi 'dra khag bshad du yod kyang 'dir spyir btang tsam zhig bshad par bya'o//rgyal po dang de'i zhabs 'bring pa khag skabs der spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs ni/ spyi tshogs de ni tsho khag gam mi rigs dum bu chung chung khas tu bgos yod cing /tsho khag de tsho sa khul khyad par ba re la gnas yod/ mi sde'i tsho khag de tshos nang phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing byed kyi yod de/ sgo phyugs 'tsho ba'i sa gnas mang po dgos shing / sgo phyugs 'tsho sa'i sa gnas la dbang sgyur ched mi tshogs sde tshan phan tshun dmag 'khrug byed kyi yod pa red/ tsho khag re la dbu 'khrid dam rgyal po re yod pa de tsho phal che ba stobs shugs dang dpa' rtsal la gzhi byas te 'dems sko byed byed srol byung yang / dus phyis rigs rgyud 'dzin srol byung ste/ rgyal po de 'das rjes de'i sras kyis srid bzung ba'i srol dar/ gang ltar mi sde tsho khag de'i srung skyob byed pa ni rgyal po de'i las 'gan yin zhing / de la khong tsho'i nye 'khor tshos rogs ram byed kyi yod 'dugmi sde'am tsho khag de tsho'i 'dod pa ltar rgyal pos srid bskyangs pa dang / mi mang po zhig gis de la rogs ram byed kyi yod pa red/ g.yul 9 bya ba byed mkhan dmag mi rnams kyi dbu 'khrid gcig yod pa de la dmag dpon nam sde dpon zhes bya zhing / dmag dpon de rgyal po'i lhan du rtag par sdod kyi yod pa red/rgyal po'i ched du chos kyi cho ga sogs byed mkhan mdun na 'don re yod pa des rgyal po la gros 'char yang 'bul gyi yod pa red/ rgyal po tshos rang gi pho nya btang nas nye skor gyi grong gseb khag tu gnas pa'i so so'i tshogs sde'i mi rnams dang 'brel ba byed cing / rgyal pos so so'i mnga' khongs kyi mi rigs rnams sam grong gseb kyi gtso bo rnams dang gros bsdur byed kyi yod pa red/ gal srid don gnad gal chen po'i rigs la bsam gzhigs bya dgos pa byung ñtsha rgyal pos sde tshogs kyi mi mtha'
88 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/dag la gros sdur byed/ skabs der yul mi tsho'i tshogs 'du zhig yod tshod/ de'i nang su zhig gis kyang so so'i bsam 'char 'don chog tshogs 'du de ni mi dmangs nas 'dems sgrug byas pa'i tshogs 'du chung chung zhig yin par mngon/ rgyal pos tshogs 'du de la to sdur byas pa na mi mang tshang mar go sdur byas par cha 'jog byed/grong gseb/ mi sde'i tsho khag de yang sde tshan chung chung khag hūṃ bgos pa de tsho la jam ste grong gseb ces brjod/ grong gseb re re'i nang mi tshang mang po yod pa red/ mi rnams kyis 'brog pa'i mi 3 dor nas so nam pa'i las don 'go 'dzug byas rjes grong gseb rnams che ru phyin te/ tshogs sde'i mi mang po grong gseb nang sdod 'go tshugs pa red/ nang mi cha tshang yod pa'i khyim tshang ngam mi tshang la kul te rigs dang /bsha ste yul zhes brjod/ mi sde'i tsho khag gcig gi mi tshor jan ste dmangs zhes brjod/grong gseb ni khyim tshang khag tu bsgos shing / khyim tshang re re'i nang mi tshang ma mnyam du sdod pa dang / pha gtso che ba'i lugs srol te/ nang mi'i nang nas mes po'am yang mes sogs skyes pa lo na rgan shos gcig gis nang mi'i 'go byed srol yod la/ de ni dbang cha'i do gnas lta bur byed de des don gnad tshang ma thag gcod byed cing / nang mi gzhan tshang mas thag gcod de la khas len nges par du byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ bu la bag ma blangs pa'i rjes khong gnyis bu'i pha'i khyim du sdod srol yod cing / spyir btang bud med la ñtsa mthong chen po byed pa dang / bu dang mnyam bu mo 'ga' shas la slob sbyong byed srol yod 'duggrong gseb nang du so nam pa las gzhan pa'i mi mang po gnas pa de tsho'i nang la lag bzo ba yang yod pa red/ grong gseb kha shas la rgyu cha 'bel los la ltos pa'i lag bzo ba yod de/ dper na grong gseb gcig la rdza ma bzo byed sa 'bel po
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 89yod pa yin na der rdza mkhan mang ba yod pa bzhin red/ grong gseb phan tshun dngos zog brje len byed pa'i tshong byed 'go tshugs pa red/ 'on kyang de dus tshong las ni spyir btang tsam las yag po rang med tshod/grong gseb khag tu rdza ma'i kha bad can gyi spyil bu brtan po rang med pa khag yod pa de tsho'i phyogs bzhi la ra ba dang / de tsho'i nang la zhing kha yang yod pa red/der sa zhing 'debs lko sogs byed cing / khron pa'am yur ba'i brgyud chu drangs te zhing khar chu gtong srol byung / nas kyi zhing las de rgya che zhing de nyid ston thog gtso bo yin/ dus phyis su gro dang 'bras kyi zhing las byed 'go tshugs/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gzhan gal che ba ni/ ngon byed pa de yin zhing / de yang glang chen dang sha ba dang /phag pa sogs kyi ngon byed/ glang la zhing rmo ba'i las ka bskul ba dang / dud 'gro'i nang nas ba phyugs la gal che shos su rtsi ste de la dngos po mang po zhig brten yod pas red/ mgron po gal chen po rnams la ba glang gi sha 'bul ba ni gus bkur gyi rtags mtshan du ñtsa/ phyis su bram ze tshos sha za ba spangs pa red/mi'i srog ni ba phyugs brgya'i srog dang mtshungs par 'dod pa yin te/ gal te mi gcig gis mi gzhan zhig bsad pa yin na/ de'i chad pa la gshin po de'i nang mi la ba phyugs brgya sprod 'jal dgos/ rta ni rtsa ba'i rgya gar gyi dud 'gro ma yin te/de ni ār+ya'i mi rnams kyis stag gzig gam/ zhwarwan sogs dbus yeshilā'i sa khul nas rgya gar la khrid yong ba red/ gang ltar rta yis shing rta'i 'khor lo 'drud 'then byed cing / shing rta 'khor lo ni dmag 'khrug skabs med spyod byed pa dang / shing rta'i rgyugs rtsal 'gran rgyu de ltad mo gal chen po zhig yin 'dug der ma zad shing rta 'khor lo de spyi tshogs nang che bstod kyi rtags mtshan du song nas phyis kyu dus rabs
90 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/khag tu rgyal po rnams shing rta 'khor lo'i thog bzhugs te phebs pa dang / yang na glang chen la chibs pa'i srol byung / yang rta de chos kyi ched du gal che ba zhig kyang yin twi/ rta mchog gi mchod sbyin skabs rta mchog gcig btang nas des yul ji tsam la bgrod cing sus kyang gegs ma byas pa de tsam la rgyal po des dbang bsgyur bar byed pa yin par bshad yod/ār+ya'i mi rigs dang / bran nam 'bangs/ārla'i mi rnams rgya gar byang brgyud kyi sa gnas khag tu gnas chags pa na/ sa gnas der sngon yod a+yau mi rigs rnams dang dgra zlar gyur cing / sa gnas mi rigs de tsho la ār+sha tshog bran nam yang na 'bangs zhes ming btags yod pa red/ der brten ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho rgya gar nub nas byang brgyud bslebs skabs sa gnas de tshor sngar nas sa gnas kyi mi rigs snyom chung nus med khag thar thor gnas yod tshod/ gang ltar ār+ya'i mi rigs tsho'i lha rnams la bran nam 'bangs tshog mchod pa ma byas shing /de tsho'i skad kyang ār+sha'i skad dam sa1ta legs sbyar skad las gzhan yin pa red/ rim bzhin bran nam 'bangs de tsho ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho'i bran g.yog dngos gnas par gyur pa red/ bran g.yog tu bskol te de tsho la las ka shin tu sdug po byed du bcug pa dang /de dag dang mnyan/ du spyod lam ngan pa byas shong / de tshor rigs ngan tha chad du brtsis pa red/ 'on kyang rjes su rim bzhin ār+ya'i mi rnams sa gnas kyi mi dang mnyam du 'dres te de tsho dang mnyam gnyen mdun sogs byas/spyi tshogs/ ār+sha'i mi rigs de tsho rang nyid kyang rigs gsum du bdos yod pa m+pi/ stobs shugs che shos ni rgyal po dang de'i dmag mi rnams yin zhing / de tsho
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyu byung rabs/ 91la rgyal rigs zhes/ brjod/ de bzhin shin tu gal gnad chen po ni mdun na 'don nam rgyal po'i bla ma lta bu ste bram ze rnams yin/ de rjes bzo bo dang / zhing pa rnams yin zhing / de ltar ār+sha'i mi rigs de rigs gsum du bgos yod/ rigs gsum pa de la rje'u rigs zhes brjod/ de gsum las gzhan pa'i rigs bzhi pa ni gdol pa'i rigs yin zhing / de ni sngar bshad pa'i bran nam 'bangs de rnams dang ār+ya'i mi rigs 'dres pa las byung ba yin la/ bran nam 'bangs dang 'dres pa'i ār+sha'i mi rigs de shugs kyis dman par bcas/de ltar ār+ya'i spyi tshogs de rim bzhin rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs dang /rje'u rigs dang / gdol pa'i rigs te bzhi ru phyes/ thog mar phru gru sus kyang so so'i 'dod mos ltar 'tsho ba skyel chog kyang / rim pas so so'i pha mes kyi 'tsho ba'i lam de rang la zhugs pa red/ thog mar rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs gnyis kyi gnas stangs gcig pa yin yang rim bzhin bram ze'i rigs de'i gnas stangs mtho ru phyin te spyi tshogs nang rim pa mtho shos su gyur/ chos la gal chen por brtsis pas bram ze de gal cher por gyur pa red/rigs kyi dbye ba'i lugs srol/rigs kyi dbye ba dang / reg mi rung ba'am/ phrad du mi rung ba'i lugs srol 'di ni hortsa'i spyi tshogs kyi khyad chos gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yin zhing / spyi tshogs gzhan dag phal cher nang gral rim gyi dbye ba ni dpal 'byor dang stobs shugs sogs las phye ba yin yang / rgya gar hi:'i spyi tshogs nang gi rigs kyi dbye ba de ni skyes stobs 'ba' zhig las byung ba yin pa 'di ni spyi tshogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yin/
92 'phags yul ca grang babarjodapa/'phags yul du rigs kyi lugs srol de ga dus dang ga 'dra se byung ba yin min bshad rgyu de dka' ba zhig ste/ 'ga' shas kyis 'di ni ārla tsho'i sngon drasprigayan skabs nas byung ba yin par 'dod cing / 'on kyang mkhas dbang mang pos rgya gar la rigs kyi lugs srol dar ba 'di ni ār+sha'i mi rigs tshos byas pa yin zhis gsungs/de yang ār+yā tsho'i skabs mchod gnas pa dang / dgra 'thab mkhan dpa' bo dang /so nam pa dang lag shes pa bcas sdi tshan gsum yod kyang de ni skyes stobs kyis min par 'tsho ba'am las don gyis phyes pa yin pa dang / ār+sha'i mi rigs dang / ārla min pa'i mi rigs tsho 'dres pa las rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs su rigs mtho dman gyi lugs srol de rim gyis byung ba yin srid/ des na rgya gar gyi mkhas pa mang pos rig byed kyi dus skabs su rigs kyi lugs srol de skyes stobs kyis min par gong gsal ltar 'tsho ba'am las don gyi cha nas 'jog par 'dod/ gang ltar phyis su rigs mtho dman gyi lugs srol dang / rigs dma' ba rnams la reg pa'am phrad khra rung ba'i srol de dar khyab chen po byung / 'di la dpyad pa zhib tu bya rgyu yod kyang skabs 'dir btang snyoms su bzhag na legs/nges brjod kyi rig byed dang rigs kyi lugs srol/nges brjod kyi rig byed nang pārugisulta ste skyes bus legs brjod ces pa'i gzhung zhig yod pa de'i nang 'jig rten byed pa po tshangs pa'i zhal nas bram ze dang /dpung pa las rgyal rigs dang / brla las rje'u rigs dang / rkang pa las gdol pa'i rigs byung tshul bshad yod/ de la gzhi byas na rig byed kyi dus rabs 'go tshugs pa'i skabs ār+sha'i nang nyid du khra rigs bzhi po de yod par grub/ nges brjod kyi rig
le'udang po/ sngon dusagyi byung rabs/ 93byed kyi lung du de ltar gsal bzhin du'ang / lo rgyus mkhan tshos ār+sha'i dus rabs snga ma'i skabs su rigs gsum las med la/ ār+sha dang ār+ya min pa gnyis 'dres pa las rim bzhin gdol pa'i rigs byung ba yin zhis 'dod tshul yod/rig byed kyi dus rabs phyi ma'i skabs rigs kyi lugs srol/rig byed kyi dus rabs phyi ma'i skabs su mi rigs mtho dman gyi dbye ba shin tu nas che ste/ mchod sbyin gyi rig byed nang rigs chen po bzhi'i bshad pa sna tshogs byas 'dug de'i skabs su rig byed kyi chos de gal che zhing dka' las khag por gyur pa dang / cho ga'am mchod sbyin gyi bya ba la mkhas pa rnams gal po cher gyur pa na/de dag la mkhas pa'i mi de tsho la bram/ ze zhes spyi tshogs nang gnas stangs mtho shos su gyur pa gong bshad ltar dang / ār+ya'i mi rigs tsho panāb nas chu mo gaṅga'i lung par rim bzhin khyab pa na sa gnas kyi mi tshos gdong len byas par de dang dmag 'thab ched dmag mi dpa' bo dag dang / 'do 'khrid dag byung bar rgyal rigs dang / ār+sha'i mi rigs lhag ma rnams zhi bde'i ngang so nam dang tshong las dang / bzo las byas te bsdad pa de tsho la rje'u rigs dang/ rigs mtho ba de gsum la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan nam g.yog las byed mkhan mang po dgos pa byung bas sa gnas kyi mi rnams bran du bkol ba dang / de tshos kyang ār+sha'i bran g.yog gam 'bangs su khas len dgos byung ba las mi rigs bzhi pa gdol pa'i rigs byung ba yin zhes byung rabs pa rnams spyir btang 'dod/ de lta na'ang sngar buruk+ṣaswāk+ta nang gi lung de la bltas na rigs bzhi'i dbye ba de thog ma nas byung yod par gdon mi za ba yin/ yang na lung de nges brjod kyi rig byed thog mar byung ba'i skabs su med par sprus su bsnan pa yin srid/
94 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/skabs 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni/ rigs chen po bzhi'i rnam gzhag 'di la rtsa ba'i rgya gar skad du watsā zhes brjod pa yin zhing / waṇ+ḍa zhis pa'i don kha dog yin pas/ thog mar kha dog la gzhi byas te rigs so sor phyes pa yin srid de/ de yang mi'i sha mdog gam yang na de tshos gyon pa'i gos kyi mdog so sor yod pa yang srid/ rtsa ba'i mdog gam waṇ+ḍa bzhi ni bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / gdol pa'i rigs bcas bzhi yin zhing / de re re la'ang rigs te dzāti mang po yod/'on kyang bod skad du watsā la rigs dang / dzāti la yang rigs zhes tshig dod gcig las med pas khyad par 'byed rgyu khag por gyur kyang / waṇ+ḍa la rigs chen po dang /dzāti la rigs zhes zhib cha byed rgyu yin nam dpyad par bya'o//mdog gam rigs kyi dbye ba de dong du bshad pa ltar skyes stobs 'ba' zhig las yin par 'dod kyang / rgya gar ba'i mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis de ni skyes stobs kyis min par las don las rigs mtho dman du gyur pa yin te/ dper na dro'o:rlu ste slob dpon bre bo che zhes pa skya seng bu lnga'i g.yul gyi slob dpon chen po dang / parashunām ste rtsib skyes zhes pa rgyal rigs rtsa med du gtong mkhan de gnyis skyes stobs kyis bram ze yin yang rgyal rigs kyi las don byas pa dang / drang srong chen po lngashiṣ+ṭha ste gnas 'jog dang / skya seng bu lnga'i mdun na 'don chen po khrisnur zhes pa gnyis smad 'tshong ma'i bu yin pa dang / drang srong rgyas pa zhes pa mahā:rata rtsom pa po de nya pa'i bu mo las skyes pa yin zhes brjod cing de tsho skyes stobs kyis rigs dman yang rigs mthon po yin zhes bshad/ 'di ni phal cher skyes stobs kyis rigs mtho dman 9 dbye 'byed thabs sdug rigs pa dang tshan rig gang dang yang mi mthun pa de 'geb pa'i phyir phyis su gtam rgyud mkhan tshos rim bzhin ched du bzos pa yon srid/ gang ltar gong
le'u dang po/ sngon dusaca byung rabs/ 95gsal gtam rgyud de tsho sngon rabs gtam rgyud nang bris 'dug cing / sngon rabs bco brgyad sogs ni rig byed bzhi'i bstan bcos las phyis su rim bzhin bris pa yin/gang ltar skyes stobs kyis rigs sam kha dog gi lugs srol de chu mo gaṅgā dang /ya munā'i bar gyi yul khag de tshor shin tu mkhregs por dar zhing / rim bzhin yul khag gzhan du'ang dar khyab byung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma phebs pa'i snga rol tsam du dang / sku 'khrungs pa dang / rigs dman la reg tu mi rung ba'am phrad par mi rung ba'i lugs srol yod pa'i skabs su 'phags yul du rig byed kyi chos lugs 'dzin pa'i spyi tshogs nang rigs chen po bzhi'i lugs srol de shin tu mkhregs po dang / de yang skyes stobs 'ba' zhig las yin par 'dod tshul de dar khyab chen po byung yod pa red/yishu'i sngon 3 lo 600 nas 300 tsam bar chos kyi mdo dang chos kyi bstan bcos zhes pa'i dus rabs khag byung zhing / skabs der mnus dran pa'i mdo sogs su rigs kyi rnam gzhag dang / de la gzhir bzhag nas spyi tshogs kyi 'gro stangs sogs sra mkhregs can gtan la phabs yod/rigs mtho ba gsum la rig byed slob pa'i thob dbang yod kyang gdol pa'i rigs la de ltar med/ de yang bram ze la rig byed cha tshang slob pa dang / gzhan la ston pa'i thob thang yod la/ rgyal rigs la rig byed cha tshang thos bsam byed pa'i dbang cha yod kyang gzhan la ston pa'i dbang cha med/ rje'u rigs la rig byed 'ga' shas thos bsam byed pa'i thob dbang yod/ rigs bzhi pa gdol pa'i rigs la m+pi rig byed spre cha shas tsam yang slob sbyong byed pa'i thob thang med par ma zad/ rigs mtho ba tshos gdol rigs dang mnyam du kha zas kyang za mi chog cing / skyes pa rigs mtho ba
96 'phags yul byung babarjod pa/zhig gdol rigs dang mnyam du gnyen byas pa na lugs 'byung gi gnyen zhes bya zhing /bud med rigs mtho ba zhig skyes pa rigs dma' ba zhig dang gnyen byas pa la lugs ldog gi gnyen zhes bya zhing de la nyes pa chen por ñtsa srol yod 'dug mnus dran pa'i mdo ltar na bram ze mo las gdol pa'i rigs kyi kyo ga zhig gi byis pa skyes pa de la gtum po zhes ming btags/ bstan bcos 'di'i nang bram ze gcig gi mi 3 la 'du byed bzhi bcu dang / bcu drug sogs kyi rnam gzhag dang / 4 de bzhin spyi tshogs kyi sgrig khrims byed sgo sna tshogs pa zhig bshad 'dug kyang / mthar gtugs na khe dbang dang / thob dbang che shos bram ze yin pa dang / de nas rgyal rigs dang / de nas rje'u rigs yin/ chos dang 'jig rten gang thad nas thob thang bral ba de rigs dman nam gdol pa'i rigs yin par gtan la phabs pa de dag thams cad rgyas shing zhib par 'bri dgos na skabs babs kyi brjod bya brlags par 'gyur bas mdo tsam las ma bris/'tsho rten/ ār+ya'i dus skabs su so nam las gzhan sgo phyugs gso skyong dang /nya gsod pa/ lams rigs bzo las/ shing bzo/ ko pags bzo las sogs ni grong gseb tu spyir btang gi 'tsho ba yin zhing / khams rigs bzo las pa rnams la khams rigs gsar pa zhig brnyed pa ni lcags yin la/ lcags kyi bde spyod las mi tsho la bde skyed gsar pa zhig byung yod/ de ni lcags mkhregs po dang / sra ba yin pas lag cha dang / mtshon cha sogs bzo bar zangs sam liṃ las bzang ba byung ba red/ rgya gar du lcags kyi bed spyod de yishu'i sngon gyi lo chig stong lhag tsam nas 'go tshugs yod/ thog mar mda'i mde'u dang / mdung gi rtse mo dang / ral gri dang /lag gri lta bu'i mtshon cha'i bed spyod byas shing / rjes su sta re dang 'jor sogs bzo
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyibyung rabs/ 97'go tshugs pa dang / gaṅgā'i lung par nags tshal mthug po de tsho gtsang mar bzo bar phan thogs chen po byung ba red/ tha mar thong gshol gyi gshol lcags kyang bzos pa red/ der brten sa gnas de ru zhing las la gar rgyas byung thub pa red/mchod gnas pa rnams ni chos kyi cho ga rnams la mgo 'khor zhing / dmigs bsal gyi sbyin sreg khag tu mi tshogs yongs rdzogs 'dzoms nas nyin mang por 'gor gyi yod pa red/ mchod gnas pa de rnams phru gu tshor slob sbyong sprod mkhan yang yin la/phru gu rnams mchod gnas pa de dag gi mnyam du bsdad nas rig byed kyi sngags klog tshul sogs slob kyi yod pa red/ mchod gnas pa de dag grong gseb tu sman pa'i las ka yang byed de de rnams kyis rtsa sman sngo sman sogs shes kyi yod pas mi zog la na tsha byung skabs sman bcos ched mchod gnas pa de dag 'bod kyi yod pa red/gos sam gyon pa/ de skabs kyi mi tsho'i gos ni/ snga mo'i haraspru'i skabs kyi mi rigs tshos gyon pa'i gos dang mi 'dra ba cher med de/ stod gos dang / smad sham gnyis yod/ rkang pa'i bol le bar du bslebs pa'i gos gzhan zhig kyang yod pa dang / mgo la mgo ras kyang dkri gi yod 'dug par ma zad rgyan cha yang mang po 'dog gi yod pa de rnams ni gser ram yang na khams rigs gzhan rnams las bzos yod pa red/ bud med tshos nor bu sna tshogs kyi phreng ba gyon pa dang / phyug po'i skyes dman tshos gser gyis spras pa'i dar gos gyon gyi yod pa red/dga' spro'am rtsed 'jo/ shing rta 'khor lo'i rgyugs rtsal 'gran pa dang /rgyu gar sogs la dga' po byed pa dang / gling bu dang / sgra snyan dang / rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo'i yo byad la bde spyod byed kyi yod pa red/ sho dang mig mang rtse ba ni rtsod 'jo gag shos su ñtsa gi yod par snang /
98 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/kha zas/ ār+ya'i mi tshos 'o ma dang / mar khu sogs la bed spyod shugs che byed par ma zad shing tog dang / tshal dang / 'bru rigs dang / sha bcas la bed spyod chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ de tshos sbrang rtsi sogs las bzos pa'i myos byed cig kyang 'thung gi yod pa dang / khong tsho'i btung ba dmigs bsal zhig ni somaras zhes pa de yin zhing / de ni chos kyi dus ston khag tu 'thung gi yod pa de bzo ba ni khag po yin tshod/ khyad mtshar ba zhig la somaras zhes pa'i tshig de zur sung zad chags nas somaratsa zhes bod skad du bris pa yin tshod/ 'on kyang bod pas somaratsa'i ngos 'dzin byed stangs la jugs gzhi zhig 'dug pa m+pi/ somaratsa zhis pa rtsa skud zhig la 'jog cing / de yi zhing las rgya cher rgya gar sogs su byed pa yin/'on kyang de las myos byed kyi btung ba bzo gi yod med ma shes shing / deng sang ni rgya gar gyi mi tshos de las btung ba bzo tshul shes kyi mi 'dug cing lag len la yang med/ sngon dus su de la dngos po gzhan bsres pa'am phab sogs kyis bsnyal nas myos chu bzo gi yod pa'ang srid/ yang na bod pas ngos 'dzin byed stangs nor ba yang srid/ dper na rtsa ku sha'i ngos 'dzin byed stangs nor nas ku sha rtsa nas min pa'i gad phyag bzo byed gcig la ku sha ngos 'dzin byed kyang/ ku sha dngos gnas de ga re la zer min rgya gar ba nu/ la dris na'ang gsal por shes thub/chos/ chos kyi skor shes par byed pa la thog mar ches snga ba'i dus rabs sirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul ma dar ba'i sngon rol du yul 'dir chos kyi ngo bo ga 'dra zhig yod par shes dgos gal che bas mkhas pa tshos lo rgyus byung rabs la zhib 'jug byas yod pa red/ siṅgā'i sngon rol 3 mi rigs ni drabiṭa kyi rma rigs rnams yin zhing /de skabs sku 'dra la mchod pa dang / shing tog dang / me tog dang / chu sogs lha
le'u dang po/ sngon dusaspre byung rabs/ 99la 'bul srol yod pa de deng sang yang rgya gar gyi chos lugs tshang mar gnas yod pa red/ lha dang lha mo'i mtshon byed la seng ge dang / yang na glang gi gzugs brnyan byed pa 'di deng sang yang dbang phyug pa rnams la dar yod pa de/ de skabs kyang yod par 'dod/ deng sang dbang phyug dang / lha mo uma'i rtsa ba de drabiṭa skabs kyi chos lugs la thug yod ces lo rgyus smra ba tshog 'dod/dbyin ⑮ lo rgyus mkhas pa simitha (371 (5) yis sngon bdud kyi rigs la mchod pa 'bul srol yod pa de phyis su bram ze tshos lha dang lha mo sogs kyi gzugs su bsgyur nas khas blangs te mchod pa byed srol 'go tshugs pa red/ ces gsungs 'dugsirnyu'i ya rabs spyod tshul gyi skabs su lha mo la gal cher sne srol yod la/ mo ni 'jig rten 'grub pa'i rtsa ba yin par yid ches byed/ sirnyu'i skabs kyi zhig shul btog bsngogs byas pa las brnyed pa'i rtags thel gcig thog sprupal zhes pa'i shing sdong gi yal ga zhig thog lha mo zhig bzhengs bzhin pa'i mdun du mchod pa byed mkhan tshos ra zhig 'khrid yong ba gsal 'dug pa de dmar mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga la tshang ma 'du 'dzom byed pa de bstan pa yin 'dug lha mo ma zad lha la yang mchod pa 'bul gyi yod par nges te/ rtags thel gcig nang lha dbu gsum pa zhig 'khod 'dug pa sogs las shes/ der ma zad dud 'gro la mchod pa dang / shing sdong la mchod pa byed kyi yod 'dugnges brjod kyi rig byed kyi skabs su ār+sha'i mi tshos 'gro ba mi'i bde don ni 'byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi stobs shugs la brten pa yin par shes nas de dag la rdzu 'phrul dang stobs shugs dang ldan par gsar gtod byas pa red/ der brten nges brjod kyi rig byed nang du lha dang lha mo sum rtsu so gsum yod ces grags pa de tsho nam
100 'phagasayul9 byung ba brjod pa/mkha'i lha dang / bar snang gi lha dang / sa gzhi'i lha gsum du 'dus/ dper na/dgung sngon dang / chu lha dang / nyi ma dang / khyab 'jug dang / thun mtshams kyi lha sogs ni nam mkha'i lha dang / dbang po dang / drag po dang / rlung lha ni bar snang gi lha dang / sa gzhi dang / me lha dang / rla ba dang / phur bu dang /gtsang po'i lha sogs ni sa gzhi'i lha'i khongs su 'dus pa yin par bshad/ nyi ma ni rigs dang po de'i gtso bo dang / rlung lha ni rigs gnyis pa de'i gtso bo dang / me lha ni lha rigs gsum pa de'i gtso bo yin par 'dod/ dus skabs sna tshogs su lha de tshor gal che chung sna tshogs 'pho 'gyur byung 'dug pa tshang ma brjod kyis mi long shi ba'i rjes su skye ba yod pa'i 'dod tshul gsal po med la dus phyis ār+sha'i bram ze tshos che 'di nas phyi mar 'pho ba dang / las dang / thar pa bcas kyang rim bzhin 'dod cing bshad pa byas/ mig 'khrul dang / sgyu ma dang / sngags sogs kyang dar zhing /phyugs kyi mchod sbyin sogs kyang dar khyab gyur/ skye ba dang 'chi ba'i rgya las grol ba na thar pa thob par 'dod cing /ri de 'thob pa la ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam gtan la brten dgos shing dka' thub dang brtul zhugs sogs kyang rim bzhin dar yod 'dugrig byed kyi dus rabs rjes ma dang / dpa' bo'i dus rabs skabs su sngon dus kyi rig byed a+yau lha rnams kyi mtshon don nus med du gyur te/ lha gsar pa 'dra min gzhan gal chen por gyur pa dang / sku gsum mam gzugs gsum gyi 'dod tshul dar ba de ni tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / lha chen po gsum yin zhing /'jig rten byed po tshangs pa dang / gnas pa po khyab 'jug dang / 'jig pa po lha chen dbang phyug yin par 'dod/ mi tshos las 'bras dang / skye ba snga phyi dang /dka' thub la yid ches brtan po byed cing / dad pa dang / shes rab dang / las
le'udang po/ sngon dus sprebyung rabs/ 101bcas ni thar pa'i lam gal che shos su ñtsa/de nas dus rabs rim bzhin 'das pa na/ rig byed kyi cho ga rgya che zhing rgyun ring la 'gro gron shin tu chen po dang bsgrub dka' ba dag dar zhing / thams cad sngags dang cho ga la rag las pa lta bur gyur/lha dang lha mo rnams kyis mi la sdong grogs byed cing / gal te de tsho khros na 'jigs su rung ba'i grub 'bras ngan pa yong bas tshang mas 'jigs snang byed/ der brten de tsho'i thugs dam skong ba gal chen po chags pa dang / ār+ya'i mi tshos bsam par mchod gnas bram ze tsho'i brgyud nas byas pa'i sbyin sreg gis lha rnams 9 thugs dam skong ba yin/ des na sbyin sreg gi gra sgrig rgya chen po byed cing / rig byed kyi sngags brjod de phyugs kyi mchod sbyin nam dmar mchod byed/ de'i sgo nas lha la gsol ba 'debs/ des lha rnams mnyes te sbyin bdag gi bsam don nam 'dod don 'grub par 'dod/ de ltar mchod gnas pa bram ze de rnams ni lha dang mi'i bar gyi bar rma lta bur gyur pas de rnams shin tu shugs chen po dang gnas stangs mthon por gyur pa red/phyugs kyi mchod sbyin nam dmar mchod de dar khyab chen por gyur pa dang / lta ba dang grub mtha' yang mi mthun pa shin tu mang po dang / mchod sbyin dang cho ga yang 'dra min shin tu mang po byung zhing 'phel bas bsam blo'i gnas stangs la zing cha chen po byung / mchod sbyin dang / chos byed mkhan dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam 'khrid mkhan ni bram ze las gzhan med cing de la brten nas bram ze rnams shugs che shos su gyur pa dang / rig byed dang / cho ga rnams ni saskrota ste legs sbyar kyi skad 'ba' zhig nang ma gtogs byed mi chog pas mi dkyus ma tshor skad kyi dka' ngal chen po byung bar ma zad rigs mtho dman gyi lugs srol des rigs dma' ba tsho ni 'ching
102 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/thag dam pos bcings pas chos dang 'jig rten gang thad nas mgo bo mtho sa med pa sogs mdor na mi tshang mar dka' sdug tshad med byung bas tshang mas lam stabs bde po zhig dang byams dang snying rje ldan la phyogs ris dang bral ba'i lam zhig 'tshol ba'i thabs shes byed 'go btsugs yod pa red/ de la brten nas 'chad 'gyur ltar rgyal ba pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dar khyab byung yod pa red/skabs 'dor dpyad par bya ba zhig ni/ ār+sha'i mi rigs zhes pa'i ār+ya dang /'phags pa la ār+sha zhes pa'i legs sbyar 9 skad dod gcig pa yin zhing / rgya gar la 'phags pa'i yul zhes brjod pa yongs su grags pa yin/ spyir btang bsam tshul la ār+sha'i mi rigs tsho yong nas gnas chags shing dar rgyas su phyin pa'i yul yin pas rgya gar la 'phaḍa pa'i yul zhes brjod pa yin/ de lta na yang bstan bcos rnams su khyad par du 'phags pa'i gang zag dang skyes bu chen po sogs la ār+sha zhes brjod pa yin zhing de bod skad du bsgyur ba na 'phags pa zhes brjod/ so skye dang 'phags pa gnyis su phye ba'i 'phags pa la yang ār+sha zhes brjod pa dang / de bzhin 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad sogs thams cad la ār+ya'i sgra 'jug pa yin/ skabs 'dir dri ba ni/ ār+ya'i khra rigs zhes pa'i ārla de yang bod skad du 'phags pa'i mi rigs zhes brjod chog gam mi chog zhig pa 'di yin/ gal te de ltar yin na ni byung rabs gyi skabs 'dir siṅgā'i rjes 'phags pa'i mi rigs rnams kyis rgya gar la gnas chags zhes sogs stabs bde po yong gi red/ gal srid ār+sha'i khra rigs la 'phags pa'i mi rigs zhes lab rgyu min na ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag dang 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi sogs kyi skabs 'phags pa'i tshog 'di la rgya gar skad du ār+sha zhes pa'i tshog 'di 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig yod dgos/
le'udang po/ sngon dus 'byung rabs/ 103ār+sha zhes pa'i tshog 'di spyir btang don bzhi la 'jug ste dang po ār+sha'i mi rigs de sngar bshad pa ltar dbus yeshilā nas yong nas rgya gar dang nub gling yuropa khul khyab pa'i mi rigs dkar po zhig la go zhing / gnyis pa ār+ya'i skad rigs gcig pa yin ma'i rgya gar gyi ār+ya'i mi rigs rgya gar byang rgyud khul du gnas chags pa rnams la go gsum pa chos dang rig gzhung dmigs bsal ba rig byed sogs dang khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la go /bzhi pa ni lta ba khyad du 'phags pa'am/spyod pa khyad du 'phags pa'am/ rigs mtho ba rnams dang / grus zhing bkur bar 'og pa'i gang zag sogs la 'jug pa yin/ mdor na thog mar ār+sha zhes pa mi rigs khyad par ba de'i ming yin la/ rim bzhin khyad du 'phags pa'am 'phags pa'i don du sbyar ba yin zhing / de ni mchog gam gzhan dang mi 'dra bar legs pa'i don yin par sems/ der brten ār+sha'i mi rigs la 'phags pa'i mi rigs zhes brjod kyang rigs pas gnod pa cher med par mngon/ de lta na'ang 'jig rten spyi mtshungs ltar ār+sha'i mi rigs zhes bris na legs pas kho bos de ltar bris yod/yishu'i sngon gyi lo drug brgya nas bzhi brgya'i bar gyi rgya gar/yishu'i sngon gyi lo drug brgya tsam bar du chu mo gaṅgā'i rgyud kyi rgya thang rnams phal cher gtsang ma bzos/ zin cing / mi rnams sa khul 'dra min khag tu gnas te grong dang grong khyer khag chags yod pa red/ srid don gyi byung rabs kyi cha nas bltas na yishu'i sngon gyi lo drug brgya pa'i skabs su dmigs bsal 'gyur ba chen po khag byung yod/ de yang de'i sngon du 'phags yul byang phyogs su rgyal phran tsho'i nang du shin tu stobs che ba su yang byung med ming phan tshun bar drag po'i dmag 'khrug kyang chen po byung med pa red/
104 'phagasayul gyi :nga ba brjod pa/yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i 'do stod du 'phags yul byang rgyud de ma(janapad ste skye bo'i ldongs chen po bcu drug du bgos yod pa de rnams ni/ aṅga dang / kāspu dang / koshal dang / wardzu'am u:na dang / mal+la dang / cedi dang / wat+pa dang / kuru dang / pānal dang / ma3 dang / shurasen dang /ashāka dang / awa: dang / gartswar dang / kukrong dang / mgadha ste bcu drug go /dzo aṅga ste dbang po'i rgyal khams de deng dus bihār mnga' sde'i rdzong lhagalabur dang / musnar bcas tshud yod cing / de'i rgyal sa ni casprunagasmi ste tsam pa ku'i grong zhes pa de yin/ dbang po'i yul de dus ring mo zhig nas mgadha dang 'gran bzhin gnas pa dang / mthar mgadha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i dus su de mgan+ta'i dbang 'og tu 'dus nas de'i cha shas su gyur/kha) kāspu ste yul gsal ldan ni dus skabs gcig la rgyal khab stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung zhing / de'i rgyal sa ni lārā&r+sā red/ sangs rgyas ma phebs pa'i snga rol du yul gsal ldan de koshala'i mnga' 'og hu tshud pa red/gad koshal yang na kosala'i rgyal khab de tshod dpags byas na deng sang gi awadha dang / g.yosgyu ste 'thab med dang / shāwastu ste gnyan yod dang sāketa ste gnas bcas rnams rim bzhin kosala'i rgyal sar gyur pa dang / sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su phrasenajita ste rgyal po gsal rgyal zhes pa de rgyal po gal che shos yin pa dang / rgyal po 'dis mgan+ta'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra ste anātashatru dang mnyam so sor srung skyob ched dmag 'khrug byas pa red/ kosala'i rgyal sras sprirluṇ+ḍaka ste 'phags skyes po zhes pa'i rjes su kosala'i yul de mgadha'i cha shas sugyur/

106 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/nga u:yan ste 'phags rgyal gyi rgyal khab de spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rigs brgyad gcig hu bsdoms pa zhig yin la/ de ni deng dus kyi isdo dang rtsosprul gyi nub phyogs sogs dang grujarātra'i shar rgyud bcas yin/ lirgyuspri dang / wa: bcas lus 'phags (bideha) kyi rgyal rigs tshang ma stobs shugs chen po sha stag yin pa red/4shu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang 25khri stobs shugs rgyas te mgadha'i rgya skyed la gdong len byas par ma zad phar rgol yang byas yod pa red/ 'on kyang rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de tsho dang gnyen 'dun gyi 'brel ba bzhag ste gcig mthun gnang ba red/ 'on kyang ma skyes dgra yis lits+tsha'i rnams dang dgra zlar byas nas lits+tsha'i rnams kyi stobs shugs med par bzos pa red/tsa) malnga ste phreng ldan gyi yul de yang 'phags rgyal ltar spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rigs brgyad tsam gcig tu bsdoms pa zhig yin/ phreng ldan gyi yul 'di ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo 'ga' shas rjes bar rang btsan du gnas pa dang /de nas mnga' khul de tsho mgadha'i cha shas su gyur pa red/cha cedi zhes pa'i ljongs de chu bo yamuX'i 'gram gyi sa khul sngar gyi rgyal rigs tshos bskyangs pa zhig yin la/ sunyamati zer ba de de'i rgyal sa red/ lo rgyus 'ga' shas su cadere zhes pa de'i rgyal sa yon tshul bshad/ 'di smru deng dus busmyulakhaṇ+ḍa sa khul gyi lho phyogs kyi cha shas khag dang / jabalapur gyi byang phyogs kyi cha shas 'dus pa de yin/ja wat+pa ste bu'i ldongs de ni sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su 'phags yul byang phyogs kyi rgyal khab gtso che ba bzhi'i nang nas gcig yin zhing / rkoX ni de'i rgyal sa yin/ nashā: ni yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang rgya gar gyi grong khyer
le'udang po/ sngon dusakyu byung rabs/ 107chen po drug gi nang nas gcig yin pa red/ 'di ni gaṅgā dang gamunā gnyis kyi bar gyi mdo yi nub rgyud 5ltag sa khul yin zhing deng dus i.āhāshādayi nub rgyud la yod/ rgyal po udagan ste 'char byed ni wāk+ka'i yul gyi rgyal po yin zhing / de yis mgalha'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra dang / awa:'i rgyal po rab snang dang dmag 'khrug byas pa red/nya) kuru ste sgra mi snyan gyi rgyal khams de ni skabs shig stobs shugs che shos yin yang / yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang de'i stobs shugs nya9/sa pa red/de'i rgyal sa ni i〈pāsga ste dbang po'i rab gnas yin zhing / deng dus disnya sa khul nub rgyud kyi nye skor sa gnas khag la yod/taka pānal ste yul lnga len nam lnga 'dzin ni thog mar rgyal pos bskyangs pa'i yul yin yang / yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi 'dzug skrun byas pa red/ 'ga' shas kyis 'di ni gaṅgā dang yamunā gnyis kyi bar du yod cing /sngon dus su lho phyogs su casbal gyi 'gram bar dang / byang phyogs su harigār bar du khyab yod ces bshad/ 'on kyang deng sang byung rabs smra ba tshos de ni deng dus kyai ru)lakhaṇ+ḍa 'di nyid pustsol yul yin par 'dod cing / rgyal sa ni byang phyogs kyi rgyal sa rāmanagar dang / lho phyogs kyi rgyal sa kukhulā yin/thar maklu ste nya yi yul ni deng dus jagasur dang / de 'brel gyi sa khul 'ga' shas yin zhing / werwasanagar zhes pa de'i rgyal sa yin/da shārasen ste dpa' ba'i sde zhes pa'i ljongs de yi rgyal sa ni mthurā ste ༄bcom brlags zhes pa de yin zhing / de ni chu bo yamunā'i lho phyogs su yod cing /deng sang yang mthurā'i grong khyer zhes pa'i chen po grags can de yin/na ashāka dang mulaka zhes pa de gnyis lho phyogs ā:phradesha'i khyim mches
108 'phags yul 9byung babarjodapa/kyi yul ljongs gnyis yin zhes nang pa'i gzhung las gsungs yod cing / de ni deng dus 535desha'i mnga' khongs su yod pa dang / chu bo godakarī ste ba sbyin gyi 'gram zhig la yod/par awa: ste srung byed ni rgya gar dbus nub khul hu rgyal pos bskyangs pa'i ljongs shin tu stobs che ba zhig yin la/ nanadu chu bo'i byang rgyud kyi sa khul de yin zhing / de'i rgyal sa ni deng dus kyi uXn zhes pa de yin zhing de la gawa(bud+dhā ste srung byed kyi grong zhes bya/5) galhar ste dri za'i yul ni deng dus pānastun gyi rdzong poshāwar zer ba'i sa khul de yin la/ tak+ṣaṇ+ḍalā ste rdo 'jog gi yul de'i rgyal sa red/ 'di ni )bul gyi mtha' mtshams kunar dang sasnu gtsang po gnyis kyi bar du yod cing / deng dus bshāwar zer ba de yin la de la sngon dus puruṭapur zhes bya ste skyes bu'i grong zhes pa'i don yin/ dus phyis yul so sor gyes pa ma gtogs sngon dus su 'di tshang ma 'phags yul gyi cha shas yin/bde rmalhoja zhes pa dri za'i yul gyi nub byang du yod cing deng dus pā'ilhan gyi byang rgyud sa khul du yod la lugs la mkhas pa 〈9kya 'am smugalu yi dus su ljongs 'di rgyal srid min pa'i rgyal khams zhig yin par bshad/ sngon dus 'di la gshasgyun ste rta yi gnas khi/sa bya ba de deng sang zur chags nas aphaXnistun zhes pa 'di yin zhes mkhas pa mang pos bzhed/ma'i mgadha ni rags pa tsam byas na deng dus kyi paṭanā dang bihār mnga' sde'i gaṅga'i 'gram gyi rdzong khag 'dus pa'i yul khams zhig yin/ 'di'i sngon dus kyi rgyal sa ni rgyal po'i khab yin la phyis su pāsaliputra ste skya nar bu'i grong yin la tshig 'di
le'udang po/ sngonadusakyibyung rabs/ 109zur chags nas deng dus paṭanā zer ba 'di yin/gong du bshad pa'i rgyal pos bskyangs pa'i rgyal khab dang / rgyal pos ma bzung bar spyi mthun rgyal khab bsdoms bcu drug de rnams las gzhan pa'i mnga' khul chung chung khag mang po yod pa de tsho yang gzhung 'dzin pa sna tshogs kyis bskyangs yod pa red/byung rabs la mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis spyi mthun rgyal khab khag gi grangs bcu gcig tu nges zhes gsungs yod/ de tsho'i nang nas dper na shākya'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gtso che zhing / de'i rgyal sa gapilabastu sī ser skya'i grong yin/ mor+sha spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa pisparbawan yin pa sogs grangs bcu gcig yod skad la de dag phal cher deng sang gi goragapur dang murnga5rapur gyi byang khul du yod/gong du bshad pa'i skye bo'i ljongs bcu drug po de dag gi nang nas 'ga' shas ni rgyal srid kyis bskyangs pa yin te/ rgyal rgyud gcig gis mi thog rim byon rgyal sa bzung ba yin la/ 'ga' shas spyi mthun rgyal khab yin te/ de tsho'i srid gzhung skyong mkhan ni/ mi mang gi tshogs 'dus bdams pa'i gang zag zhig gam/ yang na mi mang gis thad kur bdams pa'i mi zhig gis srid bskyangs pa yin pa las mi rgyud gcig rang gis sred 'dzon srol med/ 'on kyang spyo mthun rgyal khab de tsho'i nang rgyal regs rnams 'ba' zhib sa zhing gi bdag po yin zhing / tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi tsho yang rgyal rigs kho na yin pa dang / der brten tshogs 'dus bdams pa'i srid skyong mkhan de yang rgyal rigs kho na yin/ de lta na'ang / rgyal srid can gyi rgyal khab dang / spyi mthun rgyal khab gnyis la khyad par chen po yod pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar snga ma de rgyal rgyud gcig 'ba' zhig gis skyes stobs kyis srid dbang bzung ba yin la/ phye ma de 'thug mis bdams pa'i rgyal rigs gang yang rung bas srid bskyangs pa yin/
110 'phags yul gyi :nga ba ba da pa/de ltar rim bzhin yul lcongs de tshor khrims gsar pa sna tshogs bzo 'go tshugs shing srid skyong tshul yang 'gyur bzhin yong ba zhig red/ yul khams de tsho rang dbang rang btsan yin zhing de tshang ma'i spyi thog la dbang byed pa'i gzhung stobs chen skabs der med/ shākya'i rigs dang / lits+tshasa'i rigs kyi spyi mthun rgyal khab grags chen khag yod cing / bdag cag gi ston pa zag gtsang sras po de nyid shākya'i rgyal rigs su 'khrungs pa yin no/mgadha'i mnga' thang /mahā:rata'i gtam rgyud byung skabs mgadha'i yul 'di rgyal po 1bhadratha ste shing rta chen po zhes pa'i dbang 'og tu yod cing / rgyal rgyud de la rgyal po nyi shu rtsa brgyad byung ba'i tha ma de rgyal po ri5tshog ste dgra las rgyal ba/ zhes pa de yin pa dang / de nyid rgyal sa las phabs te rgyal rgyud de yishu'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag drug pa'i dkyil la rdzogs pa red/ gang ltar yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang mgadha de rgyal khab stobs che shos sugyur pa red/rgyal po 1hadatha'i rjes 'dzin gyi rgyal po su byung min skor sngon rabs dang / nang pa'i gzhung ngam lung gnyis bar bzhed pa mi mthun pa chen po yod/ sngon rabs ltar na/ rgyal po 56ta ste rab snang ni 2nyadratha'i rjes 'dzin pa yin zhing de ni sheshunāg ste klu'i gzhon nus bcom pa yin/ der ma zad sngon rabs nang du rgyal po tsho'i mtshan tho'i nang gzugs can snying po dang / ma skyes dgra gnyis rim bzhin shilnganug rgyal rgyud kyi rgyal rabs lnga pa dang drug pa yin par bshad/ 'on kyang nang pa'i lung tshad ldan rnams la dpyad na sngon rabs rtsom mkhan tshos gong gi rgyal rabs rnams kyi rim pa
le'u dang po/ sngonadus kyu byung rabs/ 111'chol ba dang / rnam rtog gis rang dgar go rim bsgrigs pa las dngos 'brel ma yin par shes sla/ sngon rabs dang / nang pa'i lung gnyis ku'i nang rgyal po rab snang gis awa: ste srung byed kyi yul la dbang bsgyur ba las mgadha la dbang bsgyur ba min par mthun/ des na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lung ltar/ rab snang gi rgyal rgyud las rgyal po dang po ni rgyal po zla ba rab snang ca656ta yin zhing / de ni mgadha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang dus mnyam yin/ shi(nug ste klu yi gzhon nu ni rgyal po zla ba rab snang gi mi rabs bzhi pa'am lnga pa'i rjes su byung ba yin pas gzugs can snying po'i rjes su byung ba yin/ des na klu yi gzhon nu de rgyal po 1bhadratha bcom mkhan gyi rgyal rgyud de'i thog ma min par ma zad des gzugs can snying po'i rjes su mgadha la dbang byas pa yin/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas 1hadatha'i rgyal rgyud rtsa med du bcom mkhan rgyal po gzugs can snying po yin pa las klu yi gzhon nu ga la yin te ma yin no/gzugs can sming po/rgyal po gzugs can snying po ni harig:kul gyi rgyud pa yin zhing / mgadha'i mnga' thang spel mkhan thog ma dngos gnas de yin/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 1bhadratha'i rgyal rgyud bcom te yishu'i sngon gyi lo 542 lor mgalha'i khri la 'khod pa dang / khong gis yishu'i sngon gyi lo 493 bar du srid bskyangs/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po (bim+bisār)ni g.yul la mkhas pa'i dpa' bo dang / rgyal gces pa chen po zhig yin/ khong gis 'phags sdu/la byang phyogs kyi rgyal po stobs ldan gzhan khag dang gnyen mdun gyi sgo nas mthun grogs gnang nas rang gi mnga' thang phyogs thams cad
112 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/la rgyas par mdzad/ adra'i yul ma gtogs rgyal khab gzhan tshang ma'i mnyam du 'brel lam yag po mdzad par dgongs te/ byang nub kyi dri za'i yul bcas thag ring gi yul khag la yang rang gi pho nya btang gnang ba red/ paṭanā'i nye 'gram na rgyal po'i khab ces pa de khong gi rgyal sa yin la/ de ni mtha' ri yis bskor ba'i grong khyer shin tu mdzes po zhig yod pa de'i zhig shul rnams dngos shul rnying rigs brtag dpyad mkhan tshos brkos bsngogs byas pa las deng sang yang mthong thub pa yod/ rgyal po 'dis rang gi rgyal khab de rgya skyed mdzad de khong gi mnga' 'og tu grong gseb khri brgyad 80000yod pa dang mtha' skor khra li'am le dbar nyis stong tsam yod pa red/ rgyal po 'dis sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur sogs rgya cher mdzad pa'i skor lung rnams su gsal/ma skyes dgrargyal po gzugs can snying po la sras mang po yod pa'i nang nas gal che shos rgyal po ma skyes dgra (anātashatru)yon la/ des rang gi yab gzugs can snying po bkrongs nas rang nyid mgadha'i khri la 'khod/ ma skyes dgra yis rang gi yab kyi srid byus mu mthud bskyangs nas rang gi rgyal khab de da dung stobs shugs che ru btang ched khyim mches kyi rgyal khab khag phams par byas na ma gtogs thabs med par mthong nas rang gi zhang po kosala'i rgyal po'i thog dpung 'jug byas pa dang / des ma tshad wa4ga'i rgyal po khag dang yang g.yul byas pa red/ wa4ya'i spyi mthun rgyal khab de bihār gyi byang phyogs su yod pa dang / de dang mnyam ma skyes dgras lo mang po'i ring dmag 'khrugs byas 'dug mthar ma skyes dgra la rgyal kha thob ste 'phaḍa yul byang rgyud du mgadha de stobs dang mnga' thang che shos su gyur/
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyibyung rabs/ 113rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang / ma skyes dgra yab sras gnyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams su gal chen por gsungs yod pa dang /gnyis ka gangs rgyas kyu rjes 'jug pa yin par gsal po yod pa dang / de ltar nang pa tshang mas khas len byed/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo yang yod/'on kyang drang srong rgyal ba pa'i gzhung khag tu'ang rgyal po 'di gnyis ka rgyal ba pa'i rjes 'jug yin par bshad yod pa dang / rgyal ba pa'i sbyin bdag lta bu yin pa'i skor mang po bshad 'dug pa ya mtshan/ rgyal po yab sras de gnyis nang pa dang / rgyal ba pa gnyis la khyad par med par dad gus byas pa yin nam/ yang na rgyal ba pa tshog rtog bzo byas pa gang yin dpyad dgos pa zhig red/rgyud 'dzin/ma skyes dgra'i rgyal tshab udagan ste 'char byed ma skyes dgra'i rjes su mgadha'i rgyal po byas shing / de'i rjes anirud+dha ste ma 'gag pa dang / de'i rjes su muṇ+ḍa ste mgo zlum dang de'i rjes nugadus ṣ+ṭi klu'i 'bangs zhes pa rnams kyis mgadha la dbang sgyur byas pa red/ byung rabs la mkhas pa tshos ma skyes dgra nas bzung rgyal po 'di thams cad kyis rang rang gi yab bkrongs pa yin par 'dod/ 'on kyang gzhan rnams kyis ji ltar byas pa gsal shes ma byung la/ ma skyes dgras rang gi yab bkrongs pa ni ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo sogs lung du ma nas gsal/gang ltar mi mang tshos rgyal po la mi dga' ba chen po byung ste rgyal po la ngo log chen po byung ste mthar sheshunāg ste klu yi gzhon nu zhes pa'i blon po zhig khri thog tu rgyal por mnga' gsol ba red/ klu yi gzhon nus har+shaka rgyal rgyud de rtsa med du btang
114 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/nas mgadha la dbang bsgyur zhing / des awa: dang / kosal dang / wat+pa bcas mgadha'i mnga' 'og tu btsud pa red/ka95ashudhakade rjes ku'agashoka ste sgyu rtsal mya ngan med ces pa de klu yi gzhon nu'i khrir 'khod cing rgyal po de la sngon rabs su shākawaman te bya rog go cha zhes mtshan btags 'dug rgyal po 'di'i sku ring la khrishārlu ste yul yangs pa can du sangs rgyas pa'i bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad pa de ni khong gi sku che la byung ba'i gnas tshul gal che shos yin/rang re'i lo rgyus la mkhas par rloms pa mang pos kulugashoka dang chos rgyal mya ngan med gnyis so sor yin par ma shes par de gnyis gcig pa yin par bsam nas chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bka' bsdu gnyis pa'i sbyin bdag byas par 'dod la/ de la brten nas chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi dus tshod sogs la 'khrug rkyen mang po byung ba dang /rgyal rabs lo rgyus tong 'og 'chol ba rnams la yid brtan ci yod/nan+da'i rgyal brgyud/byung rabs mkhan tshos gsungs gsal ltar/ kunā.ashoka ste sgyu rtsal mya ngan med dam shākawasman ste bya rog go cha de'i ske la gri btsugs nas bkrongs pa dang / rgyal po gsod mkhan de nyid bya rog go cha'i rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur/ de nyid phal cher nan+da'i rgyal rgyud 'dzug pa po yin tshod/ shrīka (ku9665) gi yig cha dang /sngon rabs rnams su nan+da'i rgyal rgyud rnams ni gsang ba'i byus ngan gshom pa po dang /mi gsod khrag sbyor byed mkhan sdug po yin pa'i bshad pa byas 'dug 'on kyang nang
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyi byung rabs/ 115pa'i lung rnams su ni nan+da'i rgyal rgyud rnams ni mgadha la rgyal kha thob pa'i dpa' bo yongs grags bsngags par 'os pa dag yin par gsungs yod/nan+da'i rgyal rabs te dga' bo'i rgyal rabs 'go 'dzug mkhan ni mahāpad+manan+da ste pad+ma chen po dga' bo yin zhing / khong gi mtshan 'di'i mtshon don ni/ khong gi dmag gi stobs shugs che ba'am yang na dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs che ba de yin nges/ nan+da'i drag po'i stobs shugs che ba de bstan bcos pa mang pos gsal bshad byas yod pa dang / dpal 'byor che ba'i skor yang rgya gar lho phyogs tamil gyi gzhung mang por bshad pa byas yod pa red/pad+ma chen po dga' bo de ni lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i rgya gar gyi 7gong ma dang po de yin zhis brjod chog cing / khong gi rgyal khab bam mnga' ris su pahāb snye lnga len dang / nub byang gi sa mtshams rnams phud pa'i rgya gar byang rgyud yongs rdzogs dang ṇ+ḍaliṅga dang bcas pa'i lho phyogs kyi cha shas 'ga' zhig yod/ dga' bo'i rgyal rabs tsho'i skabs su rgyal ba pa'i ring lugs dang / sangs rgyas pa'i ring lugs gnyis dar rgyas gcig car du byung ba yin zhes lo rgyus mkhan tshos bzhed/pad+ma chen po dga' bo de'i rgyud 'dzin khong gi sras brgyad kyis rim bzhin rgyal sa bzung ba yin la/ dga' bo'i rgyal po tha ma ni dhanānan+da ste nor dga' 'am dga' bo nor yin zhing / de ni 'chad 'gyur gyi shrīka yul gyi dpa' bo sele3nyar gyi dbung 'jug skabs mgadha'i rgyal po red/ nan+da'am dga' bo'i rgyal po de tsho drag shul dang /dpal 'byor shin tu chen po byung yang / srid skyong tshul la mkhas po med pas mi mang tshos dga' po med tshod/ dmangs kyis dga' po med pa'am dga' bo med par ched du bzos pa gang yin yang rung / de la brten nas can+dagustamor+sha ste mor+sha'i rgyal po zla
116 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/ba sbas pas nan+da'i rgyal po'i rgyal srid bcom par las sla po byung yod ces byung rabs lo rgyus mkhan rnams mthun par bzhed/ de ltar yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi pa'i nang nan+da'i rgyal po tshos rgyal srid bzung zhing / yishu'i sngon gyi lo 325 la smar+sha'i rgyal po zla ba sbas pas mgadha'i rgyal srid bzung bar 'ogaci tu 'chad par 'gyur ro//de skabs spyir btang gnas stangs/rgyal rabs kyi rim pa gong gsal ltar la/ de tsho'i skabs su srid don dang spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs ga 'dra zhig yod dam zhi na/ rang re nang pa'i mdo dang /skyes rabs sogs lung rnams dang / nub gling yuropa gi shrīka (07665) yul gyi byung rabs mkhas pa tsho'i 'bri rtsom la brten nas nga tshos dus skabs de'i gnas stangs gsal por shes thub/gong du bshad pa ltar 'phags yul byang rgyud der yul khag mang po zhig yod khongs nas 'ga' shas ni rgyal srid can yin la/ 'ga' shas spyi mthun rgyal khab yin zhing / de gnyis kyi ngo bo yang sngar bshad zin pa ltar yin/ spyi mthun rgyal khab khag tu yul gyi srid 'dzin mkhan de dmangs kyis 'dems pa'i srol yod kyang / rgyal srid can gyi rgyal khab khag tu ni rgyal po zhes pa de gang zag phal pa dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar khyad par can gyi skyes bu chos dang mi mang gnyis na'i srung skyob byed mkhan yin par ngos 'dzin byed/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos ma dar ba'i sngon bram ze tshos chos kyi cho ga sna tshogs byas nas rgyal po rnams ni lha yi ngo bo yin pa las mi phal pa dang mi 'dra zhes brjod nas rgyal po rnams shugs chen po bzos pa dang / bram ze 'ga' shas kyis mdun na 'don dang / 'ga' shas kyis blon chen sogs byas te/ dngos don du
