162 'phags yul 3 grang ba brjod pa/la engaskyuṇ+ḍar grongs pa red/ khong 'das pa na khong gi rgyal khams chen po der zing 'khrug byung rkyen dmag dpon tshos rgyal khams chen po de bgo bsha' brgyabs nas dmag dpon so sos skyong rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa ltar bskyangs pa red/khracheskyuṇ+ḍar gyis dpung 'jug las byung ba'i shugs rkyen nam do phogbyung rabs mkhan 'ga' shas kyis yengaskyuṇ+ḍar gyis btsan rgol byas pa de zhar byung du gleng ba tsam las/ de las shugs rkyen nam do phog chen po gang yang byung med tshul dang / rma bzos pa de 'phral du sos te/ kho'i dpung dmag dang rgyal kha tshang ma mi tshos brjed zin pa red/ ces zur za'i bshad pa byas yod/ 'on kyang byung rabs la mkhas pa mang che bas yengaskyuṇ+ḍar de rlung 'tshub ltar bslebs nas char rlung drag po lta bur phyen pa red ces gal chen pos bshad pa byed/ de ltar byung rabs mkhan tshos 'dra min sna tshogs bshad pa tsam las dngos 'brel gyi bshad pa nyung shas las mi snang /rgya gar gyi byung rabs 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir gnad don 'di ma bshad par bzhag na ma 'grig pa cher med kyang / rang re bod pa tshos e.iñdziṣ+ṭar gyi skor shes mkhan dkon zhing gsal bris byas pa nyung bas skabs 'dir gsal bshad nan tan byas pa yin/ 'on kyang dpa' bo de'i lo rgyus zhib rgyas ni 'dir skabs su ma babs pas mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa yin/67skyuṇ+ḍar gyi tshong dang drag po'i 'char gzhi des shar gling dang nub gling gnyis kyi dpal 'byor 5na tshogs yong ba'i sgo phyes yod par ma zad khong gi 'grul bzhud la brten nas meṇ+ḍa9drenigan (5071(3ngalngas0lngas) gyi yul rnams la 'dzam gling
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyibyung rabs/ 163'di'i skor la shes rgya che ru phyin pa red/seletāṇ+ḍar gyis shar phyogs kyi yul khams rnams nub phyogs dang mthun par bzo rgyu'i thugs 'dod gnang ba dang / de'i ched du khong rang dang mnyam du byung rabs la mkhas pa dang / 'khrul las la mkhas pa rnams khrid yong ba red/ gang laḍa zer na khong gis dmag 'khrug tsam byed rgyu'i bsam rgya chung chung ma yin par dbang bsgyur ba'i sa cha'am sa khul khag tu gtan 'jags 'dzin skyong bya rgyu'i thugs bsam bzhes yod pa red/ khong rang nyid rgya gar nas rang yul du log khar gtan 'jags chab srid 'dzin skyong byed mkhan bzhag pa des khong gi phug rgyang ring po'i bsam blo de gsal bar mablardon thub/rgya gar gyi sa thog tu bzhuḍa yun thung thung rla ba bcu dgu'i ring rgya gar gyi dbang 'dzin pa rgyal po rnams dang dmag 'khrug brgyabs nas brel zing chen po de lta bu'i ngang la yang khong gis dbang du bsdus pa'i sa khul tsho la chab srid 'dzin skyong tshags tshud gnang thub pa dang / shin hu rgyas spros can 3 'dzin skyong gra grag byas pa des mele〉ṇ+ḍar ni g.yul las la mkhas pa'i dpa' bo zhig yin pa tsam ma yin par phug bsam can gyi chab srid 'dzin skyong byed mkhan zhig kyang yin par bstan pa red/khong ni sa thag ring po de lta bu nas phebs pa de 'phrog bcom byas te so so'i sger gyi phun tshogs bzo ba'i ched du yong ba ma yin zhing / gzhan la sdug po gtong ba'i ched du yang yong ba min par dmigs yul lte ba ni rgyal khams chen po zhig 'dzug skrun ched yong ba zhig red/ (ka gi dbang cha'i lhag ma de lo gnyis rjes su panāb dang sidha nas yal na yang / shrīka gi grong khyer khag ni dus ring po'i bar gnas yod pa red/spyi tshogs kyi cha nas yeseskyuṇ+ḍar gyis dpung 'jug byas pa des rgya gar gyi spyi
164 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/tshogs la do phog gang yang ma byung zhing de las ldog ste :ka gi mi rgya gar du bsdad pa de rnams rim bzhin rgya gar gyi chos lugs su zhugs te rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs su thim pas rjes su de tshor rtsad bcad kyang mi snang bar gyur 'dugsrid don gyi cha nas melerjenyar gyis dpung 'jug byas pa las rgya gar gyi srid don gyi gnas stangs la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba ni/ dbung 'jug des rgya gar gyi rgyal khab mang po skyo po bzos pa la brten nas yul dbus kyi rgyal po zla ba sbas pa zhes pa mor+sha'i rgyal pos de tsho pham par byas te rgyal khams chen po zhig 'dzug skrun byed par phan thogs chen po byung bar ma zad (ka gis dpung 'jug byas pa de las rgya gar du srid don 9 chig sgril yong bar phan thogs chen po byung yod/ dpung 'jug de las rgya gar la slob gso chen po zhig thebs yod pa ni yul du dpa' rtsal dang ldan zhing go lag sogs legs par ldan pa'i drag po'i dpung dmag stobs chen po phyi logs nas dpung 'jug btsan rgol byung che gdong len byed nus pa zhig dgos par gzhi nas shes pa red/de'i sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po tsho la rkang dmag dang / rta dmag dang / shing rta 'khor lo zhon mkhan gyi dpung dmag chen po yod kyang / de tsho gcig gyur men pa dang /bkod 'doms ma bde ba lta bu zhig yod 'dugspyi tshogs dang shes rig gi 'brel lam che shos ni shrīka gi dpung 'jug pa tsho'i rgyud nas shar phyogs kyi ya rabs spyod tshul dang / nub phyogs kyi ya rabs spyod tshul gyi bar du 'brel lam thog ma de byung ba red/ de nas bzung ste shar nub bar yig zam dang / 'grul bzhud yar rgyas su phyin te phan tshun 'brel ba brtan po chags pa de nam yang nyams chags su phyin med pa dang / shar nub gnyis kyi bar mtsho lam dang / sa thog gi lam gnyis ka bad spyod kyis gnyis ku'i bar 'brel thag nye ru phyin
le'udang po/ sngonadus7byung rabs/ 165pas phan tshun bsam shes go rtogs che ru phyin yod pa red/ ོsa gzhi'i gnas stangs kyi cha nas bshad na oyeskyuṇ+ḍar gyis mtsho lam nas 'grul bzhud dang / ya yud che ba'i 'grul bzhud gzhan khag gi 'char gzhi bkod pa des khong gi dus skabs kyi sa gzhi'i rgya kyon gyi tshad rgya che ru phyin yod cing / yig phrin gyi lam gsar pa sgo phyes pa dang / rgya mtsho'i brgyud tshong las a+yau sgo gsar du phyes yod pa red/byung rabs sam lo rgyus kyi cha nas 6le〉ṇ+ḍar gyi phyag rogs tshos khong gi lo rgyus kyi yig cha lo dus zla tshog gsal por bkod pa de tsho las dus phyis rgya gar du srid don gyi 'gyur ba ga re byung min gyi lo tshogs kyi gzhi rtsa nges can gtan 'bebs bya ched phan thogs shin tu chen po byung yod/ dngos don du 6lerngaṇ+ḍar gyi dpung 'jug de m+pi rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs lo tshogs gtan 'bebs byed sa'i rtsa ba gcig pā de yin/ der ma zad rgya gar gyi dong tse'am/ ṭam sgor bzo skrun yar rgyas la (ka gi me tshos phan thogs chen po byung yod de/ rdo 'jog nas brnyed pa'i sngon dus su rgya gar la dbang sgyur byed mkhan rgyuka pa'i dong tse rnams ni bzo lta legs po rang med kyang / de la brten nas phyis su rgya gar du dong tse bzo legs pa mang po :ka gi lag rtsal ltar bzos yod pa red/ der ma zad shrīka dang 'brel ba byung ba'i grub 'bras gzhan zhig ni rgya gar gyi skar :sa kyi srol la helenika (561/3010) ste shrīka gi lugs srol 9 shan chen po zhugs yod par bshad/engaskyuṇ+ḍar gyis 'dzug skrun gyis rgya gar la 'dzug skrun byas pa'i rgyal khams de yun ring por ma gnas kyang / shrīka gi mi tsho las rgya gar la cha du ma'i sgo nas shugs rkyen thebs yod pa red/ dper na garnyura'i sgyu rtsal te dri za'i srol gyi bzo las kyi rig
166 'phagasayul 3 byung ba brjod pa/pa gsar pa zhig rgya gar la dar khyab byung ba de 6letāṇ+ḍar gyis dpung 'jug byas pa'i nus shugs khyad par 'phags pa zhig yin/ de lta na yang bzo rig des rgya gar gyi bzo rig gh+nā rtsal la dbang sgyur chen po byed ma thub pas dus phyis su lugs srol de nyams dmas su gyur/byung rabs smra ba 'ga' shas cas ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa tshos (ka pa dang mnyam 'brel ba byung ba kho na las sku brnyan bzhings rgyu shes pa red/ ces gsungs/shrīka dang rgya gar gyi 'brel lam las :ka pa tshos rgya gar las tshan rig dang / lta grub dang / ang rtsis dang / gso ba rig pa'i skor yag por shes te lob pa yin zhes byung rabs mkhas pa tshos bzhed/rgya gar gyi lta grub kyi shan shrīka gi lta grub dang shes rig la phar zhugs yod cing /rgya gar gyi mkhas pa 'ga' shas shrīka dang / yeshilā menor sogs la phebs nas :ka pa tsho dang phan tshun gleng mol dang bdar sha bcad yod nges te/ pāli skad du yod pa'i theg dman gyi bstan bcos mi.in+da'i dri ba zhes pa thig 'dug pa de nang pa'i dge slong klu yi byang chub la shrīka gi rgyal po milen+da zhes pas dre ba bkod pa la/ klu yi byang chub kyis lan btab pa yin zhing / de'i nang shing rta la dpe byas nas gang zag gi bdag med tshul shin tu snyan la rigs pa dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pas :ka pa dang nang pa gnyis bar du 'brel ba zab mo yod par go nus/smar+sha'i rgyal rgyud kyi mnga' thang dar rgyas/sngar bshad pa ltar yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang tsam du 'phags yul byang phyogs de skye bo'i ljongs te yul khams rang btsan pa bcu drug dang / spyi mthun rgyal khab du mar bgos yod pa dang / rim bzhin mgadha'i mnga' thang rgyas te
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 167byang khul du stobs che shos su gyur pa red/ de yang thog mar yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug pa'i nang mgadha zhes pa'i khongs su deng dus kyi paṭanā dang / g.yu sogs bihār lho rgyud kyi sa khul rnams las med kyang / klu yi gzhon nu dang / dga' bo'i rgyal rgyud rnams kyis rim bzhin rgyal khams gzhan dag kyang dbang du bsdus te mgadha zhes pa de rgya gar byang phyogs su stobs che shos su gyur pa red/nan+da'am dga' bo'i rgyal po tshos mnga' thang rgya skyed byas te/ ḍakan zhes pa'i lho phyogs kyai cha shas gang mtshams kyang dbang du bsdus pa dang / rgyal po de tshor dpung dmag mang po dang / bang mdzod kyang phyug po yod par gong du bshad pa ltar yin/ dga' bo'i rgyal rgyud tha ma ni dhanānan+da ste nor dga' yin la/ rgya gar byang nub rgyud la tsale〉ṇ+ḍar gyis btsan rgol dpung 'jug byas skabs nor dgas mgadha la dbang bsgyur ba'i dus skabs yin/nan+da'i rgyal po de tsho drag shugs che ba'i skor dang / dpal 'byor che ba'i skor rgya gar byang phyogs ma zad lho phyogs pa tshog kyang mang po bris 'dug pa ltar yin/ de lta na yang rgyal po de tsho chab srid 'dzin skyong la mkhas po rang med tshod/ der brten tshang mas dga' po mi byed pa dang / rgyal srid la blo kha mi khengs pa zhig yod 'dugde la brten nas lugs la mkhas pa drang srong tsār+shakya zer ba des rogs ram la brten nas mor+sha'i rigs kyi gzhon nu dpa' bo zla ba sbas pas nor dga' khri las phabs te dzor+sha'i rgyal rgyud thog mar 'go 'dzug byas pa red/mor+sha'i 7gong ma'i rgyal khams/ (yishu'i sngon lo 3254188)spyir btang byung rabs shes pa la khungs gtug sa tshad ldan dgos pa ltar/mor+sha'i rgyal rabs kyi khungs tshad ldan mang po yod pas thog mar khungs de tsho'i skor
168 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/mdo tsam 'bri bar bya ste/ de yang gal che shos ni/ mele〉ṇ+ḍar gyi rjes 'dzin pa :ka gi pho nya ba megasaning (50823153038) zhes pas bris pa'i iṇ+ḍaka (106178) zhes pa dang / tsār+shakya yis mdzad pa'i anashāsta ste don gyi bstan bcos dang / sngon rabs khag dang / maspriwasha ste rigs rgyud chen mo dang / muṅgārāk+ṣas ste srin po'i phyag rgya zhes pa'i bstan bcos rnams yin la/ 'di dag las rla ba sbas pa dang / 〈9kya gnyis kyis nor dga' khri las ji ltar phabs tshul gsal bar bstan yod/ der ma zad rgyal ba pa'i lung rnams su/ zla ba sbas pa de nyid rjes su rgyal po las dgongs pa zhus nas rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs su zhugs pa yin tshul 'khod 'dug chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis brkos bris khag kyang mornya'i skabs kyi byung rabs shes par gal che zhing /brkos bris khag kyang sirnyu'i skabs kyi rtags thel dang / khang thog sogs la brkos pa'i ri mo khag gi rjes su rgya gar du brkos bris rnying shos yin/ 'on kyang brkos bris 'di dag las smar+sha'i skabs kyi srid don gyi byung rabs las 'dzin skyong dang / spyi tshogs kyi rma che'i skor mang ba shes thub/ khungs de dag gi ngo sprod rgyas tsam zhig 'dir 'god par bya ste/〈gakya'i athaXlta/ ga4shāsta ste don gyi bstan bcos 'di ni srid gzhung gi 'gro stangs 'chad pa'i bstan bcos shig yin zhing / 'di la rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis yod cing gnyis ka mdzad pa po gcig gis brtsams pa yin/ mkhas pa re zung gis bstan bcos 'di smar+sha'i rjes su bris pa yin zhes bshad pa de mkhas pa mang che bas khas mi len zhing / de ni tsār+shakyas bris pa yin par bzhed/ tsā&kya la nasalā zhes kyang 'bod pa yin/ bod du phyis su bris nor gyis tsa na ka sogs bris pa ma dag par gdon mi za zhing / gang ltar lugs la mkhas pa drang srong tsa na ka zhes pa de slob dpon 'di
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 169nyid rang yin/yang mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis grub mtha' dang lag len shin tu mang ba'i bstan bcos 'di lta bu mi gcig gis 'bri thub pa srid dam snyam pa'i dogs pa bslangs pa la snying po gang yang med de/ phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos sku che gcig la bstan bcos pod grangs shin tu mang po bris yod pas mi gcig gis 'bri mi thub pa gang nas yong / des na don gyi bstan bcos zhes pa lugs kyi bstan bcos chen po 'di ni 〉〉kya'am yang na to:lus brtsams pa yin zhing / khong gis dga' bo'i rgyal po khri las 'bebs par rogs ram rgya che byas par ma zad mor+sha'i rgyal srid 'dzin skyong la las don rgya che byas pa red/ khong gis bstan bcos nang du srid don lam lhong 'byung thabs su mi dge ba'i bya ba khag mang po dang / rtsod pa can gyi thabs lam mang po zhig la 'jug tu rung bar bshad yod pas/ khong la rgya gar gyi mi gsod khram can zhes kyang brjod srol 'dugiṇ+ḍaka iṇ+ḍa1 zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyi deb 'di :ka gi mkhas pa megasganaja yis bris pa yin zhing / megasgani4 ni oyeskyuṇ+ḍar gyi dmag dpon selhakas (33105053)yis paṭanā la rla ba sbas pa'i 'gram du pho nyar btang ba yin pa dang / khong paṭanā la lo mang po bsdad de lo rgyus 'di bris pa yin/ de skabs kyi grong khyer paṭaX'i 'dzin skyong sogs kyi skor ni lo rgyus 'di 'ba' zhig las khungs gzhan med/ lo rgyus 'di'i nang du grong khyer 59liputra (paṭanā) ste skya nar bu'i grong de rgya gar gyi grong khyer che shos yin pa dang / grong khyer de shing gi lcags ri dang / sa dong gis bskor nas srung skyob byas yod tshul dang / srung skyob kyi las don de tsho mor+sha'i dmag mi sum rtsu yod pa'i tshogs pa zhig gis byed kyi yod tshul sogs 'khod 'dug 'on kyang deb 'di'i
170 'phags yul 9byung ba brjod pa/nang mi srid pa'i dngos po 'ga' shas kyang bris 'dug pa dper na lho phyogs pāṇ+ḍala'i yul du rkang pa gcig kho na yod pa'i mi dang / kha dang sna med pa'i mi dang / lo bdun tsam lon pa'i a ma yod tshul 'khod 'dug pa de tsho ni megasartswa rang nyid kyis mthong ma myong bar gzhan las thos pa tsam yig thog tu bkod pa yin nges zhes mkhas pa tshos gsungs/ gang ltar dpe deb 'de ni rgya gar gyi byung rabs shes par phan thogs shin tu che zhing khungs bzang shos su rtsi/muXrāk+ṣas ste srin po'i phyag rgya/ srin po'i phyag rgya zhes pa 'di zlos gar gyi bstan bcos zhig yin zhing / de ni gup+ta'i dus rabs su byung ba'i zlos gar rtsom pa po bishākhadat+ta ste sa gas byin zhes pas bris pa yin la/ 'di nyid mor+sha'i skabs su bris pa min rung mor+sha'i byung rabs shes par gal chen po yin te/ de'i nang mor+sha'i gsar rje'i skor bshad pa byas yod cing / zla ba sbas pa'i sku che la bde 'jags med pa'i skor sogs bshad 'dugmya ngan med kyi brkos bris khag mya ngan med kyu brkos bris khag gi skad ni rang bzhin pa'i skad dang / rgyuka gi skad dang / arlabaka skad rnams yin yang /bskos bris mang che ba ni :smyu yi ge'i nang yod/ mya ngan med kyi brkos yig rnams chos kyi yig cha yin yang de dag las khong gi sku tsho'i mdzad pa dang / grub 'bras dang /rgyal khab 'dzin skyong byed tshul skor gsal bar byed pas mdor bsdus na bskos yig 'di tsho mya ngan med kyi rnam thar lta bur rtsi chogsiṅgala'i rgyal rabs lo tshogs/ rdupawasha ge sgron me'i rgyud pa dang /ma〉washa ste rgyud pa chen po zhes pa 'di gnyis ni siṅgala'i yig cha rgyal rabs lo tshogs gtan 'bebs byed mkhan yin zhing / lo rgyus 'di gnyis ka nang pa'i yul gyi nang
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 171pa'i mis bris pa yin pa dang / nang pa'i mthong tshul ltar bkod pas don gnad 'ga' shas la skyon yod tshul byung rabs mkhan 'ga' shas kyis smra bar byed/ de tsho'i nang chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis dam chos khyab spel gnang tshul dang / skya nar bu'i grong khyer la bka' yi bsdu ba byung tshul sogs gsal por bkod yod/ 'on kyang khyad mtshar ba zhig la mya ngan med kyis ṇ+ḍaliṅga'i dmag 'khrug brgyabs tshul dang / nub phyogs yul khag tshor dam chos spel tshul skor 'khod mi 'dug gang ltar 'di gnyis ni mornya'i rgyal rabs shes par phan thogs che/lag rtsal dang khang bzang / dzor+sha'i skabs kyi khang bzang dang / lag rtsal sogs phyos su brnyed son byung ba rnams las kyang / de skabs kyi spyi tshogs kyi mi ñtsha dang / dpal 'byor dang / chos kyi 'tsho ba sogs rjes su dpog nus pa yod/ de lta bu'i khungs dang gzhi rtsa rnams la 'chad 'gyur gyi mor+sha'i rgyal rabs skabs kyi byung ba rnams brten pa yin par shes par bya la/ de bzhin mor+sha'i rgyal khams dang rgyal po rnams kyi byung ba 'chad par bya'o/mor+sha'i rgyal po zla ba sbas pa/ (eshu'i sngon lo 325pha01)yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi pa'i bzhi cha tha ma'i nang (325) drang srong tsā&kya yis mnyam 'brel grogs ram la brten nas mor+sha'i rigs kyi zla ba sbas pas dga' bo'i rgyal rgyud tha ma nor dga' de khri la sa phabs te mor+sha'i rgyal rabs gyi gzhi btsugs shing / rgyal rabs de nyid yishu'i sngon 3 lo 188 bar du gnas pa yin/dga' bo'i rgyal srid bcom par byas pa de zla ba sbas pa dang / 〈9kya gnyis kyi nang nas su'i mthu nus che ba byung min bshad pa shin tu dka' ste/ drang srong de srid byus
172 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/shin tu mkhas shing spyang grung che ba dang / zla ba sbas pa dpa' rtsal che zhing dmag 'thab mkhas pa gnyis gal che chung mtshungs pa yin tshod/ gang ltar mornya 7gong ma'i rgyal srid kyi gzhi rtsa tshugs pa de ni rgya gar gyi byung rabs nang 'gran zla med pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/mor+sha'i rgyal po zla ba sbas pa 'di yi pha mes kyi rigs rgyud skor rgya gar gyi mkhas pa tsho'i bzhid pa mi mthun yang / phal cher de ni ri bo dngas can (517lnga/lnga5lngas)pa'i rigs rgyud cig yin tshod/ mornya'i mi tshos de dag rgyal rigs yin tshul bshad/'on kyang bram ze tshos ni smar+sha'i mi rnams ni gdol pa'i rigs las bzang ba min zhes zer/ khyab 'jug gi sngon rabs dang / tsāgakya gnyis kyis smar+sha zla ba sbas pa de rgyal po nor dga'i nal phrug gam byaṃ phrug yin zhes bshad/ nang pa'i gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar na ni zla ba sbas pa de ni ri bo gangs can kyi nye 'dab pispangawan sa khul gyi mor+sha'i rgyal rigs shig yin tshul 'khod yod/gang ltar zla ba sbas pa de thog mar rgyal po dga' bo'i gzhung zhabs pa zhig ni nges par du yin/ rgyal pos kho la mi dga' ba byas pa'am/ yang na rgyu rkyen gzhan gyis de rgyal po nor dga' khri las 'bebs pa'i las don la zhugs pa zhig red/byung rabs mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis gsungs don ltar na/ smar+sha'i rla ba sbas pa de panāb la phyin nas oyeskyuṇ+ḍar dang thug 'phrad kyis yul mgadha la dpung 'jug btsan rgol byed dgos par bskul ba red/ 'on kyang shāka gi dbung 'jug pa tshos mornya zla ba sbas pa'i skad cha lab stangs dang / spyod lam la ma dga' bas ma tshad zla ba sbas pa de 'dzir bzung bya dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba red/ 'on kyang zla ba sbas pa de 'dzin bzung ma thub par shāka gi sdod sgar nas bros thar byung ba red/ 6beskyuṇ+ḍar
le'udangapo/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 173rgya gar nas phyir thon byas te be'ilon la 'das grongs phyin pa'i rjes su dzor+sha zla ba sbas pas go sgrigs kyis panāb khul du :ka gi srid dbang la ngo rgol mthar phyin byas pa red/byas 'bras/ de nas kha/gas la mkhas pa nagakya 'am shasalu dang mnyam 'brel gyis pajub dang / timālaga'i rgyal phran rnams kyi mthun 'brel sogs la brten nas rla ba sbas pas mgadha'i rgyal po nor dga' khri las phabs te bsad pa red/de ltar d+marnya zla ba sbas pa'i byas 'bras che ba dang po ni/ dga' bo'i rgyal srid bcom nas dzor+sha'i rgyal srid kyai rmang gzhi btsugs pa de yin/zla ba sbas pa de ni dmag 'thab la mkhas shing nus stobs che ba'i rgyal po zhig yin pas/ rgya gar nub rgyud kyi sa khul khag kyang dbang du bsdus pa red/ byas 'bras chen po gnyis pa ni/ rgya gar byang nub kyi mnga' khul de spru rgyal gyi dbang 'og nas bcings bkrol gtong ba de yin zhing / byang nub kyi sa khul khag tu phyo rgyal ba'i srid dbang la mi dga' ba'i gnas tshul des mor+sha zla ba sbas pa'i las don de la phan khyad chen po byung yod pa red/ de yang kuñtshar zer ba'i sa khul nang gi shāka gi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan rgya gar ba'i dpon rigs la ngo log byung zhing / sirnyu lung pa'i stod kyi srid skyong phi'ipas (251119943) zer ba de yishu'i sngon gyi lo 225 lor bsad pas sa khul der shrīka gi stobs shugs nyams dmas su gyur/mornya zla ba sbas pas sirnyu smad de bcings bkrol gtong rgyu'i 'go 'dzugs byas pa de la phelepasma yi rjes 'dzin pas ya lan ma bslog par rgya gar nas phyir thon byas na legs par mthong nas yishu'i sngon gyi lo 317 lor phyor log byas pa red/ der brten zla ba sbas pas panāb dang sirnyu gnyis ka dbang 'og tu bsdus pa red/shrīka gi dmag dpon se3kas nigegar (331khu6khu6 7160(01) gyis rgya gar gyi
174 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/mnga' khul shor ba rnams slar len thabs byed 'dod byung yang / yengañtsaṇ+ḍar skabs dang mi 'dra bar senyukas skabs 'dir gcig sgril can gyi rgya gar gyi rgyal po stobs chen zhig gi gdong len byed dgos byung zhing / mor+sha zla ba sbas pas dbung 'jug byed bzhin pa dang thug pa red/ zla ba sbas pa dang / shrīka bar dmag 'khrug byung min gsal por ma shes kyang / se3kas dang / zla ba sbas pa gnyis bar chengs yig bzhag par gsal por shes thub/ari0rgyu (811lnga) dang garakosekhu/ (872050318) sogs sa khul rnams se3kas yis rla ba sbas pa la rtsis sprod byas shing / de dag gi tshab tu rgya gar gyi 7gong ma zla ba sbas pa las glang chen lnga brgya tham pa se3kas la thob pa red/ de ltar shrīka gis bzung ba'i sa khul khag thob nas mor+sha 7gong ma'i mnga' ris kyi mtshams hi(kusha bar du rgya bskyed byung ba red/ sa mtshams de ni dngos don du rigs pa dang 'brel ba'i rgya gar gyi sa mtshams yin/shāka gi dbang 'dzin pa dang / mor+sha gnyis bar mthun 'brel dam zab du gyur te/ se3kas yi sras mo telānade mornya zla ba sbas pa'i btsun mor gyur pas phan tshun gnyen 'brel byas/ der ma zad se3kas yis rang gi sku tshab megasganing(smi3343(56733) skya nar bu'i grong khyer du zla ba sbas pa'i drung du btang ba des da dung 'brel lam dam zab tu phyin pa red/ megazesnang de grong khyer skya nar bu la lo mang po bsdad de rgya gar gyi byung rabs lo rgyus e kā zhes pa'i grags can de bris pa red/mor+sha zla ba sbas pas gungarwata dang / kāk+ṣaXbār bcas dbang 'og tu bsdus kyang ga dus dbang du bsdus min gsal por ma shes/ mor+sha'i 7gong ma zu ba sbas pa'i mnga' ris de lho phyogs su ri bo 'thigs byed brgal nas rgya skyed byas yod min gsal
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 175por ma shes kyang / byung rabs mkhas pa rāgatsun+tas+thā (5lnga〉 050575571) ltar byas na dga' bo'i rgyal rabs kyis ḍamin zer ba'i lho phyogs mnga' khul de la dbang sgyur byas pas/ zla ba sbas pa la yang mnga' khul de dga' bo'i rgyal po las thob dgos pa chos nyid yin zhing gsungs/ 'on kyang mkhas dbang simitha (27 8lo115) yis rla ba sbas pa de shin tu brel ba che bas rgya gar lho phyogs la dbang sgyur ba'i dus skabs thob med par bsam zhes gsungs/ deng dus kyi gnas stangs la bsam na ḍamin dang /lho phyogs kyi cha 'ga' shas zla ba sbas pa'i rjes su khong gi sras thig le snying pos dbang du bsdus yod srid/rgyal ba pa'i lung rnams las rla ba sbas pa'i che smad kyi skor gsal kha dod pa zhig bshad yod pa ni rgya gar byang phyogs su mu ge chen po zhig byung ba'i 'bras bur rgyal ba pa'i rjes 'jug pa chig khri nyis stong (12000) dpung bzang gi sme khrid 'og lho phyogs kunuṭaka'i sa gnas sarawan beladol zer bar smin pa dang / de tsho'i mnyam du mor+sha'i rgyal po zla ba sbas pa yang phyin nas de gar sku che las 'das pa yin zhes gsal/mor+sha'i 7gong ma zla ba sbas pa'i mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon/ mor+sha'i 7gong ma zla ba sbas pa'i mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon ni/ byang phyogs ri bo gangs can (517lnga/ku5lnga)nas lho phyogs mesur bar dang / shar phyogs baṅgāl nas nub phyogs garab gyi rgya mtsho dang aphashāni1na par khyab yod/ 'on kyang gong du bshad zin pa ltar mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis smar+sha zla ba sbas pas lho phyogs su ri bo 'bigs byed dang / satabur brgal nas rgya skyed ma byas shing / sras thig le snying pos lho phyogs dbang sgyur byas pa yin tshul gsungs pa ltar na ni lho phyogs kyi sa mtshams ri bo 'bigs byed bar du yod dgos/ mya ngan med kyis lho shar spruliṅga ma gtogs dbang du bsdu bya lhag mi 'dug
176 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/pas lho phyogs kyi mnga' /sdul gzhan rnams yang na ni zla ba sbas pas dbang du bsdus pa yin la yang na ni thig le snying pos dbang du bsdus pa yin dgos/mtha' bsdoms/ mor+sha'i 7gong ma zu ba sbas pa de nyid m+pi rgya gar du 7gong ma'i rgyal srid 'dzugs skrun byed mkhan chen po'i gras zhig yin zhing / des 'dzugs lta/ spra ༵ zloshā paXng rnyiX sbyaX lha ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ /dri ༷ ṭ+wāṃ dā ༷ zloji / 'dzi( zlos ༵da (sta lha ni spus legs shing tshags su tshud pa cha mang po'i thad nas yar thon ldan pa zhig yin/mornya'i dus skabs su shes rig la gar rgyas phyin pa de zla ba sbas pas dmiḍa yul chen po de'i don du mthun sbyor cha tshang bed spyod byas pa las byung ba zhig yin la/ zla ba sbas pas rgyal srid bskyangs pa de la brten nas rgya gar du srid don gyi chig sgril thog mar byung ba red/ mor+sha'i 7gong ma rla ba sbas pa'i mnga' thang rgyas tshul skor sgro btags dang / phul byung gi bshad pa sna tshogs 'dug kyang / de dag thams cad mkhas pas khas blang bar bya ba ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag na legs/thig le snying po (yishu'i sngon lo 3004273)mor+sha zu ba sbas pa'i rjes su de'i sras bisdusar te thig le snying pos rgyal sa bzung zhing / 〈9kya yis rgyal po 'di yi gzhung zhabs pa yang byas/ bod kyai byung rabs la mkhas pa hānānāthas thig le snying po 'dis rang gi mnga' ris shar nub kyi rgya mtsho gnyis bar du rgya skyed byas tshul gsungs shing / shar nub kyi rgya mtsho gnyis bar rgya skyed byas pa'i go don ni gzhan gang yang min par rgya gar lho phyogs kyi cha shas mang che ba dbang du bsdus pa la nges par go dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang hārwanāthas thig le snying
le'u dang po/ sngon dus m+pi byung rabs/ 177po de mya ngan med 3 rjes su bzhag 'dug pa sogs rgyal rabs gong 'og 'chol la lo dus ma 'grigs pa mang bas yid brtan dka'/chos rgyal mya ngan med la kraliṅga gcig pu ma gtoḍa dbang du bsdu bya lhag med pas rgya gar lho phyogs kyi cha shas gzhan rnams thig le snying po'i skabs mor+sha'i mnga' 'og tu nges par du yod dgos/ smar+sha'i 7gong ma tshog rgya gar lho phyogs su mnga' ris rgya skyed byas tshul skor lho phyogs kyi tamil 9 gzhung lugs sarlam zhes pa'i nang du yang 'khod yod 'dug rgya gar gyi lho mtha'i mthar thug sa'i sa khul col dang /cer dang / pāñtsi dang / sa65dra'i rgyal khams rnams ni smar+sha 7gong ma'i mnga' ris su med/ ālidra'i rgyal po kharawelas hāsprigumapa la btsugs pa'i brkos bris nang lo 112 sngon hāmil tshogs pa zhig yod skor gsal bas ṇ+ḍaliṅga dang mnyam hāmil tsho yang thun mong gi dgra mornya'i kha gtad du langs yod par the tshom bral/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten pas 〉mil gyi rgyal khams de smar+sha'i mnga' 'og tu tshud med de/ mya ngan med kyi brkos bris khag tu yang / col dang / cer dang / pākyu dang / sacaputra'i rgyal khams rnams mor+sha 7gong ma'i mnga' ris kyi phyi logs su yod par gsal yod/'dir shes dgos pa zhig la/ tamil zhis pa de deng sang gi tamilanā1 zhes pa'i mnga' sde 'di tsam la go rgyu ma yin par rgya gar gyi lho mtha'i ce khul deng dus geral yi sa khul 'ga' shas kyang tshud pa'i tumil gyi rgyal khams de la do dgos/thig le lhang pos shrīka gi dbang 'dzin pa tsho dang mdza' 'brel mu mthud bskyangs pa dang / skya nar bu'i grong khyer du shrīka gi gzhung tshab pa megasaXja tshab tu ṇ+ḍalamakos (231sku'i0503) bskos pa dang / de'i brgyud thig le snying pos shrīka gi rgyal po e:otos dang po (80(100503—1) la chang mngar mo dang / phig (60437
178 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjodapa/bu'i33) zer ba'i shing tog mngar mo skam po dang / g.yo rtsed mkhan zhig bcas dgos 'dun zhus par/ chang mngar mo dang / shing tog phig gnyis khong la phul yang /g.yo rtsed mkhan ma thob pa red/ shrīka gi rgyal po e:otos dang pos thig le snying po la lan phul don/ nga tshos khyod la chang mngar mo dang phig phul yod pa dgyes bzhes dang / 'on kyang rgyuka gi khrims la g.yo rtsod pa 'tshong gtong byed par dgag bya yod pas dgongs 'gal med par zhu/ zhes 'khod 'dugsiṅgala'i rgyal rabs ston byed mahā.āsha zhes pa'i nang thig le snying po'i btsun mo btsu drug las sras brgya tham pa byung tshul bshad kyang / mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis mahā.āsha'i nang du skabs 'dir bden pa ma bshad pa yin zhes bzhid/ gang ltar thig le snying po la sras mang po yod pa ni mya ngan med kyi brag bskos bka' khyab lnga pa'i nang du gsal zhing / de yang thig le snying po'i sras che ba ni sur+sām dang / de nas bigatagashoka dang / de nas gshoka yin par gsal/gshoka ste mya ngan med kyis yul rdo 'jog dang / 'phags rgyal la rang gi yab thig le snying po'i rgyal tshab tu bzhugs/ yab thig le snying po 'da' khar mya ngan med skya nar bu'i grong du myur bar phebs/ phal cher yishu'i sngon gyi lo 273 la thig le sming po grongs yod pa red/ mya ngan med de sras rgan shos min na yang ngo rgol byed mkhan tshang ma bsad de yab kyi rgyal sa bzung ba yin par mngon/ mahā.āsha'i nang /mya ngan med kyis rang gi spun dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa yin zhes bris 'dug pa bden min ma shes/ gang ltar mya ngan med shin tu khag po'i sgo nas khri la 'khod yod par thag chod/ mya ngan med ni mor+sha'i rgyal po tshang ma'i nang nas stobs che shos dang /byas rjes che shos yin pa dang / 'dzam gling na snyan par grags pa'i chos rgyal zhig
le'u dang po/ sngon dus3 byung rabs/ 179yin pas 'og hu dmigs bsal gyis 'chad par 'gyur la/ skabs 'dir mor+sha'i rgyal srid skabs 'dzin skyong byed tshul sogs byung zad 'god par bya'o//smar+sha'i 'dzin skyong/ mor+sha'i dus rabs de ni rgyal srid rgya cher skyong ba'i dus rabs shig yin la/ zla ba sbas pa dang / tsugakya gnyis kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi lam srol la brten nas yul lung phyogs sgril byed ched gzhan thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlags pa red/ der brten smar+sha'i rgyal srid 'dzin skyong de ji 'dra zhig yin min skor byung rabs mkhan rnams la dogs pa yong srid pa chos nyid yin/ngo bo'i sgo nas mor+sha'i 'dzin skyong de drag po'i dbang 'dzin gyi lugs ma yin zhing / srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi lugs srol yang min/ 'dzin skyong gi dmigs yul tha ma ni rgya che'i yul mi rnams la nang gi sems dang / phyi'i dngos po gnyis ku'i thad nas phan bde 'byung thabs de yin pa red/ des na mor+sha'i rgyal srid 'dzin skyong de drag po'i gzhung gi srid dbang sger 'dzin zhig min par nges pa yin/dbus gzhung / mor+sha'i srid dbang 'dzin skyong gi yang rtser 7gong ma rang nyid gnas shing / de la dbang cha cha tshang yod kyang / des rang gi blon po tsho'i 'dod pa dang / gsal 'debs la gsan 'jog byed pa yin/ smar+sha'i rgyal po tshos rang nyid lha'am dkon mchog gi sprul pa yin pa'am khyad par du 'phags pa'i gang zag zhig yin pa'i bsam blo nam yang gtong med/ rgyal po ni khrims bzo mkhan zhig min par khong gi bka' nyid khrims yin/rgyal po la blon chen lhan tshogs zhig gis phyag rogs zhu zhing lhan tshogs de'i nang du srid blon dang / mdun na 'don dang / dmag dpon nam dmag spyi chen mo dang / rgyal tshab sogs yod pa red/ blon po rnams ni spyir btang spyod pa bzang
180 'phagasayul 9byung ba brjod pa/zhing 'jon thang can gyi mi yin la/ blon po'i grangs tshad ni nges pa gtan nas med/blon po de rnams las gcig gam/ yang na du ma su la gros sdur byed min rgyal po la rang dbang gtsang ma yod/blon po tsho'i 'og tu dpon rigs mang po zhig yod pa de tshos dpal 'byor dang /mi mang 'dzugs skrun las don khang dang / rgyal po'i yig 'brel khang sogs kyi dbu 'dzin byed/ der ma zad tshong las sde tshan dang / bre srang sogs tshad 'jal sde tshan dang / gos 'thag las dang / so nam sogs kyi sde tshan gyi do dam pa mang po yod/rgyal srid kyis spyi tshogs 9 las don sna tshogs kyang lag len bltar gyi yod pa red/mdor na mor+sha'i 'dzin skyong de gzhung zhabs dpon rigs lam lugs (6570lnga'i07805)sheg yin 'dugbud med tshos rgyal po'i sku sger gyi zhabs 'degs tshang ma zhu srol yod pa dper na zas la dug gi nyen kha las srung skyob bya rgyu dang / btsun mo'i gnas khang du gsang nyul ba 'gog thabs sogs las 'gan mang po zhig bud med tshos byed dgos pa yin/'dzin skyong gi cha shas/ mornya 7gong ma'i mnga' ris de mnga' sde khag mang por bgos shing / dbus kyi mnga' sde lte ba de 7gong ma rang nyid kyis bskyangs shing /mnga' sde gzhan rnams rgyal po'i nang mi'am nye 'brel rnams kyis bskyangs/ dper na rdo 'jog dang / 'phags rgyal gnyis la thig le snying po'i rgyal tshab mya ngan med kyis gnang ba ltar red/ 'dzin skyong gi cha shas dma' shos ni grong gseb yin zhing / de ni grong gi sde pa'am/ grong dpon gyis bskyangs/ grong gseb lnga nas bcu'i steng la dopa ste srung ba po zhes pa re yod/ gopa'i khyab khongs las che ba ni sdunika ste gnas skyong ba zhes pa de yin la/ de'i gong la rdzong gi dpon po dang / de'i gong la srid
le'u dang po/ sngon dus m+pi byung rabs/ 181skyong ngam phradesheka ste zhing chen skyong ba zhes pa rnams yin/dpal 'byor/ samaharta ste yongs su bsdu ba pos rgyal khams yongs rdzogs nas khral bsdu ba'i las don byed cing de la lta rtogs byed/ zhing sa gshin po ni yong khungs gtso bo yin/ so nam pa rnams las thon skyed kyi drug cha gcig khral gyi tshul du sdud kyi yod pa red/ yong khungs gzhan khag ni dud 'gro'i rtsa thang khag dang / gter kha dang / nags tshal sogs yin/ grong dang grong khyer khag gi yong 'babs kyi khungs ni/ lam khral dang / chad pa dang / bre srang sogs tshad 'jal byed la brtag dpyad byas pa'i gla cha dang / skor bya ba'i las don dang / yul gyi pe shag dang / phyi skyod lag khyer dang / chang rag dang bshas khang dang / skud pa bzo ba dang / snum dang mar khu dang / bye ma ka ra dang gser bzo ba dang / dos khang dang / smad 'tshong ma'i gnas dang / sho sbag sogs kyi rtsed khang dang / shing bzo dang lag shes pa'i skyid sdug tshogs khag dang / lha khang dang / ltad mo ston mkhan tshogs pa khag grong khyer du 'dzul zhugs ched blangs pa'i khral sogs khral rigs rnams yin/yongs su bsdu ba po de ni 'gro gron gyi do dam pa yang yin zhing / 'gro song gtong yul gtso bo ni rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i nang las dang / rgyal po'i sku tshab rnams dang / dos khang dang / dbul phongs la skyob gso dang / chos dang /dmag mi sogs yin la/ 'gro gron la 'char can gyi 'gro gron dang / slo bur gyi 'gro gron dang / mtshams mtshams la gtong dgos pa'i res 'ga' ba sogs dbye ba mang po yod pa dang / gtan 'bebs byas pa'i deb skyel mang po zhig rtsis zhib ched nyar tshag byed kyi yod pa red/sa dmag dang mtsho dmag mor+sha'i 7gong ma zla ba sbas pa la gtan 'jags
182 'phagasayulagyi byung babarjod pa/dmag dpung chen po yod pa dang / rkang dmag drug 'bum (600000) dang /rta dmag sum khri (30000) dang / glang chen dmag mi dgu stong (9000) shing rta'i dmag mi nyis stong (2000) yod pa red/ zu ba sbas pa la mtsho dmag yod kyang ches chung ngu las med/megasgaXja yis 'thus mi lnga re yod pa'i tshogs pa drug gis drag po'i 'dzin ñdzadī chodad ((nga sgyu ṅge shā/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ du/ ga gaXhā tā ༵ kau zlam ba ra (sta shā /pa )pa/ ṭ+wāṃ sele〉ṇ+ḍar gyi dmag dpon tsho'i kha gtad du drag po'i dbu khrid gnang yod par ma zad/mya ngan med kyis spruliṅga'i g.yul sa ru dmag gi 'go khrid gnang ba red/ dmag spyis dmag gi 'go khrid byed srol de mya ngan med kyi rjes su ma gtogs byung med/ mya ngan med kyi rjes su rgyal po tshos dus nges can zhig la drag po'i spyi khyab pa'i dbu khrid pa'i dmag rtsed la gzigs zhib gnang gi yod pa dang / mor+sha'i 7gong ma tha ma de'i drag po'i spyi khyab rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen zhes pa des de 'dra'i gnas skabs su rang gi rje bo bkrongs nas rang nyid rgyal por gyur tshul 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur/mi tho grangs bsher/ mor+sha'i rgyal srid skabs su mi grangs tho bsher gyi las don de gtan 'jags sde tshan zhig gis byed cing / de la gtan 'jags gi dpon rigs yod pa red/ de'i dmigs yul ni srid don dang dpal 'byor gnyis ka yin zhing / de la brten nas rgyal khab kyis mi mang gi g.yo 'gul la kha lo bsgyur thub pa dang / rgyal khab kyi brtan cha nges can du bzo thub kyi yod par ma zad/ des phyi dngos po'i phun tshogs rnams kyang gtan 'bebs byed thub kyi yod pa red/mi grangs tho bsher gyi las don des grong gseb kyi gzhung zhabs pa tshos grong
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 183gseb re re'i nang gnas pa'i mi'i grangs dang mthun par tshang ma'i spyod tshul dang /dpal 'byor gyi kunas stangs shes thub pa dang / grong sde lhan tshogs kyis kyang las don de grong dang grong khyer sogs su byed pa yin/ der ma zad de tsho phyo rgyal gyi mi rnams kyi 'gro skyod dang / sa gnas su gtan sdod byed mkhan min pa'i mi rnams kyi tho yang 'dod kyi yod pa red/ grong gseb dang / grong khyer khag gi gzhung zhabs pa tshos bkod pa'i de lta bu'i yig cha deb skyel rnams dpon rigs sdong ma tshos brtag dpyad byas te khungs ldan yin par bsgrub dgos shing / gsang ba'i las don byed mkhan tshog snyan sgron zhus pa khag ni zur du brtag dpyad byed srol yod/khrims srol/ grong gseb khag tu grong gseb a+yau 'go dpon dang / bgres song rnams kyi gros bsdur 'og gnad don chung ngu khag thag gcod byed mkhan gyi dmiḍa bsal gyi khrims sa khag phud pas yul du khrims khang khag gnyis yod pa red/ khrims khang khag gnyis po de ni/ dharma:ga chos kyi gnas pa dang / kuṭaka〈snyan te cher ma sbyong byed zhes pa gnyis yin/ khrims khang rnam pa gnyis po de'i khyad par ji yin gsal po rang ma shes kyang phal cher dang po de spyir btang spyi tshogs nang gi kha mchu gtugs sa dang / gnyis pa de mi gsod rku 'phrog brdung rdeg sogs sdig can gyi kha mchu thag gcod mkhan yin las che/ khrims kyi lugs srol gyi yang rtse mthar thug sa ni 7gong ma nyid yin la de ni snyan sgron zhus pa'i don gnad tshang ma la dgongs bzhes kyis dus 'gyangs med par thag gcod gnang gi yod pa red/mi gsod rku 'phrog sogs sdig can gyi khrims lugs shin tu tsha po yod pas nyes chad drag po gtong gi yod pa red/ dper na rta lcag zhu ba dang / yan lag gcod 'breg dang / srog gi chad pa gcod pa sogs byed/ 'di 'dra'i nyes pa gtong
184 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/sa'i nag nyes kyo rigs khrims khang du zhus pa ni/ rkun ma dang / mi gsod dang /gab yib kyis 'jab 'dzul dang / btsan g.yem dang / so so'i rigs rus kyi khrims dang 'gal ba sogs yin zhing / mi srog bcad pa dang / lag shes mkhan gyi dbang po la skyon btang ba dang / chu rags gtor gshig byas pa dang / pan bzhi bcu (deng sang sgor mo 40 tsam) dang de las mang ba'i rku ma byas pa bcas ni srog thog tu gtong dgos pa'i nags nyes yin/grong sde lngan tshogs kyi 'dzin skyong / mor+sha'i dus rabs gyi grong khyer skya nar bu'i grong sde lhan tshogs kyi 'dzin skyong ji ltar yod med ni nga tshos iṇ+ḍaka 'ba' zhig las shes thub cing / dpe deb 'di yang rgya gar 9 byung rabs mkhan tsho la cha tshang thob med/iṇ+ḍigā ltar na skya nar bu'i grong khyer de rgya gar la de skabs kyi grong khyer che shos shā/ phru ji /nga / de rdo shā pasag ṭ+wāṃ shāshā na/ ra tsho (3 ༷ji ṭ+wāṃ ga/spya r+nghi dhī sdeX lha/ r+sha (tāk+ta) dang / zheng la le dbar gcig dang bzhi cha gsum (1(wa) yod pa la shing gi lcags ri dang / sa dong gi ra bas bskor yod pa red/grong khyer de ni 'thus mi sum rtsu yod pa'i grong sde lhan tshogs kyis dbang sgyur byed cing lhan tshogs de yang 'thus mi lnga re yod pa'i tshogs chung drug tu bgos yod/khyad mtshar ba zhib la rkosalnga'am cunakya yis grong sde 'dzin skyong gi tshogs chung 'di dag gi skor gang yang bris mi 'dug gcig byas na phyi rgyal tshos do snang byed yul de la sa gnas kyi mig do snang ma byas pa yang yin srid/grong sde lhan tshogs kyi tshogs chung drug po des lta rtogs bya rgyu ni/ bzo las
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 185dang / phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs dang mi tho grangs bsher dang / tshong las dang / dngos zog bzo 'don dang / de dag tshong 'grem dang / tshong khral bsdu len bcas red/de tsho'i nang nas phyi rgyal mi rigs las don gyi do dam byed mkhan tshogs chung sogs 9 grub 'bras ha cang bzang por byung bar the tshom gtsang chod yin pa ni nub phyogs kyi yul khag dang mnyam du smar+sha'i rgyal khab kyi tshong 'brel legs po byung ba las shes/grong sde lhan tshogs kyi gtso 'dzin la nagaraka ste grong khyer skyong zhes bya/ skya nar bu'i grong khyer gyi srang lam khag tu mtha' stong pa bzhag nas chu yur mu mthud bzos pa de grong khyer gyi mtha' ru sa dong gting ring ba'i ra ba'i nang du gtugs yod/ srang lam khag tu dngos po phan mi thogs pa dang / dzar dzer khag gcig tu spungs pa dang / lam du dzer po bzo ba sogs ni khrims 'gal yin pas chad pa phog pa'i gzhi yin/ khang pa rnams ni mang che ba ni shing las bzos pa yin pas/ me shor ba gsod mkhan ru khag kyang yod pa red/dge mtshan/ mor+sha'i 'dzin skyong de la dge mtshan nam/ legs pa'i cha shas dang nyes pa'i cha shas gnyis ka yod nges la/1) mor+sha'i 7gong ma'i rgyal srid 'og zhi ba'i sde tshan khag dang / drag po'i sde tshan gnyis khag khag phyes nas tshags su tshud po yod/2) mornyas gtan 'jags kyi dmag dpung dpa' mdzangs gnyis ldan bzhag yod pa des drag po'i g.yul ngor ga dus yin na yang dka' ngal med par gtong chog yod pa red/3) yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi pa'i skabs su yang smar+sha'i srid dbang 'og mi grangs tho gsher gyi sde tshan gtan 'jags zhig gtan 'jags gzhung zhabs pas
186 'phags yul 'a byung ba brjodapa/'dzin skyong byas pa de lta bu ni khyad chos can gyi gnas stangs zhig yin te deng sang yang mi grangs tho gsher gyi las ka ni lo bcu re'i rjes su byed pa ma gtogs gtan 'jags byed srol med/4) grong khyer skya nar bu'i grong sde lhan tshogs kyi 'dzin skyong de ni bsngags par 'os pa zhig yin la/ iṇ+ḍaka'i nang skya nar bu'i grong khyer lhan tshogs kyi skor ma gtogs bshad mi 'dug kyang / de ga nang bzhin mor+sha'i mnga' 'og gi grong khyer dang grong sde gzhan dag la yang de mtshungs yin par rigs pas grub pa yin/skyon cha/mor+sha'i rgyal srid skyong tshul de la mi dge ba'am skyon gyi cha yang yod pa dper na/1 mya ngan med ma gtoḍa smar+sha'i skabs su sdig spyod nag nyes la khrims shin tu drag po btang ba de ha cang thal drag pa zhig yin par mkhas pa tshos bzhed/2) mor+sha'i gzhung gis khral rigs sna tshogs pa zhig bsdu len byed srol des mi mang thog gnod smyud chen po yod nges/3 mor+sha'i gzhung gi gsang ba'i las don de shin tu tshags tshud dang / 'jon po yod kyang / de la brten nas mi mang tsho'i mi che la dka' ngal chen po zhig rtag tu byung yod par gdon mi za/4 skyes stobs las byung ba'i rgyal rgyud dang / rgyal po'i mdzad phrin tshang ma dus rtag tu legs par gnas ma thub par mor+sha'i 7gong ma thog ma gsum po de'i mnga' thang shin tu rgyas kyang / mya ngan med kyi rjes kyi rgyal po rnams 'jon po med pas mnga' ris rgya chen po de'i cha shas mang po shor ba sogs byung /
le'udang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 187mtha' bsdoms/mor+sha 7gong ma'i 'dzin skyong byed srol de tshags su tshud po yod pas sāta nywahan sogs mor+sha'i rjes 'dzin pa tsho la bka' drin shin tu che/ mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyi gsung ltar na mor+sha'i chab srid 'dzin skyong gi lugs srol de la erwan te stag gzig gi chab srid 'dzin skyong gi shan zhugs yod ces gsungs/ rgya gar byang nub kyi sa khul 'ga' shas su lo brgya phrag tsam ring stag gzig gis dbang 'dzin byas par brten mor+sha'i 'dzin skyong byed tshul la de'i shan zhuḍa yod srid/ 'on kyang shan ji tsam zhugs yod min bshad pa dka'/ gang ltar yishu'i sngon gyi brgya phrag bzhi pa lta bu'i sngon dus de la yang morla 7gong ma'i mnga' ris rgyal khams shin tu rgya che zhig la 'dzin skyong tsha9 tshud tshul ldan de lta bu ni 'jig rten 'di la mig dper 'os pa rmad du byung ba zhig yin par nges/ de ltar smar+sha'i skabs kyi byung ba spyir bshad nas mor+sha'i 7gong ma chen po mya ngan med a+yau skor dmigs kyis bkar nas 'god par bya'o//chos rgyal mya ngan med dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dar rgyas/mor+sha'i rgyal rgyud tsam du ma zad rgya gar gyi rgyal po tshang ma'i nang nas chos srid gnyis thad nas mdzad rjes che shos 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa ni mornya'i 7gong ma mya ngan med yin la/ khong gis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dar rgyas la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod pas de dag gi tshul mdo tsam zhig byung rabs dang mthun par bshad par bya ste/sku che'i mdzad pa/'dzam gling gi byung rabs nang du shin tu grags che ba chos rgyal mya ngan med ni
188 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/mor+sha'i 7gong ma dang po zla ba sbas pa'i tsha bo dang / yab thig le snying po'i sras yin zhing / phyi rgyal ba'i mkhas pa 'ga' shas (5 ku gag3113) kyis mya ngan med kyi rgyal srid de ni 'gro ba mi'i dka' sdug gi byung rabs nang bar gyi snang ba gsal shos shig red ces bshad pa byas yod/mya ngan med chung dus kyi sku che'i mdzad rnam dang mdzad spyod sogs kyi skor byung rabs mkhas pa tshos cung zad las shes thub med/ sgrung gtam lta bu'i bshad pa sna tshogs shig yod cing / lhag par du bod du yang mya ngan med kyi skor sgrung sna tshogs shig bshad srol 'dug kyang / tshad ldan byung rabs dang mthun par dka' zhing / byung rabs dang sgrung gtam gnyis mnyam bsre byed mkhan tshor dga' ba skyed pa tsam yin/nang pa'i bshad srol ltar na mya ngan med de sangs rgyas par ma gyur gong dbang phyug pa'i rjes 'jug pa yin tshod/ khong gi yab kyi dus su rdo 'jog (145118) la rgyal tshab gnang ba dang / de rjes yab 'da' khar uḍūn ste 'phags rgyal du rgyal tshab gyi mdzad khur bzhes te rgyal gces kyi dpa' bo zhig yin pa'i cha nas khong gis rang nyid kyi 'jon thang dang nus pa legs par bstan yod/ yishu'i sngon 9 lo 273 lor yab thig le snying po 'das rjes khong smar+sha'i rgyal sar 'khod/ rgyal sar 'khod tshul de shin tu dka' ba'i ngang nas 'khod yod tshod gong du bshad zin pa yin/ṇ+ḍaliso'i dmag 'khrugmya ngan med khri la 'khod rjes yishu'i sngon gyi lo 269 nas g.yul las kyi bya ba 'go 'dzugs byas shing / khong gi rgyal srid ring srid don gyi 'gyur ba gal che shos ni ṇ+ḍaliṅga'i rgyal khams mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa de yin/ de yang thog mar mya ngan med
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyibyungarabs/ 189kyis āliṅga'i rgyal khams de smar+sha'i mnga' 'og tu bsdu ba'i dgongs pa bzhes pa la dzoliṅgas 'dod mthun ma byas tshod/ der brten mthar khong khri la 'khod pa'i lo bcu gnyis pa la mya ngan med kyis spruliṅga la dmag 'khrug byas te drag po'i g.yul ngor zhuḍa pa'i dpa' bo'i mi ñtsha gsar pa zhig lag len du bstar ba red/g.yul 'khrug de'i nang du mi khri khrag gcig bsad pa dang / chig 'bum lnga khri (150000) 'dzin bzung dang / shin tu mang po'i dbang po'am gan lag la skyon byung yod pa red/kralilha'i dmag sa'i 'jigs su rung ba'i gtor skyon des mya ngan med kyi thugs la tshor ba gsar pa zhig skyes te/ drag po'i sgo nas gzhan la dbang sgyur gyi bya ba de la dge mtshan dang snying po ci yang med par ma zad/ nyes med kyi mi mang tsho'i 3 srog lus dang longs spyod bcas la shin tu mi rung ba'i gnod skyon 'ba' zhig las med par dgongs/ des na khong gi srid don gyi lag cha'i tshul du dmag 'khrug bya rgyu spangs nas chos kyi sgo nas dbang sgyur byed rgyu'i thag gcod gnang ba red/gnas tshul 'di m+pi byung rabs nang mtshungs zla med pa zhig yin pas/ byung rabs mkhan tshos 'char can bshad don ni/ mya ngan med kyis ālibla'i dmag 'khrug rjes drag pos dbang sgyur ram/ phyogs las rnam rgyal byed pa'i dus rabs de nang don rig pa'am chos kyis dbang sgyur byed pa'i dus rabs su bsgyur ba red ces brjod srol 'dugkraliṅga dbang du bsdus rjes dka' rnyog slong mkhan sa mtshams sa khul khag gi phyir du yang mya ngan med kyis sngar srol gyi srid byus dang / chad pa drag po gtong ba'i srid byus de spangs nas lhag bsam bzang po dang brtse sems kyi sgo nas de tsho'i mi ñtsha
190 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/skyel stangs la sgyur bcos dang / byams pa dang snying rje'i chos la 'jug dgos par bskul nas zhi bde yong ba'i thabs shes gnang ba red/ sdig can nag nyes can tsho'i khrims gcod la yang nyes chad yang du btang ba'i sgo nas mi che skyel stangs gtsang ma zhig yong rgyu'i 'bad pa gnang / lo re'i nang btson khang tshang ma thengs gcig sgo phyog te btson pa tshang ma glod dkrol thengs re btang / rang gi mnga' ris tsam ma zad/3 yi yul khams rnams su yang sems can kun la gzhan phan gyi bsam blo spel gnang ba red/ 'o/ nga gis rgyal sred 'dzin skyong gi tshul lugs rnams la chos dang mthun par legs bcos gnang ba dang / khong gi rgyal srid kyi dmigs yul ni/ chos sems chen po'i dpung dmag la byams dang snying rje'i mtshon chas spras te chos mthun gyi rgyal srid gong mthor gtong rgyu de red/mya ngan med kyi mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon/sngon dus su rgya gar gyi rgyal po sus kyang mya ngan med gyi mnga' ris lta bu shin tu rgya chen po la dbang bsgrur ba ma byung zhing / nub ekalā'i rgyuka dbang 'dzin pa tsho ni mya ngan med kyi khyim mches su gnas la/ kushagrwar te kha che'i yul de yang mya ngan med kyi mnga' khul yin/ shar phyogs kyi sa mtshams ni baṅgāl dang / miswār gyi ci ༷ladurga'i rdzong khul ni mya ngan med kyi lho mtha'i mnga' khul yin zhing / bsgrar+sā nye 'gram soparā dang / kuñdzarmāXr gyi giranār du yod pa'i brag brkos yig thog tu gsal ba ltar na mya ngan med kyi mnga' ris de lho nub garab kyi rgya mtsho la thug yod pa yin/spruleṅga'i dmag 'khrug tu mi gsod gtor bcom ya nga ba'i rkyen gyis nges 'byung skyes med na/ mya ngan med kyis rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rtse mo mthar thug tarmal de
le'u dang po/ sngonadus kyi byung rabs/ 191yang nges par tu dbang du bsdus yod kyi red/ 'on kyang rjos rgyal des dmag 'thab byed rgyu dang / btsan dbang gis yul khams dbang du sdud rgyu de spangs pas ṇ+ḍaliṅga dbang du bsdus rjes drar+sha po'i g.yul las gnang mi 'dugmya ngan med dang sangs rgyas pa'i chos/rgyal rabs dang / byung rabs khag tu mya ngan med 'di ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 7gong ma chen po zhig yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa khyab spel gyi sgo nas bstan skyong rgyal po zhig tu bshad pa byas dang byed bzhin yod/ nang pa'i yul gzhan khag mang po'i bshad srol ltar na/ 'phags pa nyer sbas kyis mya ngan med de nang pa sangs rgyas par bsgyur ba yin tshul bshad/ 'on kyang bod kyi bshad srol la ni dgra bcom pa grags pas mya ngan med la chos bstan par bzhed/ gang ltar spruleṅga'i g.yul 'khrug rjes su nang pa sangs rgyas par gyur pa yin par grub/ ṇ+ḍalilha'i dmag 'khrug nang 'gro ba mi yi tshi srog la gnod skyon byas pa de yi gun gsab lta bu zhig byed rgyu dang / de yang sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab spel gyi sgo nas phyi'i dngos po dang / nang gi sems stobs gnyis kra'i gnas stangs legs su gtong nas bya ba de bsgrub rgyu'i thugs thag bcad gnang ba red/ der brten mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab spel gyi las don rgya che ba sna tshogs shig gnang ba red/chos khyab spel/chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis rang gi 'bangs rnams khong rang gi dbu 'khrid 'og sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'brang thabs gnang nas sku che hril po gangs rgyas kyi chos kyi don du bya ba byas pa dang / de yang thog mar sems can gyi sha'i zas rigs spangs shing /
ya rab rdo 4༷ khuwa rijigacaXri༄wawawa rde lte || rnyi/
le'udang pa/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 193rgyal po'i gsol thab tu sha'i zas bzo bar dgag par mdzad/ sems can bsad de mchod sbyin byed pa'am dmar mchod byed mi chog pa'i bka' khyab gnang / sngar spro 'cham gyi 'grul bzhud zhes rgyal pos ngon byed srol yod pa de'i tshab tu chos kyi 'grul bzhud dam chos don gyi skor g.yeng gnang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'tsho bzhugs skabs dang / mya ngan las 'das pa sogs dang 'brel ba'i sa gnas rnams su gzigs skor mjal kha la phebs par mdzad cing / mya ngan med rang nyid kyis mi mang tshang ma la byams dang snying rje'i chos bshad/ mya ngan med kyis rgyal po'i do gnas bzung bzhin rgyal khab kyi las don thams cad nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul dang mthun par mdzad pa red/mya ngan med kyis ris su ma chad pa'i mi mang kun la sangs rgyas kyi chos slob pa dmigs yul du bzung nas gal che'i bsti gnas khag tu brag dang rdo ring sogs la bka' yig brkos te btsugs yod pa de tsho'i nang du dge ba bcu sogs lag len byed skor 'khod yod pa red/ dper na pha ma'i kha la nyan dgos pa dang / slob dpon la gus bskur dgos pa dang / grogs po la gdung sems dgos pa dang / g.yog po g.yog mo sogs la snying rje bya dgos pa dang / sems can nam lus can thams cad la gnod 'che mi byed pa sogs kyi tshul 'jig rten spyi la lag len dgos skor 'bod skul gnang yod pa red/'dzin skyong dang 'brel ba'i legs bcos thabs tshul/mya ngan med kyis rgyal srid 'dzin skyong dang 'brel ba'i legs bcos kyi thabs tshul du ma zhig chos dang mthun par byas pa de yang mi rnams 'jig rten spyi phan gyi chos kyi lam du 'khrid pa'i don du yin/ mya ngan med rang nyid kyi nang 'khor gyis
194 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/gtsos pa'i mi mang tshang mar sbyin pa gtong ba'i bya bar bskul zhing / khong gis chos don gyi bka' blon chen po zhig bskos te de la chos yar rgyas gtong ba'i las don tshang ma'i 'gan yongs rdzogs khur du bcug yod pa red/ 'on kyang mya ngan med kyis su la'ang btsan shugs kyis nang chos su sgyur ba'i thabs shes gnang med par ma zad/bzod pa sgom pa de gal chen po yin par mkhyen te/ khong gis chos khyab spel gyi las don de rang nyid 'tsho zhing gzhan la'ang 'tsho ru 'jug dgos zhes pa'i grub mtha' la gzhi byas yod/ mya ngan med kyis gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten shin tu mang po bzhengs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs gnang ba red/rgyal po zhig yin pa'i cha nas mya ngan med kyis chab 'bangs kyi bde sdug la gzigs rtogs shin tu legs po mdzad yod/ grong khyer phan tshun sbyor ched lam rgya che la legs pa bzos gnang zhing / lam gyi g.yas g.yon du bsil grib ldan pa'i ljon shing btsugs/ 'thung chu'i ched du khron pa khag brus shing ngal dub can gyi 'grul pa tsho'i ngal bso ba'i ched du chos khang ngam/ ngal bso khang sogs brtsegs pa dang /nad pa tsho'i nad gso ba'i phyir gso ba rig pa'i basmi gnas dang / sman khang sogs btsugs/ dud 'gro rnams kyi nad gso ba'i phyir du dud 'gro'i sman khang sogs kyi gra sgrig kyang gnang 'dugmdor bsdus na mya ngan med kyi chab 'bangs skyong tshul de pha yis bā la byams skyong byed pa ltar yin la de ltar dgos zhes khong gis nan tan gsungs yod/ mya ngan med kyis lam bstan pa de la khong gi 'og ma rnams dang / khong gi gnyen nye 'brel tshang mas rjes 'brang byas yod 'dug
le'u dngapo/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 195bka' bsdu'i sbyin bdag zhus pa/sihala'i rgyal rabs lo tshogs ltar na ni/ mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' yi bsdu ba gsum pa'i sbyin bdag byas pa yin la/ de yang rmosgosuputra zhes pa'i gnas brtan gyi gtso skyong 'og bka' bsdu gsum pa mdzad pa dang / bka' bsdu de sā: dang / nasham+bhi dang / sāranātha bcas su rdo ring chung khag la bka' khyab brkos btsugs kyis mjug bsdus/ bka' bsdu des rab byung pa dang / rab byung ma rnams kyis bslab par bya ba'i chos gsung rab rnams dang / chos yongs su dag pa spyad par bya ba tshang ma gtan la phabs pa yin/ zhes bshad 'dug siṅgala'i bshad tshul 'di bden par byas na mornya'i 7gong ma chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bka' bsdu gsum pa'i sbyin bdag gnang bas theg chen dang theg dman gnyis 'dod kyi bka' bsdu gsum pa de de ltar yin la/ rgyal po kuniṣ+ka'i dus kyi bka' bsdu de silhala'i gzhung nas bshad pa mi snang bas byung rabs smra ba phal mo ches kuniṣ+ka ni theg chen gyi rjes 'brang pa yin zhing / de'i skabs theg chen dar/'go tshugs pa yin par 'dod pas 'di dag la dpyad pa nan tsam da dung dgos par sems/dam chos khyab spel gyi bya ba/mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab gdal du btang ba de khong gi mnga' ris tsam ma yin par khong gis chos khyab spel byed mkhan gyi tshogs pa khag lho phyogs tamil gyi rgyal khams su yang btang bar ma zad/ nub phyogs :ka gi rgyal khams khongs gtogs r+sāriX dang in+t+ras (28796) dang / mesazloniX (lo60170018) dang /sihala'i yul dang / barmā la yang sangs rgyas kyai chos khyab spel byed mkhan btang
196 'phagasayulagyi4nga ba brjod pa/yod pa red/ khong gis btang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab spel mkhan tshos dam chos kyi sgron me de shin tu thag ring gi yul khams rnams su khyer nas spel ba red/mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos de 'jig rten spyi'i chos kyi gnas stangs su mthon por spel ba red/ byung rabs mkhan tshos/ yishu'i bla chen ser thal (bya 28khu/) dang / 7gong ma aṅgāsmin (856khutre(12 ) gyis yishu'i chos kyi ched du bya ba byas pa ltar mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos la bya ba byas yod/ ces gsungs pa de go don chen por mthong /dam chos kyi skor mya ngan med kyi bzhed tshul/smar+sha'i 7gong ma chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis khyab spel gnang ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi skor lo rgyus smra ba'am/ byung rabs smra ba rnams kyi bshad tshul mi mthun pa mang po zhig yod pa de rnams ni rang cag gangs can pa rnams la sngar ma grags pa yin pas 'di'i skor skabs 'dir phyogs tsam btod na phyis 'byung blo gsar don gnyer can rnams kyis gzhan gyi 'dod tshul shes pa'i dge mtshan yong nges/nang pa sangs rgyas pa dag gi sngar srol bshad tshul sna tshoḍa shig yod la bshad tshul de tsho nang pa'i gsung rab khag tu gsal bas bskyar zlos ma dgos te/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin na des thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i lta ba dang spyod pa gnyis ka khas len mkhan zhig yin pa las 'os ma mchis la/ de lta na yang byung rabs la brtag dpyad byed mkhan mkhas pa mang po'i bsam tshul ni/ mya ngan med kyi brag bskos chos kyi bka' khyab khag tu sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' bden pa bzhi dang / 'phags lam gan lag brgyad dang / rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi rnam gzhag sogs 'khod mi 'dug pa dang / der ma zad mya ngan med kyis chos kyi
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 197'grul bzhud kyi sgo nas mi mang rnams la chos nyams su len dgos kyi bslab bya gnang ba'i dmigs yul ni mtho ris kyi go 'phang tsam yin pa las thar pa'i go 'phang ma yin par bshad srol yod/ ces bsam tshul bstan yod/ bsam tshul 'di byung rabs la zhib 'jug byed mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i bzhid tshul yin na yang rigs pas dpyad na 'thad par dka' ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab spel ched brag bskos bka' khyab rnyed son byung ba khag nang ma 'khod na mya ngan med 9 dgongs bzhed min pas ga la khyab ste ma khyab cing / mya ngan med kyis btsugs pa'i rdo ring che chung dang / brag brkos bka' khyab ma lus pa da bar rnyed son byung yod par bshad mi thub cing / ga tshod rnyed pa de tsam yin par yang ma nges pa dang / mya ngan med kyi bzhed tshul tshang ma brag brkos bka' khyab nang nges par 'khod dgos pa yang ga la yin/ der ma zad brag brkos bka' khyab rnams ni skye bo phal pa rnams kyis lag len du bstar thub tsam gyi dge ba rnams khyab bsgrags byas pa tsam yin pa las/ zab cing rgya che ba'i lta grub 3 rnam gzhag rnams thog ma nas bka' khyab tu sgrog dgos pa yang min la/ las sla ba'i mngon mtho mtho ris kyi go 'phang 'thob byed kyai chos rnams la 'bad thub na/ dka' ba'i chos nges legs thar pa 'thob byed kyi chos la rim pas khrid dgos pa mkhas pa'i luḍa yin pa'i phyir na mya ngan med de spyi dmangs la nang pa'i chos khyab spel byed stangs de shin tu nas thabs mkhas shing blo ldan gyi lugs yin par grub pa las/ khong gis 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / 'phags lam gan lag brgyad sogs mi bzhed pa'i khungs su mi 'gro/yang rgya gar 9 mkhas dbang k+shi ār rāmacan+da de4ta (27 5 9 257730580478 2173511) mchog gis mya ngan med ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos sgor
198 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/nam yang ma zhugs zhing / sku tsho hril po bram ze'i chos lugs su gnas la/ khong gis gzhan la dam chos bstan pa lda rnams ni deng sang gi hiḥ'i chos lugs kyi 'dod tshul ltar gyi snying po de rang yin zhes zer/yang 'ba' shas kyis mya ngan med kyis khong gi rgyal khams mnga' ris kyi riḍa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang / dus tshod dang bstun nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos de stabs bde por bzos te legs bcos byas pa yin la/ mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyu chos de shes rab skam po'i rjes su 'brang ba'i ring lugs shig las gzi brjed can gyi chos lugs dang stobs dang ldan zhing myong tshor gyi ro bcud ldan pa kun gyis mos shing rgya che ba'i chos lugs shig tu bsgyur ba yin/ zhes zer/gong gsal 'dod tshul de gnyis ka m+pi byung rabs dang lo rgyus dang mthun pa lta ci/ rang 'dod babs col du smras pa yin par ma zad/ bden pa'i cha shas tsam yang med pa dang / rang nyid kyi chos la rmongs dad ches che bas 7gong ma mya ngan med lta bu 'jig rten spyi la grags che ba de nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin par bzod ma thub pa'i blun gtam 'ba' zhig yin/ byung rabs la mkhas pa tshang mas lugs de gnyis ka mi 'thad par bshad yod/ lugs de gnyis mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mya ngan med kyi brag brkos bka' khyab chung ba khag tu/ bka' khyab de dag brko 'dzugs byed pa'i skabs mya ngan med rang nyid dge bsnyen du gyur te lo gnyis lhag song bar gsal bar 'khod par ma zad dge bsnyen bsgrubs skabs sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin no/ /zhes 'khod yod pas/ mya ngan med nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos sgor zhugs yod cing sangs rgyas pa 'khrul med yin pa'i khungs 'di las btsan pa ci zhig dgos te mi dgos so/
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 199yang 'ga' shas kyis ha cang thal drag ste/ gong gi bka' khyab kyi tshog brjod las/ mya ngan med dge 'dun gyi gral du zhugs te dge slong gi na bza' bzhes pa yin zhes zer zhing / mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis mya ngan med dge slong du gyur pa yin min la the tshom byed/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba'i go don ji bzhin ma rtogs pa yin tshod 'dug mya ngan med kyis dge 'dun la skyabs su bzung yang / dge 'dun gyi gral du 'dzul mi dgos pas rten khyim pa yin par skyon ga la yod/ der ma zad mya ngan med kyis rdo rje gdan dang / kusmini dang / sāranātha sogs gnas chen khag la gnas skor mjal smon du nan gyis phebs pa des kyang khong sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa che ba mtshon nus pa yin/brag brkos bka' khyab 'di tsho 'ga' shas thog sangs rgyas kyi mtshon byed dam/sangs rgyas kyi chos kyo rtags sna tshogs 'dug pa/ dper na/ glang chen dkar po dang / 'khor lo sogs brkos yod/ byung rabs smra ba gzhan dag tshos glang chen dkar po 'di ni 'jig rten kun la bde ba 'dren pa'i rtags yin zhes zer la bde ba 'dren byed yin par ngos 'dzin byed par skyon med kyang / sangs rgyas pa zhig gis bltas na/ glang chen thal dkar de ni lhums su zhugs skabs yum sgyu ma lha mo'i rme lam sogs mtshon byed yin par gsal por shes/rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na mya ngan med kyis spel ba'i chos de sangs rgyas kyi chos 'khrul med yin pa las/ bram ze'i chos sam/ rig byed kyi chos deng skabs hiḥ'i chos lugs kyi snying po khyab spel byas pa gtan nas min par byung rabs kyi gnad don dang / ribs pa gnyis ka las grub pa yin/ bram ze rig byed pa mgo mkhregs mang pos mya ngan med la mthong tshul sdug po byas pa de nyi ma la sbar mos 'geb thabs
200 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjodapa/byas pa dang mtshungs pas tshad ldan byung rabs mkhas pa phal cher gyi bzhed pa gcig mthun ni gong du bshad pa ltar lags shing / mya ngan med de sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'brang par gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi chos de gzhan la khyab spel chen po gnang bar the tshom tsam yang ma dgos shing / byung rabs mkhas pa mang che bas de ltar du gsungs pa mkhas pa'i legs bshad yin/mya ngan med kyis khyab spel gnang ba'i dam chos kyi dmigs yul ni ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ spyi tshogs nang dge ba'i sems stobs gong 'phel du gtong ba de yin zhing / mya ngan med rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'brang dngos gnas pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas 'jig rten pa'i lha yi gtam rgyud sogs dang / rtog bzo'i grub mtha' rnams yongs su dor nas dge sems kyi stobs dang ldan la 'jig rten pa kun gyis thun mong du spyod bde ba'i chos gtsang ma zhig spel thabs gnang ba red/mya ngan med kyis/ brag sogs su brkos yig bka' khyab khag tu/ pha ma sogs kyi bka' la nyan dgos pa dang / rgan pa la gus bkur dgos pa dang / sbyin pa gtong dgos pa dang / sems can la 'che ba mi byed pa dang / sming rje byed pa dang / bden par smra ba dang / spyod pa gtsang ba dang / sems bzang ba dang /don med 'gro gron mi gtong ba dang / rang nyid dul ba dang / lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang / dren gzo ba'am/ byas pa gzo ba dang / nye bar gus pa dang /chos la chags pa sogs kyi brjod tshog bkod 'dug pa rnams ni/ spyi tshogs gag po zhig gi nang / nang mi phan tshun gyi dge ba'i spyod tshul la gzhi byas te thun mong gis spyod rung gi dam chos khyab spel gnang ba zhig yin par the tshom med cing / rtsa ba'i gzhi rtsa 'di rnams la chos lugs gzhan rnams phal che ba dang mi mthun pa cher med
le'u dang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 201pas yul khams chen po zhig gi 7gong ma zhig yin pa'i cha nas spyi tshogs dang 'jig rten spyi la dam chos kyi skul ma chen po zhig red/sangs rgyas pa'i chos la goms 'dris cung zad tsam yod mkhan zhig gis bltas na yang / gong gi brjod tshog de rnams 'phags lam gan lag brgyad la gzhi byas te go bde bar bzos pa yin par gsal por shes thub kyi red/mya ngan med kyi brag brkos chos kyi bka' khyab khag gi skor la byung rabs smra ba tshos mya ngan med kyi chos kyi bzhed tshul skor mi mthun pa'i rtsod pa sna tshogs shig byas 'dug kyang / gzu bo'i blos dpyad na ni gong ltar yin par sems/mya ngan med de sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad 'dun shin tu che ba de lta na yang rgyal po zhig yin pa'i cha nas khong gis rang gi las 'gan la nam yang btang snyoms gnang med cing / rgyal khab kyi srung skyob dang / 'bangs kyi bde don soḍa gang sa nas lhod med gnang ba dang / chos dang 'jig rten gnyis snyoms kyis shin tu tshags su tshud po gnang yod/ khong gi rgyal srid skyong yun ring mnga' ris rgya chen po de lta bu'i cha gang du'ang srid don gyi dka' ngal sogs gang yang ma byung zhing / zhi bde dang bde skyid kyi dpal yon shin tu rgyas pa byung yod/mya ngan med kyi brkos yig khagmya ngan med kyis btsugs pa'i brkos yig khag 'tshol ba ni shin hu dka' ba'i las don zhig yin te/ de dag ni sa'i 'og dang / nags gseb mthug po'i khrod du dang / bgrod dka' ba'i sa gnas sogs su yod tshod/ mya ngan med kyis brag brkos rdo ring ga tshod btsugs yod med shes ma thub cing / da bar gang rnyed khag gi
