206 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjodapa/rgyal po engaskyuṇ+ḍar dang / dbyin ji'i rgyal po sisar (032381) dang 'dra sdur byas yod 'dugg.yul las byed pa de srid don gyi lag char khas len ma gnang ba'i rjes su yang shin tu rgya che ba'i mnga' ris yongs rdzogs gcig gyur tu gnas pa'i thabs shes mthar phyin gnang yod par ma zad khong gi gzi brjed che ba'i gshis babs dang / khyad par du 'phags pa'i dgongs tshul des mi mang tsho la sems 'gul chen po thebs yod pa dang / tshang ma la sems kyi nus stobs chen po skyes pa red/ mya ngan med kyis/mnga' ris shin tu rgya chen po de lta bu zhig tu sngar gyi lugs srol dang / goms gshis sogs bsgyur nas 'che med dge ba'i lam 'ba' zhig tu 'khrid grub pa de ni ches bla na med pa'i mdzad pa zhig red/mya ngan med kyis drag po g.yul gyi bya ba dang / dpung 'jug la ma mnyes par byams sems dang / lhag bsam dang / gdung sems dang / zhi bde dang / mi 'tsho ba la gzhir byas pa'i bka' khrims 'ba' zhig gis 'gro ba mi'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs thub pa byung ba red/ khong gi dgongs tshul de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos la gzhi byas pa yin yang / khong gis lam ston gnang ba de rnams chos lugs gcig gam/ grub mtha' gang yang rung ba gcig kho na ma yin par thun mong gis spyod rung zhig yin pa de ngo mtshar che/ mya ngan med kyis gnad don mtha' dag sems can spyi dang / 'gro ba mi'i khe phan ched thugs bsam rgya chen po'i sgo nas gzigs pa yin pas/ khong gi bstod bsngags kyi mtshan du deswānāmasprug ste lha rnams kyi gnyen dang / smigada'i ste mthong na dga' ba zhes pa de don dang mthun pa yin/ gyo gar la dbang sgyur byed mkhan gyi rgyal
le'udang po/ sngon dus m+pi byung rabs/ 207po tsho'i nang nas mor+sha'i 7gong ma chen po mya ngan med lta bu da bar byung med nges/ mya ngan med kyi dbang sgyur 'og srid don gyi chig sgril byung ba des 'phags yul du shes rig gi chig sgril yang byung ba de ni khong gis yul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad thog sangs rgyas kyai chos khyab spel gnang ba la brten nas byung / khong gis rgya gar yul du gang sar mchod rten dang gtsug lag khag bzhengs pa des rgya gar gyi sgyu rtsal lag bzo yang 'go 'dzugs byung ba zhig red/ mya ngan med kyus sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sgo nas rgya gar gyi shes rig gi dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i rmang gzhi brtan po zhig bzos gnang ba red/mya ngan med kyi rjes 'dzin/mya ngan med la sras lnga byung yod tshod la/ de tsho ni/ btsun mo bdeshā de'i'i sras mahen+d+ra dang / kāruX'i sras ྅war dang / pasmyulngatwa'i sras kur+sāl lam yang na sugasha (grags bzang ) dang / kustan dang / āloka gsum bcas lnga yod 'dug sras mo sadhami6dang / 〉ruma3 gnyis byung / de tsho'i nang nas mahen+d+ra dang / salhami1 gnyis ni dge slong dang btsun mar gyur te chos khyab spel ched sihal ru phyin pa red/ mya ngan med 'das pa'i rjes su kurngal gyis rgyal sa lo dgu tsam bzung ba dang / de rjes de'i tsha bo sogs kyis rgyal sa bzung nas mor+sha'i rgyal po tha ma 1nyadratha (shing rta rgyas pa ) yin zhing / mdor na yishu'i sngon gyi lo chig brgya brgyad rtsu gya bzhi tsam bar du mornyas srid bskyangs yod 'dug kyang / mya ngan med kyi rjes 'dzin pa de tsho'i nang nas su sa kyang rgyal srid legs par sngar bzhin bskyangs ma thub par mor+sha'i rgyal khams rim bzhin nyams pa red/ mya ngan med 'das pa'i rjes su ring min shin tu stobs che ba'i mor+sha'i rgyal srid de nyams nas mthar rtsa med du phyin pa red/
208 'phagasayulaca byung ba brjod pa/mor+sha'i rgyal srid nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen/mornya'i rgyal srid nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen dngos gnas ni gang yin mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang / mkhas pa tshos bzhid tshul dang bshad tshul 'dra min sna tshogs yod 'dugbram ze tshos ngo log byas pa/ mkhas dbang mahāmato5phel/ har brasād shā: mchog gi bzhed tshul ltar na/ bram ze tshos ngo log byas pa des mor+sha'i rgyal srid rtsa med dum bur btang ba red ces dang / khong gis gsungs don ltar na mya ngan med kyi brkos yig bka' khyab khag ni dud 'gro'i dmar mchod kyi 'gal zlar song ba de bram ze tshos ngo log byas pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bor gyur cing / mya ngan med kyis brkos yig brgyud chos kyi bka' khyab gnang ba de tshos bram ze'i rigs la thad kur 'gal zla byas pa zhig yin pas ches nyes pa che ba yin te/ de dag ni gdol pa'i rigs kyis btang ba'i bka' yin par ma zad/ mya ngan med kyis sa steng du gang sangs rgyas la gus pa de la che bstod chen po byas pa dang / dharma mahāmata ste chos kau bka' blon chen mo gsar bskos gnang ba de bram ze tshos khong tsho'i khe dbang la thad kur lag 'jug byas pa zhig yin par bcas/rgyu rkyen gzhan yang yod de/ mya ngan med kyis rang gi dpon rigs gzhung zhabs pa tsho'i brgyud nas nyes chad 'dra snyoms dang / khrims lugs 'dra mnyam gyi grub mtha' la srung ñtsa nan cher byed du btsug pa de bram ze tsho'i dmigs bsal khe dbang thob thang 'phrog pa yin par bsams te bram ze tsho la lus srog gi chad pa sogs mang po zhig la dmigs bsal yod pa sogs thob dbang mang po yod tshul brjod kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang mkhas dbang rlagacomadhari mchog gis gong gsal shāshrī mchog gi
le'u dang po/ lngan dus kyi byung rabs/ 209dgongs tshul de tsho tshang ma brtag dpyad zhib tu ma byas pa'i gtam red ces mdzub ston gnang 'dug pa gsham gsal/dud 'gro'i dmar mchod bkag pa de bram ze la 'gal zla byas pa yin par bsgrub mi rung zhing / haraphraspyad shāsnra yis mornya rnams dmangs rigar su bshad pa yang nor ba dang / der ma zad chos kyi bka' blon gsar bskos byas pa'i nang bram ze med pa ma yin zhing / bram ze'i rigs i na na mya ngan med kyi chos kyi bka' blon sogs su zhugs mi chog pa yang min/ der ma zad mya ngan med gyis bram ze la sdang po byas pa'i khungs bang yang med par ma zad mya ngan med kyi brkos yig gcig nang /bram ze rnams la gu yangs dgos skor gsal 'khod kyang 'dug des na mya ngan med 'das pa'i rjes su dzor+sha'i rgyal srid nyams pa de bram zes ngo log byas pa las byung ba gtan nas min/ zhes gsungs/harasrasād shāsnra mchog gi bzhed tshul de la/ ge en 〉lakaṇ+ḍashāspyo (5 7smo1 1677(1 3588nga1 ) dang / mkhas dbang āraka dzaskrubaraji (27 5 5 1400557pa33)gnyis gyis skyon brjod byas don/ mya ngan med kyis bram ze la sdang po byas pa'am gnod pa'i las don byas pa'i khungs gang yang med ces gsungs/'on kyang mkhas dbang āraḍi banasdi (27 2 2 28237306) mchog gis gsungs don/ 7gong ma chen po mya ngan med rang nyid smar+sha'i rgyal srid nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig yin pa'i skyon yongs rdzogs las grol ba ma yin te/ khong gi sems gtso smra ba'i ring lugs dang / chos dad che ba des drag po'i dbung dmag tsho'i sems shugs la do phog byung yod nges shing / khong gis rgyal kha che shos ni chos gyi rgyal kha yin par gsal bshad gnang ste khong gi sku che'i ring dpa' bo'i sgra dbyangs de
210 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjodapa/chos kyi sgra dbyangs su bsgyur gyi yin zhes mi mang tsho la dril bsgrags gnang skabs mor+sha 7gong ma'i rgyal srid nyams par 'gyur ba de bstan zin pa red/ ces gsungs 'dug pa 'di la dngos gtso smra ba zhig gis bltas na yin mdog kha yang / sems gtso smra ba'am chos dngos 'brel shes mkhan tshos bltas na ni bden par mi sems te/ rgyal srid ga 'dra zhig yin yang ches dar ba'i rjes mthar rgyud pa ni chos nyid yin pas sus kyang zlog par dka'/mya ngan med kyis bram ze'i chos sogs chos lugs gzhan su la yang sdang po byas pa'am chos lugs gzhan la gnod pa'i las don gang yang ma gnang yang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la shin tu dad pa che zhing / khyab spel gnang ba la brten nas bram ze rig byed kyi lugs 'dzin pa 'ga' shas rang bzhin gyis ma dga' ba dang / phrag dog byung yod par smos ma dgos shing / phyis su dzor+sha'i rgyal srid de bram ze zhig gis mgo bde pos bcom pa 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar lags/lhan skyes kyi dka' ngal/ mkhas dbang ar ke mutshoṭ+wāṃ (075 5 lo00rdzongalasu4)mchog gi bzhed tshul ltar na/ smar+sha'i rgyal srid nyams rgyud byung ba de'i rgyu rkyen mkhas pa so sos bshad pa de dag bden mdog kha po zhig yod kyang / mor+sha'i rgyal sred nyams pa de skyon cha 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba gcig rang la thug yod ces lab pa shin tu nas dka'/ mya ngan med 'das pa'i rjes su mor+sha'i rgyal sred nyams pa de drag po'i dbung dmag dang 'brel ba ma yin zhing / sems shugs nyams pa yang ma yin mod/de'i rgyu rkyen ni mornya 7gong ma'i rgyal srid de srid don gyi sgrig 'dzugs cig yin pa'i cha nas nang du lhan skyes su yod pa'i gnad don zhig la thug yod pa yin/ mya ngan med rang nyid kyis 'ga' shas rang dbang du bzhag pa dang / gcig tu ma bsdus par bzhag
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 211pa de tshos khong gi mnga' ris rang du las don byas yod pa red/ dper na/ kuspong dang / kha che'i yul sogs la sdu yangs btang bas/ de tsho mya ngan med 'das rjes stobs shugs che ru phyin nas mthar mor+sha'i rgyal srid nyams pa'i cha rkyen du gyur pa red/mor+sha'i rgyal srid nyams rgyud du phyin pa'i skor mkhas dbang mukharje mchog gis gsungs don/ gal srid mya ngan med kyi srid byus 'ga' zhig gi rkyen pas mor+sha'i rgyal srid nyams pa yin pa'i dbang du btang na yang / rgya gar gyis de la 'gyod pa byed dgos don gang yang med de/ gal sred mya ngan med kyis khong gi yab ltar drag po'i sred byus lag len du bstar yod na yang rgyal srid de snga phye ma gtogs nam zhig nyams rgyud du 'gro bar ni nges shing / 'on kyang rgya gar gyi shes rig dang / nang don rig pa'i gnas tshad ches mtho ba de ya rabs spyod tshul ldan pa'i 'dzam gling gi cha shas rgya chen po gzhan la yang khyab pa de gtso bor mya ngan med la brten nas byung ba yin zhing / rgya gar gyi shes rig gi dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa de dus rabs mang por gnas thub par ma zad/ lo stong phrag rjes su yang 'jig rten 'dir ma nub par bsdad yod pa red/ ces gsungs pa de shin tu nas bden par snang la dngos don dang 'brel ba'i gtam yin/ mya ngan med kyi rjes su 'dzin mkhan gyi rgyal po rnams 'jon po dang stobs chen po ma byung bas shin tu rgya che ba'i mnga' ris de 'dzin skyong tshul bzhin ma thub pa sogs kyis mor+sha'i rgyal srid dum bur phyin pa red/mor+sha'i rgyal srid nyams rgyud du phyin pa'i rgyu rkyen mya ngan med kyi chos kyi srid byus dang / 'tsho med zhi ba'i srid byus sogs yin par 'dod pa de la gtan tshog yang dag pa gang yang med de/ drag shul gyi srid byus lag len bstar mkhan gyi rgya gar gyi rgyal po gzhan rnams dang / yul gzhan gyi rgyal po khag gi rgyal sred thams
212 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/cad nyams rgyud du phyin pa las sngar bzhin yun ring gnas ma thub pa des shes thub la/drag shul ji tsam che ba de de tsam myur du nyams pa yang mthong / 'on kyang mya ngan med kyi che ba dang / 'gro ba mi rigs yongs la shin tu sman pa'i mdzad pa bla na med pa de nam yang ma yal bar 'chi ba med par gnas yod pa lags/shuga'i rgyal rabs/mya ngan med gyi rjes mor+sha'i rgyal po rnams 'jon po ma byung bas mnga' ris rgya chen po de skyong ma thub pa dang 'dzin skyong tshags tshud ma byung bar nges shing / mornya'i rgyal po tha ma 1nyadratha ste shing rta rgyas pa'am shing rta yangs pa zer ba de yin la/ de nyid rang gi drag po'i gzhung zhabs pa bu'imibashug zer bas bkrongs nas shug rang nyid kyis mor+sha'i rgyal sa bzung pa red/ mor+sha'i rgyal sred nyams rjes rgya gar du srid don gyi gong bu chig sgril gyi nus pa zhig nas slar yang rgyal srid chung chung mang por 'thor ba red/ de yang ṇ+ḍaliṅga rgyal khab rang btsan zhig tu gyur te de'i rgyal rgyud kyi rgyal po khyarawela'i 'og tu mnga' thang rgyas par gyur/ lho phyogs su āt+na'i rgyal rgyud la dbang cha thob pa dang / aphaXnistun la rgya gar gyi rgyuka rgyal khams 'ga' shas su gyes/shug khri la 'khod rjes mgadha'i drag po'i dpung shugs che ru phyin te/ sngon gyi 'che med zhi ba'i gnas tshul de las ldog ste bram ze'i lugs srol gyi rgya skyed dang btsan gnon de slar yang 'go tshugs pa red/56midrashug (rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen )puyimidrashug ste rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mgadha la rgyal rabs gsar pa zhig gi rmang gzhi bting pa de la shuga'i rgyal rabs zhes bya zhing / rgyal rgyud des lo 112
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyi grang rabs/ 213tsam rgyal srid bskyangs pa red/ de yang shuga'i rgyal rgyud kyis yishu'i sngon gyi lo 118nas bzung yesdu'i sngon gyi lo 76 bar du rgyal srid bskyangs shing / rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen the bas shuga'i rgyal po khyon bsdoms bcu byung ba red/mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de 'phags pa'i gang zag gam/ mi bzang po zhig min tshul bshad 'dug shug zhis pa de mi sde'am mi rigs kau ming yin zhing nang mi'i rgyud pa'i ming ni bsgrika (281yong15lnga) yin/ rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de ni mchod gnas bram ze zhig yin pa dang / yishu'i sngon gyi dus rabs gnyis pa'i nang bram ze rnams rga gnas mthon por sleb thabs byas par lam lhong ma byung ba'i gras sheg yin tshul bshad srol 'dug pa bden min gang ltar de nyid bram ze yin par nges pa red/ shuga'i rigs de 'phags rgyal gyi nye 'gram bideshā zer ba'i sa gnas dang 'brel ba yod skad 'dug pas khong tsho'i pha mes kyi nang de ga nas yin srid/mor+sha'i rgyal po tha ma shing rta rgyas pa'i skabs rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de dmag spyi gtso bo yin pa dang / des g.yo sgyus mdo bskor nas mor+sha'i rgyal po shing rta rgyas pa de bkrongs pa yin zhing / las don de la dmag mi tshos rgyab gnon byas yod tshod/ gnas tshul de ni blon pos ngo log byas par dmag mis rgyab skyor byas te g.yo sgyus mgo skor btang ba'i gnas tshul zhig red/rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyal rgyud kyi khungs tshad ldan/snyan ngag mkhan nag mo khol gyis brtsams pa'i mālakhriXsgyumitra zhes pa'i zlos gar gyi bstan bcos nang shuga'i rgyal po thog ma gsum gyi skor cung zad gsal yod pa de tsho ni/ puyimitra ste rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen dang / at+nameta ste me'i bshes gnyen dang / bsumitra ste dbyig gi bshes gnyen bcas gsum yin/ zlos gar gyi bstan
214 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/bcos 'dis rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyal tshab kyis khridar+bha'i yul du dpung 'jug ji ltar byas tshul dang / rgyal po'i khri de mi gnyis bar bgo bsha' ji ltar byas tshul dang /de dag shuga'i chab 'og tu ji ltar gnas tshul bshad yod pa red/maskṛta'i skad kyi brda sprod la mkhas pa chen po patatsholi yis rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis rta mchog gi mchod sbyin byas tshul skor bshad 'dug g.yosgyu smi 'thab dka' nas saskrota skad thog rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi sras drug pa dhanadewa ste nor gyi lha zhes pas btsugs pa'i brkos bris gcig rnyed pa'i nang rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de rta mchog gi mchod sbyin byed pa por bshad 'dug oris la yod pa'i hāsprisumapa la bskos yig cig tu rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen dang dmag 'khrug byas te khurawel la rgyal kha thob pa'i lo rgyus 'khod 'dug pa dang / shāka gi lo rgyus khag tu rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen dang shrīka pa 'khrug 'dzing byas tshul 'khod yod skad/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lung rnams las rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis nang pa tshor sdug po gtong tshul 'khod yod pa red/ khungs tshad ldan de dag la brten nas rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de bram ze yin par ma zad bram ze'i chos la chags zhen che zhing / sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / de'i rjes 'jug pa tsho la shin tu sdang po zhig yin par the tshom mi dgos shing / nang pa'i gzhung mang por rgyal po de ni sangs rgyas pa'i spyi dgra yin par bshad/ des mor+sha'i rjes rgyal staX rgyargya spridapo bye/ ༵༵༵ /brdzus shesta deX ༷sprin rtsapa sna (sna yod (( zlodange spyad/ mkhan dang / stobs zhan pa zhig yin par ma zad des rang gi mi ser tsho la khas len byas pa rnams bsgrub ma thub pa red/ der ma zad shrīka pa rnams kyis rgya gar gyi sgo 'gram du nyen kha bzos nas yong skabs de tsho la rgol 'dzing ma thub pa red/ der
le'u dang po/ sngan dus kyi byung rabs/ 215brten mi mang tshos rang yul srung skyob byed thub mkhan gyi stobs shugs ldan pa'i rgyal po zhig dgos pa'i bsam blo shugs drag po btang yod nges la/ bram ze rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis go skabs bzung nas mor+sha'i gzhung srid 'dzin rgyu'i 'char gzhi gting ba yin nges/ bram ze rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs yul ni/ bram ze'i chos lugs nyamus pa bskyar gso bya rgyu dang / mgadha'i rgyal khams de :ka gi dbung 'jug las srung skyob bya rgyu dang / rgya gar gyi sngon dus kyi rig byed kyi shes rig yar rgyas gtong rgyu bcas ni de'i dmigs yul gtso bo khag red/ der brten kho rang nyid smar+sha'i dmag spyi chen mo yin pa'i go skabs de yang bzung nas nyin gcig mornya'i 7gong ma shing rta rgyas pa'am shing rta yangs pa des dpung dmag la gzigs zhib gnang bzhin pa'i skabs rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis 7gong ma bkrongs pa red/ de dang mnyam du mor+sha'i rgyal sred rdzogs shing / smar+sha'i rgyal srid zhig rjes ye'u'i sngon gyi lo 188 lor shug rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen khri la 'khod nas shuga'i rgyal rabs de 'go tshugs pa red/shug gis khridar+bha'i yul du dmag 'khrug byas pa/rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi sras asnomitra ste me yi bshes gnyen la mgadha'i lho phyogs kyi srid skyong du bsko bzhag byas pa red/ de'i skabs yul khridar+bha'i rgyal po'i nye 'brel yin pa mān+tabasen this pa zhig gis gsang ba'i thog nas me yi bshes gnyen dang thug phrad byas par brten khridar+bha'i rgyal pos mi de 'phral du btson 'jug byas pa na me yi bshes gnyen kyis mi de glod dkrol gtong dgos par zhus kyang khridar+bha'i rgyal pos de ltar ma byas pa na/ me ye bshes gnyen gyis khridar+bha'i rgyal po yanasen ste mchod sbyin sde dang dmag 'khrug byas pa red/ mthar mchod sbyin sde pham nyes su gyur te khridar+bha de
216 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/shuga'i mnga' 'og tu bcug pa yin la/ de yang rgyal srid de dum bu gnyis su bgos nas mchod sbyin sde la phyed ka dang / phyed ka mān+tabasen la sprad pa red/āliṅga'i rgyal po khyarawel dang dmag 'khrugku rla'i hākhrigumapa'i brkos yig tu gsal ba ltar na/ rgyal po khurawela'i rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i lo 'khor dus ston brgyad pa'i skabs su des mgadha'i sa gnas rgyal po'i khab la btsan rgol gyis pham nyes su btang ba dang / rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i lo 'khor dus ston bcu gnyis pa la des yang bskyar mgadha la dbung 'jug byas te shuga'i pho brang du des glang chen rnams bzhag nas mgadha'i rgyal po 1haspati mitra ste phur bu'i bshes gnyen dbang du bsdus te slar log skabs rgyal ba pa'i sku 'dra zhig mnyam 'khyer byas pa de ni sngon nan+da'i rgyal pos khyer ba de yin pa dang / gzhan yang dngos zog mang po 'khyer ba red/ ces gsal/brkos yig nang gsal lo rgyus nang gal gnad che shos ni/ phur bu bshes gnyen zer ba de su la ngos 'dzin byed dgos min de yin la/ kha shas kyis phur bu bshes gnyen zer ba de rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen la ngos 'dzin byed cing / mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis de la dgag pa byas 'dug gang ltar khungs 'di las ālidra'i rgyal po khyarawel gyis mgadha'i rgyal po shuga'i thog dpung 'jug lan gnyis byas pa dang / thengs gnyis kur khyarawel la rgyal kha thob pa ni gsal por shes thub pa red/āka dang dmag 'khrugmor+sha'i mnga' thang nyams rjes rgya gar nub phyogs nas ༷ka gi yul rnams dang
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 217dgra ji ltar byung tshul skor mkhas pa tsho'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang / trañtsayan shāka rgyal khab kyis yar rgyas dang stobs shugs ni khyad du 'phags pa yod 'dugmkhas pa mang po'i bzhed tshul ni/ 〉ka gi lo rgyus la khungs su byas te rba②yan shrīka gi rgyal po lngame:yas (2373171053) 'am yang na khong gi phyag rogs zhopoloṇ+ḍaṭas (89011070(08) dang / minaṇ+ḍar (6765 5761) gnyis kyis rgya gar nub phyogs nas dpung 'jug byas pa yin zhing / tak+ṣaṇ+ḍalā snye rdo 'jog yul blangs pa'i rjes su lngamen+t+rags yis minaṇ+ḍar la rdo 'jog yul du dbang byed du bcug nas lapoloṇ+ḍaṭas la sirnyu dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir lho shar phyogs su bskyod dgos bka' gnang ba ltar des kyang de ltar byas te slar rdo 'jog tu log pa red/ de rjes khramaṇ+ḍar gyis shākal dang / mthurā dang / sageta sogs dbang du bsdus nas mthar 59liputra yang dbang du bsdus pa red/ des na rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis shākal bar mdun skyod byas pa de don med du gyur/ zhis gsungs/yang 19sahiṅgā zer ba'i bram ze'i bstan bcos nang gsal ltar na rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyal srid ring gi shrīka pa tshos dpung rgol thengs gnyis byas shing / dang po de kho'i rgyal srid 'go btsugs skabs dang / gnyis pa de rgyal srid kyi mjug rdzogs mtshams byas shing / btsan rgol dang po de ṇ+ḍamegrogs yis byas shing / de ltar na sāketa dang 5r+sāl dang / mthurā dbang du bsdus rjes des 5975dra la dpung rgol byas pa yin srid/ 'on kyang shrīka pa tsho'i nang khul rnyog zing gi rkyen gyis dpung rgol de'i grub 'bras bzang po la longs su spyod ma khoms par dmag sa nas phyir log bya dgos byung ba red/ de ltar yin par :ka gi lo rgyus khungs ldan las kyang grub ste :ka nang du 〉kriṭa.oḍis (6khu67lnga(1633) yis dka' rlog bzos par brten 59liputra nas
218 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/phyir 'then bya dgos byung 'dug tshul shrīka gi lo rgyus su gsal yod 'dug minaṇ+ḍar gyis rang gi rje bo 9miṭa'os yi bka' bzhin byas te yishu'i sngon gyi lo 168 tsam la shāka gi dpung dmag rnams pāsaliputra nas phyir 'then byas tshod/ de ni phyogs gcig nas rgya gar gyi stobs shugs dang / tshorawel gyis rgya gar byang phyogs su dpung 'jug byas pa la brten nas phyi rgyal ༷ka pa tshos 59liputra 'dzin skyong byed par khag po byung ba yon tshod/ de la brten nas rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi mnga' khul shor ba kha shas tshur thob pa'i nang awadha tshud yod cing / de kho rang gi rgyal sar bzos yod par bshad/shrīka gis dpung 'jug gnyis pa ni mirjenyar gyi dbu 'khrid 'og byas shing / de skabs rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de shin tu rgas pas rang gi tsha bo bsumitra ste dbyig gi bshes gnyen de :ka pa'i gdong len byed du sirnyu gtsang po'i nye 'gram du btang ba na/dmag 'khrug de'i nang rgyuka pa rnams pham pa red/ ces gsal/rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mornyas bskyangs pa'i sa khul lte ba la dbang byas te lho phyoḍa su narlad gtsang po'i cung zad phar phyogs bdaralha bar du dbang sgyur byas shing /khong gis rgyal kha thob pa'i dus dran du rta mchog gi mchod sbyin thengs gnyis byas te kho'i rgyal srid ring rig byed kyi mchod sbyin bskyar gso byed thub pa byung bas rig byed pa rnams gyis kho la dga' mos chen po byed cing / bsngags brjod byed/sangs rgyas pa rnams la sdang dgra dang gnod skyon btang ba/nang pa'i gzhung lugs khag nas rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen de ni 'tsho ba che zhing /sangs rgyas pa la sdang po dang gnod skyon gtong mkhan bstan pa'i dgra bo zhig yin par bshad srol yod/ des dgon pa dang / gtsug lag khang khag mang po rtsa gtor
le'u dang po/ lngan dus kyu byung rabs/ 219btang ba dang / dge 'dun pa mang po bkrongs par ma zad dge 'dun pa re bkrong thub na bya dga' yang ster bar byed/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen la gomishanadu zhes brjod cing / de ni gdug rtsub shin tu che bas dmyal bar skyes so/ /zhis gsungs yod par grags/dus phyis kyi rgya gar gyi byung rabs mang po'i nang du/ rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mor+sha'i rgyal srid mgo rting bslogs kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos rtsa med bzo ba'i thabs shes byas pa'i khungs nges gtan gang yang med tshul dang / nang pa tshos bshad tshul de tsho phru btags pa yin pa tsam las byung rabs dang mthun pa ma yin zhes bris pa'ang 'dug gang ltar rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis rta mchog gi mchod sbyin byas pa des bram ze rig byed kyi chos 4tshe bskyar gso byas par gsal zhing / mi 'tshi ba'i chos la mi dgang ba dang / mor+sha'i 7gong ma mya ngan med kyi byams dang snying rje'i srid byug la gtan nas mi dga' ba zhig yin par nges/ des sangs rgyas pa la gal srid dngos su gnod 'che byas med pa'i dbang du btang na yang / brgyud nas gnod skyon chen po byas yod par gdon mi za ba lags/shul 'dzin pa rnams/mālakhriXsgyumitra zhes pa'i zlos gar dang / sngon rabs rnams su a:mitra ste me yi bshes gnyin gyi skor bshad pa de dag las nga tshos rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi shul 'dzin pa khag gi skor cung zad shes thub/yab rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyal tshab du bidoshā la dbang byas te yab grongs pa'i rjes su me yi bshes gnyen gyis lo brgyad ring rgyal srid bskyangs/ lnga len yul
220 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/(9770khri'i/ji) gyi byang brgyud nas dong tse gcig rnyed son byung ba de me yi bshes gnyen gyi dong tse min par brten des yul lnga len la dbang bsgyur min gsal por ma nges/bsumitra ste dbyig gi bshes gnyen ni/ shuga'i rgyal rgyud gsum pa de yin zhing /de la rta mchog mchod sbyin byed mkhan dang / 〉ka pa pham du 'jug mkhan zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed srol yod la/ de ni zlos gar la shin tu dga' bo yod pa dang / nyin gcig zlos gar 'khrab mkhan tsho'i dkyil du kho rang gi blon po mitradewa ste bshes gnyen lha zhes pas rgol 'dzing byas yod 'dug pa 'di tsho la bltas na de dus rgya gar gyi blon po tshos rgyal po las rgyal srid 'phrog thabs byed srol yang yang byung yod tshod/shuga'i rgyal po khyon bsdoms bcu'i nang nas gzhan rnams kyi skabs khyad du 'phags pa'am dmigs bsal gnas tshul gang yang ma byung bas gal cher ma cas/sngon rabs ltar na shuga'i rgyal rabs dgu pa ni lhag yin la des lo sum rtsu so gnyis bskyangs pa dang / khri lo bcu bzhi pa'i lo 'khor dus ston skabs rdo ring khung gi mdo bo can zhig nor lha'i ched du bzhings pa de'i steng brkos yig nang / rang nyid dul ba dang / sbyin pa dang / rang rig pa'i ye shes te 'chi ba med pa'i dge sems gsum po de nyams su blangs na mtho ris 'thob par 'gyur zhes 'khod/ yig cha 'di las shug dang rgya gar gyi shrīka rgyal khams bar 'brel lam legs po yod pa yang gsal zhing shrīka gzhung tshab pa zhig khyab 'jug pa'i rjes 'brangs su gyur te mahā:rata yi gtam rgyud la mkhyen rgya che zhing nyams len byas tshul yang bshad/shuga'i rgyal po tha ma ni dewa:ti ste lha'i phun tshogs yin la/ de nyid kho rang gi blon po bāsudewa kāt+yā zer bas bkrongs pa red/
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyibyung rabs/ 221shuga'i rgyal rabs skabs kyi gal che'i gnas tshul/shuga'i rgyal srid des smar+sha'i rgyal srid nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen byas pa dang / byang phyogs gaṅgā'i lung rgyud kyi rgyal khams de trañtsayan tshos dbang sgyur dpung 'jug las srung skyob byed thabs gang mtshams kyang byas yod cing / mthar āka pa tsho dang mnyam zhi bde'i 'brel ba byas/ shuga'i rgyal po tsho rang nyid bram ze yin par ngos 'dzin dam por byas te rig byed pa'i chos dang / rta mchog gi mchod sbyin dang / lhag par khyab 'jug pa'i ring lugs de yar rgyas su btang yod/ mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis shuga'i skabs su saskrota ñdzi legs sbyar skad nang du bstan bcos mang po zhig brtsams yod pas gzhung lugs gar rgyas kyi dus skabs lta bur ngos 'dzin byed tshog ces bshad/ shug rgyal pos sbyin bdag byas te saskrota la mkhas pa patañdzali yis sgra mdo snyan grags can pāk+ṣani yi 'grel pa chen po mahā:'i zhes pa de brtsams pa red/mkhas pa kha shas kyis gsungs pa ltar na/ shugs khang bzo sogs sgru rtsal gsar pa'i 'do 'dzugs byas yod tshul yang bshad/ phal cher shuga'i rgyal srid ring la lharahuta'i mchod rten de la nyams gso byas te sngar gyi shing gi ra ba de yi tshab tu rdo yi ra ba btsugs nas rgyal sgo ring po zhig bzos/ de skabs kyi rdo sku'i lag bzo'i sgyu rtsal de tsho shin tu nas ngo mtshar zhing / chos la dad pa dang yid ches dang / mi tsho'i skyon chas dang / za chas dang / lugs srol dang / spyod tshul sogs dang / mi che'i dga' skyid dang 'dod yon sogs stabs bde po zhig gi sgo nas mtshon thub pa yod par bshad/rgyal sgo dang / ka ba'i ngos su dang / ra ba'i ngos su bskos bris byas pa rnams mdzes shing phyi'i snod bcud kyi rang bzhin dang / skyes rabs kyi lo rgyus mtshon
222 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/par byed/ deng dus snrunā grong khyer gyi nye 'gram lhas (2khri'i3lnga) las brnyed pa'i gtsug lag khang grags can de dang / brag bshags nas bzos pa'i mchod rten khag dang /thaja la yod pa'i cabyu ste mchod rten gyi tshom chen dang / nubaka dang / aja3 dang /amarāwa3'i mchod rten dang / rdo rje gdan gyi lcags ri mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba khag kyang shuga'i rgyal srid skabs bzhings par ngos 'dzin byed/ nang pa'i rten de dag nang pa tsho dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa la dga' ba'i rgyal po'am sbyin bdag gzhan khag gis mthun sbyor byas pa las bzhengs pa yin pa las shuga'i rgyal po thog ma gsum gyis ni ma bzhengs par nges/ 'on kyang shuga'i rgyal po tshang mas sangs rgyas pa la ngaga' po ma byas pa'i tshul bshad du mi rung ba e yin/ gang ltar 'di la dpyad pa bya dgos/ lharanyuta la shing gi lha sku shin tu mdzes po de dang besanagar la yod pa'i bya khyung gi rdo ring sogs ni shuga'i skabs kyi lag rtsal phul du byung ba'i dpe mtshon byed yin par ngos 'dzin byed chogshuga'i rgyal po rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis srid skyong ba'i skabs tsam zhig la gangs ljongs kyi yul du rgyal po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan pos rgyal phran sil ma tsho'i nang nas 'ga' zhig dbang du bsdus te bod spyi'i rgyal po byung ba yin/ gnya' khri btsan po de'i 'byung khungs skor lugs sna tshogs 'dug pa dper na/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i sras yin tshul sogs dang / bon gyi lo rgyus ltar na rgya gar gyi rgyal po skya seng zhes pa zhig gi sras yin tshul sogs bshad tshul mang po zhig 'dug rgya gar gyi sras zhig yin pa kha mthun/ 'on kyang rgya gar nas khungs btsan po ma brnyed pa dang / sngon dus kyi lo rgyus mang che ba lo rgyus tsam yin yang byung rabs su 'gro min dpyad rgyu lhag yod pas mtha' cig tu thag gcod par dka' bar mngon/
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 223kuṇa'i rgyal srid/shuga'i rgyal po tha ma dewa:ti lha'i dge ba'am dge ba'i lha'am lha'i phun tshogs yin pa gong du bshad zin la/ de nyid rang gi blon po bāsudewa paṇa te dbyig gi lhas bkrongs te des paṇa khra rgyal rgyud kyi gzhi rtsa btsugs/ 'on kyang gāṇa'i rgyal rgyud kyi rgyal srid de ni yun thung ngu las ma gnas shing / kho rang ma the bas rgyal po gsum las ma byung / hāṇawas zhes pa de tsho'i rigs kyi ming red/ rgyal po gzhan gsum po m+pi/ :mimitra ste sa gzhi'i bshes gnyen dang / nurāyaṇa ste sred med kyi bu dang /sushamaṇa ste dge sbyong bzang po bcas gsum yin zhing / kuṇa'i rgyal rabs bzhis khyon bsdoms lo bzhi cu zhe lnga bskyangs pa ni yishu'i sngon gyi lo 75 nas 30 bar srid bzung / rgyal khab de yang shin tu rgya chung ste bāṭa putra tsam zhig yin/ de tshos kyang sngar gyi rig byed kyi chos lugs rnying pa de la srung skyob mu mthud byas shing / lho phyogs āt+na'i rgyal pos kuṇa'i rgyal srid bcom pa yin par sngon rabs su bshad/kuṇa'i rgyal srid nyams nas bzung yishu'i 'das lo 320 tsam bar du yul mgadha'i byung rabs dang lo rgyus ga re byung yod med gsal shes ma thub pas de la mun pa'i dus rabs sam/ dus rabs nag po zhes byung rabs mkhas pa tshos brjod/skabs 'dir shes dgos pa gal che ba zhig brjod par bya ste/ smar+sha 7gong ma'i rgyal srid nyams rjes yishu'i sngon gyi lo 200 nas yishu'i 'das lo 300 tsam bar rgya gar gyi gling 'dir rgyalaci khab mang po zhig byung zhing de tsho'i nang nas rgyal khab 'ga' shas ni chung chung dang / 'ga' shas ni gang mtshams chen po yang byung yod/ yishu'i sngon gyi lo 200 nas yishu'i 'das lo 100 tsam bar rgya gar byang phyogs 'dir
224 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/phyi'i yul khag nas mi tshogs 'dra min mang po zhig yong nas rgya gar du gzhis chags 'dug pa de tsho'i so so'i mi che skyel tshul gyis sgo nas rgya gar gyi shes rig yar rgyas su btang yod/ mi tshogs de tsho ni baiḍūgan te rgya gar gyi shāka pa tsho dang / 5thigan dang /shaka dang / ku69 bcas yin la/ shrīka pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma yeshilā'i dkyil nas yong ba sha stag yin/ dbus yeshilā nas yongs te rgya gar du gnas chags pa tshos rgya gar gyi shes rig la do phog btang bar ma zad de tsho rang nyid kyang rgya gar gyi mi mang gi cha shas su gyur pa red/'o na rgya gar gyi shāka pa zhes pa de'i byung tshul dzo 'dra yin zhe na/ sngon khracheskyuṇ+ḍar gyi dmag dpon tshos 'arān dang / aphaXnistun so sor rang rang gi srid dbang btsugs pa dang / de tsho'i rjes 'dzin pa tshos phyis su rgya gar byang phyogs kyi sa khul phyogs su mig zug yod de/ gang lags zer na/ de skabs rgya gar byang phyogs di dpal 'byor gyis phyug la ṅgārān dang / dbus oshilā'i yul khag dang mnyam tshong 'brel chen po yod/ mor+sha'i 7gong ma'i mnga' thang nyams rjes :ka gi rgyal po de tshos pañtsab dang / ༷bul gyi lung pa tshor dka' ngal med par blangs te dbang bsgyur byas shing / mnga' khul de tsho la ga〉 mnga' khul zhes brjod pa yin/ ga〉 mngal khul la dbang bsgyur byed mkhan gyi shrīka pa rnams la rgya gar gyi ༷ka pa zhes brjod pa yin/rgyal po de tshog dong tse'am sgor mo 'dra min sna tshogs bzos 'grems byas yod pa de dag las khong tsho'i lo rgyus shes thub pa red/rgyal po de tsho'i nang nas 'ga' shas nang pa sangs rgyas par gyur cing /dper na rgyal po minaṇ+ḍar ram/ yang na mi.in+da zhes pa de dge slong klu yi sde la gang zag gi bdag med sogs kyi skor dri ba gnang mkhan grags can de nang pa sangs rgyas

le'u dang po/ sngon dus9 byung rabs/ 239dbyangs kyang yod cing / dge 'dun tshogs pa'i dbus su mdzad sgo rgya chen po dang bcas sde snod gsum zangs kyi gleg bu la bris te rdo yi sgam du btsug pa'i steng du mchod rten brtsegs pa yin zhis gsungs/ gong gi rta dbyangs de klu sgrub kyi slob ma yin pa'i rta dbyangs de yin min ma nges la spyir rta dbyangs zhes pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' shas byung yod tshod/byung rabs mkhas pa tshos 'char can bshad srol ni kuniṣ+ka ni theg chen pa yin la theg dman pa tshos chig bsgril gyis theg chen la ngo rgol byas par brten bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad dgos byung zhes bshad/ gang ltar bka' bsdu 'di ni yishu'i 'das lo brgya tham pa'i lor mdzad pa yin par 'dod/bod kyai bshad srol ltar na ni sde pa bco brgyad po ma mthun pa'i dbang gis rtsod pa byung bar de 'dum pa'i don du kuniṣ+ka'i skabs su bka' bsdu mdzad pa yin zhing /bka' bsdu de ni gsum pa yin par bzhed/ de lta na yang byung rabs mkhas pa tshos bzhed tshul ltar na ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar bka' bsdu dang po de ma skyes dgras sbyin pa/dkyi byapya ṭ+wāṃ khro'i byu /pas da ༈ byung shā (1 /pa de shāX ༷ ṭ+wāṃ sna ṭ+wāṃ rnyiX shā khrisde ṭ+wāṃ ༵༵༵ ༵ byung ba dang / kukhug 7gong ma kuniṣ+ka'i skabs su bka' bsdu bzhi pa mdzad pa yin zhing / bka' bsdu gnyis pa'i skabs yangs pa can du sde pa so sor gyes pa yin par 'dod/ gcig byas na yangs pa can du dge 'dun nang rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi la mi mthun pa'i rtsod rnyog byung ba dang / sde pa so sor gyes pa'i rtsod rmyog gnyis deng dus rgya gar ba'i mkhas pa tshos gcig tu 'khrul pa yin srid/ gang ltar da dung dpyad pa zhib tu bya dgos par snang /
240 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/kuniṣ+ka ni mya ngan med gnyis pa lta bu yin min/7gong ma kuniṣ+ka yis dbus yeshilā dang de 'brel mnga' khung/ khag tu sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / nang pa'i sgyu stsal dang gzhung lugs khyab spel rgya cher gnang yod pa dang / gzhung lugs la mkhas pa chen po rta dbyangs dang / slob dpon klu sgrub lta bu'i lta grub la mkhas pa dang caraka lta bu'i gso ba rig pa la mkhas pa sogs slob dpon 'jig rten na snyan par grags pa rnams la rgyal po kuniṣ+kas ches bkur zhing bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa ma zad mthurā dang / spyaranātha sogs la rgya gar gyi sgyu rtsal gtsang ma dar rgyas mdzad pa dang / 'phags yul byang nub phyogs su shrīka nang pa'i lag rtsal ga〉ra'i lugs srol ltar gangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan mang po bzhings/ shrīka dang rgya gar skad gnyis 'khod yod pa'i kuniṣ+ka'i dngul sgor rnams ni shar phyogs kyi bzo dbyibs la romen gyi lag rtsal ldan pa khag bzo 'grem gnang ba red/ der brten nang pa'i bstan bcos khag tu mya ngan med dang / kuniṣ+ka gnyis sangs rgyas kyai bstan pa la mdzad rjes shin tu che ba'i rgyal bstan gyi sbyin bdag gnyis su ngos 'dzin byas yod pa red/byung rabs mkhas pa tshos rgyal po de gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa khyab spel gnang mkhan yin pa dang / bka' bsdu'i sbyin bdag byas pa 'dra yang kuniṣ+ka de mya ngan med dang gtan nas mi mtshungs pas mya ngan med gnyis par 'dod mi rigs zhes gsungs/ byung rabs mkhan 'ga' shas kyis de la mya ngan med gnyes pa zhes bshad yod/ ku69 7gong ma kuniṣ+ka de smar+sha yi 7gong ma mya ngan med dang mtshungs pas de la mya ngan med gnyis par 'bod pa 'os min ji ltar yang rgyal po des theg chen gyi chos khyab spel chen po gnang bas chos rgyal chen po zhig yin pa ni the tshom med/
le'u dang po/ sngon dusagyi byung rabs/ 241kuniṣ+ka'i skabs su gal che'i byung ba/kuniṣ+ka'i rgyal srid ring ku69 7gong ma'i mnga' thang che zhing rtse mo'i mthar thug par bslebs shing theg pa chen po'i chos rgya che gcig gyur gyis shar gling yeshilā'i nang du dar rgyas shin tu chen por gyur/ mthurā ste bcom brlags tu rgyal ba pa'i chos kyang dar rgyas su gyur/ nub phyogs rom dang 'brel thag nye po byung ba des tshong las dang / de skabs kyi shes rig la 'gyur ba chen po byung / der ma zad rgya gar dang rgya nag bar la'ang tshong 'brel byung / kugāṇa rgyal pos rgya nag las dpe blangs te rgyal khab kyi lo 'khor yig tshang ngam/ lo 'khor lo rgyus 'bri 'dod byed rgyu'i srol btod/dus rabs de'i nang shes rig la yar rgyas chen po phyin pa des ku69 7gong ma tshog mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i phyi rgyal sa khul de tshos chos dang shes rig la sdang dgra ma byas par myur du rgya gar gyi shes rig gi ngo bor bsgyur ba red/rjes 'dzin pa/1niṣ+ka'i sras hakhri'i (55tso1355lnga) yis yishu'i 'das lo 120 lor rgyal sa bzung / 'on kyang de skabs mālalha dang / sidha la rudradaman dang po (557727772541) ste drag po 'dul dang po zhes pa de khri la 'khod yod pas mnga' khul de tsho kukhucu 7dong ma'i mnga' 'og nas grol dgos pa'i rtsod pa byas pa red/ de lta na yang mnga' khul de tsho kāṣ+ṭhak+ṣa 'og nas thar med pa red/ yab a+yau rjes su 'brangs nas hakhriska yis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la srung skyob sogs rgya cher byas shing mthurā la nang pa'i dgon pa zhig chags btab pa ma zad kusha'ir la hakhri'ipur zer ba'i grong khyer zhig kyang gsar bzo byas pa red/
242 'phags yul 9byung ba brjodapa/de rjes bsudewa ste dbyig gi lha yis yishu'i 'das lo 152 lor rgyal srid bskyangs zhing / de ni ku69 gyi rgyal po tha ma yin/ de'i skabs su ku69 7gong ma'i mnga' thang nyams 'go tshugs te mnga' ris rgya chung ngur gyur/ khong gi dngul sgor ram dong tse khag yu pi sa khongs su brnyed thob byung yod kyang / brkos yig ni mthurā ma gtogs sa gnas gzhan las ma brnyed/ khong gi rgyal srid skabs dka' ngal chen po zhig byung yod pa ni khong gi dngul sgor phyis brnyed byung ba khag las gsal te/ dngul sgor de tsho'i thog dbang phyug dang de'i ba glang nayanī'i snang brnyan 'khod 'dug pas/chos lugs kyi dka' ngal chen po zhig byung bar nges/ gang ltar khong ni rig gnas gzhung lugs la thugs snang chen po yod pa zhig yin par bshad/ rgyal po 'dis yishu'i dus rabs sam 'das lo 177 tsam bar srid bskyangs/ku69 7gong ma'i mnga' thang nyams rgyud/dbyig gi lha yi rjes kukhucu gyi rgyal srid rtsa brlag tu gyur te rgya gar byang nub mnga' khul khag la rgyal phran chung ngu mang pos dbang bsgyur ba red/ ku4ṇa 7gong ma'i mnga' thang nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin skor mkhas dbang sermathas gsungs don/ phyi lo 167 lor lha 'brum sogs nad rims chen po byung ba des nub khul gnod skyon chen po byung ba dang / mthar rgyal khab kyi mnga' thang la gnod skyon byung ba red/ ces gsungs/ sngon rabs ltar na phyo rgyal gyi dbung 'jug chen po zhig gis kukhucu skyo po bzos tshul 'dug pa bden srid/ gang ltar phyi lo brgya phrag gsum tsam gyi yas mas skor gyi rgya gar byang phyogs kyi byung rabs lo rgyus gsal shes med pas de skabs kyi byung rabs skor sus kyang dpog ma nus par lus/ phyis su
le'u dang po/ sngon dus ③ byung rabs/ 243nges brnyed byung na de skabs su rtogs par 'gyur ba las 'os ma mchis/ga:ra'i sgyu rtsal skor/kukhug rgyal rabs skabs su dar zhing rgyas pa'i bzo yi rnam pa ga〉ra'i sgyu rtsal shā gh+nā ༵ dā sbyaX /shā ṭ+wāṃ (rdzu /shā (dzo ༵༵ /phrulapo tsa)ga na khrin balhar phra/ ༵ sta( ba/ra tsaspya /la dar rgyas su yod pa zhig yin/ pañtsab sa khul de ga〉ra'i sgyu stsal ches shin tu dar sa'i lte ba yin zhing garwar zhes pa'i mnga' sde de nyid theg chen gyi chos dar rgyas che ba'i sa gnas lte ba de yin la sa gnas de ni rgya gar dang / rgya nag dang / zhwarwan ste stag gzig dang / shāka dang rom gyi shes rig kun 'dzom sa'i sa gnas shig tu gyur yod cing / des na phyi rgyal gyi bsam blo dang rnam pa sogs gcig la gcig thim 'gro ba las sla po byung yod pa red/ de lta bu'i shes rig 'dres ma zhig las bzo yi rig pa gsar pa zhig byung yod pa red/ de'i rtsa ba beka9riX dang rgya gar byang nub la dbang 'dzin shāka las byung zhing / rgya gar gyi bzo rig gi mtshon don yod pa zhig la ga〉ra'i bzo bkod dam sgyu rtsal zhis bya/ sgru rtsal de ni dbus yeshilā'i mi rigs shaka dang / kugāṇa dang / lhag par kuniṣ+ka la brten nas dar rgyas su phyin pa zhig red/ mi rigs de tshog rang gi sngon rabs pa :ka pa rnams las sgyu rtsal gyi lugs srol de khyer yong nas khong tshos rang gi sa khul khag tu yeshilā'i nub kyi he niX'i lugs srol de 'grel bshad byas pa red/ kuniṣ+ka'i sku dus su khong gis bzo rig de ga'i sgo nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa dang / mchod rten dang / sku brnyan sogs grangs med bzhengs bskrun mdzad pas sgyu rtsal de cher dar
244 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjodapa/khyab chen por gyur pa red/garwara'i bzo rtsal 'di nyid shrīka pa'am heleni yi bzo rig roman 7dong ma'i mnga' khul dang / yeshilā menor zhes pa las blangs pa zhig yin zhing / de la rgya gar gyi :ka sgyu rtsal lam/ yang na rgyuto roman sgyu rtsal zhes brjod cing / lag bzo'i sgyu rtsal de rgya gar bas dang du blangs te nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos thog bed spyod byas pa zhig red/ der brten 'di la shāka nang pa'i lag bzo'i sgyu rtsal zhes kyang brjod/bzo rig 'di la bzo stangs de shrīka nas blangs pa zhig yin yang rnam pa dang mtshon don de rgya gar ba yin zhing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i yid ches dang don 'ba' zhig ston pa'i ched du bed spyod byas pa zhig red/ shrīka gi lugs srol gyi sku 'dra bzo stangs yin pa gang zhig la sangs rgyas a+yau che ba'i khyad chos tshang ba dang / rgyun roman gyi lha yi bzo stangs la nang pa'i lha yi sku brnyan khag bzhengs pas rgya gar gyi bstan don zhig swāto roman kyi bzo rig brgyud nas 'grel bshad byas pa zhig red/mdor na ga〉ra'i bzo bo mkhas pa tshos lag bzo shrīka dang / bsam blo rgya gar la gzhi byas pa lta bu zhig red/ gang ltar ga〉ra'i lag bzo 'di bzhin rgya gar gyi phyi logs su rgya nag dang / tu'istun dang / sog yul dang / korilnga dang / nyi hong sogs la dar rgyas chen po byung zhing / tshang mas dga' mos byed/ bod du lag bzo 'di dar min cha ma mches/ 'phags yul nas bzo rig pa bod du dar yod tshul bshad pa tsam las mthil phyin pa'i bshad pa ma mthong /gangs rgyas kyi sngon ma'i 'khrungs rabs dang / da lta'i mdzad pa sogs ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku brnyan mang po rdo nag po las bzo bskrun
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 245byas 'dug pa las ga〉ra'i bzo rig las sku brnyan gyi bzo skrun la khyad du 'phags pa'i grub 'bras thon yod par shes thub/gartswara'i lag bzo'i sgyu rtsal de ni rgya gar gyi lag bzo'i sgru rtsal gzhan las khyad du 'phags par shes sla ste/ dang po sbyoto roman gyi mdzes rig la dpe blangs te bzhengs pa'i nang pa'i sku brnyan khag gi zhal ras dang / sku gzugs kyi dbyibs sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ste/ de dag gi zhal ras zlum po dang / na bza' lhug lhug dang / dbu skra rba rlabs ltar su lu can yod cing / sku yi cha shas thams cad kyai tshad snyoms pa yod/ khyad chos gnyis pa ni sku gzugs kyi cha shas yan lag thams cad tshang zhing mi dngos gnas pa zhig gi gzugs po nang bzhin bzhengs yod pa red/ gsum pa ni/na bza' lhug lhug la lteb tse chen po dang ri mo mthug po yod pa des gzhan dang mi 'dra ba lta bu zhig mthong rgyu yod/ bzhi pa ni sku brnyan tsho la bskos legs po dang / rgyan cha rgyas spros chen po dang / mtshon don zab po yod pa de yin/ rang re bod dang bcas pa'i yul mang po sangs rgyas kyi dbu skra su lu shig ge yod pa 'di ga〉ra'i bzo bkod las byung ba yin srid/gong gsal sku brnyan de tsho rdo 'jog gi zhig shul dang / aphaXnistun dang /pāṇ+ḍastun gyi byang nub kyi sa khul shin tu mang po nas brnyed son byung yod cing / de tsho ni rdo la brkos pa dang / rdza ma las bzos pa dang / 'dam las bzos pa la gser ñtsha byugs pa lta bu sogs yod 'dug bshāwar dang / 'ahor gyi 'grems ston khang khag tu ga〉ra'i bzo rig gi dngos po shin tu mang po ltar tshag byas yod/sngar dus tshod ring po zhig gi ring / gartswara'i lag bzo las byung ba'i sangs
246 'phagasayulagyi byung babarjod pa/rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku 'dra khag dang / mthurā sogs nas brnyed pa'i sku brnyan khag gcig pa yin pa'i yid ches byas kyang / mkhas dbang mjumadur (27 lo'i35774) mchog gis mthurā la brtag dpyad gnang nas gsungs don/ gartswara'i bzo bkod kyi sku brnyan tsho ni dngos gnas don dang mthun pa dang / gzugs po'i mdzes cha la shugs brgyabs yod pa dang / mthurā sogs nas thon pa tsho la che ba'i rnam 'gyur dang / nang gi mtshon don la gal cher byas pa zhig red/ ces gsungs 'duggartswara'i bzo rig sgyu rtsal de sku brnyan rkyang pa la ma yin par khang bzo la yang mthong rgyu yod pa ni ri yi ngos dang / ri'i rtse mo sogs la bzhengs pa'i nang pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / dgon pa dang / lha khang shin tu mang por khang bzo'i lag rtsal mthong rgyu yod/ de dag gi zhig shul dang gyang gog rnams peXwar dang / rāwalapoX'i nye skor dang / ༷bul gyi sawata lung pa'i nang du yod/ de tsho'i nang nas 'ga' shas ni shin tu rgya chen po yod cing / 'ga' shas ni brag btub ste bzos pa yin/dgon pa la rnam pa me 'dra ba gnyis yod pa ni mchod rten dang / grwa shag gnyis kyi rnam pa de red/ mchod rten ni dgon pa'i rdo gcal gyi dkyil du bzhengs 'dug pa de yang rdo gcal gru bzhi pa thog ma bkab pa'i dkyil gyi stegs bu'i thog mchod rten ring po la gdugs rim pa drug yod pa mtho tshad khyon bsdoms miṭar bcu drug tsam yod/ byang phyogs su rdo skas rgya chen po zhig yod pa de nas stegs bu'i bar du 'gro/rdo gcal de'i phyogs gsum la lha khang chung chung gsum yod pa de dag la sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra re yod/ lha khang gi thog sgor sgor nyi gdugs dbyibs can de rgyuka gi bzo stangs byas pa de la byang khog 'dab ma gsum ldan rgya gar gyi spyir btang dbyibs yin pa red/ dgon pa'i nang gi lha khang chung chung khag gi thog 'bubs stangs khyad par can
le'u dang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 247'di tsho ni gartswara'i khang bzo'i khyad chos chen po zhig red/ mchod rten dang rdo gcal can gyi dgon pa de ni lho phyogs su yod cing / de dang byang phyogs kyi dgon pa'i bar gyi sa cha de la mchod rten dang lha khang chung chung khag yod pa de tshor sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhugs/ mchod rten gyi rdo gcal thog ma phub pa de bgrod lam dang skas 'dzeg zhig gis sbrel yod/ khyad chos gal che ba zhig ni dgon pa'i dkyil gyi rdo gcal gyi mtha' skor du shag mang po yod cing / grwa shag de tsho'i bar gyi rtsig pa'i ngos su sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas pa la dad 'dun byed mkhan tsho'i gzugs brnyan tshon khra mdzes po yod pas brgyan zhing / de tsho tshang ma la lcags ringam rwa bas bskor yod/'di tsho ni ri mo'am gzugs brnyan gyi 'grems ston khang lta bu mthong rgyu yod tshod/dgon pa'i nub brgyud du tshogs khang ngam 'du khang yod la/ de'i rgyab tu gnyer tshang dang / thab tshang dang / g.yog po sdod khang sogs tsag gi tsig ge mang po yod pa de tsho yang / 'ga' shas shrīka gi lugs ltar bzos yod/ ga〉ra'i lugs kyi khang bzo'i sgyu rtsal de ༷ka pa'i lugs srol thog sangs rgyas pa'i che ba'i khyad chos ston byed cig red/bzo yi srol de ku69 rgyal po tsho'i skabs dar khyab byung ba tsam ma yin par de'i rjes su yang brgya phrag gnyis lhag dar khyab byung / hāṇa gyi mi rigs tsho bslebs pa dang / zing 'khrug byung ste/ mchod rten dang dgon pa chig khri drug stong (1600)tsam rtsa gtor btang ba red/ garwara'i sgyu rtsal la de lta bu'i gnod skyon byung ba de ni shin tu bskal ba zhan pa'i gnas tshul zhig yin/ de nas phyi lo brgya phrag lnga pa'i nang du sgyu rtsal de rgya gar la rtsa brlag tu phyin pa red/ de nas ga〉ra'i sgyu rtsal de rgya gar du gnas ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgya gar dang shāka gnyis kyi shes reg dang /
248 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/lugs srol la mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba chen po byung ba'i gnad kyis yin zhes mkhas pa mang pos bzhed/ sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'i nang mi tsho'i mi 3 dang / yid ches byed stangs sogs ston gyi yod pa red/ mdor bsdus na/ dus skabs de tsho'i nang du rgya gar la shes rig dang / sgyu rtsal sogs kyi gnas tshad shin tu mthon po yod 'dug'on kyang ku69 7gong ma'i rgyal srid nyams rjes 'phags yul byang phyogs 'dir dus tshod gang mtshams ring shes rig dang / sred don gcig gyur brtan po zhig ma byung bar re zhig sil bur 'thor ba red/gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud kyi byung ba/ku69 7gong ma'i rgyal srid nyams rjes phyi lo brgya phrag gsum pa'i nang 'phaḍa yul byang phyogs 'dir rgyal phran rang btsan pa chung khag dang / spyi mthun rgyal phran chung chung khag shin tu mang po byung yod kyang de tsho'i skor zhib gsal da bar rgyu mtshan dang ldan par shes ma thub/ mor+sha 7gong ma'i rgyal srid rjes rgya gar byang phyogs su 7tong ma che shos gnyis pa m+pi gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud yin zhing / de yang phyo lo brgya phrag gsum pa'i mjug tsam du gup+ta'i rgyal srid kyu rmang gzhi tshugs yod tshod la/ brgya phrag bzhi pa'i nang sduga'i mnga' thang shin tu rgyas shing / dus rabs de nas gup+ta 7gong ma'i dus rabs dngos gnas 'go tshugs pa yin/ rgya gar gyi byung rabs nang gup+ta'i dus rabs de la rgya gar gyi shes rig gi cha nas khyad du 'phags pa'i dus rabs su ngos 'dzin byed/ dus rabs der slar yang byang phyogs su sred don 9 chig sgril chen po zhig byung zhing byang phyogs kyi rgyal khams su spyir btang zhi bde byung yod/ dus rabs 'dir phyogs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la nyams rgyud kyang byung yod pa dang /
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 249rgyal ba pa'i bstan pa yang nyams dmas su gyur/ rig byed kyi chos lugs la rgyal kha dang dar rgyas shin tu chen por byung ba red/ sgyu rtsal dang / gzhung lugs dang /tshan rig dang / mtshan nyid la yar rgyas chen po byung zhing / rgya gar la mtshan mthong chen po byung yod par brten gup+ta'i dus rabs de la gser gyi dus rabs te dus rabs shin tu bzang po zhig yin zhes rgya gar ba tshos bshad dang shod bzhin pa 'di rig byed kyi chos kyi cha nas shin tu bden par mngon yang / sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi cha nas mya ngan med dang / ku4ṇa rgyal rabs lta bu rgya gar la byung med pa yin pa kun gsal red/khungs gtugs sa/gup+ta 7gong ma'i rgyal srid skor khungs gtuḍa sa mang po yod pa'i nang nas bstan bcos kyi khungs ni sngon rabs nang nas lā.upārāṇa te rlung lha'i sngon rabs dang /ma65rāṇa te nya yi sngon rabs dang / khri45rāṇa te khyab 'jug gi sngon rabs dang /lhagawataburāṇa te legs ldan gyi sngon rabs de tsho gal che bar brtsi zhing / de tsho'i nang nas rgyal po tsho'i mi rgyud kyi rim pa dang / mnga' ris dang / mnga' sde dang / sa mtshams skor gsal yod/ der ma zad khrishākhadat+ta ste sa gas byin gyis mdzad pa'i muXrāk+ṣas ste srin po'i phyag rgya dang / nag mo khol gyis mdzad pa'i kumārasalhawa ste gzhon nu 'byung ba dang / shakun+ta.ā ste bya len ma sogs zlos gar gyi bstan bcos mang po las kyang gup+ta'i dus rabs skabs kyu srid don dang / spyi tshogs dang / dpal 'byor gyi mi che'i skor cung zad dpog thub/ stabs legs pa zhig la rgya nag gi gnas skor ba pārgyun (92—5317) gyi lam yig la lta chog yod pa khong ni tsan+d+ragup+ta gnyis pa'i
250 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/skabs rgya gar du phebs pa zhig red/ khong gi lam yig nang 'khod pa tshang ma bden min ji ltar yang rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs dang chos kyi gnas tshul zhib gsal 'khod yod pa red/ i.āhāshād nas thob pa'i samudragup+ta'i rdo ring thog gi brkos bris la khungs ldan gyi gnas lugs mang po 'khod yod pa red/ der ma zad udagagiri yi brag phug gi brkos bris dang / menyarole rdo ring dang / 34ra yi rdo ring thog gi bskos yig rnams kyang gup+ta'i rgyal srid kyi byung rabs la phan thogs chen po yod/gup+ta'i dus rabs su bzhengs bskrun byas pa'i dewaṇ+ḍaha'i lha khang dang / gaja1'i brag phug dang / sku brnyan rnams ni byung rabs kyi nyams zhib la rin thang shen tu che ba red/ gup+ta'i 7gong ma tsho'i skabs kyi gser dngul gyi dong tse spus legs sna tshogs pa de tsho las kyang / gup+ta'i rgyal po 'ga' shas kyi sku yi gzi brjed dang / srid don gyi 'khrug cha sogs kyi skor rjes su dpog thub/gup+ta'i rgyal srid kyi rmang gzhi/yul mgadha zhes pa srid don gyi lte ba de smar+sha'i rgyal srid nyams rjes kunawas rgyal rabs kyis bzung ste/ de rjes lo mang po zhig ring sa gnas der ga re byung min gsal shes ma byung yang / 3 lo brgya phrag gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i skabs rgyal srid gsar pa stobs chen zhig dar rgyas su gyur pa red/ de yang i.āhāgad yi rdo ring dang gruga'i brkos yog gzhan khag tu shrīgug ste dpal ldan sbas pa dang / ghalgoskoca zhes pa'i rgyal po gnyis kyi mtshan gsal zhing / der ma zad rgya nag gi gnas skor ba etrag (1131 saḥ) zhis pa des kyang rgyal po chen po shrīgup+ta ni brgya phrag de'i nang lha khang bzhengs mkhan tu bshad/ des na shrīgup+ta zhes pa de gup+ta'i rgyal sred kyu rmang gzhi
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 251'dzug mkhan yin par gsal/ 〈gup+ta ni phyi lo 270 tsam la khri la 'khod yod tshod/lhagashuca gup+ta de 3 lo brgya phrag gsum pa'i bcu phrag dang po gnyis tsam du rgyal srid bskyangs pa yin par cha 'jog byed thub/ de'i rjes cajagup+ta ste zla ba smras pa dang po de phyi lo 320 lor khri la 'khod/can+dagup+ta dang po/ (phyi lo 320pha30)yishu'i dus rabs bzhi pa'i 'go stod du rgyal po chung ngu zhig stobs chen por gyur te mgadha la dbang byas shing / de ni tsan+d+ragup+ta dang po ste zla ba sbas pa dang po de yin zhing / rgyal po des sngon dus kyi lits+tsha) rgyal rigs kyi sras mo kumāradeX ste gzhon nu lha mo zhes pa zhig khab tu bzhes/ le:spru tsho dang mnyam gnyen 'brel byas pas de tsho'i grogs ram la borten nas rgyal po de'i stobs shugs rgya skyed byas te gawadha dang / mgadha dang / i.āhāshād bcas pa'i gaṅgā'i nye skor gyi yul rnams la dbang bsgyur byed thub pa byung ba red/'gup+ta dang / gharnyoskaca ñtsa gup+ta'i rgyal po dang po de gnyis la mahārā4 ste rgyal po chen po zhes 'bod cing / de gnyis kyi tsha bo cargyuzhug la mahārāhāḥrāng ste lhag pa'i rgyal po chen po zhes 'bod pa yin/ zla ba sbas pa dang po de ni rang gi btsun mo dang /btsun mo'i phyogs kyi mi rnams la brten yod pa ni khong gi gser gyi dong tse'i thog kho rang gi mtshan dang btsun mo gzhon nu lha mo'i mtshan dang / lots+tsha) rgyal khams kyi ming 'khod pa las gsal rtogs thub pa yin/ khong ni rgyal rgyud de'i rgyal po che shos dang po yin pa la the tshom med/ zla ba sbas pa de gup+ta'i lo rabs 'go 'dzugs gnang mkhan yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / grulta'i lo rabs ni phyi lo 320 phyi zla gnyis pa'i ches 26 nas ba: ba yin/ lo ches de khong khri la 'khod pa'i lo ches yin/
252 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/lo rabs de rgya gar gyi cha shas rgya che ba'i nang lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring bed spyod byed bzhin yod/zla ba sbas pa dang po de'i rgyal srid lo nyung nyung zhig smi phal cher phyo lo 330lor rdzogs shing khong gi khri yun rdzogs skabs gup+ta'i mnga' rig de bihār gyi cha shas mang che ba dang / nub tu deng sang gi ut+tarabadesha'i cha shas 'ga' zhig dang / shar phyogs su baṅgāl bar du khyab yod tshod la gup+ta'i rgyud pa des 7gong ma'i gnas stangs su bslebs par mnga' thang rgya skyed byas yod/samudragup+ta ste rgya mtsho sbas pa/ (phyi lo 3304375)zla ba sbas pa dang po'i rjes su khong gi sras samudragup+ta ste rgya mtsho sbas pas rgyal srid bzung zhing / des khri lo bzhi bcu zhi lnga rgyal srid bskyangs pa dang / de ni rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs nang brjed du mi rung zhing mnga' thang che ba'i rgyal po tsho'i gras shig yin/ rgya mtsho sbas pa'i skor mang po zhig sgor mo khag dang / bskos yig khag las gsal zhing / sngon mya ngan med kyis btsugs pa'i rdo ring zhig thog legs sbyar saskrota'i skad du brkos pa zla ches ma 'khod pa zhig ekāhāshāda'i rdzong du yod/ de ni mya ngan med kyis bcugs pa'i rdo ring zhig gi thog phyis rgya mtsho sbas pas rang gi gnas tshul bskos bris byas yod pa dang / de'i rjes kha che'i rgyal pos kyang liṃ ge brkos 'dug gang ltar rdo ring de deng dus i.āhāhād yi rdzong mkhar du yod/brkos yig de'i nang gsal rgya mtsho sbas pa de rgyal po zhig yin par ma zad snyan ngag mkhan zhig kyang yin pa dang / rang gi yab kyis khong rang gi rjes 'dzin par bdams shing de nyid ni 'os shing mtshams pa yin pas blon po sogs zhabs 'bring pa
le'u dngapo/ sngon dus 9byung rabs/ 253rnams dga' bo byung yod tshul sogs 'khod yod la/ der ma zad bskos bris de'i nang du rgya mtsho sbas pa'i snying stobs dang / blo gros dang / dmag mi'i yon tan khag gi skor zhib gsal 'khod yod pa red/ de ltar rdo ring gi ngos sa cha stong pa yod sar rgya mtsho sbas pas khrag sbyor dmag 'khrug gi bya ba byas tshul dang / btsan rgol byas pa'i lo rgyus brkos 'dug pa de mya ngan med kyi zhi bde'i phrin bzang de dang 'gal ba che zhing de yang mya ngan med kyi rdo ring thog brkos pa de khyad mtshar po zhig red/rgya mtsho sbas pas rgya gar byang phyogs su dbang bsgyur byas pa/brkos yig nang rgya mtsho sbas pas dbang sgyur gyi bya ba dang / de la brten nas 7gong ma'i gnas stangs la phan thogs byung tshul bshad pa byas 'dug rgyal po des khong rang nyid rgya gar du stobs shugs che shos 'byung ched las don 'jiḍa su rung ba lag len du bstar nas grub 'bras kyang thon pa red/ thog mar khong gi bka' dbang la bca 'jog ma byas pa'i gaṅgā'i thang gi rgyal po rnams dbang du bsdu bar lo 'ga' shas 'gor ba dang / gaṇapa:nāg the bas rgyal po dgu pham par byas te de rnams kyi rgyal khams khag gup+ta 7gong ma'i mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ de nas khong gi nags gseb kyi mi sde khag dbang du bsdus te de tshos khong gi bka' la nyan pa dang / khral 'bul ba sogs byas te 7gong ma la dngos su mdo 'bul byas/rgya mtsho sbas pas lho phyogs su dpung 'jug byas pa/rgya mtsho sbas pas lho phyogs ḍamin la dbung 'jug thengs gcig gam de las mang ba byas yod 'dug cing des kosala'i rgyal po mahen+d+ra dang / mahākan+dara'i rgyal po 9grarlang dang / kāṅgā'i rgyal po bistugopa sogs rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyal po bcu lhag
254 'phagasayul9byung babarjod pa/tsam pham par byas te 'dzin bzung byas kyang 'phral du glod dkrol btang / byung rabs mkhas pa mang pos lho phyogs kyi rgyal khams rnams gtan 'jags 'dzin bzung ched du dpung 'jug byas pa min tshul bshad/ gang ltar lho phyogs kyi yul khams de tsho rgya mtsho sbas pa'i dbang 'og nas myur du grol ba yin tshod/ rgya mtsho sbas pa las pham nyes byung ba'i rgyal po tsho las 'bul dngos blo kha khengs pa thob ste rang gi rgyal sa la rin po che'i mdzod kyis khengs pa byung ba yin zhes lo rgyus nang 'khod yod/ lho phyogs su rgya mtsho sbas pa la gdong len byed mkhan rgyal po su yin min dang / rgya mtsho sbas pas rtsa med btang ba'i rgyal srid gang yin pa ngos 'dzin rgyu shin tu khag cing / rgya mtsho sbas pa las pham par khas len byed mkhan gyi rgyal po dang / sa cha sogs kyi skor mkhas pa tsho'i bzhed pa me mthun pa yin/ dper na mkhas dbang yeca si rāg :dhari mchog gis kosalā ste deng dus kyi t+palās5ra dang / rāgapur dang / sam+bhalapur rnams rgya mtsho sbas pas pham par byas pa yin zhes gsungs/ mkhas dbang lharmārakār gyis mahānaṭar nas dzaso bar dang / ajalalhar sogs bun+dalakhaṇ+ḍa yi sa gnas rnams yin tshul gsungs 'dug rādza :dhari yi dgongs pa ltar na sa gnas de dag ma65desha'i nags gseb kyi sa khul yin par 'dod/ rgya mtsho sbas pas pham par byas pa'i sa gnas kokhurā zhes pa de keral gyi sa gnas wenagi'i nye 'gram dang / ku'4 zhes pa dbus phyogs mnga' sde dang / eraṇasapale zhes pa khrinadesha yi iran9le yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / 'ga' shas kyis de yinaṭapali smi khrishākhripacanam dang / dewarāṣ+ṭa ni mahārāṣ+ṭa la ngos 'dzin byed/ de bzhin dzi5bur ni wanaji dang / kunaci la ngos 'dzin byed par rtsod pa chen po med/ gong gi ngos 'dzin tshul rnams mkhas pa gcig gi bzhed tshul min par mang pos 'dra min du bzhed pa yin/ 'on kyang rgya mtsho sbas
le'udang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 255pa'i dpung dmag rnams kunaciburam bar du bslebs pa yin nam/ yang na paluwa'i rgyal po bistugopa dang mnyam lho phyogs kyi rgyal po khag sa mtshams su thug nas rgya mtsho sbas pas de dag pham par byas pa gang yin skor la mkhas pa tsho'i bsam tshul mi mthun pa yod/ gang ltar rgya mtsho sbas pas lho phyogs su dpung 'jug byas dus khong gi dpung dmag tsho sa thag ring po'i sa khul bgrod dka' ba'i gnas su 'gro bskyod byas yod pa dang / de las khong gi drag po'i stobs shugs ji yod gsal por bstan yod pa zhig kyang red/ 'phrog bcom byas pa'i dngos rdzas khag dang snyan grags chen po dang bcas khong rang yul gyi rgyal sar log yong ba red/ rgyal kha'i rten 'brel ched du rta mchog gi mchod sbyin byas shing / bram ze tsho la dngos skyes gya nom pa sbyin pa dang / gser gyi byang bu dang / dong tse sgor mo ya mtshan pa mang po bzo 'grems byas pa red/rgya mtsho sbas pa'i mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon/mya ngan med kyi rjes su 7gong ma che shos rgya mtsho sbas pa'i rgyal kha'i mdzad bzang rtse mor son skabs khong gi mnga' ris de shar phyogs nas bra25ta dang / nub phyogs su casbal dang / byang phyogs su re bo gangs can dang / lho phyoḍa su namadā gtsang po'i bar du rgya skyed byas yod/ de lta na yang parleb dang mālalha yi rtsa ba'i mi rigs sde tshan dang / sa mtshams kyi sa khul mang po stobs chen rgyal po de yi srung skyob 'og rang skyong ljongs su gnas pa red/khyim mches rgyal khab khag dang 'brel lam/rgya mtsho sbas pa'i rgyal kha des khong gi mnga' ris kyi phyi logs kyi rgyal po dang / mi mang rnams ha las te mang po zhig gis 'bul ba dang / lo khral sogs phul/ de
