le'udangapo/ sngonadus 9byung rabs/ 257tsho'i nang du pañtsab ñtsa mthun rgyal khab dang / rā45tānā dang / myalalha dang /gsam dang / baṅgāl gyi dbang 'dzin pa tsho dang / kār+sharā dang / kumālā/garanywal mnga' sde bcas yod cing / kāspul gyi kukhug rgyal po dang / sisola'i nang pa'i rgyal po bcas nas sku tshab kyang 'byor ba red/ ñtsāṅgala'i rgyal po meghawarma ste sprin gyi go chas rang gi sku tshab brgyud rgya mtsho sbas pa la 'bul ba bskur te/ khong gi gling nas gnas skor ba tsho'i ched du rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub ljon shing gi byang phyogs su dgon pa rdzig po zhig bzhengs chog pa'i bka' khrol zhus pa red/rgya mtsho sbas pa'i skor gsal bshad/rgya mtsho sbas pa de mi shin tu 'jon thang chen po zhig yin pa dang / gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i lhan skyes kyi yon tan yod pa zhig yin zhing / g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dmag spyi chen mo zhig kyang yin/ der ma zad khong ni rang gis dbang 'og tu bsdus pa'i mnga' ris rgya chen po de'i nang zhi bde dang / khrims dang / bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa gnas skyong byed thub pa'i rgyal gces pa zhig kyang red/ khong rol dbyangs la mkhas po yod pa ni gser gyi sgor mo'i steng du khong rang nyid khri'i thog pi wang dkrol bzhin bzhugs yod pa 'khod 'dug pa des gsal por shes thub/ khong ni snyan ngag la mkhas po yod pas snyan ngag mkhan grags can gzhan ltar khong gis kyang snyan ngag mang po brtsams yod tshul bshad/ khong ni mi mkhas pa'i gras la brtsi mthong chen po byed mkhan zhig yon zhing / lhag par mtshan nyid dang/ stan ngag mkhan la do snang chen pos bca bkur byas yod 'dug khong ni bram ze'i chos lugs pa zhig yin zhing / khong gi rgyal rgyud gzhan ltar khyab 'jug la lhag par dad pa chen po
258 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/zhig yod par nges la/ der ma zad khong rig byed kyi chos lugs la mkhregs bzung byed mkhan zhig yin yang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa tsho la yang srung skyob byas yod pa red/ 'ga' shas kyis slob dpon dbyig gnyen las rgya mtsho sbas pas nang pa'i skor slob sbyong byas yod tshul bshad/ yang 'ga' shas kyis rgya mtsho sbas pas dbyig gnyen de la rang gi blon por bskos pa yin zhes zer/ 'on kyang slob dpon dbyig gnyen de rgyal po 'di'i skabs su byung ba yin min brtag dpyad bya dgos/ rgya mtsho sbas pas rgya gar gyi byung rabs nang gser gyi dus rabs 'go 'dzugs byas pa yin zhes 'char can brjod srol yod cing / khong gi rjes 'dzin pa zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa'am rnam gnon nyi ma ni de las kyang stobs che la gzhan phan byed mkhan gyi rgyal po zhig yin/rgya mtsho sbas pa'i skor bshad pa byed bzhin mkhas dbang ār si mjumadur mchog gis gsungs don/ rgya mtsho sbas pa ni rgyal po ngo mtshar can zhig dang phal cher 'gran zla med pa'i skyes bu zhig yin zhing rgya gar yongs rdzogs mnga' 'og tu bsdu ba'i bsam blo yod mkhan zhig yin par ma zad dmag gi 'go 'khrid dang / rgyal gces pa khyad du 'phags pa zhig red ces gsungs/mkhas dbang ār ka mukhaṭ+wāṃ mchog gis/ rgya mtsho sbas pa dang mya ngan med gnyis 'dra sdur byas te gsungs don/ mya ngan med kyis zhi bde dang 'che ba med pa'i srid byus bzung ba yin la rgya mtsho sbas pas de las ldog ste dmag 'khrug dang rgol 'dzing gi srid byug bzung yod pa red/ rgya mtsho sbas pa de la rgya gar 9 nepoliyen zhes 'bod cing / des dmag 'khrug brgya tham pa brgyabs pas dmag brgya pa dang /rgya gar gyi cha shas thams cad la phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'grul bzhud byas te rang nyid stobs dang mnga' thang che shos yin pa de bstan pa red/ mdor na rgya mtsho
le'u dang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 259sbas pa de mi pham pa rnams pham par byed mkhan gyi mi pham pa zhig yin/ zhes brjod srol 'dug rgya gar gyi byung rabs smra ba phal cher gyis mgrin gcig tu rgya mtsho sbas pa de la bstod pa gang thub byas shing / spyir btang sduga'i dus rabs de rgya gar gyi lo rgyus nang gser gyi dus rabs zhes dus rabs bzang shos yin par bshad dang shod bzhin pa lags kyang / mnga' thang ni d+marnya'i rgyal po mya ngan med las chung zhing /spyir btang 'dzam gling nang byas rjes ni mya ngan med dang mtshungs pa'i phyogs tsam yang med/ rig byed kyi chos lugs pa yin pas khong tsho'i cha nas bltas na de ltar yin pa'ang srid par nges/zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa'am phyi ma/ klu lo 375ra 15)rgya mtsho sbas pa'i sras rla ba sbas pa gnyes pa de yum daXdeX las 'khrungs pa yin zhing / yab kyi rjes su gup+ta'i rgyal sar 'khod/ yig cha 'ga' shas dang / 3 lo brgya phrag dgu pa bcu pa'i nang gi rākhri'i nang gi bskos yig 'ga' shas nang la gzhir byas na rgya mtsho sbas pa'i rjes thog tu rāmagup+ta ste dga' byed sbas pas rgyal srid bzung ba yin dgos pa dang / des rgyal srid lo gnyis las ma bskyangs par bshad/ 'on kyang bshad tshul 'di yid ches bya rung du ma mthong bas zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa de rgya mtsho sbas pa'i khri la 'khod par nges pa yin/ rgya mtsho sbas pa la sras gzhan yang yod par gsal/ 'on kyang zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa de nyid sras kun gyi nang nas 7gong ma'i rgyal sa la 'os shos yin pas dmigs bsal gyi 'dems sgrugs gnang yod tshod/ rgyal po 'di la zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa zhes byung rabs mkhan tshos bris pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud gcig gi nang la yang zla ba sbas pa snga phyi gnyis byung bas de
260 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/gnyis mi nor ba'i khyad yin/ der ma zad zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa 'di la mtshan gzhan yang yod de 〉kramadit+ya ste rnam gnon nyi ma zhes bya zhing mtshan 'di'i thog grags che/rgyal po 'dis dpung 'jug byas tshul/rla ba sbas pa gnyis pa 'di'i drag po g.yul gyi grub 'bras ni/ mālalha dang /gungarātra dang / sorāṣ+ṭa bcas la dpung 'jug gis dbang du bsdus pa de yin zhing / sa khul de tsho ni brgya phrag du ma'i ring shaka rgyal po tsho'i dbang 'og tu yod pa red/ shaka'i dbang 'dzin pa de tsho kukhug rgyal po'i bsil grib 'og tu gnas pa dang / de tsho la k+ṣatapa ste srid skyong du 'bod srol yod pa red/ zla ba sbas pas phal cher shaka'i srid skyong de tsho mu mthud rang dbang du gnas pa yin na 'phags yul gyi sred don gyi chig sgril la gnod cing nyen kha che bar bsam yod tshod/ khong rang gi dmigs yul 'grub ched thog mar lho phyogs ḍamin gyi dbang 'dzin pa wakaṭaka dang mnyam du mthun sbrel byas shing de'i dbang 'og hu buṇ+ḍalakha9 yi sa khul tshang ma yod pa red/ zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa yis rang gi sras mo prabhāwartu zer ba de ḍaskan rgyal po'i btsun mor sprad de/de las rgyab skyor thob/ de nas khong gis nub phyogs sa khul du dpung 'jug byed pa'i 'go btsugs/udagagiri ste 'char byed ri bo la yod pa'i brkos yig gcig nang gsal ba ltar zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa 'di yi zhi bde dang g.yul gyi blon po lngarasen ste dpa' bo'i sde zer ba 59liputra nas yin pa de nyid rgyal pos 'jig rten las rgyal bar byed pa'i las don la zhugs skabs udagagiri la rgyal po'i rjes su bcar ba yin par gsal 'dug de nas zla ba sbas pas nub phyogs kyi srid skyong tha ma rudasen ste drag po'i sde
le'u dang po/ sngonadus gyi byung rabs/ 261zhes pa de pham par byas te g.yul ngor bsad/ mālalha dang / sujarāto dang /〈rāṣ+ṭa dbang 'og tu bsdus/ dpung 'jug dbang sdud kyi bya ba des gup+ta'i mnga' ris rgya skyed byung bar ma zad nor dang longs spyod mang po yang thob pa dang / lhadzoca dang /so5rā sogs gru kha mang po yang thob pa de tsho las nub yeshiga'i rgyal khams tsho dang mnyam du tshong las byed kyi yod pa red/mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon/zla ba sbas pas rang gi mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon ni nub byang sa mtshams brgal nas rgya bskyed garang zhing / de ni kuṣ+ṭhacu dong tse 'ga' shas dang / deslo'i kutuba'inur 9 'gram du yod pa'i lcags kyi ka ba zhig gi thog leḍa sbyar skad nang brkos yig gcig las shes thub pa yin/ skya nar bu'i grong khyer ram/ 5975ta de ni zu ba sbas pa'i rgyal sa yin/ us+thān zhes pa ste/ 'phags rgyal de rgyal sa gnyis pa lta bu zhig yin par mngon/ der ma zad zhoyosgyu ste 'thab pa med pa de zla ba sbas pa'i las khang lte ba khag nas gcig yin/ gup+ta'i skabs kyi mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon ni rmona'i skabs kyi mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon las shin tu chung ba ni bshad mi dgos pa yin/mtha' bsdoms/zla ba sbas pas zangs dang dngul gyi ṭam sgor khag gsar du bzos pa dang /gser gyi ṭam sgor khag las khong gi rgyal khams kyi phun tshogs dang stobs shugs dang /rgyas spros bcas shes nus pa yod/ ṭam sgor de tsho'i nang la zla ba sbas pa de gzhu thog pa'i dpa' bo'i tshul du bstan cing rgyab phyogs su seng ge'i thog tu lha mo bzhuḍa pa 'khod yod/ ṭam sgor gzhan pa khag nang khong gis seng ge gsod bzhin pa 'khod pa de khong
262 'phags yul byung ba brjod pa/gi yab kyi ṭam sgor nang stag gsod bzhin pa 'khod pa dang mi 'dra ba yod/ ṭam sgor steng seng ge gsod bzhin pa des khong gis gujarātra'i yul dbang du bsdus pa de mtshon gyi yod tshod/ gang lags zer na rgya gar gyi nang sa gnas de kho na la seng ge yod pa red/ sa gnas de nas sa cha gzhan du khrid pa ni yod/ rgya nag gi gnas skor ba pārgyun (ga2—5312) zer ba de rgyal po 'di'i rgyal khams su phebs pa dang / de'i lam yig nang nas rgyal khams de'i phun tshogs dang / zhi bde dang / 'dzin skyong tshags su tshud pa yod pa de khungs skyel thub pa yon/la srung ༵༵ rdo rnyiX gh+nā hūm̐ shāpyal nardo rgya~X rnyi ṅgi/ gyis sdishāX /zlo da/ pa'ag ṭ+wāṃ dī shāshā sa pa chen po zhig yin pa dang / khong gi rgyal srid bzang po'i lo rgyus rnams rtag tu dran 'os pa zhig tu gyur yod/ khong gi lhan tshogs nang rin po che'am mkhas pa'i mi dgu yod pa'i nang nas nag mo khol de kun gyi yang ce yin par 'dod/ mdor bsdus na zla ba sbas pa'i rgyal srid ni rgya mtsho sbas pas gzhi btings pa'i gup+ta'i rgyal srid gcig lha( sbyo hā hūm̐ ༵ ༵ /shā lha shār/ ya/ nāX lha par da ṇā hūm̐ rlo pa sta (zo /sopa da ( rgya/ ma~X spra sprad pa dang zla ba sbas pa yab sras 'di gnyis kyi bka' dren yin par 'dod/ shrīka gi dpa' bo engaskyuṇ+ḍar dang / lho phyogs kyi rgyal po grags can rwajedrecal gnyis ltar zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa 'di yang yab chen po zhig gi sras chen po zhig yin la/ rang gi yab kyis 'go 'dzugs byas pa'i bya ba rdzogs par byed mkhan zhig yin/kumāragup+ta ste gzhon nu sbas pa/ (phyi 'ag 415ra 55)zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa'i rjes su kumāragup+ta ste gzhon nu sbas pas rgyal sring bzung ba yin la/ rgyal po de ni ldab mes ltar dbang sdud spi bya ba grags che bca gras
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 263su mi brtso zhing / zhi bde la dga' bas khong gi rgyal srid ring / zhi bde dang phun tshogs yun gnas byung / khong gis 'dzin skyong legs po khag yar rgyas btang ba dang /mnga' ris de brtan po dang stobs chen por gnas par byas/ rgyal po 'di chos dang gzhung lugs la lhag par dang 'dod chen po zhig yin pas/ lo rgyus mkhan tshos dpal nulan+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen mo de rgyal po 'dis chaṇa btab pa yin par 'dod/ 'on kyang bod kyi bshad tshul la/ dpal nul: de'i thog mar chags 'debs pa po mya ngan med yin zhing / rgyas par mdzad pa klu sgrub yin zhes bzhed srol 'dug pa 'di dag la khungs gang yod par ma shes pas brtag dpyad bya 'os su mthong / gang ltar gtsug lag khang 'di ni 'jig rten la snyan par grags pa'i gtsug lag slob khang chen mo zhig yin/gzhon nu sbas pa'i rgyal srid kyi lo dus ring po de'i nang nub phyogs nas hāṇa (5574)mi rigs kyis dpung 'jug byas 'dug kyang / de'i sras man+dagug ste phung po sbas pa 'am zhi ba sbas pa zhes pas drag po'i shugs kyis phyir zlog byas pa red/man+dagulta ste (zhi ba sbas pa/) zhu lo 455'ag67)man+dagup+ta ste zhi ba sbas pa ni gup+ta'i rgyal po chen po tha ma de yin/ gzhon nu sbas pa 'das pa'i rjes su rgyal srid sus 'dzin min la dka' rnyog dang rtsod pa byung yod tshod kyang / zhi ba sbas pa'i 'jon thang dang byas rjes las yab kyi shul 'dzin du lam lhong dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rgyal sar 'khod/ nang gi dgra bo rnams mgo mnan rjes rang gi gnas stangs brtan po bzos te zhi ba sbas pas 'jigs su rung ba'i nyug mi rigs tsho las rang yul gyi srung skyob byed dgos byung ba red/ hun zhes pa'i mi rigs de tsho ni nub phyogs yuropa dang / shar phyogs yeshilā gnyis kur mi bde ba
264 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjodapa/bzo mkhan zhig yin 'dug la hun gyi skor gsham du cung zad rgyas par 'god rgyu yin/zhi ba sbas pas hun tsho pham par byas te mthar sprod btang nas guga'i rgyal khams la grung skyob byas pas ma tshad/ rgya gar yongs rdzogs la gnod skyon chen po 'byung nyen byung ba de las srung skyob byas pa zhig red/ der brten rgyal po 'de la bikamādongu smi rnam gnon nyi ma zhes pa'i gzengs bstod kyis brgyan pa de dngos 'brel don dang mthun pa zhig red/ rnam gnon nyi ma m+pi khong gi yang mes rla ba sbas pa gnyis pa'i mtshan yin zhing / de dang mdzad rjes mtshungs pa sogs kyis rgyal po 'di la gzengs bstod phul ba yin par nges/'on kyang zhi ba sbas pa 'di 'das rjes gup+ta'i rgyal khams zhis pa sngar rgyal phran chung chung zhig nas stobs chen 7gong ma'i rgyal khab tu dar zhing rgyas pa de nyid rim bzhin nyams nas mthar dum bur rtsa brlag tu phyin pa red/ gup+ta'i rgyal srid nyams te rtsa brlag tu phyin pa'i rgyu rkyen dang / gup+ta'i mnga' thang gi phun tshogs sogs kyi skor gsham du 'chad rnga ra bya'o//gup+ta'i skabs kyi chab srid 'dzin skyong dang / spyi tshogs dang / dpal 'byor gyi mi che dang / shes rig yar rgyas sogs/byung rabs smra ba tshos 'char can bshad srol ltar na/ perisalen (96501380)skabs kyi grwas dang / sidzar (062881) skabs kyai rom dang / e.ipabetha (211226365) skabs kyi dbyin yul rnams yul de tsho'i gser gyi dus skabs te dus skabs bzang shog su brtsi srol yod pa red/ de bzhin rgya gar du gup+ta'i dus rabs de la yang gser gyi dus rabs te chos dang 'jig rten gang thad nas dus skabs bzang shog yin zhes bshad tshul 'dug sulha'i rgyal rgyud rnams drag po dmag gi stobs
le'u dngapo/ sngonadus gyi byung rabs/ 265shugs 'ba' zhig gi cha nas grags che ba min par rgyal khab 'dzin skyong la zhib tshags dang do snang shin tu chen po yod pa dang / sgru rtsal rig gnas la yar rgyas chen po byung yod/harisen zhes pas bskos yig nang rgyal khab kyi 'dzin skyong thad gsal bshad byas yod pa ltar na gup+ta'i skabs su gzhung gi ngo bo ni rgyal srid yin zhing / gup+ta'i rgyal po tsho'i skabs su rgyal po la dkon mchog gi mthu nus yod pa'i bsam srol de dar so chen po yod nges te/ dper na rgya mtsho sbas pa de nyid dkon mchog mi'i gzugs su sa steng du byon pa yin tshul bshad 'dug de lta na yang rgyal po de tshos dbang shugs sger 'dzin gyi bya ba nam yang byas med cing / dbang shugs sger spyod byed mkhan 9 rgyal po rnams yun ring du gnas ma thub par nyams pa yin zhes byung rabs mkhas pa tshos spyir btang bzhed/ rgyal po tshos bgres pa rnams kyi gros la gsan gyi yod 'dug pas srid gzhung gi mdzad don la mkhas pa yod 'dug spyir btang rgyal sras rgan pa de la rgyal tshab tu 'dems sko byed srol yod cing / des rgyal po'i phyogs nas mnga' sde khag gi chab sred 'dzin skyong byed/ gal te rgyal po sku na shin tu bgres na chab srid 'dzin skyong gi khur mtha' dag rgyal tshab kyi phrag par 'babs pa yin/ kumāradeX dang /3wadeX bcas re gnyis ma gtogs spyir btang bud med rigs rgyal sa la 'god pa'i srol med/ dbang 'dzin rgyal po de tshos dmigs bsal mtshan gnas bzhes srol yod pa dang / mtshan gnas de tsho ni dper na rāhā:rāju ste lhag pa'i rgyal po chen po dang / ekarās ste rgyal po gcig pā dang / saspuṭa ste 7gong ma dang/ parameshār te mchog gi dbang phyug sogs red/ mtshan gnas de dag so so'i gnas stangs dang mthun par bzhes srol yod pa red/ skabs re btsun mo rnams la yang mahādeX ste lha
266 'phagasayul gyi byungab brjodapa/mo chen mo zhes pa'i mtshan gyis gzengs bstod 'bul srol yod pa red/ rgyal po tsho la dbang shugs tshad med pa yod pa dper na de tshos thugs mnyes pa'i mi la sa gzhis gnang ba dang / khral bsdu ba dang / chu rag rtsig pa sogs gnang thub kyi yod pa red/ snyan ngag mkhan dbyug pa can gyis gup+ta'i gzhung de ljon shing dang / de'i rtsa ba ni shes rab kyis drangs pa'i 'char gzhi khag dang / yal ga ni shugs nus dang /'bras bu ni gzhan la phan pa yin zhes gsungs/ spyir btang rgyal po tsho so so'i rjes 'dzin pa de rgyal po rang nyid kyis 'dems srol yod cing 'on kyang tshogs 'dus rgyal po'i rjes 'dzin gyi ming 'bod byas pa'i skor yang bshad 'dugrgyal srid lhan tshogs/ grulta'i dbang 'dzin pa tsho la phyag rogs zhu mkhan blon chen lhan tshogs yod cing / blon chen de tsho ni spyor btang rgyal sras tsho dang /ches mtho'i dpon rigs khag dang / sger bdag khag nas sko bzhag byed srol yod/nang blon chen mo ni rgyal po dang blon chen lhan tshogs bar sbrel mkhan lta bu zhig yin zhing / blon chen po ni blon chen lhan tshogs kyis thag gcod byas pa'i don gnad de lag len star mkhan yin/ der ma zad phye sred las don blon po dang / dpal 'byor ram nor srid blon po dang / khrims don blon po bcas yod cing / blon po de tsho spyir btang rigs rgyud 'dzin mkhan sha stag yin pa dang / tshogs 'du'i las don rnams gsang ba byas nas 'jog pa yin/zhi ba'i 'dzin skyong byed mkhan gyi las byed pa mang po sko bzhag byas yod pa de tshos rgyal po'i btsun mo tsho'i nang don la lta rtogs dang / rgyal po la mjal 'phrad zhu mi tsho la gra sgrig lta rtogs dang / gnas phrin tshang ma rgyal po la snyan seng zhu rgyu bcas byed kyi yod pa red/ skabs re de tshos rgyal po la gros 'debs zhu mkhan lta bu'i las
le'udang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 267don yang byed cing / de tshos rgyal po la lam ston zhu mkhan dang 'gan len zhu mkhan gyi tshul du las ka byed/khral bsdu rgyu'i las don dang skor bya ba'i las don gnyis rnam pa kun tu tha dad pa min la dpon rigs gal che ba khag ni gong blon dang / sdud dpon (khral sdud ba po )sogs yin/dmag gam drag po'i 'dzin skyong ni dmag dpon dang / dmag dpon chen mo dang / khrims ngapon dang / 'khrug sdom pa (dmag don drung che ) dang / srung skyob pa sogs kyis byed/ de tsho'i nang nas che shos ni dmag dpon chen mo yin la de ni deng dus dmag spyi chen mo dang gcig pa yin/ khrims dpon la drag po'i las don dang khrims kyi las don zung 'brel gyi las 'gan yod tshod/ srung skyob pa zhes pa de gzhung gi khrims rtsod pa lta bu zhig yin/khrims kyi las don ni khrims dpon chen mo dang / khrims khang gi drung yig sogs kyis phyag rogs zhus te rgyal po rang nyid kyis byed cing / khrims dpon chen mo/ ni khrims bdag dang / khrims khang gi drung yig ni yig cha 'god mkhan yin/pārgyun gyis guga'i rgyal po tshos nyes can la gzugs po'i thog chad pa gcod 9 med tshul dang / nyes can rnams la so so'i nyes pa lci yang la ltos te khrims gcod byed tshul bshad/ 'on kyang gzhung la ngo rgol thengs gnyis pa byas na de yi lag pa gags pa gtub pa'i chad pa gcod/ gal te nag can zhig la srog gi nyes pa phog na de ske bsdam gzar gyis gsod pa'am/ glang chen la gsod du bcug pa bcas byed/ chad pa rtsub shos ni mig 'don pa'i chad pa de yin/ spyir btang chad pa 'di rnams srid don gyi nag nyes can rnams la gtong ba yin/ nyes can yin min brtag dpyad ched
268 'phags yul rgya byung babarjodapa/chu dang mes gnod min dpyad pa dang / srang la 'degs pa dang / dug blud pa sogs byed srol yod/ dper na mi zhig gis nag nyes khas ma blangs na me thog gom pa spo bcug pa'am/ lag pa me nang bcug skabs mes ma tshog na dkar po yin pa dang / lag pa tshog na nag nyes can yin par ngos 'dzin byed srol yod 'dugmnga' ris ni mnga' sde du mar bgos shing / mnga' sde'i spyi khyab la gong blon nam/skyong ba po'am srung ba po zhes 'bod/ spyir btang rgyal po'i nang mi tshos mnga' sde'i spyi khyab kyi go gnas 'dzin srol yod/ mnga' sde ni rdzong khag tu bgos shing / de tsho la rdzong dpon tshos dbang sgyur byed/ rdzong ni grong gseb khag tu bgos shing de rnams la grong dpon tshos dbang byed/ grong gseb kyi tshogs 'du khag dang / grong khyer lhan tshogs rnams ni rang skyong gi 'dzug skrun yin la de dag la rgyal po'i dpon rigs khag gis gzigs rtogs byed/da dung gzhung zhabs pa mang po yod pa dper na grong khyer gyi phyug bdag ces pa grong khyer gyi tshong pa tsho'i tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin sogs yin/ rgyal khab kyi yong 'bab ni sa zhing gi khral 'babs yin/ de ni sa zhing thog bdag po'i thob thang med pa tsho las so nam gyi khral blangs pa rnams yin la khral de rnams ni dngul thog dang / thon skyed dngos po gnyis thog nas len srol yod pa red/ der ma zad nyes can tsho la dbang med du ngal rtsol dang / chad pa brgyabs pa las kyang yong 'babs yod/chab srid 'dzin skyong 'di ni gzhan la phan pa dang 'jam mkhas can gyi srid 'dzin skyong gi rnam pa lta bu zhig yin zhing / sger gyi mi tsho la sdug sbyong gis the byus cher med/ dbus gzhung dang mnga' sde gzhung gnyis ka sgrig 'dzugs shin tu yag po yod cing / rgyal po'i rgyal srid lhan tshogs des las don tshags tshud byed kyi yod pa
le'udang t+pā/ sngon dus kyibyung rabs/ 269dang / grong gseb khag dang rdzong khag la ga re 'byung gi yod min skor gyi gnas tshul tshang ma ji bzhin shes rtogs yod pa red/ nag nyes can la khrims gcod a+yau 'dzin skyong ni khrims lugs dang 'gro ba mi'i 'du shes gnyis 'dzoms kyi phan bde'i rang bzhin zhig yin zhes bshad srol yod/ gzhung gis mi dmangs kyi chos dang srid gnyis ku'i bde don la lta rtogs byed/ gzhung gi 'dzin skyong de dbus su gcig 'dus ma yin par sa gnas 'dzin skyong sde khag tsho la dbang shugs chen po yod cing 'grul pa tsho phyir ba grod lam la srung skyob nus ldan byed kyi yod pa red/spre tshogs kyi gnas stangs/ rig byed chos lugs pa'i spyi tshogs ni sngar srol ltar rigs bzhir bgos te/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u'i rigs dang / gdol pa'i rigs bcas bzhi red/ yang yongs su gnas pa'am āsham bzhi yod de/ tshangs par spyod pa dang / khyim du gnas pa dang / nags su rab tu gnas pa dang / yongs su spong ba'am 'dor ba'i gnas pa ste bzhi yin zhing / de dag bzhi por gang zag gcig rim bzhin 'jug par byed pa yin/ rgyal po ni spyi tshogs kyi go rim la rogs ram dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan yin zhing / sgrig 'dzugs bskyar du bzos pa'i sgo nas phyi rgyal ba rgya gar du gtan sdod byed mkhan tsho la rig byed pa'i spyi tshogs nang thob dbang nges can zhig sprad yod pa red/ gru yang gi dus skabs gang mtshams shig gi rjes su rigs tri rnam bzhag de sbug srub dog po dang sra mkhregs can zhig tu gyur nas bram ze rnams spyi tshogs kyi nang gi rtsed mo lta bur gyur yod pa red/bram ze la sbyin pa'am 'bul ba phul ba'i yon tan dang de la bsngags brjod chen po byas pa dang / nyes pa che chung la ltos pa'i dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs skrag bskul nas rigs so so'i byed sgo rnams la bram ze tshos dbang bsgyur byas/ rgya nag
270 'phags yulagyi byung babarjodapa/gi gnas skor ba mkhas pa pārgyun gyis gsungs gsal/ rgya gar yul tshang ma la sus kyang srog chag gang yang mi gsod cing / sus kyang myos chu mi mthung ba dang / sgog pa dang / btsong yang za gi mi 'dug 'on kyang gdol pa'i rigs rnams zur du phyes te/ rigs de ni smad par 'os pa'i ming du 'dod cing / de tsho tshang ma mi tshogs gzhan rnams las zur du gnas dgos pa dang / de tsho grong khyer nang dang /khrom la yong dgos dus so so gzhan las khyad par 'byed pa'i don du de tshos shing gi dum bu zhig brdungs te 'gro dgos/ de la brten nas mi tshos de rnams su yin shes nas de tsho dang 'brel ba mi byed cing / de rnams las ring du byol/ de min mi mang rnams la gzhung gi the gtogs ma byas par phyug cing skyid po 'dug mi mang rnams so sos gang 'dod kyi sa la rang dbang gis 'gro bskyod byed chog gi 'dug ces bris 'dugder brten gup+ta'i skabs su spyi tshogs su rigs ngan tsho'i gnas stangs de shin tu tha chad cig red/bud med tsho'i gnas stangs/ bud med rnams ni skyes pa rnams kyi dbang 'og tu sdod dgos kyi yod tshod/ skabs 'gar khyo ga'i lag pa nas bud med tsho la rta lcag zhu gi yod pa'i skor yang bshad 'dug cing / lhag par du rigs dma' ba'i bud med tsho'i gnas stangs shin tu skyo po yod par nges/ de lta na yang sduga'i yig cha 'ga' shas nang rigs mtho ba'i bud med tsho la shes yon sprod kyi yod pa dang / glu dang gar 'khrab pa'i sbyong brdar sprod kyi yod pa'i skor yang 'khod 'dug par ma zad bud med la shes yon sprod mkhan gyi 'dzug skrun yod pa dang / bud med dge rgan yin pa yod tshul 'khod 'dugdpal 'byor gyi gnas ltangs/ skabs der so nam dang / bzo las
le'udang pa/ sngon dusagyi byung rabs/ 271dang / tshong las dang / dngul khang sogs la yar rgyas chen po phyin yod cing /rdo ring sogs su bris brkos byas pa ltar na/ so nam gyi las ka ma byas pa'i sa stong lhag med pa dang / grong khyer khag tu khron pa dang / rdzing bu dang / lha khang dang /chu mdzod dang / skyed tshal ldum ra dang / mtsho sogs bzos yod pa red/ skabs de'i za cha'i gtso —bo khag ni 'bru rigs dang shing 'bras khag yin la/ 'bru rigs nang 'bras dang / gro/ sran ma/ pad kha'am pad gam sogs yin la/ shing 'bras nang / āmā dang / nuri kel dang / liṃ dang / kham bu/ skyur kham dang /rgyun 'brum dang / tsha lu ma dang / chu can gyi shing tog (lo6107) sogs red/nang chas mdzes po bzo byed dang / dam phrug bzo byed du ba so la bed spyod shugs cher byed/ mi mang tshos gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang zhwa nye dang / li ('khar ba ) dang / lcags la bed spyod byed/ skyes pa dang bud med gnyis rdzas phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshon byed du rgyan cha mang po gyon/ spyir btang de skabs kyi nor bu'i rigs nyi shu tsam gyi ming gsal zhing / gtso che ba ni pha lam dang / pad+marāg dang / mu tig bcas la bed spyod shugs cher byed cing / de yang rgyan cha dang /gos mdzes byed sogs su bed spyod byed/ skabs der rdo rtsa che rnams gtub pa dang /ñtsa gtong rgyu bcas shes kyi yod pa red/ mi phyug cing phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni rgyas spros chen pos mi ñtsha skyel bar byed/skyid sdug tshogs pa khag dngul khang gi las byed pa dang / tshong las pa dang / bzo las pa dang / lag rtsal mkhas pa khag dang / snum 'tshong pa dang /dar 'thag mkhan sogs kyi skyid sdug khag yod cing / skabs der skyed sdug mang po mnyam du bsdus te/ skyed sdug lte ba'am tshogs pa bzo srol yod/ dngul bdag
272 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/gnyer gyi las ka ni skyid sdug khag de tsho'i las don gal chen po zhig red/ skyid sdug tshogs pa de tshos zhal 'debs kyang len gyi yod cing / sprod len tshang ma deb skyel tshul bzhin byed kyi yod pa red/ ras cha'i bzo las de skabs der yar rgyas chen po byung yod cing / khra tshos gyon pa'i nang dar dang / gos chen dang / bal sogs rgyu cha sna tshogs bed spyod byed kyi yod pa red/ dar gos sprug legs shos ni lngarāgar+sā la bzo gi yod cing / shing bal gyi ras cha sprus legs shos mthurā ste bcom brlag tu bzo gi yod 'dugtshong 'brel/ gup+ta'i sngon du tshong 'brel 'phel rkyen gyis grong khyer rnams che ru phyin pa dang / phyug po chags yod cing / guga'i dus rabs kyi 'go stod du de dag rgyun gnas byung zhing / yul gyi nang dang / nub yeshilā'i yul khag dang ma zad lho shar yeshilā'i yul khag dang mnyam du'ang rgya gar gyi tshong 'brel yod pa red/ tshong pa mang pos tshong zog khyer nas phyi rgyal khag tu phyin te btsongs pas khe bzang chen po thob pa red/ tshong las la yar rgyas phyin pa dang mnyam rgya mtsho'i 'grul bzhud dang /gru gzing bzo skrun gyi rig pa yang yar rgyas su phyin pa red/ der brten sngar las che ba'i gru gzing bzo 'go tshugs ti/ shar nub kyi gru kha rnams su sngar las mang ba'i gru gzing khag 'gro bskyod byed kau yod pa red/chu mo gaṅgā'i kha yi rtse mo rgya mtsho la thug sa ḍi9 la yod pa'i zangs kyi gos can zhes pa'i gru kha nas lho shar yeshilā'i yul gser gyi sa gzhi ste wamadang / 'bru'i gling dang / salhoja ste kuṇ+ḍaṇ+ḍa.ā sogs dang mnyam tshong 'brel shin tu chen po byung ba red/brngoca dang / 〈pārā dang / kumyuṇa ni nub phyogs kyi gru kha gtso che ba rnams yin zhing / de dag nas kyang / lho shar yul khag tu gru gzing gtong gi yod pa red/
le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyu byung rabs/ 273tshong 'brel dang mnyam du rgya gar gyi chos dang shes rig dang / sgyu rtsal dper na sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / rig byed kyi chos dang / legs sbyar gyi skad dang /bzo rig pa sogs lho shar yeshiX'i yul khag tu bslebs nas yul de dag gi mi rnams kyis dang du blangs yod pa red/ der brten deng dus kyang lho shar yeshilā'i yukhu/ khag mang po'i shes rig dang rgya gar gyi shes rig gnyis la 'dra mtshungs chen po yod pa red/mālā:da mtsho 'gram gyi kālikaṭa dang / kocan gru kha sogs nas rgya gar gyi tshong zog aphriX dang arab yul khag dang / stag gzig (arān )dang / sa gzhi'i dkyil gyi mtsho 'gram gyi yul khag tu 'khyer 'dren byed/ de dang mnyam du chos spel mkhan yang sa thog nas dbus oshilā dang rgya nag la phyin pa red/de lta na yang grulta'i dus rabs kyi mtha' mjug tu rgya gar du tshong 'brel la nyams chag byung bas gaṅgā'i rgya thang gi grong khyer khag tu nyams rgyud kyi rtags mtshan rim bzhin gsal/ de'i rgyu rkyen ni hāṇa (5553) mi rigs kyis dbus yeshilā'i nang mi bde ba'i las don gyis sa gnas der gnas stangs mi brtan par gyur pa de yin zhing /rgyu rkyen gzhan yang byung yod srid/ṭam sgor/ rgya nag gi gnas skor ba pārgyun gyis gup+ta'i skabs sprod len byed rgyu'i dngos po ni ba phyugs yin tshul bshad kyang / grulta'i skabs kyi ṭam sgor khag gi skor zhib gsal dkar chag gsal 'khod yod pa zhig 1914 lor par 'grems byas yod pa ltar na/ ṭam sgor kha shas thog zla ba sbas pa dang po dang / khong gi btsun mo gnyis kha sprod du bzhengs nas rgyal pos btsun mo la 'khrungs bza'i rten 'brel gyi sor gdub sprod bzhin pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / rgyal btsun gnyis kra'i mtshan yang bskos 'dug pa dang / sgor mo'i rgyab ngos su durgyu ste rdzong gi lha mo seng ge la chibs pa
274 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/'khod yod pa 'dis rgyal po nyid rdzong gi lha mo'i grogs ram la brten nas drag po g.yul las rgyal ba dang / rgyal po de g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bo chen po zhig yin par mtshon pa red/(6 44 khri 4 stiX wa/lce/ gup+ta'i rgyal po tsho'i dong tse'am ṭam sgor/rgya mtsho sbas pa'i ṭam sgor stag gi gzugs can du de nyid mkhan sbyar zhig gyon pa dang / mgo ras dkris te rgyan cha btags pa khag mthong rgyu yod pa de tshos stag gi steng nas 'jigs snang bskul ba ston gyi yod srid/ der ma zad glang chen gyi dbu can dang nya yi gzugs can gyi lha mo chu srin steng du bzhengs pa bcas kyang yod pa red/ṭam sgor 'ga' shas thog rgya mtsho sbas pa nyid gling bu gtong bzhin pa'i gzugs brnyan 'khod pa des khong rol dbyangs la mnyes po yod pa'am mkhas po yod pa de mtshon gyi yod pa red/ der ma zad rta mchog gi mchod sbyin gyi tshul can gyi ṭam sgor mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dug pa rnams ni rgya gar byang dang lho phyogs su gasdu/la las rgyal kha thob rjes par 'grems gnang ba yin tshod/ gzhu dang / dgra sta dang ral gri sogs kyis rgya mtsho sbas pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bo'i khyad chos rnams mtshon par byed/
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9byung rabs/ 275de bzhin zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa dang / gzhon nu sbas pa gnyis kyus kyang gser gyi ṭam sgor mang po spel 'grems byas yod cing / gup+ta'i dus rabs kyi stod char gyi gser gyi ṭam sgor khag ni ku69 gyi dus rabs tha ma'i skabs kyi ṭam sgor dang 'dra mtshungs chen po yod par mngon/chos kyi skor/ gup+ta'i skabs su hortsa'i chos lugs de shin tu stobs chen por chags pa red/ 'on kyang de skabs hi( zhes pa'i ming tshog 'di bed spyod byed 'go tshugs med/ skabs 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni/ rig byed kyi chos 'di la hiṅgā'i chos zer zhing / hiḥ zhis pa'i tshog 'di legs sbyar gyi skad ma yin zhing / sngon dus rgya gar du yod pa'i tshog gtan nas min/ dus phyis arab kyi mi rnams kyis rgya gar la hoḥ'i yul dang / rgya gar gyi chos la hiḥ'i chos zhis dang / rgya gar gyi mi rnams la hiḥ'i mi zhes btags pa yin zhing / de yang don du sirnyu'i yul zhes chu bo sirnyu'i ming nas btags pa yin la/ arab kyi skad nang sa yi tshab tu ha bris pa mang po yod pas siṅgā la hiḥ brjod pa red/ dper na bdun phrag la saXha zhes brjod par arab skad du haXha zhes pa lta bu red/ de ltar byas 3 rgya gar la si('am siṅgā'i yul dang / rgya gar gyi chos la siṅgā'i chos zhes btags pa yon par nges/de skabs rgya ga gyi chos la sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / rig byed kyai chos dang /rgyal ba pa'i chos te gsum yod/ 'on kyang hiḥ'i chos zhes pa'i tshog 'di rig byed kyi chos 'ba' zhig gi ming gi rnam grangs su yongs su grags pa red/ der brten deng sang hiḥ'i chos zhes pa 'di rig byed pa'i chos la go dgos/brjod bya dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ gup+ta'i skabs su hiḥ'i chos lugs pa tsho dbang phyug dang / khyab 'jug la yi dam du byed mkhan yin pa dang / de skabs
276 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug sgrub pa la dga' mos chen po yod pa red/ der brten gup+ta'i skabs kyi chos lugs de la hiḥ'i chos lugs zhes dmigs bsal du grags pa yin par sems/zhuga'i rgyal po phal che ba khyab 'jug pa yin zhing / de tshos rta mchog gi mchod sbyin yang byas pa red/ de lta na yang sngon rig byed kyi dus rabs su yod pa lta bu'i sbyin sreg dang mchod sbyin rgya chen po mang po byed ma thub pa dang / rgyal po tshos lha khang bzhings ched sbyin pa chen po gtong yod cing / bram ze tshos kyang gsol 'debs dang bstod pa'i sgo nas khyab 'jug mnyes pa'i thabs shes rtsal du bton/ lha dang lha mo'i sku 'dra la mchod pa'i srol shugs ches dar bas lha dang lha mo bzhugs sa'i lha khang chung chung yang mang po bzhengs/ lo rgyus mkhas pa mang pos 'di dag ni rgya gar du lha khang bzhengs pa'i thog ma yin tshul gsungs/ de ltar yin na de'i sngon mya ngan med dang kuniṣ+ka'i dus su lha khang bzhengs srol ma byung ba yin nam/ yang na sangs rgyas dang byang sems 9 rten bzhugs sa'i gtsug lag khang lta bu de la lha khang zhes mi brjod pa gtsug lag khang ngam dri gtsang khang sogs 'bod cing / lha khang zer ba de deng dus mgon khang ngarim lha dang srung ma'i sku 'dra yod sa zhig la zer ba yin nam/ gang ltar dpyad 'os par snang /sems can rnams la lam bzang po ston ched dang / bdud srin gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i don du skabs skabs su khyab 'jug sa gzhi'i thog tu babs pa yin zhing / de la sprul pa zhes bya zhing / de yang mi dang dud 'gro ci rigs pa'i gzugs su byon pa yin par yid ches byed srol byung / des na dus skabs 'di nas khyab 'jug gis sprul pa la gal chen po brtsi srol byung / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das

278 'phags yul 9byung ba brjodapa/de lta na yang rgya gar du sangs rgyas pa'i chos nub med cing / dpal nulan+d+ra ni slob sbyong gi basmi gnas sam gdan sa lte ba zhig yin la slob dpon dbyig gnyen lta bu'i nang pa'i mkhas pa de la yang gup+ta'i rgyal po tshos sbyin bdag zhus te che bstod zhus/bram ze'i rig byed kyi chos la yar rgyas phyin pa des nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs de gal gnad chung du phyin pa yin zhes lo rgyus mkhan tshos bzhed/bram ze'i chos dang sangs rgyas pa'i chos gnyis gcig gis gcig la sgrib g.yog byed res byung na yang / rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs la bram ze'i chos kyis gnod skyon nam yang byung med de/ bram ze'i chos de sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa che zhing / rgyal ba pa'i chos dang de tsam mi mthun pa med pas yin sred/ sduga'i skabs su yishu'i 'das lo 454 lor rgyal ba pa'i bka' bsdu chen po de byung ba dang /rgyal ba pa'i dos dkar can gyi ring lugs pa'i bka' rnams bris te gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs de khag gnyis su gyes pa dang / rgya gar lho phyogs su shin tu dar rgyas chen po byung ba red/sgyu rtsal lam dngos po'i mdzes rig dus skabs de'i gup+ta'i rgyal po rnams dang / rgyal po gzhan rnams kyis khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug gi rten bzhugs yul lha khang khag bzhengs ched ma rtsa'i mthun sbyor mdzad pa dang / de skabs kyi lha khang rnams ni gaja( dang / eyorā ltar brag ri bcad gtub kyis bzos pa ma yin par so phag dang rdo lta bu'i rgyu cha las bzos pa yin zhing / skabs de'i lha khang rnying pa khag spyir btang tsam las shin tu spus legs min par ma zad/ de tsho'i nang du lha yi rten nam sku 'dra bzhugs yul gyi khang mig gcig pā de las med/ khang khrag der 'dzul sa'i sgo la yang sku 'dras mdzes par byed srol yod/ 'on kyang rim bzhin khang mig
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 279gi grangs 'phel te gcig nas gnyis dang / gsum bzhi sogs je mang du can/mthar dus rabs spru ma tshor lha khang shin tu gzi brjed chen po khag byung zhing / de tsho'i nang du khang bzang mang po bzhings 'go tshugs/ suci la yod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mchod rten gyi nye 'gram du skabs der bzhengs pa'i khang mig gcig yod pa'i lha khang zhig mthong rgyu yod pa dang / deng dus 〉r+sā'i rdzong gi dewagaṭa thig pa'i sa gnas su yang skabs de'i lha khang chung chung zhig yod/ gup+ta'i skabs su bzhings pa'i nang pa'i dgon pa'am gtsug lag khang rgya chen po zhig lngarāṇasa'i 'gram du sāranātha la yod cing / de nas sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra khag brnyed son byung yod pa red/ sku 'dra 'di tsho ni 'phags yul gyi sku brnyan bzo skrun gyi rig rtsal nang nas mdzes shos shig red/rig byed hiḥ'i chos byed pa tshos kyang so so'i lha rnams kyi sku brnyan bzhings nas bzhugs su gsol ba red/ nang pa'i lha khang 'ga' shas ni brag ri bcad gtub kyis bzos shing / de dag ni brag phug gi tshul du yod pa dang / de tsho'i nang nas gcig ni charaṅgābyad zer ba'i sa gnas klu nye 'gram gangalce la yod pa red/ brag phug 'di tsho'i :ga ngos su sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang skyes rabs kyi ri mo shin tu legs po dag bris bkod byas yod cing / de dag gi tshon mdog phal cher sngar ltar gnas yod/blo pham 'os pa zhig la 'phaḍa yul du kha che dang hāṇa mi riḍa kyis btsan 'dzul sogs byas pa'i rkyen gyis gup+ta'i skabs kyi lha khang brten gnas sogs yongs rdzogs la gnod skyon byung nas deng dus zhig ral skyon shor 'ba' zhig las lhag med/gzhung lugs sam rig gzhung / gup+ta'i rgyal po rnams kyis chos tsam du ma zad gzhung lugs la yang thugs snang rgya che gnang yod 'dug cing / khong rnams kyis
280 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjodapa/snyan ngag mkhan rnams dang / 'bri rtsom la mkhas pa rnams la gzengs skyes bdag gnyer chen po mdzad yod pa red/ dus rabs 'di la saskrota legs sbyar skad de dar khyab chen po byung ba dang / tshangs pa'i 'am (27lnga571) nāgagrwa yi ge zhes pa'i gzugs su yar rgyas rim bzhin phyin pa red/ der brten gup+ta'i yi ge zhes pa de byung yod pa red/ siṅgala'i nang pa tsho dang theg dman pa rnams kyis pāli'i skad la bed spyod byas shing / rgyal ba pa snams kyis rang bzhin pa'i skad 'ba' zhig la bed spyod byas par shin tu gsal zhing / rig byed pa tshos ni legs sbyar skad la bed spyod byas pa dang / theg chen pa tshos kyapa legs sbyar gyi skad la bed spyod rgya cher byas par bshad mi dgos pa kun gsal red/gup+ta'i dus rabs 'di rig byed hiḥ'i chos lugs pa tsho'i phyir du gser gyi dus rabs zhes bsngags brjod shin tu chen po byed srol yod pa dang / skabs der hiḥ'i chos dar rgyas che shos byung ba bden pa yin la/ 'on kyang dus rabs der nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas pa yang ches mang po byon zhing / bstan bcos mang po brtsams yod pa red/gnas brtan pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas dbyangs kyis sde snod gsum gyi 'grel ba mdzad cing / rnam par dag pa'i lam zhes pa'i bstan bcos snyan grags can de khong gis brtsams pa yin/ btsun pa ming chen gyis mahā.āsha ste rigs rgyud chen mo zhis pa'i siṅgala'i byung rabs grags chen de brtsams/ thogs med dang /dbyig gnyin dang / phyogs glang bcas kyang gup+ta'i dus rabs 'dir byung ba yin zhing /'ga' zhig gis dpal ldan chos grags kyang skabs der byon par bzhed kyang dpyad par bya dgos/ byung rabs smra ba tshos 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / 'phags pa lha sogs

282 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/skyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud lnga pa zhes pa'i gtam rgyud de yang 'dzam gling la yongs su grags pa zhig yin/ 'chi med seng ges 'che med mdzod brtsams shing slob dpon 'di nang pa yin par nges/phyi rol pa'i sngon rabs rnams ni thog mar rgyal khab kyi lo 'khor yig cha lta bu yin yang / rim bzhin je mang du phyin nas sngon rabs 'ga' zhig ni sgrung gtam 'ba' zhig yin/ gang ltar sngon rabs rnams gup+ta'i skabs 'dir mjug grub par byas pa yin la/ mthar de rnams tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug gi mdzad pa'i yon tan brjod byed kyi tshul du chos kyi glegs bam du gyur pa red/ de bzhin rig byed pa'am bram ze'i bstan bcos mtha' gas pa zhig dus rabs 'dir brtsams pa yin/tshan rig yar rgyas/ spyir btang yul zhig gi shes rig chen po ni mdzes rig gam sgyu rtsal dang / spyir btang gzhung lugs 'ba' zhig las grub pa ma yin la tshan rig gi yar rgyas nges par dgos pa red/ gup+ta'i dus rabs su skar rtsis dang /gso ba rig pa dang / ang rtsis la mkhas pa mang po byung yod pa de'i rgyu rkyen gcig ni tshong 'brel gyi sgo nas gzhan dang mnyam du 'brel ba sna tshogs byung ba dang / blo gros kyi khyab 'phel byung ba de yin nges/ dus rabs 'di'i tshan rig pa grags che ba gnyis ni ārlabhañtsa dang lharārnyarma:ra gnyis red/ de dus ang rtsis kyi skar rtsis dang /'bras rtsis gnyis khag khag phyes zin pa dang / 'bras rtsis nang nam mkha'i gza' dang skar ma rnams kyi 'gro stangs de rmongs dad dam rnam rtog dang 'brel ba'i dgos don ched bed spyod byung ba red/ār+sha46 zer ba'i mkhas pa des sa gzhi 'dis nyi ma la skor ba byed bzhin yod tshul gsal bshad byas pa red/ stabs ngan pa zhig la khong gi grub mtha' de de skabs

284 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/gcig gyur dang / dbus gzhung stobs chen po zhig byung ba dang / chab srid skyong stangs gcig mtshungs kyis gzhung zhabs pa'i lta rtogs dam btsan 'og bka' khrims dang zhi bde srung skyob sogs brtan po bzos yod pa red/ dus rabs 'di'i nang phyi nang gi tshong 'brel gag po byung yod pa dang / de la brten nas rgya gar gyi shes rig kyang phyi logs su gang 'tshams khyab yod pa red/ rgyal po tshos sbyin bdag gnang bar brten saskrota ste legs sbyar gyi skad la yar rgyas tshod med byung yod par ma zad khang bzo dang /sku 'dra bzo ba'i rig pa dang / ri mo 'bri ba'i rig pa gsum po gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mdzes rig la lhag par yar rgyas phyin yod/ gup+ta'i rgyal po khag ni 'phags yul du )rtswa'i 7gong rma 'i dbang 'dzin pa tha ma de yin la/ de tsho'i skabs hiḥ'i chos te rig byed kyi chos de la bskyar gso chen po byung ba red/gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen/56mitra ste rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen dang / hāṇa mi rigs sogs phyi logs nas btsan 'dzul mkhan tshos btsan 'dzul byas pa des gup+ta'i rgyal khams de skyo po bzos yod par nges/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen zhes pa 'di mya ngan med kyi rjes su shuṅga'i rgyal po'i thog ma rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen zhes pa'i bram ze de ma yin par phyi logs nas yong ba'i btsan 'dzul mkhan zhig gi ming yin tshod/ 'on kyang man+daguga'i stobs shugs kyis gup+ta'i rgyal khams de re zhig skyob thub pa byung ba red/ khong gis rgyal khams gcig gyur gnas ched lhag bsam bzang po'i sgo nas so so'i nus pa gang yod bton gnang ba red/ 'on kyang khong gi rjes su byung ba'i gup+ta'i rgyal po tsho gnas tshul dka' rnyog can de la gdong len byed thub mkhan 'jon po med pa red/
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 285man+dagup+ta 'das pa'i rjes su gra ma 'grig pa mang po zhig byung yod pa red/ khong gi rjes su gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud kyi skor nges can zhig lab thub pa dka' zhing / da bar byung rabs mkhan mos nges gtan thag gcod thub med/ gup+ta'i rgyal po mang po zhig gi mtshan 'dug kyang de tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba dang / ko rim dzo yon nges ma thub/byung rabs mkhan tsho'i dgongs bzhed ltar na skabs der phan tshun 'gran zla byed mkhan gup+ta'i rgyal po'am dbang 'dzin pa khag dus gcig car du byung ba yin srid la/ de tshor rang rang gi rgyal sa nas gcig gis gcig la 'gran zla byas pa yang yin srid/ gang ltar man+dagup+ta ste zhi ba sbas pa'i rjes su gup+ta'i rgyal po gal che ba ni purulagusta ste skyes bu sbas pa dang / kumāragusta ste gzhon nu sbas pa dang / bud+dhaḥpā ste sangs rgyas sbas pa rnams yin zhing / gruga'i rgyal po gzhan khag gis nus shugs ldan pa'i las don byas med pa dang / de tshos rgyal khams nyams rgyud du 'gro ba 'gog ma thub pa red/sngon tsan+d+ragup+ta gnyis pas nub phyoḍa sa mtshams su do snang gal cher byas pa de mu mthud ma byas par brten phyi rgyal gyi dpung 'jug gam/ btsan 'dzul byung ba las rgyal khams la nya 4 sa rgyud chen po byung / gzhon nu sbas pa'i dus su rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen dang / hāṇa mi rigs kyis dpung 'jug byas pa des gup+ta'i rgyal khams kyi brtan cha la nyen kha shin tu chen po byung / de lta na yang sum+bha'i rgyal po tshos hu9 mi rigs la gdong len mthar phyin byas te grulta'i rgyal khams de hāṇa mi rigs a+yau mnga' 'og tu 'gro ma thub pa de bden zhing / 'on kyang hāṇa dang dmag 'thab yun ring byas rkyen gup+ta'i rgyal khams kyi dpal 'byor dang mthun rkyen dang / thon khungs la gnod skyon tshod med byung nas shin tu skyo po chags pa red/ des na spyir btang hu9 gyi dpung 'jug de (pā'i rgyal rgyud nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin par tshang mas yid ches byed pa lags/
286 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/lo rgyus mkhan 'ga' shas kyis gup+ta'i mnga' ris kyi phyi logs su yod pa'i sa khul kushasmyur dang / gapha1nistun bcas ma gtogs gup+ta'i rgyal khams su hāṇa mirigs 'dzul ma thub pa dang / gup+ta'i rgyal khams nyams rgyud du 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen nihāṇa gyis dpung 'jug sogs ma yin par gup+ta'i mnga' 'bangs su gtogs pa'i sde tshogs kyi 'do khrid yashodharman ste grags pa'i chos lta bu 'dod chen mang pos ngo log byas pa de grulta'i rgyal rgyud nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin zhes bzhed/ de ltar yinpa'i dbang du btang na yang hāṇa dang / 'thab 'khrug lan mang byas pa las gup+ta'i rgyal khams skyo po chags pa la the tshom ye nas med cing / nang logs nas ngo log byung ba yang bden te sngon dus dang deng dus ga dus yin na yang rgyal khab skyo po byung dus nang khul nas ngo log dang mi mthun pa rang shugs kyis 'byung ba chos nyid yin/gang ltar sde tshogs kyi 'go khrid gup+ta'i rgyal po la ngo log byas te yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag drug pa'i dkyil tsam la byang phyogs ut+tar5desha zer ba'i rgyal khab rang dbang ba gsar pa zhig byung zhing / man+dagup+ta'i skabs su 〈rākhri zhes par drag pos dbang bsgyur dang / brgya phrag drug pa'i smad tsam du myalalha la rgyal khab gzhan zhig btsugs pa dang / wamagri la yang rgyal khab gsar 'dzugs kyis rang dbang ba'i rgyal khab mang po 'phel/ de nas lho phyogs dang / shar phyogs baṅgāl yang gup+ta'i srid grib 'og (677 3—3khu23781 545) nas thon te rang dbang cha tshang du gyur/ sde tshogs kyi 'go khrid de tsho thog mar gup+ta'i gzhung zhabs pa chen po sha stag yin yang gup+ta'i mnga' thang skyo po byung dus de tshos ngo log byas te so so'i rgyal khab rang btsan pa bzos/ de ltar grulta'i rgyal khams de dum bur phyin nas nyams pa red/byung rabs lo rgyus smra ba re zung gis gup+ta'i 7gong ma tha ma gsum ni nang pa
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 287sangs rgyas pa'i chos la shin du dad pa che bas gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud nyams pa yin zhes zer/de ni shin tu rma 'os pa'i 'dod gtam yin te/ smar+sha'i 7gong ma mya ngan med dang /kuṣ+ṭhacu 7gong ma kuniṣ+ka lta bu'i rgya gar gyi 7gong ma snyan grags can rnams nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin pa dang / de tsho'i rgyal srid mnga' thang shin tu che ba yod par gsal ba yin/des na gup+ta'i rgyal khams nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen ni gong du bshad pa ltar hāṇa dang yun ring dmag 'khrug byung bas dpal 'byor la gnod skyon chen po byung ba dang / nang nas ngo log byung ba sogs kyis rkyen byas pa las mthar rgyal khams nyams pa yin/hāṇa gyis rgya gar gyi sgo phyes pa las gup+ta'i rgyal khams nyams par 'gyur ba zlog tu med pa yin/ gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud rtsa brlag tu phyin pa de lta na yang shes rig dang / shes yon gyi gar rgyas mu mthud du gnas shing lhag par du sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung 4tshe la nyams chags ma byung bar yar rgyas mu mthud phyin yod/ gup+ta'i rgyal khams nyams pa de la phyi rol pa rig byed kyi phyogs 'dzin pa tshos yid pham chen po da lta yang byed bzhin yod/hāṇa mi rigs/skabs 'dir hāṇa mi rigs kyis gup+ta'i rgyal khams la rgol 'dzing byas tshul dang / de la brten nas mthar gup+ta'i rgyal khams stong pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yongs grags gong gsal ltar la/ hu9 zhes pa de'i skor gsal bshad dgos gal che bar mthong nas cung zad 'dod par bya ste/thog ma'i 'byung khungs/ hāṇa zer ba de tsho dbus yeshilā nas yin zhing stor bcom byed mkhan gyi 'jigs su rung ba'i 'brog pa'i mi sde yin pa dang / de tsho dbus yeshilā nas tsho khag shin tu chen po byas nas yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag bzhi pa'i nang
288 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/stor bcom chen po byas nas thag ring po dang / sa rgya chen po la khyab pa red/ de nas de tsho khag gnyis su gyes te/ khag gcig ni nub gling yuropa la phyin nas stor bcom tshod med byas pa dang / khag gcig okasngas (0553) lung pa'i nang gnas chags/ okas ni urusu'i lho phyogs 2rkamān nang yod/ de tsho rim bzhin stag gzig (parashiX ) dang / rgya gar la bslebs nas yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag lnga pa'i nang du hāṇa dkar po zhes yongs su grags pa red/ de tsho la stag gzig pa tshos kha gtad byas kyang kha gtad ma thub par stag gzig dbang du bsdus/ de nas aphaXnisnran gyi rgyal sa ༷bul la kukhug rgyal khab chung chung zhig yod pa de yang bcom nas rgya gar gyi sa mtshams su bslebs pa red/hāṇa gyis rgya gar la btsan rgol/ hāṇa mi rigs tshos rgya gar gyi rgya thang la btsan rgol ni gup+ta'i 7gong ma gzhon nu sbas pa'i srid dbang rdzogs pa'i skabs byas shing / de tsho'i btsan rgol dang po de la man+dagultas phyi lo 455 tsam la gdong len mthar phyin byas te hāṇa tsho pham pa red/ 'on kyang hu9 mi rigs de tsho gnas skabs pham pa las gtan nas med pa bzo ma thub pas de tshos slar yang phyo lo 465 tsam la btsan rgol byas te nub phyogs dri za'i yul garwara'i yul dbang du bsdus nas byang phyoḍa kyi gaṅgā'i rgya thang lte ba la 'dzul bskyod byed rgyu'i thabs shes yang yang byas pa red/'go khrid/ de tsho'i 'go khrid ni toramāṇa (1077773) yin zhing / phyi lo brgya phrag lnga pa tsam la nub phyogs myalalnga la rang gi rgyal srid btsugs te/ lhag pa'i rgyal po chen po zhes pa'i mtshan gnas blangs/ de'i bu mit+tarakul (lo161187512)yin zhing / de ni ya nga snying rje med pa'i spyod ngan gcig yin par brten hāṇa tsho la rgyal yongs nas ngo rgol byung ba dang / gshodharman dang gup+ta gnyis kus de dang 'thab
le'u dang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 289'dzing byas/ phyi lo 528 lor hu9 mi riḍa la pham nyes tshod med byung bar ma zad mit+tarakul de kāshasmyur la 'gro dgos byung / der yang khos mdo skor btsan shed kyis yul la gnod skyon dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhi bde la dga' mkhan tsho la stor bcom dang / dgon pa dang mchod rten rnams stor gshog byas/ mthar phye lo 540 lor che 'phos/ de rjes hāṇa mi rigs nang gcig gyur ma byung zhing / rim bzhin rgya gar gyi sa gnas rgyal phran tshos hāṇa gyi stobs shugs rtsa med bzos/ yormas la yod pa'i hāṇa'i rgyal khab rgya gar gyi phyi logs su yod pa de yang 'das lo brgya phrag drug pa'i dkyil smad tsam du tuska mi rigs tshos rtsa med tu btang yod pa red/srid don gyi 'pho 'gyur/ hāṇa gyis btsan rgol byas pa las guga'i rgyal khams de rtsa 'thor du gyur nas rgya gar du rgyal phran chung chung mang po 'phel/ der ma zad sngar gyi lo rgyus yig cha rin thang can mang po yang rtsa brlag tu gyur/spyi tshogs kyi 'gyur ba/ hāṇa'i mi rigs mang po rgya gar du gnas chags te yul mi dang mnyam du 'dres/ phan tshun gnyen mthun sogs byas pa las rgya gar 9 mi rigs dang hāṇa'i mi rigs 'dres nas deng sang hāṇa'i mi rigs zur du med par gyur/ sngar rgya gar la med pa'i mi rigs 'dres ma dag byung zhing / rā46ta zhes pa'i rgyal rgyud sna tshogs pa'i nang nas 'ga' shas hāṇa'i rigs rgyud las byung ba yin/chos kyi 'pho 'gyur/ hāṇa rnams thog mar rgya gar la 'byor skabs de tsho'i goms gshes gtsang ma gag po med pa dang / mi'i bya spyod las 'das pa'i lag len 'ga' shas yod tshod/ 'phrod bsten dang gtsang sbra gang thad nas rgya gar ba tshos hāṇa'i me rigs dang thag gang ring bsdad pa red/ ārlan gyi mi rigs dang / hu9 9 yi mi rigs bar gyi 'gronge 'brel las phyis su chos dang dge ba'i bsam tshul gyi gnas
290 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjodapa/tshad dma' ru phyin yod par ma zad rmongs dad dam/ rnam rtog ngan pa mang po yang byung yod 'dugde ltar hāṇa rigs kyis rgya gar la btsan 'dzul byas pa de srid don dang / spyi tshogs dang / chos sogs kyi cha nas rgya gar gyi lo rgyus nang 'gag rtsa chen po zhig yin par nges/ gang ltar hāṇa yis btsan rgol las gup+ta'i 7gong ma'i rgyal khams de nyams te rgya gar byang phyoḍa su rgyal srid sil bur 'thor nas mthar harla ste dga' ba'i lha zhes pa'i rgyal po de byung ba red/nyar+sāwartan gyi dus rabs/ (phyi lo 6064647)phyi lo brgya phrag lnga pa'i mjug rdzogs mtshams gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud nyams pa dang chabs cig rgya gar byang phyogs de slar yang rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan pa chung chung mang por bgos shing / de dag phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dmag rtag par byas/de ltar sred don gyi gcig gyur med cing sel bu'i dus skabs su gup+ta'i rgyal srid rdzogs nas lo brgya tsam rjes 7gong ma ha〉warnyan ste dga' ba 'phel zhes pa de byung zhing de ni :rjeshur zer ba'i sa gnas kyi 5yi:ti rgyud pa nas yin/ :rjeshur zer ba'i grong khyer deng dus kyi diX'i byang phyogs su kurutratra yi nye 'gram du yod pa yin/ deng sang de sa gnas chen po gang yang min mod/ phyi lo brgya phrag bdun pa'i nang gnad che ba'i rgyal sa zhig yin pa red/ rgyal po dga' ba 'phel gyis byang phyogs kyi sa khul rgya chen po gang mtshams la dbang bsgyur zhing / de la 'phags yul byang phyogs kyi rje bo zhes yongs su grags/ khong gis lo bzhi bcu lhag ring byang phyogs su srid dbang bsgyur te rgya bskyed kyi thabs shes mdzad pa red/
le'udang po/ sngon dus sprebyung rabs/ 291khungs/harla 7gong ma'i byung rabs skor khungs gtso che shos ni/ gzhung lugs sam yig cha'i khungs khag yin zhing / stabs legs pa zhig la/ rgya nag gi mkhas pa nyusnyenasaṅga (51khungs 18408) dang / snyan ngag mkhan 69lhaka gnyis kyis bris pa'i gzhung lugs khag la lta chog yod pas harla'i skor gsal por shes thub/ yang rgya nag gi mkhas pa khri26 (113103) gi lam yig dang / harla rang nyid gyis bris pa'i zlos gar gyi bstan bcos sogs yig cha gal che mang po las kyang tar+ṣa'i skor shes thub cing /yig cha 'di tsho'i thog bskos yig dang / dong tse sogs kyi rgyab gnon yang yod pa yin/(wenasaṅga zhes pa de rgya nag gi gnas skor ba zhig yin zhing / phyi lo 630 dang 644 bar gyi dus skabs su rgya gar du phebs pa red/ dgung lo 26 skabs khong rgya nag las thon te sngar rgya nag gi gnas skor ba pārgyun phebs lam gyi rjes su 'brangs nas dbus ekalā brgyud rgya gar du 'byor/ khong ni chos rgyal dga' ba 'phel dang 'brel ba thag nye spro yod par ma zad dga' ba 'phel gyis khong la sdus bkur chen po zhus yod pa red/ nyusnyenasārla ni dpal nulan+d+ra la slob phrug dang dge rgan gnyis ku'i tshul du bzhugs par grags/ khong rgya gar lho phyogs nywaljospru dang kāt+yā sogs yul mang por phebs nas rang yul du phyir log skabs sangs rgyas kyi gzhung lugs khag dang /ring bsrel du ma bsnams phebs thub/ khong ni srog ldan dang srog med tshang ma la thugs snang chen po gnang mkhan zhig yin pas khong gi lam yig rgya nag skad du ci yu gi zhes pa de khungs tshad ldan zhig yin/ khong rgya gar du phebs pa de rgya gar gyi byung rabs rtsad 'tshol ched min par sangs rgyas kyi chos 'tshol du phebs pa yin na yang / khong gi lam yig des byung rabs shes par shin tu phan thogs che zhing / khungs yid rton
292 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/'pher ba yin/ khong gis rgyal po harla dang khong gi 'dzin skyong skor bris yod par ma zad grong khyer khag dang / grong gseb khag dang / dpal 'byor dang / chos dang /spyi tshogs gi gnas stangs dang / phun tshogs dang / mi dmangs kyi goms gshes skor zhib gsal bris 'dug khong rgya gar du lo mang por bzhugs te gsan bsam sogs gnang nas tshur phebs sa'i lam de ga rang nas rgya nag tu phyir log gnang ba red/khungs gnyis pa ni snyan ngag pa bāgalhabs mdzad pa'i harla'i rnam thar de yin la lhaka ni harla rgyal po'i 'khor tshogs nang du yang yod pa zhig ste/ khong gis mdzad pa'i harla'i rnam thar de deng dus kyi rnam thar ltar mdzad pa'i lo rgyus cha tshang gral rim bstar chags su med kyang yig cha gzhan las cung zad gnas tshul mang ba yod/ dpe deb 'di'i nang harla'i mi rabs gong ma'i byung tshul dang / sku che'i stod kyi mdzad rim dang / khong gi sring mo rāngashrī de dgra bo'i lag nas bskyabs pa'i bar gyi dpa' ba'i mdzad rjes bcas 'khod yod pa red/ dpe deb 'di bzhin mdzad pa po des rang gi rje bo la phul byung gi bstod pa byed ched snyan ngag gi lam nas bris pa zhig yin pa las mdzad pa cha tshang ba bkod mi 'dug pas brtsams 'phro lta bu zhig yin/ de lta na yang lo rgyus kyi cha nas khungs gal chen po yin/harla rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i rin chen phreng ba dang / klu kun tu dga' ba dang / mthong na dga' ba'am lta na sdug pa ste zlos gar gyi bstan bcos gsum yod pa de tsho las harla de la mkhas pa'i yon tan ji yod gsal shes thub par ma zad khong gi skabs spyi tshogs dang chos kyi gnas stangs ji 'dra yod pa yang gsal por shes thub/gong gsal yig cha khag las gzhan pa'i harla'i srid dbang skabs kyis bskos bris 'ga' shas kyang yod pa ni/ ma6wan gyi byang bu'i brkos bris dang / sonapata
le'u dang po/ sngon dus spre byung rabs/ 293yi bskos bris dang / banasakharā byang bu'i brkos bris bcas ni gal che shos yin zhing /lho phyogs kyi rgyal po bulanashin gyi g.yitol (815013) brkos khrag las kyang tar+ṣa'i srid kyi mdzad rjes skor gsal thub/ harla'i skabs kyi dong tse khag kyang rgyal rabs de'i khungs gtugs sa byed chog/dga' ba 'phel gyi pha mes/tar+sāwarnyan smi dga' ba 'phel gyi rgyal rgyud gang du gtogs pa'i rgyal srid de ni 565ti ste rgyas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes pas rmangs btsugs pa yin la/ de ni dbang phyug la mchod pa byed mkhan zhig yin skad/ de'i rjes 'dzin pa tsho'i nang nas pu3karawarnyan ste 'od byed 'phel zhes pa de gtso che shos red/ des lhag pa'i rgyal po chen po zhes pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes shing / rgyal khams che tsam zhig la dbang bsgyur yod tshod kyang / de'i skor zhib gsal shes ma thub/ des rang gi rgyal khams de che ru gtong rgyu'i thabs shes byas yod pa ni nges/ de la sras gnyis byung ba ni rā6warnyan : rgyal srid 'phel dang / ha〉warnyan ste dga' ba 'phel gnyis dang / sras mo rāngashrī ste rgyal srid dpal mo bcas gsum yod/ yab 'od byed 'phel gyis rang gi sras mo rgyal srid dpal mo de kumaja'i rgyal po 9hawa89 rmokhari ste khyim gyi go cha zhes pa de'i btsun mor sprad pa dang / de la brten nas yul byang phyogs dbus kyi rgyal po stobs che shos gnyis bar phan tshun gnyen 'brel byung ba red/ 'od byed 'phel gyi rgyal srid mjug rdzogs nye'i skabs shig la rang gi sras che ba de hāṇa 'dul ba'i ched du btang ba na sras des kyang rang gi byed sgo lam lhong dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa red/ 'on kyang yab 'od byed 'phel de phye lo 605 la dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/
294 'phagasayul gyisang ba brjod pa/de rjes sras che ba rgyal srid 'phel khri la 'khod/ yun mi ring bar baṅgāl gyi rgyal po shashug ste ri bong yan lag (zla ba )gis rogs byas nas myalalnga'i rgyal pos na(ja'i rgyal po khyim gyi go cha bsad pa red/ de 'phral khyim gyi go cha bsad pa'i dgra sha len ched rgyal srid 'phel dpung dang bcas g.yul du chas shing mālalnga'i rgyal po pham par byas pa red/ 'on kyang ri bong yan lag gis mgo bskor btang nas rgyal srid 'phel de phyi lo 606 lor bsad pa red/ der brten sras chung ba dga' ba 'phel de nyid dgung lo bcu drug las ma lon yang khri la 'khod pa red/dga' ba 'phel khri la 'khod pa/rgyal po 'od byed 'phel 'das pa'i rjes su sras che ba rgyal srid 'phel khri la 'khod kyang ri bong yan lag gis mgo bskor btang nas bkrongs pa gong du bshad pa ltar la/ der brten sras chung ba nya4warnyan ste dga' ba 'phel zhes pa yongs grags la dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha zhes kyang 'bod pa de nyid phyi lo 606 lor khri la 'khod pa yin zhing / khong la dka' ngal che ba'i bya ba ni sring mo rgyal srid dpal mo ri bo 'bigs byed kyi nags gseb tu bros yib tu gnas pa de skyob pa dang / rang gi gcen po dang / sring mo'i zla bo gnyis gsod mkhan la dgra sha len rgyun de red/ (wenasāg gis gsungs gsal/ dga' ba 'phel de thog mar rgyal srid bzhes rgyu'i 'dod pa med ces gsungs 'dug pa de lo rgyus mkhan tshos rang gi sreng mo'i khyo ga'i rgyal khams ku(ja'i rgyal srid bzhes 'dod med pa la go rgyu yin pa las rang gi yab kyi rgyal srid :rjeshur gyi khri la bzhugs 'dod med pa ma yin zhes 'dod/ gang ltar khong gi sring mo rgyal srid dpal mo de ri bo 'bigs byed kyi nags gseb tu bros yib byas pa de rang
