le'u dang po/ sngon dusakyi byung rabs/ 303tshos chos phyogs kyi las 'gan bsgrubs shing / rgyal rigs tshos yul la dbang bsgyur byas/ de tsho ni dpa' bo'i gral rim yin/ rje'u rigs kyis tshong las byed cing /dmangs rigs sna zhing pa'am so nam pa dag yin pa red/ reg tu mi rung ba'i rigs rnams dang mnyam khyad par ram dbye 'byed byed srol yod cing / shan pa dang / nya pa dang / gshed ma dang / mi gtsang ba 'phyag mkhan rnams grong khyer gyi phyi rol du sdod bcug pa las grong khyer nang sdod dbang med/ de lta na yang spyir btang spyi tshogs phan tshun bar 'dres skyod sogs yod la/ 'on kyang rigs mi 'dra ba'i bar gnyen mdun byed srol med/ yug sa ma tshos bskur du chang bza' rgyag mi chog cing thag nye'i nye 'brel tsho'i bar chang bza' rgyag mi chog pa yin/ khyo shi ba'i rjes de'i dur me'i nang chung ma shi ba'i srol yang yod 'dugmi rnams kyi za cha'i gtso bo ni gro zhib kyi zan dang / 'bru ngos pa dang / bye ma ka ra dang / 'o ma'i zas rigs sogs dkar chu bcas red/ nya sha dang dud 'gro 'ga' zhig gi sha yang za gi yod 'dug nyusnyenasārla gis spyir btang rgya gar gyi mi rnams drang po dang / mi 3 stabs bde po yod tshul bshad 'dug phyug po rnams kyi gnas khang ni shin tu mdzes shing rgyas spros chen po yod la dbul po tsho'i nang khyim ni stabs bde po yod/ sa gnas so so'i chas nos tha dad yod 'dug yang nyusnyenasārla lhas gsungs don ltar na rgya gar gyi mi rnams rlung tsha po yod kyang drangs po yod pa dang /gtsang sbra la dga' po yod ces gsungs 'dugkhrims 'gal nyes can gyi mi mang po med tshul gsungs kyang / khong rang nyid 'grul bzhud skabs thengs mang por gzhan gyis bcom tshul skor bris 'dug srog gi chad pa gtong srol med cing ñtsha btson ni nyes chad che shos yin zhes gsungs pa de gong
304 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/du'ang bshad zin/chos/ dga' ba 'phel gyi skabs su rig byed pa'i chos dang / rgyal ba pa'i chos dang / sangs rgyas pa'i chos theg chen dang / theg dman gnyis rdza'i nyams len byed srol yod/ dga' ba 'phel gyi yab de hi( rig byed pa yin zhes rgya gar gyi lo rgyus nang gsal zhing / khong gi spun dang sring mo ni theg dman pa yin/ harla khong rang thog mar hiḥ rig byed pa'i chos lugs 'dzin mkhan zhig yin srid kyang / rjes su theg chen par gyur pa yin zhes lo rgyus mkhan tshos bzhed/ khong ni chos lugs tshang ma'i mkhas pa rnams kyi 'bel gtam nyan pa la mnyes po yod pa dang / rgya nag gi mkhas pa nyusnyenasārla la shin tu mnyes po gnang / de'i rkyen gyis khong theg chen par gyur pa yin zhes byung rabs mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs yod/harus phyi lo 643 lor ku(ja la chos kyi tshogs 'du chen po zhig sdu bskong gnang ba der rgyal sras mang po dang / sangs rgyas pa dang / rgyal ba pa dang //༈ //rdzu hūm̐ mkhasta (ja ༵ ((3 pa'i/ ༷/ nāṃ ༵༵ hūm̐ 3) dzos ༵ stag rgya~X sta ngasku gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ chen po zhig byas/ harla yis pāXg la lo lnga re'i rjes 'du ba chen po re bsdu bskong gnang yod tshul lo rgyus las bshad/ 'du ba de tsho'i skabs nyi ma re la lha mi 'dra ba re la mchod pa byas shing / mthar harla rang nyid kyis sbyin pa gtong bar byed/ de la bltas na rgyal po 'dis chos lugs tshang ma la phyogs ris med par gcig gyur gyis lugs srol bzang po zhig gsar gtod gnang thabs byas pa dang / der ma zad rgyal po dga' ba 'phel 'dis theg pa chen po'i chos de dar khyab chen po zhig gnang ba'i thabs shes byas yod pa red/ 'on kyang skabs der yul du chos kyi gnas stangs thad
le'u dang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 305bram ze rnams shugs che ba'i skabs yin tshod/ bram ze'i chos kyi rjes su theg chen de khyab che zhing / theg dman gyi chos nyams pa'i skabs yin zhing / rgyal ba pa'i chos de sa khul 'ga' khas su gal che ba tsam gnas/dga' ba 'phel gyi skabs gzhung lugs dang sgyu rtsal/dga' ba 'phel gyi gzigs rtogs 'og gzhung lugs dang / sgru rtsal dang /khang bzo sogs yar rgyas su phyin yod/ khong rang nyid mkhas pa chen po zhig yin pas khong gi 'khor du mkhar/ pa mang po yod pa dang / mkhas pa tsho la gzigs rtogs che ba ni smos mi dgos/ snyan ngag mkhan 69lhaka dang / khuwenasārla dang / ithir+sha dang / gzhan yang khungs gzhan mang po las dga' ba 'phel gyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang / snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i yon tan rnams gsal po shes thub/ dga' ba 'phel gyis zlos gar gyi bstan bcos gsum mdzad yod pa ni rin chen phreng ba dang /mthong na dga' ba'am lta na sdug dang / klu kun hu dga' ba gsum yin/ der ma zad khong gis byang chub sems dpa' sprin la zhon gyi rtogs brjod tshog lhug ma zhig kyang brtsams yod/ khong gi rgyal po'i tshogs rar yod pa'i snyan ngag pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs sholoka lnga brgya can zhig brtsams yod tshul lo rgyus su gsal 'dug pa de sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs phyogs bsdus byas pa zhig yin srid/khong gi nye gnas su grags che shos 6964 zhes pa de yin zhing des harla'i mdzad rnam zhes pa de dang / kādapas+thā zhes pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos khag brtsams/der ma zad khong gi rgyal po'i tshogs rar 'phrog byed byin dang rgyal ba'i sde dang / myos pa'i gan lag sgron me zhes pa sogs mkhas pa mang po yod 'dug
306 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjodapa/dga' ba 'phel gyi skabs gzhung lugs dang blo gros kau bya ba shin tu rgya chen po byas yod 'dug cing / dgon sde khag dang / ri khrod khag ni thos bsam gyi ba: gnas yin/ dpal nulanā sogs gtsug lag slob khang chen mo khag yod/ lo rgyus mkhan tshos bzhed pa ltar na/ dpal nālen+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen po de man+da༄lhas btab pa yin zhing / dga' ba 'phel gyi skabs su 'dzam gling la yongs su grags pa zhig yin la/ dga' ba 'phel gyi gzigs skyong 'og da dung gtsug lag khang de nyid rgyal spyi'i gtsug lag khang chen po zhig tu gyur pa red/ ces bshad srol 'dug kyang /gtsug lag khang de sus btab pa yin min skor sngar bshad zin la/ gzhan rnams bden par snang / gtsug lag khang der tshud pa la dka' ngal che zhing / shes yon gla med dang / gnas khang dang za chas sogs rin dzad du sprod pa red/ gtsug lag khang der chos dang / sgra rig pa dang / tshad ma rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa dang /rtsis sogs slob tshan mang po slob kyi yod pa red/ (wenasārla yang gtsug lag khang de'i slob phrug yin pa red/ sgyu rtsal khang bzo'i thad harlas gup+ta'i lugs srol gyi rjes su 'brangs shing / dpal nālen+d+ra la rdo sku mang po bzhengs yod pa dang / sirabur la yod pa'i la:ṇa gyi lha khang de yang skabs der bzhengs pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra shin tu mdzes po khag dang / gzhan yang lha sku mang po bzhings yod 'dug dga' ba 'phel gyi dong tse khag m+pi khong gi skabs kyi sgyu rtsal dang lag shes rmad du byung ba mtshon byed yin/mtha' bsdoms/rgyal po harla'am dga' ba 'phel de ni dpa' bo chen po zhig dang / g.yul las rnam par rgyal zhing 'dzin skyong mkhan dang / mkhas pa chen po zhig yin/ khong
le'udangapo/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 307gis drag po g.yul gyi bya ba mang po gnang zhing / rgyal kha yang mang po thob yod pa red/mnga' ris rgya chen po dbang du bsdus pa dang / rgya gar byang phyogs su rgyal khams chen po zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang ba red/ khong ni mig dper 'os pa'i rgyal po zhig yin la mi mang gi bde sdug la do snang chen po gnang nas de tsho'i bde don gong nas gong du spel thabs gnang / khong ni mi gshis bzang po zhig dang / sbyin pa la dga' po zhig yin pa red/ chab srid 'dzin skyong pa zhig gi cha nas khong hur po zhig dang / khrims drang po zhig yin/ byung rabs mkhan 'ga' shas kyis dga' ba 'phel de ni rgya mtsho sbas pa dang mya ngan med gnyis kyi mdzad spyod 'dres ma ldan pa zhig yin tshul bshad yod/ dga' ba 'phel gyis dmag 'khrug brgyabs pa tshang mar rtag par rgyal kha thob med kyang khong gis rgyal khams chen po zhig la srid kyi stobs 'byor chen po yong thabs su 'bad brtson lhod med byas yod/ khong ni sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa shin tu che zhing / bzod sran che zhing bsam blo rgya chen po zhig yin/ chos lugs la mgo mkhregs nam yang byas med/ rgya gar gyi byung rabs mkhan 'ga' shas kyis dga' ba 'phel 'dis sku 3 hril por sangs rgyas kyi chos dar khyab chen po gnang ba de sgug srub dog po ma yin par mya ngan med dang 'dra bar lag len byed bde ba'i spyi mtshungs zhig khyab spel gnang ba yin zhes bshad 'dug dga' ba 'phel de drag po dmag dbung dang 'brel ba'i rgyal po zhig yin zhing / khong rang gi rgyal khams su chos lugs tshang ma la 'dra mnyam rtsi mthong dang / chos lugs tshang ma'i mkhas pa khag dang bka' mol gros sdur la thugs mnyes po yod pa red/ dga' ba 'phel ni rgya gar byang phyogs su rgya gar gyi chos lugs 'dzin pa'i rgyal po tha ma yin par ma zad nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs 'dzin pa'i 7gong ma tha ma yang yin par khas len byed chog khong ni
308 'phags yul 3 byung ba ba da pa/mkhas shing blo rgya che la rgya gar gyi rgyal po chen po khag gi gras yin par gdon mi za mod/rgya gar gyi byung rabs mang po'i nang khong la gal che'i gras ma brtsis pa lta bu yang 'dugrgya gar byang phyogs su dga' ba 'phel te hag byon pa'i skabs 'dir bod du rgyal po srong btsan sgam po byon pa yin par nges te dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i bod chen po'i srid lugs dang 'brel ba'i rgyal rabs deb ther dkar po'i nang /des na kun mkhyen bu'i bzhed pa bzhin byas te/ srong btsan me glang la 'khrungs/ sa glang de khri la phebs pa'i lor byas/ lhag ma'i lo tshogs rnams rgya'i lo rgyus sor bzhag byas nas/ de thams cad drug bcu skor gcig gi nang du rkyang rtsis su byas na rgyu mtshan shin tu che snyam zhing / de ltar byas che sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo chig stong brgya dang re gcig pa'i me glang la srong btsan 'khrungs/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa kun mkhyen bu ston gyi bzhed pa ltar yin/ der ma zad rgyal rabs de'i nang du/ rags pa tsam byas na/ bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang / rgya gar gyi rgyal po shrīhak+ṣa dang / slob dpon phyogs glang dang / nag mo khol dang / dbyug pa can dang / kha che'i ston pa sbrang rtsi'i blo gros sogs du mtshungs pa yin tshul gsungs pa spyir mkhas pa'i legs bshad du snang yang / snyan ngag mkhan nag mo khol ni/ gup+ta'i dong ma zla ba sbas pa gnyis pa'am/ rnam gnon nyi ma'i nang 'khor du yod pa'i rin chen mi dgu'i nang nas gcig yin pa rgya gar gyi lo rgyus byung rabs tshad ldan thams cad du gsal bas de ni yishu'i 'das lo 375 nas 415 bar du byung ba yin/da dung 'di lta bu'i bshad pa mang po zhig rgyal rabs theb ther dkar por bris 'dug kyang de thams cad la rnam pa kun tu long bas glang mjug 'dzin pa'i tshul du bya mi rung ba mang por yod par mngon pas dpyad par 'tshal/
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 309dga' ba 'phel 'das rjes su dus yun gang mtshams ring 'phags yul byang phyogs su chab sri da brtan po med par gyur cing rgyal khams dum bu mang du phyin nas phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing byas te gnas/ de 'dra zhig la rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyal khams stobs che bar gyur pa red/mornya'i chos rgyal chen po mya ngan med kyi rjes su rgya gar 'phaḍa pa'i yul 'dir byang phyogs dang lho phyogs gnyis kyi gnas stangs tha dad du song bas kuṣaṇa 7gong ma kuniṣ+ka dang / gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud dang harla bcas kyis rgya gar byang phyogs khul la dbang bsgyur ba las lho phyogs la de tsam dbang ma bsgyur/ der brten mya ngan med kyi rjes su lho phyogs su ji ltar byung ba yang shes gal che bas da ni lho phyogs kyi byung ba mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya'o//ḍaskan dang lho phyogs kyi rgyal khams/'phags yul lho phyogs dang ḍakan la mor+sha 7gong ma'i rjes su sātalnganyan ste bde ba'i zhon pa zhes pa'i rgyal rgyud kyis dbang byas pa yin zhing / morla'i 7gong ma tsho'i skabs de tsho mor+sha'i mnga' 'og tu gnas yod kyang / mor+sha'i rgyal rgyud nyams rjes de tsho stobs shugs che ru phyin te rang dbang du gyur/bde ba'i zhon pa'i rgyal rgyud de spyir btang yishu'i sngon gyi phyi lo 230 nas 'go tshugs te de'i mnga' ris kyi rgya khyon ni ḍamin gyi khul yongs rjogs dang / dus phyog su byang phyogs su yang rgya skyed byas te yul mgadha bar du bslebs yod/ phyi lo brgya phrag dang po dang gnyis pa'i nang shaka'i mi rigs dang mnyam du rtag par dmag 'khrug byed dgos byung ste rgyal rgyud stong pa'i rkyen du gyur/ brgya phrag gsum pa'i 'go
310 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/stod tsam bar rgyal rgyud de stongs nas rtsa med du phyin pa dang / sa khul de tsho rgyal khab rang dbang ba chung ngu mang por 'thor ba red/khungs sam tshad ma/sātaXhan nam bde ba'i zhon pa'i rgyal rgyud skor khungs dang lung tshad ma nyung shas las med/ ḍakan shar phyogs kyi bskos bris bdun dang / ḍaskan nub phyogs kyi brkos yig brtu dgu tsam da bar brnyed son byung yod kyang / de dag nang du lo rgyus zhib rgyas 'khod mi 'dug ḍamin shar nub gnyis kyi dong tse khag thob yod pa de tsho rgyal rgyud de'i khungs btsan shos yin/ rgyal rgyud 'di'i skor phyi gling gi mkhas pa dang / 'phags yul gyi lo rgyus mkhan du mas brtag dpyad gnang yod la/ sngon rabs nang du yang rgyal rgyud 'di'i skor bshad yod/ 'on kyang dong gsal de tsho phan tshun mi mthun par khyad par chen po yod/ sāhanywahana'i rgyal po'i skabs rgyal blon 'du 'dzoms sar bris pa'i 1hatakaspru ste gtam rgyud rgyas pa zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de yang cha tshang ba zhig thob rgyu med/ shālākra3 ste rol ldan ma zhes pa'i dpe deb cig rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po 17 pa hālā'i btsun mo'i ming thog bris pa zhig nang hālās g.yul gyi bya ba byas tshul skor 'ga' shas bris 'dug kyang cha tshang bden par 'dzin du mi rung bar snang / chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi bskos bris khag tu gcaputra ste bden pa'i bu zhes pa'i ming gis brjod 'god gnang yod pa la gzhig na bde ba'i zhon pa zhes pa'i tshab tu bden pa'i zhon pa yang yin srid/rgyal rgyud 'di la spyir btang ā: zhes brjod de gang lags zer na de tsho'i thog ma'i 'byung khungs ārwa'i sa khul nas yin pa red/ de tsho la āṣ+ṭha 25 ste āṣ+ṭha'i
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 311'bangs zhes kyang 'bod pa yin te gang lags she na de tsho'i pha mes rnams chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi zhabs zhu byed mkhan yin la/ mya ngan med kyi rjes su de tshos nub ḍamin khul du rgyal khab rang dbang can 'dzugs skrun byas pa red/ mdor na rgyal rgyud 'di nub ḍamin la stobs shugs bskyed nas rim bzhin phyogs thams cad la khyab pa yin 'dugrgyal rgyud rim pa dang lo tshogs/sngon rabs bco brgyad gyi nang nas maklu ste nya'i sngon rabs su rgyal rgyud 'di la rgyal po 30 byung zhing / de tshos lo 450 dbang byas tshul bshad/ lhayu ste rlung gi sngon rabs las rgyal po bcu dgu'i ming dang / de dag gis lo 300 dbang bsgyur bar bshad/ shuṅga'i dus rabs su bsgrigs pa la gzhi byas na ār+ya'i rgyal po thog ma des shur+sha rtsa med du btang ba yin/ 'ga' shas kyis rgyal rgyud 'di phyi lo brgya phrag dang po'i nang nyams pa yin tshul bshad pa de mi 'thad de/ rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po'i brkos bris nusika dang / nāgar las brnyed son byung ba rnams yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag gnyis pa'i nang gi brkos bris yin pa'i phyir ro/ lo rgyus byung rabs dang 'brel ba'i byung ba khag la gzhi byas te mkhas pa tshos sātamāhan gyi rgyal rgyud 'di yishu'i sngon gyi lo 230 nas phye lo 220 bar du gtan 'bebs byas yod/simyaka (yishu'i sngon gyi lo 230207)rgyal po somuka zhis pa de nyid rgyal rgyud 'di'i thog ma yin zhing / de nas bzung bden pa'i zhon pa'i rgyal rgyud kyi rmang gzhi tshugs/ des shuga'i rgyal po tha ma de pham par byas/ rgyal po 'dis rgyal ba pa dang / sangs rgyas pa gnyis ku'i gtsug lag
312 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/khang bzhengs/ 'on kyang de'i rgyal sred kyi mtha' mjug tu gdug pa can du gyur pas rgyal srid las phabs te bgrongs 'dugkraṅgā'am kriṣ+ṭhade'i rjes rgyal po kri4'am yang kurmā zhes pa zhig byung zhing des gzhan las rnam par rgyal ba'i srid byus bzung nas mnga' ris rgya bskyed byas te nub phyogs su nusika bar du dbang bsgyur/shātakaṇ+ḍi dang po/de'i rjes rgyal po shātakaṇ+ḍa ste rna ba mdzes po dang po byung zhing / des rgyal srid dus yun thung ngu zhig las ma bskyangs na yang / de'i ring yar rgyas yag po byung ba de ni de'i btsun mo nayasnakā ste 'dren byed ldan ma zhes pas bskul ba las byung ba yin par grags/ rgyal po 'dis nub mālalha dang gnupa zhes pa'i sa khul khag dang /khridalha bcas dbang du bsdus/ de'i dus su rgyuka pa tshos btsan 'dzul zhig byung 'dugrgyal po 'dis rta mchog gi mchod sbyin thengs gnyis dang / rāngasug zhes pa'i mchod sbyin gcig byas te rang gi rgyal srid dril bsgrags byas/ dong tse khag dang / brkos bris khag las pu'uyan nas uXn dang / bideshā bar du yar rgyas byung tshul gsal bar mtshon thub/ rgyal po 'dis 7gong ma dang / lho phyogs kyi ljongs spi bdag po dang / mi pham pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs kyi mtshan gnas bzhes/ khong gi sku dus su srid pa'i phun tshogs yar ldan du gyur mod kyang / mthar khong rang g.yul sa ru sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs/
le'udang pa/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 313de'i rjes su khong gi sras shin tu chung ba gnyis te/ wedashrī ste rig byed dpal dang / sutis+thā ste bden pa'i dpal gnyis kyis rgyal srid bskyangs/ lo rgyus 'ga' shas nang du rgyal sras 'di gnyis kyi ring / rgyas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mornya'i rgyal srid 'phrogs pa yin zhes bshad 'dug pa de lo tshigs gong 'og 'grig min brtag dpyad bya dgos par snang /shātakaṇ+ḍa gnyis pa/ (yishu'i sngon gyi lo 166 nas 110)shātakasmi dang po'i rjes su rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po gal che shos ni shātakasmi gnyis pa yin la khong gis shudra'i lag nas mālalha'i sa khul tshur blangs/ spruledra'i rgyal po 63wel yis rgyal po 'di'i thog tshur rgol thengs gnyis byas shing rgyal po 'di pham pa red/ rgyal po 'dis rang gi mnga' ris ma65desha ste dbus mnga' sde'i bar du rgya skyed mdzad yod/hālā/ phyi lo (2024)rgyal po hālā ni rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po bcu bdun pa yin zhing / de ni zhi bde la dga' zhing snyan ngag pa zhig kyang yin/ de ni gzhung lugs la mkhas pa'i grags pa can zhig yin la des 'dod skyed dam chags skyed kyu sgrung bdun brgya tsam phyogs bsgrigs byas yod tshod/ khong gis siṅgāla'i rgyal po'i sras mo zhwalawa3 ṣ+ṭi rol ma khab tu bzhes/ rgyal po 'dis ḍaskan shar rgyud du dmag 'thab byas min ni rtsod pa can zhig yin/hālā'i rjes thog de ma thag tu khong gi rjes 'dzin pa bzhis rgyal srid 'dzin yun shin tu thung ba khyon lo bcu gnyis ring dka' ngal chen po byung yod 'dug de skabs
314 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/sāhanywahan yi mnga' ris kyi rgya skyed la shaka'i mi rigs tshos bkag 'gog byas yod pa red/ de nas gang mtshams rjes rgyal po stobs dang ldan pa ṇ+ḍata'iputra shātakasmi byung ba red/lhartasmyusutraXtakaṇ+ḍi phyi lo (804104)ṇ+ḍata'iputra shātakasmi rna ba mdzes ni shaka'i rigs dang pamawā dang / shrīka pa rnams 'joms byed yin par bshad cing / khong gi skabs sātwanywahana'i mnga' thang bskyar gso byas yod/ khong gis nahapan zhes pa de khri las phabs shing / dngul gyi sgor mo yang grangs mang po par 'grems byas/ shaka'i lag pa nas byang mahārāstu blangs pa dang / kokaṇa (deng sang golha )dang / namadā'i lung pa dang / snarā6 ma zad mālalnga dang / rlangaswāhāna'i nub phyogs bcas blangs/ khong gis rang gi mnga' ris de byang phyogs su kāk+ṣaXlngar dang / lho phyogs su kriṣ+ṭha dang / shar phyogs nas berār dang / nub phyogs su kokaṇa bar du rgya skyed mdzad/ khong gis rgya mtsho gsum gyi mnga' bdag chen po zhes pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes shing de'i don ni rgya gar gyi phyogs gsum la yod pa'i rgya mtsho gsum snye/ baṅgāl gyi rgya mtsho dang / zhorab kyi rgya mtsho dang / rgya gar gyi rgya mtsho gsum yin pa de tsho'i bdag po yin zhes pa'i don no/khong ni dpa' bo yin par ma zad zhi bde la dga' po zhig kyang yin la/ des sbyi tshogs la legs bcos byas te mi rigs nang spyod ngan byed pa de 'gog thabs gnang ba dang / spyi tshogs nang rigs bzhi po phan tshun mnyam bsres byed pa de yang bkag pa yin zhes lo rgyus mkhan tshos bshad/ rgyal po de la yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan la bsod nams can gyi skyabs gnas lta bu yin par bshad/ rgyal po de la khrikamādongu ste rnam gnon nyi ma lta bu yin par bshad kyang cha tshang bden pa min/
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 3155lumayi gnyis pa/6lumayi gnyis pa 'dis lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyal srid bskyangs pa dang / khong gi dngul dong tse khag chu mo goduwarāye nye 'gram dang / deng dus ā: pradesha'i gunatur zhes pa'i rdzong khongs dang / koromaṇ+ḍal gyi mtsho 'gram gyi sa gnas khag dang / lho phyogs kurnga3r nas brnyed son byung yod/ khong gis nawanagar ste grong khyer gsar pa zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig gsar du chags btab/ khong gis grong khyer gsar pa'i rje bo dang / rgyal po chen po dang / lho phyogs kyi ljongs kyi dbang phyug ces pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes/ rgyal po 'di'i srid yun ring de ni rgyal rgyud 'di'i mnga' thang rgyas pa'i rtse mor son pa'i skabs yin 'dug de'i skabs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa yod pa dang / amarāwa3 la yod pa'i mchod rten khag ni de'i skabs kyi rdo bzo'i rig pa phul byung yod pa'i mtshon byed lta bu yin/de'i rjes su rgyal po shiwa5lumayi zhes pa de byung zhing / de ni 5lumayi gnyis pa'i tsha bo yin/ rgyal po de shaka'i rgyal po rudradaman ste drag po 'dul byed ces pa des pham par byas te de'i sras mo dang gnyen 'dun byas/ sātaXhan gyi rgyal rgyud nang grags che shos ni cagarta dpal ldan mchod sbyin zhes pa de yin la/ de yishu'i 'das lo 170 nas 199 bar srid bskyangs/ des shaka'i mi rigs tsho dang mnyam 'thab rgol mu mthud byas te pha mes tsho'i skabs shor zin pa'i mnga' sde 'ga' shas slar blangs/ rgyal po 'dis dngul gyi ṭam sgor brnyed dka' ba kukhug 7gong ma'i srid skyong k+ṣatapa tsho'i ṭam sgor la dpe blangs pa rnams spel 'grems gnang / li dang zhwa nye'i ṭam sgor khag shar phyogs spre mnga' khul nas brnyed/ ṭam sgor thog gru
316 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/gzings kyi gzugs brnyan bkod pa m+pi rgyal srid kyi mnga' thang sa gzhi tsam ma zad rgya mtsho la yang khyab yod par bstan pa yin/ rgyal po 'di'i bskos bris khag nub phyogs nubaka zhes pa deng gang basbra'i nye skor du yod pa de dang shar lho'i phyogs su ulha'i mtsho 'gram sa gnas gajum dang cirnga bcas nas brnyed son byung yod/ rgyal po 'di la rgya mtsho gsum gyi lhag pa'i bdag nyid dang / dge slong klu sgrub kyi mdza' grogs zhes pa'i mtshan nas 'bod srol byung yod 'dugrgyal po 'di nyid ni shar phyogs dang nub phyogs sa khul gnyis kur dbang byed thub mkhan gyi rgyal po tha ma de yin tshul bshad/ 'di'i skabs nusika gi nye skor sa khul khag blangs nas gcig gyur chen po byung 'dug de'i rjes su shākasen zhes pa'i rgyal po de byung zhing des glang chen dang seng ge'i dbyibs can gyi dong tse khag 'grems spel byas/ 5lumayi bzhi pa ni rgyal po tha ma de yin la de'i skabs mnga' ris zhig 'thor tu gyur nas sāhanywahan gyi mnga' ris de rgyal khab chung chung lnga ru gyes pa de tsho ni lho phyogs su chuzhu'i rgyal phran dang / shar lho ru paluwa dang / ulha la ok+ṣawanyu dang /chu mo kroṇ+ḍa'i smad du at+nahār dang / sātaXhan ste lnga yin zhing / de la brten nas rgyal rgyud chen po de nyams pa red/sātamāhana'i rgyal srid skabs lho phyogs ḍaskan gyi gnas stangs/sāhanywahana'i rgyal rgyud kyi rim pa mdor bsdus te bshad nas da ni de tsho'i skabs kyi mnga' khul de ye gnas stangs 'bri bar bya snye/ de'i skabs rgyal khab kyai mnga' ris rgya chen po yod kyang / rgyal khab kyi srid byus de stabs bde zhing sa gnas kyi 'dzin skyong de rgyal po'i 'og tu mi drag sa bdag gral rim pa tsho'i lag par bzhag
le'udangapo/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 317yod pa red/ rgyal po'i khri ni skyes stobs kyis pho la dbang ba'i srol yod/ rgyal po ni spyi tshogs kyi rim pa skyong ba po yin pa dang / des khrims mthun gyis khral bsdus pa dang / dbul po tsho'i 'tsho ba yar rgyas su gtong thabs byas yod/ sa zhing dbang 'dzin gyi mi drag rim pa gsum yod pa de tsho ni/ dang po ni rgyal po yin zhing / des rang gi ming thog nas ṭam sgor dong tse par 'grems byed/ gnyis pa ni mahāmaja ste zas chen po zhes pa yin zhing / gsum pa mahāragli ste shing rta chen po yin zhing / de gnyis kyang ḍaskan nub 9 khyim tshang 'ga' shas nas yong ba tsam yin/ rgyal khab yongs rdzogs ahar ste mnga' sde khag tu bgos shing amatra zer ba'i blon po re'i 'og tu yod/ahar ni grong gseb khag tu bgos pa de rnams ni grong gseb dpon gyi dbang 'og tu gnas/ gzhung zhabs gzhan khag ni mdzod pa dang / gzhis sdod pa dang / gser bzo ba dang / ṭam sgor bzo skrun mkhan dang / yig cha bdag gnyer mkhan dang /rgyal po'i sku tshab bcas red/rgyal po ni rang gi 'gro gron lding tsam gyi ngang du bzhugs pa yin zhing / khral bsdu tshad ni shin tu chung zhing / khral gyi rnam grangs kyang nyung nyung las med/ rgyal po la dbang ba'i sa cha'i yong 'bab dang / sa khral dang / tshwa bzo mkhan rnams las blangs pa'i khral dang / khrims khang gi yon bcas las gzhung gi 'gro gron gtong gi yod cing gong gsal khral de tsho mang che ba pe shag dmar rkyang min par dngos po bsdu len byed srol yod/spyi tshogs nang 'tsho ba'i las don la gzhir byas pa'i rigs chung khag gsar du byung ba dper na lug rdzi dang / zhing rmo mkhan sogs yin/ khyad mtshar ba zhig la phyi rgyal ba rnams yul de'i spyi tshogs nang cha tshang thim nas ming yang rgya gar gyi ming
318 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/btags pa dper na bramidewa dang / roṣabhadat+ta dang / asmikarla sogs kyi ming nas bos/ gnas skor du 'gro ba dang / bram ze la ba phyugs dang / grong gseb 'bul bar byed pa ni spyir btang gi lugs srol yin tshod/amarāwa3 sogs su bzhings pa'i mchod rten khag gi bzo bkod la :ka dang /roman gyi shan chen po zhugs yod par ma zad bskos bris khag 'ga' shas su :ka gi sgron me'i skor bshad pa yang byas 'dugyig cha khag dang brkos bris khag ltar na spyi tshogs nang bud med tsho la che mthong dang brtsi bkur chen po yod pa dang / de tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi thob dbang chen po yod par shes thub/ btsun mo rnams phal cher nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos a+yau rjes 'brangs pa yin zhing / de tshos nang pa'i dgon pa dang mchod rten sku brnyan mang po bzhings bskrun mdzad yod/ amarāwastu yi brag phug dang mchod rten rnams kyang khong tshos bzhengs pa yin/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub mchog de skabs su byon pa yin tshul bshad srol 'dugbtsun mo sogs bud med rnams tshogs 'du sogs la bskyod de so so'i khyo ga dang sku mgron tsho la rogs ram dang / gros 'debs byed kyi yod pa red/ pho mo gnyis ka gyon chas la do snang che zhing rgyan cha 'dogs par dga' po yod/ nang gi 'dzin chas tshang ma bzo bkod mdzes shing spus legs po yod 'duggrong khyer khag ni :ga pa mthon po dang / lcags ris bskor yod cing / rgya sgo rnams so phag dang 'dam gyis bzos yod/ dmag khra tshos rang srung byed dang /gzhan la gnod byed kyi mtshon cha gnyis ka bed spyod byed/ dmag mi'i nang rkang dmag dang / glang chen dmag bcas yod cing / gru kha chen po khag yod pa de dag gis tshong
le'u dang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 319'brel la phan thogs chen po yod/ lo rgyus 'ga' shas su rgyal khams de'i gru gzings khag shar phyogs malaga'i gling gi rtso mo la yang 'gro gi yod par gsal/ ḍamin nub phyogs su lha'oca ni byang mtha'i gru kha dang / so5rā ni rnying shos dang / kuk+ṣaṇa ni che shos yin pa red/tshong pa tshos rang gi tshong pa'i skyed sdug khang bzos yod cing / skyed sdug tshogs pa re re la 'go khrid re yod/ skyod sdug tshogs pa de tshos dngul khang nang bzhin bya ba byed cing / pe shag gsog 'jog dang / g.yar ba bcas byed/ sgyid sdug tshogs pa de la tshogs khang zhes pa'i las khungs re yod/ dngos zog 'chor po chang dang / dar gos spus legs gras dang / shel sgo dang / li shi mngar mo bcas phyi nas nang 'dren byed rgyu'i dngos zog gtso che shos yin la/ phyir 'tshong byed rgyu ni spyir btang ras cha dang / gsang ras dang / rtsa ras sogs yin 'dugbgrod lam gag po med pa des tshong 'brel la gnod skyon byung yod/ de lta na yang ḍamin shar phyogs de bzo las dang / tshong las kyi sa gnas lte ba lta bur gyur yod/sātaXhana'i rgyal srid yongs rdzogs ring sangs rgyas kyi chos dar ba'i rtse mor son 'dug amarāwa3'i mchod rten la rgyan mdzes po bzos pa dang / che ru btang ba dang / sa gnas gzhan khag tu mchod rten rnying pa tshang ma la zhig gso dang /bzhings pa sogs byas te nang chos shin tu dar khyab byung ba red/ nusaka dang / dzinahi ri sogs la brag phug gsar pa bzo bkod byas yod pa red/ de skabs nang pa'i mkhas pa dang / grub pa thob pa mang po yod par bskos bris khag las gsal por shes/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu grub kyang sātamāhana'i rgyal rgyud skabs byung ba yin par gdon mi za/ mchod rten rnams dang byang chub ljon shing dang / bde bar
320 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ring bsrel dang sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra la mchod pa rgya chen po byed srol yod 'dugbram ze'i chos lugs kyang dar khyab byung yod/ rgyal po tshos rig byed kyi mchod sbyin khag byed cing / rang gi sras kyi ming la bedashrī ste dpal ldan rig byed ces sogs 'dogs par byed cing / halā zhes pa'i rgyal po de dbang phyug gi rjes 'jug pa yin zhing / shātakaṇ+ḍi ni bram ze'i chos la rgyab skyor byed mkhan gtso bo zhig yin tshod/ mi mang mang pos dbang po dang / dbang phyug dang / khyab 'jug dang /lha mo umā dang / shrī15 ste dpal nag po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang /tshogs bdag dang / phyugs skyong dang / me lha dang / chu lha sogs la mchod pa byed kyi yod pa red/ dus skabs 'di tshor rgyal po tshos angastu yi lugs kyi ldeb ris la bdag gces dang / sbyin bdag zhus yod 'dugsāhanywahana'i rgyal khams de 'phags yul byang phyogs dang / rgya gar lho phyogs gnyis kyi bar du zam pa lta bu zhig yin zhing / nags tshal 'thug po khag gtsang ma bzos te grong gseb kyai rnam par bsgyurd/ rgyal khams 'di ni byang phyogs chu bo namadā dang / lho phyogs su chu bo kṛt+yā dang / tu549 yi bar du chags yod cing /mnga' khul de la spyir btang ḍakan zhis brjod pa yin/ nub phyogs su nā༄ka dang /deng sang gi balharmā nye khul bar rgya skyed byas 'dug ṅgārān dang / 〈rāka dang /garab kyi yul khag nas gru gzings yong nas/ nub phyogs gru kha lhadzoca la bed spyod byed kyi yod 'dug de bzhin shar phyogs barmā'i phyogs su yang gru gzings 'gro gi yod pa red/
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 321stso4kya'i rgyal rgyud/sātaXhana'i rgyal srid nyams rjes ḍaskan du rgyal phran chung ngu mang po byung ba dang / 'ga' shas kyis rgyal khams stobs ldan du bzo rgyu'i thabs shes byas yod kyang de ltar bzo ma thub/ de rjes cukhukya yi rgyal rgyud byung zhing / rgyal rgyud de'i rgyal sa lte ba ni nywaljospru red/ phyi lo brgya phrag drug pa'i dkyil tsam la cukhukya'i rgyal srid gcig gyur nus ldan du gyur nas ḍamin gyi yul de la dbang bsgyur ba red/ r+sākhukya'i rgyal rabs de rgyal po jagasidha ste rgyal ba'i seṅge zhes pa'i rgyud pa yin yang / rgyal srid 'dzugs skrun mkhan ni bulageshin dang po zhes pa de yin/ des rang gi rgyal sa 179 la bzos shing rgyal sa de'i ming sngon dus su bdumi zhes brjod kyang / rgyal po 'dis ming bsgyur nas da lta yang lnga7spru zhes 'bod/ rgyal po des che ba'i mtshan gnas du ma bzhes shing / rta mchog gi mchod sbyin sogs rig byed kyi mchod sbyin mang po byas par grags te rig byed kyi chos la snying nas zhin pa che ba zhig yod 'dugde'i sras nurtawasman ste grags pa'i go cha yin zhing / des mnga' ris rgya skyed mdzad/ de'i rjes su malhagesha ste bkra shis dbang po byung / de'i rjes grags pa'i go cha'i sras sprulanashin gnyis pa de rgyal po grags chen zhig byung bas mnga' ris rgya skyed mdzad/ phyi lo 636 lor byang phyogs kyi rgyal po tar+sāwartan ste dpal ldan dga' ba 'phel gyis ḍaskan la btsan rgol byas par mthar pulageshin gnyis pa 'dis 3 lo 639 lor harla pham par byas pas harla yis lho phyogs su rgya skyed byed ma thub par gong du bshad pa bzhin yin/ rgya nag gi mkhas dbang (wenasārla rgya gar la gnas skor du phebs skabs khong dang sprulanashin gnyis pa mjal phrad legs par byung 'dug par ma zad bulaskrushin gyi rgyal khams la bstod bsngags mang po gnang 'dug
(waXwaX waX/ /wa wa wa wa khro wa wa wawa/waXwa
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 323de'i sras nyikamādongu ste rnam gnon nyi ma dang / de'i sras wenaXdirgya ste rnam 'dul nyi ma dang / de'i sras khri4༷dit+ya ste rnam rgyal nyi ma yin/ de tshos lho phyogs kyi paluwa'i rgyal po khag dang rtag par g.yul 'khrug byed dgos byung ba dang / de nas khrikamādongu gnyis pa byung zhing / de'i skabs arab kyi mi rigs tshos ḍamin la nyen kha bzos pa mthar bkag 'gog thub pa red/r+sā4kya'i rgyal rgyud kyi nang stobs che shos tha ma ni nut+tayor+shaṇa gnyis pa de yin zhing / des rang gi mnga' khongs kyi gzhung zhabs pa rā459 zhes pa'i rgyal rigs a+yau rgyal po da:durga zhes pa dang 'phruḍa pa na nut+tawarmaṇa gnyis pa pham nas r+sākhukya'i stobs shugs rtsa med du phyin/ phyi lo brgya phrag brgyad pa'i dkyil tsam du stsoluka'i rgyal rgyud zhig 'thor gyis ming tsam yang med par gyur pa red/cukhukya'i rgyal sred skabs kyi gnas stangs ni rgyal po tshog bram ze tsho dang rig byed kyi chos la srung skyob tshod med byas pas sangs rgyas pa'i chos mnga' khul der nyams pa'i 'go tshugs/ rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs legs par gnas thub pa byung /khyab 'jug dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug sogs kyi lha khang mang po bzhengs 'dug rgyal po 'di tsho'i ring khang bzo dang / sku brnyan bzhengs skrun gyi lag rtsal khyad par can zhig byung zhing brag btub nas brag phug brkos bris 9 lag rtsal gsar pa zhig byung bas aja〉 dang 6lorā'i brag phug sogs ni de skabs kyi lag rtsal rmad du byung ba de mtshon byed yin/rgyal po rnams rgyas spros chen po'i ngang bzhugs kyi yod pa dang / rgyal srid 'dzin skyong ni sa bdag lugs srol yin pa la cung zad lhod yang lta bu zhig yod/ sa zhing rnams la tshad legs par blangs nas khral rgyag 'os pa'i sa zhing dang / rgyag mi
324 'phags yulagyi byung ba badzad pa/'os pa'i sa zhing gnyis su phyes/ khral ni dngul thog gam yang na dngos po'i thog nas bsdu len byed/ grong gseb khag la rang skyong gi thob thang yod pa de ni de skabs kyi gnas stangs gal che shos shig yin/ bud med tsho la rang dbang dang thob thang shin tu che zhing / rtsi mthong chen po yod/ bud med 'ga' shas ni shes yon dang / sbyong brdar gag po yod cing / g.yul gyi bya ba la yang mkhas pa yod 'dug pa dper na jagasiha gnyis pa'i sring mo gaXdeX zhes pa des mnga' sde'i srid skyong byas pa dang /dmag 'khrug byas te dgra bo pham par byas pa red/ de skabs ches mtho'i shes yon la do snang chen po byed kyi yod pa dang / saskrota'i skad la sbyang brtson dmigs bsal byed kyi yod pa red/ bzo las dang / tshong las bcas ni yar rgyas dang ldan pa yod 'dugrā4kāsa'i rgyal rgyud/gong du bshad pa ltar phyi lo brgya phrag brgyad pa'i dkyil 45kya'i rgyal srid nyams rjes rā4kās zhes pa'i rgyal rgyud kyis ḍakan la dbang bsgyur ba red/ rā4kyi9 zhes pa'i rgyal rigs de'i 'byung khungs skor bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang po zhig yod kyang / lo rgyus mang che bas de tsho ni rgya gar byang rgyud kyi rāk+ṣar rgyal rigs nas yin par 'dod/rā4kās zhes pa'i tshog don de/ rgyal khams zhig gi mnga' sde la yul 'khor zhes bya zhing / de skyong mkhan te yul 'khor skyong zhes pa'i don yon pas/ sngon rā4lhaṭa'i rgyal srid skabs rgyal khams de'i yul 'khor ram mnga' sde'i gtso bor bskos pa yin par bshad/ de tsho'i pha skad ni kunaṭa snye deng dus kurmā9ka mnga' sde'i skad de yin zhing / de tsho thog mar cukhukya'i mnga' khongs yin/ stso4kya'i rgyal po tha ma nurtewasmag gnyis pa'i skabs rā6༷ṭa'i gtso bo da:durga zhes pa de shugs che ru gyur te
le'u dang po/ sngonadus gyi byung rabs/ 325kirtikar+shaṇa gnyis pa pham par byas te r+sākhukya'i rgyal khams nus med du btang / der brten da:durga ni rāḥkāsa'i rgyal srid 'dzugs pa po yin/rā4kyi9'i rgyal po grags che ba khag ni/ du:durga'i rjes kroṇ+ḍa dang po dang /de rjes gowen+da gnyis pa dang / de rjes rgyulha dang / de'i rjes gowen+da gsum pa dang /de nas sarba.amogabarla dang po dang / de nas kroṇ+ḍa gnyis pa dang / in+d+ra gsum pa dang / kroṣ+ṭha gsum pa bcas yin la/ rgyal rgyud 'dis phyi lo 975 bar ḍaskan la dbang bsgyur nas de rjes rgyal sred nyams pa red/'o na rā4kāsa'i rgyal srid skabs rgyal khams der gnas stangs ji 'dra zhig yod dam zhe na/ rgyal po ni nus stobs che shos yin la de rnams la che ba'i mtshan du mas 'bod/ phyi logs la rgyal khab kyi las don la phebs skabs ma gtogs rtag tu rgyal po'i khrims ra'am tshogs 'du la phebs srol yod/ rgyal po de tsho rgyas spros shin tu che zhing 'chor po'i ngang du bzhugs srol yod/ rgyal po'i khrims ra de yang ha cang rdzig po gra rgyas po yod tshod/ rgyal po ni rtag tu sku srung ba tsho dang / gar mkhan ma khag dang / gzhung zhabs pa rnams dang / drag po'i dpon rigs khag dang /rtsis mkhan pa tsho sogs kyis bskor nas sdod pa yin/ rgyal po ni skyes stobs kyis yin zhing / sras rgan pa des khri 'dzin srol yod/ 'on kyang skabs 'gar sras gzhon pa yang khri la bkod pa byung 'dug spyir btang blon po tshog 'dzin skyong byed cing /srid blon dang / phyi srid blon po dang / dmag spyi chen mo dang / khrims dpon chen mo dang / mdun na 'don sogs blon po mang po yod/rgyal khab 'di'i 'og khams kyi rgyal phran 'ga' shas yod pa de tsho la rang skyong ljongs kyi thob thang cha tshang yod/ 'on kyang 7gong ma'i rgyal tshogs su rtag par 'gro
326 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/dgos pa dang / 7gong ma la rgyas bcad gyi khral 'bul sprod dgos par ma zad dmag mi yang gtong dgos/mnga' ris m+pi spyor btang yul 'khor khag tu bgos yod pa dang / yul 'khor re la grong gseb khag lnga bcu nas bdun rtsu tsam bar yod/ yul 'khor rnams grong gseb khag tu bgos yod cing / yul 'khor rnams yul 'khor gyi bdag pos bskyangs shing / grong gseb rnams grong gseb kyi 'go pas dbang byed/mnga' ris rgya skyed bya rgyu'i 'dun pa chen :po yod rkyen drag po'i dpung dmag la gal chen po byed/ dmag dpung khyon chen po rgyal sa la gnas sdod byed cing dpung dmag nang rkang dmag dang / rta dmag sogs yod/ chos lugs dang rig gzhung tshang ma las dmad mir 'dzul zhugs byed/ sa zhing gi khral ni yong 'bab lte ba yin zhing / gter kha dang / nags tshal sogs nas kyang yong 'bab yod pa red/ sa zhing thon skyed kyi bzhi cha gcig khral du bsdu zhing / de yang khag gnyis gsum du rim gyis 'bul chogmi mang tshos lha dbang phyug dang / khyab 'jug sogs la mchod pa byed cing /rgyal pos mchod sbyin byed srol yod 'dug rgyal ba pa'i chos la rgyal po mang pos sbyin bdag zhus shing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de nyams dmas kyi ngang du gnas/sgyu stsal dar khyab chen po byung zhing / brag gtub nas bzos pa'i lha khang sogs bzos/ 6lorā'i brag phug tu na.āsha'i lha khang zhes pa'i dbang phyug gi lha khang gsar bzhengs byas/ khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu'i lha khang bcas bzhengs pa de tsho ni lag rtsal gyi cha nas ngo mtshar ba 'dug der brten aja3 dang enarā'i brag phug snyan grags can de tsho'i nang lha khang dang / ldeb ris dang / mchod rten sogs tshang
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byungarabs/ 327ma thengs gcig la bzhings pa min la/ der yod tshang ma nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba yod pa'i nges pa med la bram ze'i chos la dga' ba'i rgyal po mang pos gsar bsnan mang po byas yod par nges/de ltar rgya gar byang phyogs shrīharla ste dpal ldan dga' ba bar gyi byung rabs dang / lho phyogs ḍamin du sātalnganyan nas 3ri(ṭa bar gyi byung rabs mdo tsam bshad pa de ltar lags shing / 'phags yul gyi gling phran zur gsum sog pa'i dbyibs can 'di'i lho phyogs kyi zur mtha'i byung rabs mdor bsdus shig 'bri bar bya ba gal che bas de la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang ches snga mo'i lo rgyus ma 'khod pa'i dus rabs kyi gnas stangs rnams ni byung rabs su 'dod 'os par dka' zhing / ches yongs su grags pa'i byung rabs ni sathom zhes pa'i dus rabs nas 'go btsugs te lo rgyus mkhan tshos dpyad par byed pas 'dir yang de bzhin byed pa las 'os med pas de bzhin bya'o//sasgom dus rabs/rgya gar gyi lho mtha'i zur gsum ñtsa mo de la spyir btang rgya gar lho phyogs zhes bya zhing / de ni sngar bshad pa'i sātaXhan gyis bskyangs pa'i ḍamin rgyal khams gyi lho phyogs su yod cing sa gnas der lho phyogs kyu rgyal khab gsum byung ba ni/ dang po col rgyal khams yin la/ de'i lte ba ni deng dus madrusa'i lho phyogs ta:ra la yod pa dang /gnyis pa 5t+pa'i rgyal khab ste deng dus kyi ta laXḍū'i khongs gtogs mdurlayi de rgyal khab de'i rgyal sa yin/ gsum pa ni cer ste deng dus gerala'i sa khongs mtsho 'gram gyi sa khul la yod 'dug rgyal khab de gsum po'i skor nga tshos sashum gzhung lugs khag
328 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/nas shes thub pa yin/ der brten sablam gzhung lugs kyi dus rabs de la salham dus rabs zhes 'bod pa yin/ salham zhis pa'i tshog 'di ni legs sbyar gyi ming tshog yin zhing de'i doca/ ni yongs su 'dus pa'am yang dag par 'dus pa'am legs par 'dus pa zhes pa yin/ rab byung pa rnams yongs su 'dus pa la sablam zhes bya ba ni skabs 'di'i go don yin par byung rabs mkhan tshos bzhed/ des na lho phyogs hāmil gyi snyan ngag mkhan tsho dang bstan bcos mkhan tsho 'dus pa'i tshogs pa'am 'dus sde lta bu zhig la sa495 zhes pa yin/'dus pa de lta bu lan gsum byung ba dang / gsum pa de mdurlayi la tshogs pa dang / 'dus pa de tsho'i skabs lho phyogs kyi snyan ngag mkhan rnams 'dzoms nas hāmil skad du snyan ngag mang po brtsams/ dus phyis su snyan ngag stong phrag gnyis tsam phyogs bsdus byas te dpe deb brgyad du byas pa de tsho deng dus kyang klog rgyu yod pa de la sa595 gzhung kha/gas zhes bya/de skabs kyi snyan ngag mkhan rnams sa gnas kun tu rgyu zhing / mi tshogs kyi 'go khrid tshog gsol ba la brten nas snyan ngag 'bri rtsom byed kyi yod 'dug cing / snyan ngag de tsho'i nang lho phyogs kyi mi tshogs sde tshan gi 'go khrid rnams dang / mi mang gi mi 3 dang / 'tsho ba sogs kyi bshad pa byas yod pa red/ bshad pa 'ga' shas ni sngon rdo ba'i dus rabs chen mo'i rig gzhung dang 'brel ba'i dngos rnying brnyed son byung ba rnams dang 'dra po yang yod 'dug tong smos lho phyogs lku rgyal rigs col dang /cer dang / pār+ya gsum gyi bar dmag 'khrug yang yang shor gyi yod pa dang / sasgom gzhung lugs nang dmag 'khrug de tsho'i skor gsal por bris yod pa de nga tshor de tsho'i byung rabs shes par phan thogs chen po yod/
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 329'o na sar+sham gzhung lugs de tsho'i dus skabs ga re yin nam zhe na/ salham gzhung lugs kyi lo tshigs skor 'dod tshul mi mthun pa mang po yod pas mtha' gcig tu kha tshon gcod par dka' yang / 'phags yul dang / nub phyogs pa'i lo rgyus la mkhas pa mang che bas brtag dpyad tshul bzhin byas 'bras su salham gyi dus tshod ni rag rtsis byas na yishu'i sngon gyi brgya phrag lnga pa nas phyi lo brgya phrag gsum pa'i bar du gtan 'bebs byas yod pa red/sa6ma gyi gzhung luḍa rnying shos ni tomasprulam zer ba de yin la gal che ba gzhan khag ni pathukhuḍū dang / irguṭaXyi yin/ yang sel5dikaram dang / mnirmakāla.i sogs sar+sham dus rabs kyi sngon du byung ba yin zhes mang pos bzhed kyang / mang che bas 'di rnams kyang sazlum gzhung lugs khongs su gtogs par 'dod/ gang ltar gzhung lugs 'di dag las de skabs kyi rgyal khams de tsho'i byung rabs shes thub pa yin pas shin tu gal che ba lags/rgya04 po dang rgyangakhri khab khagsalham dus rabs su 'phags yul lho phyogs 'dir col dang cer dang pār+ya gsum ni srid don gyi cha nas rgyal po stobs che shos yin la chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi brkos bris nang du yang 'di gsum gyi mtshan 'khod yod pa red/cola'i rgyal khams/ cola'i rgyal pos deng dus kyi tiruḥpul+lī r+ya rdzong dang /tenajamar dang / 5dukakaka yi cha shas 'ga' shas dang / lho arakoṭa bcas la dbang bsgyur/ chu bo kā〉grwa zhes pa de rgyal khams 'di nas 'bab pa yin/ de dus kyi col 9 rgyal po grags che shos ni kurikal yin zhing / gzhan yang rgyal po nalenagikhri
330 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/dang / gir+sāwalawan sogs mang po byung / rgyal khab kyi rtags mtshan ni stag gi gzugs brnyan la byed/cera'i rgya/la khams/ deng dus kyi marala'i sa khul mālānār mtsho 'gram gyi sa khul de cera'i rgyal khams a+yau khongs su gtogs shing / rgyal sa ni wanadzo yin/udeya/ ceral dang / khrimagawaraban sogs rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po che khag yin/rgyal khab kyi rtags ni mda' gzhu yin/put+pan rgyal rgyud/ sarlam dus rabs skabs a+yau pā'in rgyal khams de deng dus kyi ku4kumud+dhā dang / tirurjelaphele dang / pad+mand dang / mdurlayi/ bcas yin/ rgyal sa ni mdurāye yin la/ rgyal khab kyi rtags ni nya yin/ rgyal po nadiyon 5lugasalayi sogs rgyal po mang po byung /rgyal rgyud che shos gsum po de yin yang / rgyal phran chung khag gzhan yang mang po yod 'dug phyi lo brgya phrag gsum pa'i nang tsam du sprulalharā zhes pa'i rgyal rgyud kyis btsan 'dzul byas par brten sarlam dus rabs kyi tamil rgyal khab gsum po de'i rang dbang rang btsan brlags nas salham dus rabs mjug sdom byas pa red/sprulabara'i rgyal rgyud kyis yul der phyi lo brgya phrag drug pa'i mjug bar du dbang byas yod 'dugsathom dus rabs skabs rgya gar lho phyogs kyi gnas stangs ni rgyal po nyid rgyal khab kyi gtso bo yin zhing / de la phyag rogs zhu mkhan rgyal po'i lhan tshogs yod/sa dmag dang / mtsho dmag 'bor chen 'jog gi yod/ so nam dang tshong 'brel la shugs chen po rgyag gi yod cing / so nam m+pi gzhung gi 'bab khungs lte ba yin/ so nam gyi las don ni las don gag po yin par tshang mas ngos len byed/ ༷snyeri soḍa
