332 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/gtsang po rnams zhing chu 'dren pa'i las don du bed spyod byed/ skud pa 'khel ba dang /thag 'thag pa yang me mang gi 'tsho thabs gal che ba zhig yin/ dar dog rnams sisgala'i gling sogs su phyir 'tshong byed/ mu tig sogs nor bu'i rigs la bed spyod byed par ma zad thag pa bzo ba dang / ko lpags bzo ba dang / lag gdub bzo ba dang /sgug khrog dang slel po bzo ba dang / shing bzo dang / gser bzo dang / lcags bzo sogs kyang 'tsho thabs yin 'dug der ma zad tshwa yang bzo 'don byed cing phyi nang gang sar tshong 'brel sdig po yod 'dug 'on kyang tshong 'brel de tshor dngos zog brje len byed pa las ṭam sgor gyi bed spyod dar po rang med tshod/ de lta na yang tumil gyi sa khul khag tu rom gyi ṭam sgor rnying pa mang po brnyed son byung yod pa red/sasgo95 skabs rigs kyu dbye ba ma dar zhing / sa gnas bye brag pa la gnas pa'i cha nas mi mang rnams khag lnga ru phyes yod par bshad/ de lta na yang bram ze rnams gal che shos su brtsis/ bud med tsho la thob dbang dang rtsi mthong chen po yod kyang de tshos las don mang po byed dgos/ chung ma gcig gi srol dar so che yang chung ma mang po 'jog pa'i srol yang yod 'dug kyo shi ba'i rjes su chung ma shi dgos pa'i srol de yang rgyal po'i khyim dang phyug po tsho'i khyim du dar srol byung 'dugde skabs kyi 〉mil mi rigs de tshos 'bras dang / sha dang / 'o ma las bzos pa'i zas rigs dang / tshal dang chang sogs la longs spyod par byed/ skyes pa tshos gos dum bu gnyis lus la gyon zhing / skra ring po 'jog pa dang / rgyan cha yang mang po 'dogs par byed/ bud med tshos stod la gos mi skyon par rgyan mang po 'dogs srol yod pa dang tsan dan gyi byug pas byugs par byed/ skro bzo stangs sna tshogs yod/ tshoms pa'i gos rgya cher gyon srol med/ de dus mi tshos glang 'dzing
le'u dngapo/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 333pa dang / bya pho 'dzing pa dang ra 'dzing du btsug nas ltad mo lta ba de dar so che/bud med tshos me tog gi pho long (po lo rang / dpyang thag tu g.yug pa sogs byed/shi ba'i rjes su dur las byed stangs sna tshogs yod pa ni/ me la sreg pa dang /sa la sbas pa dang / bya rgod dang / khyi spyang la ster ba bcas byed/ de skabs kyi tumil tsho la rnam rtog dang rmongs dad chen po yang yod 'dug de'i skabs chos lugs ni rig byed kyi lha la mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg sogs byed cing / rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs dang / sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs kyang dar khyab yod 'dug cing /rgyal ba pa dang / nang pa'i dadon pa khag yod 'dug ྅mil mi de tsho ri mo 'bri ba dang / zlos gar dang rol dbyangs la dga' po yod 'dug bud med la shes yon sprod srol yod de/ bud med snyan ngag mkhan mang po'i ming gsal 'khod yod/snyan ngag pa la rgyal po tshos che mthong chen po byed/ ྅mil mi de tshos dus ston 'dra min mang po byed kyi yod par lo rgyus su gsal/ de ltar salham gyi dus rabs de gong du bshad pa ltar yishu'i dus rabs gsum pa'i nang sprulabarā zhes pas btsan 'dzul byas rkyen mjug sdom byas pa red/kralabarā'i rgyal rgyud/kralabarā'i rgyal rgyud kyi 'byung khungs skor lo rgyus mkhan tsho'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod de/ 'ga' shas kyis de ni sagam dus rabs kyi sngon nas hāmil yul du yod pa'i rgyal phran zhig yin pa de phyis su shugs che ru phyin pa yin zhes zer/'on kyang bshad tshul grags che shos ni/ de tsho hāmil gyi mi rigs min zhing / 189ga mnga' khul gyi sa gnas sprulawabunanu zhes pa nas yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / sa
334 'phags yul gyigrang ba brjod pa/gnas de ni kunaṭaka yi shar phyogs su rgya mtsho dang thag nye sar yod/ rgyal phran de dus skabs der rgyal po stobs chen gzhan gyi 'og twā gnas kyang / nam zhig nye skor gyi rgyal po khag gis btsan shugs kyis sprulabarā'i rgyal po tsho 'khor bcas tumil yul phyogs su 'gro dgos byung ba dang der gnas dgos byung ba red/ yezhu'i 'das lo brgya phrag gsum pa'i dkyil smad tsam du tārmal yul du gcig gyur med pa dang / phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing byed bzhin pa'i go skabs de blangs nas 7mel yul gyi col dang / cer dang / pār+yan gyi rgyal po khag bcom nas (mil yul du dbang sgyur byas/kulabarā'i rgyal po gal che ba ni ga4takhrigān+ta ste rnam gnon mi 'gyur zhes pa de yin zhing / des tumil gyi rgyal po khag dbang du bsdus/ rgyal po des bram ze tsho la sbyin bdag zhus shing / lha khang bzhengs pa dang / tumil snyan ngag mkhan rnams la srung skyob byas/ de lta na yang rgyal po de tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa min nam snyam ste de tsho'i skabs rgyal khams der nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos shin tu dar khyab chen po byung yod 'dug pa dang / nang pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas byin zhes pas khrinagabinilcag ste 'dul ba rnam par nges pa dang / abhidharma shāstam ste chos mngon pa la 'jug pa zhes pa'i bstan bcos grags chen khag brtsams zhes rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus mkhan tshos bzhed/slob dpon sangs rgyas byin de theg chen pa'i slob dpon yin nam/ nyan thos sde pa yin/ 'dul ba dang mngon pa'i gzhung de gnyis deng dus theg chen gzhung ngam yang na theg dman gyi bstan bcos khag gi gral du yod min ma shes pas phyis 'byung lo rgyus mkhan tshos 'tshol bar rigs so/ rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus dang byung rabs khag nang kulabarā'i dus skabs de lo rgyus mun nag gi dus rabs zhes zer/ gcig byas na rgyal po de tsho nang chos la dad pa che bas rig byed gyi chos nyams dmas su phyin pas de
le'u dang po/ sngon dus klu byung rabs/ 335ltar brjod pa yang yin srid/ gang ltar dpyad dgos par snang / rgyal po de tsho nang chos la dad kyang rgyal ba pa'i chos la yang srung skyob legs par mdzad 'dug yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag drug pa'i mjug tsam du paluwa'i rgyal pos lho phyogs su dbang bsgyur nas kulabarā'i rgyal srid mjug sdom byas pa red/pa7wa'i rgyal rgyud/rgya gar lho phyogs su paluwa'i rgyal rgyud dang / de'i rgyal srid de gal chen po yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing lo rgyus mkhan tsho'i zhib 'jug rtsod gleng byed sa'i gnas shig kyang yin/ gang lags zer na/ paluwa'i rgyal rgyud de'i 'byung khungs skor rtsod pa shin tu che/ 'ga' shas kyis rgyal rgyud de phyi rgyal yul zhig nas bslebs pa yin tshul dang / 'ga' shas kyis ār+ya'i yul nas bslebs pa yin tshul dang / 'ga' shas kyis maṇ+ḍapalabam sa gnas yin tshul sogs 'dod tshul shin tu mang zhing da dung yang mtha' gcig tu gsal por ma shes par nyams zhib byed mus su yod/ rgyal rgyud 'di spyir btang yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag gsum pa nas byung zhing / brgya phrag dgu pa'i mjug tsam bar du gnas pa yin zhing / 'byung khungs ga nas yin rung sngon ḍaskan du sātaXhan yis dbang byed skabs patshawa 'di sātaXhana'i 'og tu gzhung zhabs pa'i las don byed mkhan yin srid cing / sātaXhana'i rgyal sred nyams pa'i skabs patshawa tsho rang gi sa gnas kyi rgyal por gyur te rim bzhin lho phyoḍa kyi kāciburam sa gnas su rgyal sred rgya skyed byas te lho phyogs su dbang sgyur byas/ des 56 dang /nālākra dang dmag 'khrug byas/patshawa'i srid dbang gi cha nas dus rabs khag gsum du phyes te/
336 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjedapa/1 sngon dus kyi paluwa'i srid gabang de yishu'i 'das lo 250 nas 340 bar yin zhing / dus rabs de'i pa7wa'i rgyal po tshos rang bzhin pa'i skad du byang bu khag bskos/2 dus rabs bar ma'i pamawa'i srid dbang de phyi lo 340 nas 570 bar yin zhing / de'i ring paluwa'i rgyal po tshos saskrota legs sbyar skad du brkos bris sogs byas 'dug3 dus phyis kyi paluwa'i srid dbang de phyi lo 570 nas brgya phrag dgu pa'i bar yin zhing / de'i skabs rgyal po tshos tumil skad du brkos bris khag byas 'dugsngon dus kyi palngalnga'i skor tshul bzhin zhib gsal ma shes kyang / wa5dewa zhes pa de rgyal srid 'dzugs pa po yin/ kāt+yā ni de tsho'i rgyal sa yin 'dug dus rabs bar ma'i paluwa'i rgyal po ni bistugopa nas 'go tshugs pa yin zhing / rgyal po de ni byang phyogs kyi grulta'i rgyal po samudagup+ta ste rgya mtsho sbas pas rgyal po bcu gnyis pham par byas pa'i nang nas gcig yin pas rgyal po de rgya mtsho sbas pa dang dus mtshungs par shes/ der brten rgya mtsho sbas pa'i i.āhāhād rdo ring nang du yang bistugopa ste khyab 'jug skyong zhes 'khod yod/ rgyal po des phyi lo 350 nas 375 bar rgyal srid bskyangs yod tshul bshad/ de rjes rgyal rgyud de la rgyal po gzhan byung yod nges kyang rgyal rabs snga lta ba bzhin ma shes zhing phye lo 575 tsam du rgyal po siha'i( ma byung bar rgyal rabs gsal po zhig byung rabs mkhan tshos shes ma thub par gnas yod pa/ red/ byung rabs mkhan tshos bzhed pa ltar na/ de bar gong gsal sprulabarās lho phyogs su btsan 'dzul gyis dbang bsgyur bar brten hāmil yul gyi lo rgyus gsal por yig cha khag tu ma 'khod pa dang / de la brten nas sprulabarā'i dus skabs de byung
le'udang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 337rabs kyi cha nas mun nag gi dus rabs zhes bya/paluwa'i rgyal rabs nang srid kyi mnga' dbang che shos ni dus phyis kyi patshawa'i rgyal po sihabaca ste khyab 'jug seng ge nas 'go tshugs pa yin zhing / rgyal po 'dis 4phyo lo 570 tsam la srid dbang bzung zhing / de dang de'i rjes 'dzin gyi rgyal po rnams la patshawa'i rgyal po chen po zhes 'bod/ khyab 'jug seng ges kulabarā dang /5t+pan dang / 〈khukya dang / col rnams pham par byas par ma zad lho phyogs paṃsgala'i gling la yang dbang bsgyur zhing / rgyal po 'dis 3 lo 570 tsam nas 615 bar dbang bsgyur/ paluwa'i rgyal po gzhan rnams ni/1 mahen+d+rawarmamā dang po/ phyi lo 615go6302 narat+nahāwarmamā dang po/ phyi lo 630bca683 mahen+d+rawarmanang gnyis pa/ phyi lo 66846704 parameshurawarmanadang po/ phyi lo 67046905 narat+nahāwarmamā gnyis pa'am rā44ha/ phye lo 69047286 parameshurawarmanakhriganyis pa/ phyi lo 72847317 na:warman ngaganyis pa phyi lo 73147958 da:warmamā phyi lo 79648479 na:warmamā gsum pa/ phyi lo 8464869na:warmamā gsum pa la sras gsum byung ba ni/ nirlabatag dang / gaparwajita dang / tamapawarman gsum gyis phyi lo 869 nas 900 tsam bar du srid dbang bsgyur/ yang phan tshun ma mthun par zing 'khrug mang du byung nas mthar shrīparama'iyam gyi g.yul sar cola'i rgyal pos phyi lo brgya phrag dgu pa'i mjug rdzogs mtshams su pham
338 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/par byas pas paluwa'i rgyal srid nyams pa red/ rgyal po de tsho'i nang nas mahe༄wamaṇa dang po de byang phyogs kyi rgyal po harla dang / ḍakan gyi rgyal po 〉lākra'i rgyal po sprulamasin gnyis pa rnams dus mtshungs pa yin/'o na pamawa'i rgyal srid skabs 'dzin skyong byed tshul sogs ji 'dra yod dam zhi na/ rgyal po 'di tsho'i skabs brkos bris sna tshogs las 'dzin skyong gi skor shes thub/rgyal khab bam mnga' ris de 'dzin skyong gi cha nas sde khag mang du bgos yod cing /sa zhing gi khral ma zad yong khungs gzhan yang yod pa ni/ dngos zog sna tshogs bzo 'don gyi khral dang / sho gam bcas yin/ sa zhing gi tshad zhib gsal rgyas shing rgyas pa yod 'dug pa dang / grong gseb khag tu grong gseb kyi rang skyong tshogs 'du khag yod pa de tshos grong gseb kyi mi tsho'i gnas stangs skor las don byed cing / tshong dang tshong 'brel gyi bya ba gar ldan du yod/chos ni dbang phyug pa dang / khyab 'jug pa'i ring lugs de shin tu dar/ dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug pa'i lha khang gzi brjed can grangs med pa bzhengs/ mi mang nang sngar nas nang pa'i chos byed mkhan rnams ma gtogs paluwa'i rgyal po tshos nang chos la dad gus ma byas/ sngar kārawela'i skabs su nang chos zhin tu dar ba'i skabs rig byed kyi chos la nyams chag byung ba de slar gso byas pa yin zhes lo rgyus su gsal/sgyu rtsal dang / khang bzo dang / sku 'dra bzo rigs ni shin tu dar te/kāt+yā mahābalipuram sogs kyi lha khang ches gzi brjed dang ldan pa de 'dra 'phags yul byang phyogs su med pa lta bu red/ brkos bris dang / ldeb ris sogs la bltas na pa7lha'i rgyal rabs skabs sgru rtsal dang / gar dang / rol dbyangs dang / ri mo sogs la yar rgyas shin tu chen po byung bar gsal/
le'u dang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 339rig gzhung ngam/ gzhung lugs kyi cha nas patshawa'i dus rabs de rang bzhin pa'i skad dang / maskṛta'i skad dang / hāmil skad du snyan ngag gi bstan bcos mang po mdzad/ snyan ngag mkhan slob dpon dbyug pa can zhes pa de paluwa'i rgyal srid skabs kyai snyan ngag pa yin zhing rgyal po'i tshogs ra'i nang du'ang bzhugs pa yen/ kāt+yā la maskṛta dang gzhung lugs gzhan khag gi slob gnyer byed sa lte ba zhig yod/ patshawa'i rgyal po narasihawarman ste mi'i seng ge'i go cha zhes pa'i skabs rgya nag gi gnas skor ba :wenasā rgya gar la phebs skabs patshawa'i rgyal sa kāt+yā la yang phebs 'dug cing khong gis gsungs pa ltar na/ dpal nālan+d+ra'i mkhan po dharmapāl de yang n+d+ranī nas phebs pa yin zhes gsungs/de ltar cha gang thad nas paluwa'i rgyal rgyud kyi dus skabs lho phyogs su lo rgyus kyi cha nas gal che zhing dus rabs bzang po zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed srol yod/col 7gong ma'i rgyal srid/gong du bshad pa ltar spru lo brgya phrag dgu pa'i nang pamawa'i rgyal srid nyams nas cola'i rgyal srid byung ba yin zhing / de yang sngon sar+sham dus rabs skabs cola'i rgyal po khag lho phyogs su byung ba yin yang / de tsho'i rgyal srid nyams nas dus rabs mang po phyin/ 'on kyang rgyal rgyud ma nyams par yod pa la slar yang phyi lo 850 la rgyal srid rgyas pa'i 'do tshugs pa yin/ dus rabs mang po'i ring nyams dmas su phyin rjes phyi lo 850 tsam la cola'i rgyal po 'i4yulaya zhes pas badzor la rgyal khams chung chung zhig 'dzugs skrun byas pa de khong gi rjes 'dzin pa tshos rgyal khab stobs chen zhig tu rim bzhin bsgyur ba red/
340 'phags yul 9 gung ba brjod pa/patshawa'i rgyal po dang / pār+yan bar 'khrugs pa dang / paluwa'i rgyal po khag kyang phan tshun 'khrug rkyen sogs kyi go skabs de la bed spyod byas te binga.ālaya'i sras 'dit+ya dang po yis/ patshawa'i rgyal po tha ma aparwajita zer ba de phyi lo 880 tsam la 〈puramathigam gyi g.yul sar pham par byas/ 3 lo 893 la cola'i rgyal po 'dit+ya yis kāt+yā'i sa khul khag dbang du bsdus te paluwa dang / pār+ya'i rgyal srid rtsa med du btang / de'i dga' ston lta bur tardzar la g.yul gyi lha mo durga ste rdzong gi lha mo'i lha khang bzhengs/ rgyal po 'di ni dbang phyug gi rjes 'brangs mgo mkhregs po zhig yin/1 khri4ālag dang po/ phyi lo 84648712 564col dang po/ phyi lo 871ga9073 parān+taka dang po/ phyi lo 907wa9534 ga68dit+ya/ phyi lo 903ga9565 aritshoya/ phyi lo 956wa9576 parān+taka gnyis pa'am/ sun+daracol phyi lo 957rna9707 lnga/t+tamacol/ phyi lo 973wa9838 8jarā chen po/ 3 lo 984410146 rā4lnga dang po/ phyi lo 1012—104410 rā:spru gnyis pa/ phyi lo 1052—106411 spurarwadzen+d+ra/ phyi lo 10644107012 lnga:shājedra/ phyi lo 1070413 ku5tuṅgā dang po/ phyi lo 10704112014 khrikamacol/ phyo lo 112041135
le'udang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 34115 kuluhungaX gnyis pa/ 3 lo 11354115016 rādza: gnyis pa/ phyi lo 11504117317 drajarātra gnyis pa/ phyi lo 117341179 18 kulukakakakaka pa/ phyi lo 11784121619 8jarāng gsum pa/ phyi lo 12164124620 rwajedra gsum pa/ phyi lo 1246gi1279gong gi cola'i rgyal po tha ma rāyen+d+ra gsum pa'i skabs shāt+pan rgyal pos tadz+dzar la btsan 'dzul byas te cola'i rgyal po pham par ma zad/ heyasala'i rgyal rigs dang /kukatiya dang / 5yin gsum gyis phyogs thams cad nas 'thab rgol byas te cola'i 7gong ma'i stobs shugs shul med du bzos pa red/'o na cola'i 7gong ma tsho'i skabs kyi gnas stangs ji 'dra zhig yod dam zhe na/col 7gong ma'i rgyal srid 'dzin skyong de shin tu tshags tshud po dang 'jon po zhig yod nges/ rgyal po rang nyid sa gnas khag twā gzigs skor du yang yang phebs pa des 'dzin skyong la phan khyad chen po byung 'dugmnga' ris de mnga' sde khag tu bgos shing / mnga' sde rnams koṭam khag tu bdos pa dang / koṭam rnams kyang rdzong khag tu bgos/ khral gtso bo ni sa zhing gi khral yin zhing de ni dngul thog dang / dngos po gnyis thog nas bsdu len byed/gzhung gi 'gro gron gtong sa gal che ba khag ni rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i lhan tshogs dang / sa dmag dang mtsho dmag dang / zhi ba'i 'dzin skyong dang / de'i gzhung zhabs khag dang / bgrod lam dang / chu 'dren byed dang / chu mdzod sogs dang /yur ba dang / lha khang khag dang / chos kyi bsti gnas khag la sbyin pa'am yon
342 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/sogs su btang ba yin/col 7gong ma la drag po'i dpung sde chen po yod pa ni/ sa dmag dang / mtsho dmag bcas yin/ de'i nang glang chen dmag sde dang / rta dmag dang / rkang dmag bcas yod/ grong gseb khag tu rang skyong ljongs kyi lugs srol yar rgyas phyin pa de col 7gong ma'i rgyal srid 'dzin skyong nang lugs srol 'gran zla med pa zhig red/grong gseb kyi tshogs 'du dang / rdzong gi tshogs 'du sogs kyi 'thug mi de tsho tshul bzhin 'dems srol yod par ma zad las don tshags tshud byed kyi yod 'dugmnga' ris der hi:'i spyi tshogs ni rigs la gzhi byas te sgrig 'dzugs bzos yod cing / rigs phan tshun bar mi mthun pa'i 'khon rtsod yod kyang spyir btang mnyam 'brel gang zab yod par bshad/ sa zhing rnams sger gyis bzung ba dang / spyi thog nas bzung ba gnyis ka yod la/ sger 'dzin byas pa'i sa zhing rnams kyi bdag po ni zhing pa tsho yin la/ spyi thog gi sa'am spyi pa'i sa cha rnams ni gzhan la bog ma lta bur gtong bar byed/sngar paluwa'i rgyal po'i skabs dbang phyug pa dang / khyab 'jug pa dar bar byas pa de la da dung shugs che ru btang / de lta na yang rgyal ba pa dang / sangs rgyas pa'i bsti gnas 'ga' shas yod par bshad/shes rig gi cha nas col 7gong ma tshos draṇ+ḍaṇ+ḍayan zhes pa'i sngon dus lho khul 'di'i rtsa ba'i lugs srol bskyar gso byas/ rgyal po 'di tshos lha khang khyad du 'phags pa mang po bzhengs 'dug pa de tsho deng dus kyang sa khul 'dir ga sa ga la mthong rgyu yod/ ri mo 'bri tshul dang / sku 'dra bzo stangs dang / khang bzo'i lag rtsal tshang ma la cola'i lugs srol zhes skad grags chen po byed/ mdor na col 7gong ma'i
le'u dang po/ sngon dus 9byung rabs/ 343rgyal srid kyi dus rabs de lho phyogs sa khul 'dir dus rabs legs pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed srol yod/gong du bshad pa ltar pār+yan rgyal po sogs kyis cola'i rgyal khams bcom nas lho khul 'dir māt+pan rgyal po 'ga' shas kyis dbang bsgyur ba yin zhing / 5yin rgyal po 'di tsho yang sngon sasgam skabs kyi lho phyogs kyi rgyal po rigs stobs che ba gsum yod pa'i nang nas gcig yin yang / bar skabs der dus rabs mang por nus med du gyur kyang / rgyal rgyud ma brlags par yod pa gzhan 'og tu tshud pa de phyi lo 1190tsam la stobs shugs che ru phyin nas mthar phyi lo 1279 tsam la cola'i thog dmag 'khrug lam lhong dang ldan pa brgyabs te col pham par byas te rim bzhin lho khul 'dir dbang bsgyur gyis rgyal srid phye lo 1311 tsam bar du gnas/lho phyogs tamil gyi rgyal khams der bajalanagar gyi 7gong ma tshos phyi lo 1336nas 1680 bar dbang sgyur byas pa dang / rgyal rgyud der rgyal po mang po byung yang phye lo 1509 tsam nas thingaganagaram gyi rgyal rgyud kyi rgyal po kri4dewarāya zhes pa de stobs che shos dang / rgyal srid phun sum tshogs shos byung yod pa red/phyi lo brgya phrag bcu bzhi pa'i nang kha che tshos lho phyogs su btsan 'dzul thengs gsum tsam byas te mthar rim bzhin rgya gar byang phyogs ltar lho phyogs kyang kha che'i 'og tu gnas pa spyi mtshungs red/de ltar 'phags yul lho phyogs kyi byung rabs shin tu mdor bsdus pa zhig byung rabs shes 'dod can tshor ngo sprod kyi tshul du bris pa las/ rgyal rabs re re'i skor rgyas par bris na shin tu mang bas re zhig de tsam laḍa/ lho phyogs kyi byung rabs ngo sprod mdor bsdus bshad zin nas byang phyoḍa kyi byung rabs kyi 'phrog nas bshad par bya'o//
344 'phags yul gyigrang babarjod pa/rātra6ta'i dus rabs/byang phyogs su rgyal po hak+ṣawartan ste dga' ba 'phel grongs pa'i rjes su yul khams gcig gyur byed thub mkhan 9 rgyal po stobs chen ma byung bar rgyal phran chung chung mang po byung zhing / dus rabs de la byang phyogs su rlang5ta'i dus rabs zhis brjod pa yin/ phye lo brgya phrag bdun pa nas brgya phrag bcu gnyis pa tsam bar dus rabs ring po zhig la rā46ta tshos 'phags yul byang phyogs dang / byang nub khul du srid dbang bsgyur zhing / shes rig gi cha nas kyang de tsho gang mtshams stobs chen po byung 'dug rā46ta'i rgyal po tshos rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan pa mang po btsugs pa dang / 'ga' shas gang mtshams stobs chen po yang byung yod pa red/rā45ta'i dus rabs su kha ches yeshilā'i dbus khul dang / al+līkā'i cha shas 'ga' shas dang / nub gling yuropa khul gyi cha shas 'ga' shas su dbang shugs bskyed nas/ rgya gar la sgo brdung bzhin yod pa red/ rā46ta tshos de la gdong len mthar phyin byas te brgya phrag 'ga' shas ring rgya gar gyis so so'i shes rig dang /chos lugs la srung skyob byed thub pa byung 'dug 'on kyang mthar rā46ta rgyal po tsho las kha ches rgya gar byang phyogs kyi sa khul rnams blangs pa red/ de lta na'ang rā46ta rnams rtsa med du btang yod pa ma red/byung rabs kyi khungs/rā46ta zhes pa'i dpa' bo dang / g.yul las byed mkhan dang / so so'i shes rig ched rang srog blos gtong byed mkhan de tsho'i lo rgyus khag saskrota skad dang /sa gnas kyu skad rigs du ma'i nang dang / brkos bris dang / dong tse khag dang /
le'u dang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 345dngos rigs rnying shul khag du 'khod yod par ma zad/ sngon rabs dang / nang pa'i gzhung lugs dang / rgyal ba pa'i gzhung lugs 'ga' shas nang phyogs tsam bstan yod pa red/ snyan ngag mkhan bā&bhañtsa yos mdzad pa'i haru'i mdzad rnam dang /hubanasārla gi rgya gar lam yig tu yang rā46ta tsho'i skor zur tsam bshad yod pa red/rā45ta'i rgyal po tsho'i mdzad rnam mang po bris yod pa'i nang nas 2thiṅgārāngarwaso dang /sprulahaṇa'i rlangatar gi〉 zhes pa sogs ni byung rabs shes par phan thogs shin tu che /sujarātra dang / rlangasprun gyi yul skad du yang sa khul de tsho'i rā45ta'i lo rgyus dang /glu gzhag khag kyang byung rabs rtsad gcod byed par phan thogs che/ der ma zad phyi rgyal ba 'ga' shas kyis kyang rā46ta'i skor bris yod/ der ma zad rā46ta'i rgyal po tshos bzhengs pa'i lha khang khag dang / pho brang ngo mtshar ba khag las byung rabs dang /shes rig dang / lhag par de tsho'i skabs kyi lag rtsal shes rig phun sum tshogs pa ji yod shes thub/rāng6ta'i 'byung khungs/'o na rā46ta'i rgyal po de tsho'i 'byung khungs ga nas yin zhe na/ 'di ni dri ba shin tu dka' ba zhig yin te/ rtsod pa shin tu che bas da bar tshang mas cha 'jog 'os pa zhig mtha' gcig tu thag ma chod par gnas/ dus phyis bram ze tshos rā46ta tsho la che mthong shin tu chen po dang / bstod bsngags tshod med byas pa des kyang gnad don 'di la dka' rnyog mang du 'phel/ rā46ta kho rang tshos 'char can nyi ma'i rigs sam/ yang na zla ba'i rigs gang rung yin pa'i spobs pa bskyed de smra/ gang lags zer na rgya gar du rigs chen po bzhi'i nang nas rgyal rigs yin na/ nyi ma'i rigs
346 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/dang / zla ba'i rigs gang rung zhig yin dgos la/ rā46ta tshos rang nyid rgyal rigs yin par sgrub ched de gnyis gang rung zhig nas yin par 'dod pa yin nges/'on kyang de tsho'i 'byung khungs dang skyes yul la lo rgyus mkhan tsho'i bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang po yod pa dper na/ de tsho phyi rgyal nas yong bar 'dod pa dang / rgya gar gyi yul mi yin par 'dod pa dang / rgyal rigs gtsang ma yin par 'dod pa dang /me'i rigs yin par 'dod pa sogs yod/phyi rgyal nas yin par 'dod tshul/ mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyi bzhed tshul ni/rā46ta tsho ni phyi rgyal ba'i mi rigs shaka dang / hu9 dang / kuṣaṇa dang / gungar sogs 9 rgyud pa yin zhing / de dag rgya gar la gzhis chags nas rgya gar ba'i bud med tsho dang gnyen byas/ rim bzhin de tsho rgya gar ba'i spyi tshogs su thim pa red/ ces bshad de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gong gsal phye rgyal ba'i gzhis chags mkhan de tsho dang rā46ta bar 'dra mtshungs mang po yod pa dper na rta la mchod pa byed pa dang /rta mchog gi mchod sbyin dang / mtshon cha la mchod pa byed pa dang / bud med tshos chang rag la dga' ba sogs ni phyo rgyal ba de tsho dang thun mong gi khyad chos su mngon/spyir btang phyi rgyal ba rgya gar du gzhis chags nas rgyal por gyur te hiḥ'i chos khas len byas pa dzes so so rgyal po dga' byed dang / kriṣ+ṭha dang / nyi ma dang zla ba'i rigs rgyud yin par shod kyang byed kyi yod pa red/rgyal rigs gtsang ma yin pa'i 'dod tshul/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus mkhan si spi bid+dhā (0 6 61 77557) 2 yes ocwa (0 3 0358) sogs kyis rā45ta tsho'i 'byung khungs ni phyo rgyal ba min par de tsho ni ārlan gyi mi rigs gtsang ma dang / rgyal rigs gtsang ma yin zhes gsungs/ rā46ta tsho dang / shaka sogs phyi rgyal ba rnams bar
le'u dang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 347'dra mtshungs gang yang med de rta mchog gi mchod sbyin ni sngon dus mahā:rata'i dus rabs nas yod pa yin zhing / mtshon cha la mchod pa byed pa dang / bud med tsho chang rag gar po la dga' po byed pa'i gnas stangs 'di sngon dus kyi rgya gar ba'i dbang 'dzin rgyal rigs tsho'i nang yod pa zhig red ces gsungs/me yi rigs rgyud yin tshul/ 'on kyang 〈thibarāngarwaso zhes pa'i mdzad rnam gal chen po de'i rā46ta tsho'i thog ma'i 'byung khungs gsal bshad byas 'dug pa de gal che shos dang khungs btsan shos su mthong / de yang sngon drang srong parashurwam ste dga' byed dgra sta zhes pa des sa steng gi rgyal riḍa thams cad med par bzos skabs lngashiṣ+ṭha ste (gnas 'jog)zhes pa'i drang srong zhig gis rāngasdun gyi sa gnas monaṭa'abu la mchod sbyin zhig byas pa na/ mchod sbyin gyi me thabs nas dpa' bo bzhi thon pa de tsho ni rā46ta yi pha mes yin/ dpa' bo bzhi po de las rā46ta'i rigs rgyud chen po bzhi byung ba ni/ paramār dang / pratihār dang / :hān dang / sol: bcas bzhi yin/ deng dus kyang rā46ta tshos byung tshul 'di la yid ches byed cing de tsho me yi rigs yin par 'dod/ 'on kyang byung tshul 'di ni rtogs pas btags pa tsam dang / chos lugs kyi sgrung gtam la gzhi byas pa tsam zhig yin/des na byung rabs la mkhas pa mkhas dbang spi e simitha (27 6 8 byamakhucha)mchog gis gsungs don ltar rā46ta de tsho ni rigs phan tshun 'dres pa zhig yin zhing rā46ta zhes pa'i tshog gi don yang rigs gang yang rung ba zhig ston par mi byed par mi tshogs dang / cha shas/ sde tshan dang / g.yul gyi goms gshis sogs ston par byed/ rā46ta 'ga' shas ni shaka dang / hāṇa dang / gurajar sogs phyi rgyal tsho'i rgyud pa yin la/ 'ga' shas ni rgyal rigs kyi sde tshan nas yin/ de tsho thog mar
348 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/gcig gis gcig la ngo rgol byas kyang / rim bzhin dus tshod 'das par phan tshun 'dres pa red/ de tsho de'i skabs kyi gzhung gi gzhung zhabs pa sogs bskos yod pa red/ de ltar rigs sna tshogs pa zhig phan tshun gnyen 'brel gyis 'dres pa las rlang6ta byung ba yin par khas blangs na rigs pa dang mthun che ba yin/ gang ltar rā46ta tsho ni dpa' che zhing / g.yul gyi bya ba la dga' ba/ dgra bo dang 'dzing thub mkhan zhig yin par tshang mas ngos 'dzin byed/rā46ta'i rgyal khab/de tsho'i nang nas nyung shas gcig gis rgyal khams 'dzugs bskrun byas yod cing / 'ga' shas ni gang 'tshams stobs chen por gyur/ dper na pratihār dang /cahān dang / paramār dang / solaX dang / ca༄la rnams kyis so so'i rgyal khab btsugs thub pa byung /pratihār rgyal khams/ pratihār zhes pa'i rā46ta'i rigs de rā46ta'i rigs nang nas che shos yin la de ni grurajar zhes pa'i mi tshogs nas byung ba yin/ khong tsho thog mar gzhis chags sa ni rā4sdun dkyil gyi sa gnas jodapur yin zhing / de tshog phyo lo brgya phrag brgyad pa nas bcu gcig pa'i 'go bar rgyal srid bskyangs/ khong tsho rgyal po nugalhas zhes pa'i 'go khrid 'og pratihār rgyal rgyud de dbang shugs chen po chags/des melhar nas lhadzoca bar du rgyal khams rgya skyed byas/ des rgya gar nub phyogs de arab tsho las bskyabs yod cing / arab tsho'i 'og tu gnas pa'i mnga' khul mang po tshur blangs pa red/ rgyal po 'di rā6zhuṭa'i rgyal po las pham na yang / rgyal khams stobs ldan zhig shul du bzhag yod pa red/
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byungarabs/ 349de'i rjes su rgyal po gal che ba lnga༄rāng yin la des ku(ja'i sa khul rnams blangs pa dang / baṅgāl gyi rgyal po dharmapāl yang pham par byas/ der brten des rgya gar byang phyogs su cha shas rgya chen po la dbang bsgyur te stobs che shos byung bas/ 7gong ma'i rgyal khams btsugs pa yin/ zhes brjod/ de lta na yang rā4kāsa'i 6wa zhes pas pham par byas pa red/de'i rjes de'i bu nugabhañtsa gnyis pas rgyal khams slar gso bus/ des grujarātra'i byang phyogs khul dang / mālanywa dang / ༷t+pa dang / birū'i mnga' khul rnams la dbang bsgyur zhing / ku4ja de de'i rgyal sa bzos/pratihār rgyal po mahoralhoja'i skabs mnga' thang yag po byas te stobs shugs gcig gyur gyis baṅgāl gyi rgyal po dewashāl dang / rā6༷ṭa'i rgyal po rnams dang 'dzings/mnga' ris de byang pa(ba dang / lho ru sorāstu bar du rgya skyed mdzad/ de'i sras mnye〈pāl gyis yul mgadha'i cha shas 'ga' zhig dang / baṅgāl gyi cha shas mang po blangs/de nas rgyal po ma〉pāl zhes pa de baṅgāl gyi rgyal po dang / rā4kāsa'i rgyal po las pham nyes byung yang slar yang bskyar langs byed thub pa byung ba red/ phyi lo brgya phrag bcu pa'i dkyil du pratihār gyi mnga' ris de homyalag nas 'ilha ste ri bo 'bigs byed bar dang / bihār nas arab kyi rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du rgya skyed byas/ 'on kyang mgyi5la gyi rjes 'dzin pa tsho skyo po byung bas khong tsho'i dbang shugs rnams canadel rgyal po tshos bzung / sku drag mang pos so so'i rang dbang rang btsan gyi mnga' khul mang po bzos/pratihār gyi rgyal po tha ma rāḥpāl yin zhing / de kha che'i muhamad sharī las
350 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/pham zhing mthar canadel rgyal pos bsad pa red/14ja'i rgyal po gnyaḍaXla'i rgyal rgyud/ pratihār gyi stobs shugs nyams pa'i rjes su 'phags yul byang phyogs su zang nge zing nge mang po byung zhing / de 'dra'i gcig la gnyaḍasprul zhes pa'i rgyal rgyud de byung zhing / rgyal po ca4dewa ste zu ba'i lha ni rgyal rgyud de 'dzugs pa po yin/ des phyi lo 1090 tsam la 14ja la dbang bsgyur byas shing / chu mo gaṅgā'i mdus mdo la rgyal srid btsugs pa dang / baṅgāl gyi rgyal po bingagasen ste rnam rgyal sde yi btsan rgol la gdong len byas/ de'i rjes su gobin+danan byung zhing / des yul mgadha dang / mālalha'i lho rgyud la dbang bsgyur/ de'i sras jagacan+da lte rgyal ba'i zla ba yin la/ des rang gi mnga' ris shar phyogs su g.yu dang /lngarākhur+sā'i bar rgya skyed byas/ rgyal po 'di dit+ta'i rgyal po prit+nagrir+sājacahān dang 'brel lam legs po rang med de cahān gyis rgyal ba'i zla ba'i sras mo btsan khrid kyis de dang mdun thabs byas pa red/ der brten dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i skabs kha che murnyasmadakarī yis cahān pham par byas pa'i dus su rgyal ba'i zla bas so so'i rigs mthun yin pa'i cha nas rogs ram byed dgos rgyu las ma byas/ 'on kyang can+daltar zhes pa'i sa gnas su rgyal ba'i zla ba rang nyid kyang phyi lo 1194 gori las pham pa red/ajamer dang dir+sā'i rgyal po :hān/rā46ta rgyal po'i riḍa cohān rigs kyis samalhar dang angamer la phyi lo 700tsam nas rgyal srid bskyangs/ rgyal rgyud 'di'i nang nas rgyal po che shos gcig ni bigraharlang zhes pa de yin la des phyo lo brgya phrag bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil tsam la rgyal srid bskyangs/ des rang gi mnga' ris rgya skyed chen po byas te/ phal cher 'dis
le'udang po/ sngon dus spre byung rabs/ 351tomar zhes pa'i rang6ta'i rgyal po gzhan zhig gi lag nas disnya blangs/ rgyal po 'di ni 'bri rtsom la mkhas shing shes yon srung skyong byed pa po zhig kyang red/de'i rjes su khong gi tsha bo 1thi'idraja zhes pa shin tu skad grags chen po des rgyal sa bzung zhing / de ni rgya gar gyi lo rgyus nang shin tu gal gnad chen po zhig smi/de dus kha ches rgya gar la dbang sgyur byed rgyu'i thabs shes byed bzhin yod pa red/〈thi'ir+sāja la khong gi khrim mches rgyal po mang pos dga' po med tshod dang / lhag par gong gsal ku(ja'i rgyal po rgyal ba'i zla ba dang ma mthun/ rgyal ba'i zla ba'i sras mo sayuthi zer ba de 1thi'i yis khrid nas btsun mor bzhes/ der ma zad 〈thika yis carjel rgyal po dang / paramar bcas kyang pham par byas/ spru lo 1191 lor tanāyin zhes pa'i dmag sar kha che ba munyasmad sharī zer ba de pham par mdzad/ 'on kyang lo gcig rjes muhamad sharī slar yang yongs nas sa gnas de ga rang du dmag thengs gnyis pa'i skabs munyasmad sharī yis 2thibarlang pham par byas shing bsad pa red/ajamer gyi grong khyer bcom nas me mang rnams sdeb gsod btang ba'am yang na bran g.yog tu bsgyur/ 2thikakaka yi rgyal po'i tshogs ra'i snyan ngag pa can+dabaraXyi zer ba des rgyal po 'di'i mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa 2thiṅgārā4rngaso zhes pa de brtsams 'dug pa'i nang rgyal po 'di'i mdzad pa tshang ma gsal 'khod 'dug cing lo rgyus dang byung rabs la yang phan thogs po yod/bu༄lakhaṇ+ḍa'i rgyal po carjel/ cadral rgyal rgyud de phye lo brgya phrag dgu pa'i nang rgyal po gshowasman ste grags pa'i go cha zhes pas btsugs/ des kāliñdzar khul dbang du bsgrur nas madhabā la rgyal sa bzos/ rgyal po des kha6rāto zhes pa'i lha khang khyad mtshar po de dag bzhengs/ rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po gal che ba gzhan dag ni/
352 'phags yul gyi byung babarjodapa/rgyal po 66 dang / ༷dhikarmā gnyis yin zhing / dhar+shas kha che'i rgyal po mahamud gajanaspru la gdong len ched hiḥ'i rgyal po gzhan khag dang mnyam 'brel gyis thabs shes byas/ 'on kyang de tsho apha nistun gyi sa mtshams su kha che las pham nyes su gyur pa red/ ༷rtelharmā gyis ceda'i rgyal po kuṇ+ḍa pham par byas shing / de nyid shes yon la dga' po yod 'dug carje rgyal po tha ma ni perngamal yin la des spru lo 1203 la rtsosprin rgyal po 2theblo la mgo bsgur/ de nas di'i'i kha che'i rgyal po ku6buXn ebaka la mgo bsgur ba red/ kha che'i rgyal po tsho'i skor rgyas par 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur/myalalnga'i rgyal po paramār/ pratihār rgyal khams zhig 'thor gyur pa'i shul du paramār rgyal rigs kyai mnga' thang rgyas shing rgyal po ubargyu zhes pa de rgyal rgyud 'di 'dzugs pa po yin/ rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po che shos dang po ni mutsho zhes pa de yin zhing / des ḍamin rgyal po r+sākhukya dang dmag 'khrug thengs mang po brgyabs shing mthar g.yul sar bsad pa red/ rgyal po de ni snyan ngag la mkhas shing snyan ngag la srung skyob byed mkhan zhig yin par grags/ paramār rgyal rgyud nang gal che shos rgyal po mja yin la/ de ni dpa' bo chen po zhig yin pas gungarātra dang / ḍamin dang /cedi'i rgyal po tsho las rgyal kha chen po thob/ pho brang dang mkhar sogs kyang brtsegs shing / khong ni mkhas pa chen po zhig yin pa dang saskrota skad kyi mtho rim slob grwa zhig btsugs te mtsho chen po zhig kyang bzos/ 'on kyang gujarātra dang / cedi'i rgyal po gnyis zung 'brel gyis rgyal po 'di'i thog rgol 'dzing byas te pham par byas/ phal cher rgyal po 'di ni paramār rgyal po rang dbang can tha ma de yin tshod/ mthar mālanywa je disnya'i kha che'i rgyal po'i 'og tu phyin pa red/solam+bhi'i rgyal rgyud/ solazla'i rgyal rgyud kyis anahiligapur la phyi lo
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyi byung rabs/ 353༷zhu shāshā /rdo sdu/ snang tsa ma na( shā lharā (sgyu ༵ /dbangargya padzo shā ༷parāng zhesna'i pa ༵ shārnyi tsho( 'jig byed yin la des kha che'i jag rgyal mahanywan ganganasmi zhes pas somanātha'i lha khang gtor bcom byed pa bkag 'gog byed ma thub pa red/ 'on kyang phyis su jagasiha zhes pas lha khang de slar gsar bzhengs byas pa red/ jagasiha zhes pa des mālanywa la dbang 'dzin byas/ rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po gzhan khag ni kumār5la te gzhon nu skyong yin zhing des di'i'i rgyal po :hān dang / paramār sogs nye skor rgyal po gzhan khag dang dmag 'khrug byas pa red/ mūlarādza gnyis pa ni gal che smi des btsan 'dzul mkhan kha che'i rgyal po munyasmad sharī pham par byas pa red/ de lta na yang mthar kha che'i rgyal po a.ā.uXn khol) yi dmag dpon gyis sdungarwata la dbang sgyur byas pa red/rā46ta'i rgyal phran tsho'i skor mdor bsdus de ltar yin zhing / de tsho'i skabs kyi gnas stangs phyogs tsam zhig 'chad par bya'o//rā46ta'i spyod tshul/rā46ta zhes pa'i tshog 'di'i don ni rgyal po'i sras sam/ rgyal po'i bu'am yang na rgyal po'i rigs zhes pa yin la/ tshog 'dis dpa' mdzangs dang gtong phod ldan pa'i mi tshogs gcig ston par byed pa yin/ rā46ta tsho ni hiḥ'i chos lugs pa yin pas de tsho'i gshis rig ni rtsa ba'i hiḥ'i gshis rig gi cha shas yin/ de lta na yang de tsho'i sger gyi spyod tshul 'ga' shas ni zur du yod la/ chos kyi yid ches dang /spyi tshogs kyi spyod tshul dang / lugs srol dang / goms gshis dang / lag rtsal gyi rnam pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yang sku(da pa yin/
354 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/rā46ta tsho ni rgyal po'i rigs yin la kho rang tshos rang nyid rigs rgyud mthon po yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / dmigs bsal dbang shugs dang thob dbang yod par ngos 'dzin byed/ khong tshor thob dbang de tsho rgyun gnas yong thabs su gzhan la phrag dog chen po yod pa red/ khong tshor mi drag yin pa'i spobs pa chen po zhig yod cing / de lta na yang khong tsho la yon tan khyad par can mang bo yod de/dper na rtag tu 'jig pa med cing dgra 'thab la mkhas pa dpa' mdzangs che ba dang /so so'i che mthong dang srung skyob ched rtag par 'dzing chog chog byed kyi yod pa red/ de tsho ni rang gi dbu khrid rnams la gzhung sems che zhing rang yul dang rang gi dbu khrid tsho'i ched du rang srog blos gtong byed kyi yod pa red/ spyir btang g.yul las la dga' po yin yang de tsho sems ngan pa dang snying rje med pa ma yin par ya rabs bsam bzang dang / snying rje can yin pas/ dgra bo rnams kyis mdo bsgur ba'am/skyabs zhus na de dag la bsam pa bzang pos byams skyong byed kyi yod pa red/ dbul po dang dgos mkho can rnams la rogs ram byams skyong chen po byed/ de tshos bud med tsho la gus bkur chen po byed cing bud med tsho'i che mthong srung skyob ched srog blos gtong byed kyi yod pa dang / bden pa la dga' po byed kyi yod pa red/go6ta'i srid gzhung /'phags yul byang phyogs su skabs der rā46ta'i rgyal khab mang po yod pa de tsho ni rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal khab yin pa dang / rgyal khab klu gtso bo'am dbu khrid ni rigs rgyud can gyi rgyal po yin zhing / de ni sku drag sger dbang ba zhig red/sbyor btang srid gzhung khag pha shul bus 'dzin byed srol yod/ spre mos yod pa'i
le'u dang po/ sngon dus spre byung rabs/ 355tshogs 'du med cing / 'on kyang rgyal po la phyag rogs zhu mkhan blon po khag yod pa de tsho'i nang nas sred blon ni gal che shos yin/ btsun mo dang / rgyud 'dzin gzhan rnams dang / rgyal po'i mchod gnas pa dang / rtsis pa bcas kyang gal chen por ñtsu/ rgyun gnas kyi gzhung zhabs pa khag kyang yod la/ spyir btang 'dzin skyong skor dang khral bsdu ba dang / khrims dang / drag po'i 'dzin skyong dang / zhi bde dang /khrims srol rgyun gnas byed rgyu sogs ni gzhung gi las don lte ba yin/ 'dzin skyong stabs bde ba'i ched rgyal khab de maṇ+ḍal zhes zhing chen lta bu mang por bgos yod cing /de'i 'og biṣaya ste rdzong lta bu dang / de nas grong gseb khag tu bgos/ grong gseb khag gi rtsod pa 'dum ched grong gseb kyi rgan pa'am grong gseb kyi dpon po yod/rā46ta'i srid gzhung de sa bdag sger dbang ring lugs kyi rnam pa can zhig yin zhing / sku drag tsho la rgyal po las gzhis ka chen po khag thob yod pa red/ sku drag de tsho mang che ba rā46ta de dang de'i rigs rgyud gcig pa yin/ sku drag de tsho ni rgyal po la sha zhen che zhing / dmag mi'i rogs ram zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i srol 'dzin gyi yod pa red der ma zad de tshos rgyal po la dpal 'byor gyi zhabs 'degs kyang zhu gi yod pa red/ rgyal khab 9 stobs shugs dang / bde srung ni gzhis khag gi bdag po sku drag tsho la rag lus pa red/ 'on kyang sku drag de tsho nang phan tshun 'thab 'dzing yang yang byed kyi yod pas thun mong gi dmigs yul gcig gi don du sred don gyi nus pa bed spyod byed rgyu ni khag po yod pa red/rā46ta'i dmag mi ni sgu drag sger pa de tsho nas yong dgos shing / dbus gzhung gi dmag mi ni nyung nyung las med/ glang chen dmag sde dang / rkang dmag ni dmag mi'i cha sha sa gal che shos yin/ dmag 'khrug skabs rgyal po rang nyid kyis
356 'phags yul9 byung ba brjod pa/dbung dmag gi 'do khrid byed cing / gal te rgyal po'i sku srog la nyes skyon byung na dmag mi rnams 'thor ba'i brda ru 'dzin/ 'dzin skyong ni drang zhing tshags su tshud pa yod kyang sku drag sger dbang ring lugs yin pa dang / rgyal po'i sger gyi gzi brjed nus pa 'ba' zhig la rag lus pa de ni rā46ta'i gzhung gi skyon che shos red/spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'am mi ñtsha/346ta'i skabs kyi spyi tshogs de ni rigs kyi lugs srol la gzhi byas pa zhig yin zhing / bram ze'i regs dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u'i rigs dang /gdol pa'i rigs bzhi ste rtsa ba'i rigs bzhi'i thog yan lag gi rigs mang po yod/bram ze'i rigs ni spyi tshogs nang mtho shos dang / de la dus bkur che shog byed/de tshos mchod sbyin byed cing / rā46ta'i blon po dang / gros 'debs mkhan dang /dge rgan gyi las don bcas byed/ rā45ta'i dbang 'dzin rgyal po rnams dang /dmag mi rnams ni rgyal rigs yin zhing / rje'u rigs rnams ni tshong pa dang /dngul gtong mkhan yin/ dmangs rigs ni zhing pa rnams dang / lag shes pa rnams sogs yin zhing / de'i skabs reg tu mi rung ba'i gral rim yang yod pa de tsho ni grong dang grong gseb kyi phyo rol du sdod par byed/ 'tsho ba la gzhir byas pa'i gral rim gsar pa khag mang po byung ba dper na shing bzo ba dang / mgar ba rnams dang /tha ga pa rnams dang / nya pa sogs yin/ yang snyan ngag pa'i gral rim zhig kyang yod cing / rā45ta'i rgyal po tshang ma la snyan ngag pa re yod/ snyan ngag pa des 'das pa'i rgyal po tsho'i dpa' mdzangs can gyi mdzad rjes rnams skyor te bshad pa byed cing / de ni rgyal po de dang de'i mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yig thog tu ma 'khod pa rnams ji
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 357bzhin srung skyob byed mkhan yin pas de la gus bkur chen po byed srol yod/ thog mar rigs kyi lugs srol de mkhregs po rang med tshod/ 'on kyang rim bzhin dam du phyin pa dang / rā45ta'i rgyal srid zhig 'thor du 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen gcig 'di yin par sems/bud med tsho'i gnas stangs/ rā46ta tshos kho rang tsho'i bud med rigs la brtse ba dang / gus bkur chen po byas 'dug de'i skabs bud med tsho la slob sbyong yag po sprad pa dang / 'ga' shas ni mkhas pa chen po yang gyur yod 'dug pa dper na gawa: sulngarā dang / esdungakhya dang / masulu dang / pamishrī sogs ni bud med mkhas pa grags can khag yin/ bud med 'ga' shas ni dpa' mo dgra 'thab la mkhas pa dang / 'dzin skyong la mkhas pa yang byung 'dug de skabs bud med tsho'i gdong pa 'gib pa'i lugs srol de med par ma zad so so'i khyo ga 'dems pa la rang dbang cha tshang yod/ sugawar zhes pa so so'i zla bo so sos 'dems pa'i sngar gyi lugs srol de rgyun gnas su yod/ rā46ta'i bud med tsho sbyin pa gtong ba la dga' po yod cing / so so'i khyo ga la gzhung zhen ston ched yug sa ma tsho khyo shi ba'i dur mer mchongs pa dang / yang na rang srog 'dor bar byed/ rā45ta'i bud med tsho rang gi che mthong srung skyob ched rang srog kyang gtong chog chog ngang du sdod pa yin/ phye rol gyi dgra bo'i lag par phyin nas mi gtsang bar 'gyur ba las skyob ched bud med mang po sdeb la me la mchongs par byed pa de la dzohār zer/ de lta na yang rāng6ta'i bud med tsho'i gnas stangs de rim bzhin sdug tu phyin nas dus phyis su byis pa'i chang bza' rgyag pa dang / bu mo yin pa'i byis pa chung dus nas gsod pa sogs kyi lugs srol dar 'dug rā46ta'i spyi tshogs su dus ston shin tu mang po yod cing gral rim mtho ba
358 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/tshos chang rag ha cang mang po 'thung bar byed/dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs/ rāng6ta tsho'i 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gal che shos ni so nam yin la de tshos zhing chu 'dren pa'i bya ba khag dang / chu mdzod dang /yur ba dang / khron pa sogs bzo bar byed/ gzhung nas so nam pa tsho la rogs ram rgya chen po byed/ tshong dang tshong 'brel gyi las don rgya chen po byed/ mdor bsdus na mi rnams dpal 'byor gyi cha nas phun sum tshogs pa yod/chos kyi gnas stangs/ rā46ta tsho'i chos ni tshang mas dga' shos byed sa'i chos ni hiḥ'i tshos yin zhing / dbang phyug dang / khyab 'jug dang / lha mo la mchod pa ni rgya cher dar/ dus skabs der 'phags yul lho phyogs su shaṅkar dang /rāpānu4 sogs hiḥ rig byed chos la legs bcos byed mkhan mang du byung / 'on kyang rigs phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing mang ba'i rkyen gyis phyi rol kha che'i chos dar rgyas su gyur/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ni shin tu rgyud pa'i skabs yin pas nyag phra'i ngang du gyur/rgyal ba pa'i chos ni baṅgāl gyi sa khul 'ga' shas la dar/ skabs 'di'i khyad chos che shos ni rgyal po so so'i sger gyi lha la dad pa byas pa des lha khang shin tu mdzes po khag bzhengs pa red/gzhung lugs/ rā45ta'i rgyal po mang che ba sgyu rtsal dang gzhung lugs la dwangs 'dod che zhing / 'ga' shas ni mkhas pa chen po yang yin tshod/ dper na munaja'i rgyal po dang / rwanāmaja ni 'bri rtsom la mkhas pa yin 'dug cing / rā64ja zhes pa des so nam gyi skor dang / gza' skar 9 skor dang / gso ba rig pa dang /mdzes rtsal dang / khang bzo'i rig pa sogs kyi skor bstan bcos brtsams yod pa red/ rā45ta'i sre da dbang skabs mkhas pa grags che ba mang po byung zhing de tshos
le'u dang po/ sngon dus 9 byung rabs/ 359maskṛta skad dang / bhañdzi'i skad nang bstan bcos khag mang po brtsams yod 'dugzlos gar gyi bstan bcos dang / mtshan nyid kyi skor sogs mang po bris yod 'dug cing / snyan ngag pa casprubaranāyi zer bas 〈thi1rā4r+sāso zhes pa de brtsams/ rgyal po dga' byed kyi rtogs brjod phyi ma zhes pa zhig dang / rgyal ba pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma brtag pa sogs bstan bcos mang po byung 'dug lo rgyus mkhan 'ga' shas kyis dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas tshad ma rigs thig kyang rā46ta'i dus skabs su mdzad pa yin zer ba de bden pa yin min dpyad dgos te/ dpal chos a+yau grags pa ni de'i sngon du byon pa yin par snang ngo / /skabs der grujarātra'i skad dang / marlagā'i skad dang / baṅgāl gyi skad sogs la gar rgyas chen po phyin yod 'duglag rtsal lam sgyu rtsal/ rā46ta'i rgyal po rnams ni khang bzang ngam pho brang sogs brtsegs pa la snyan grags che ste de tshos pho brang dang / lha khang bzhengs par rgyu nor phangs med btang 'dug khang bzo'i lag rtsal shin tu legs pa'i dpe mtshon mang po deng dus kyang mthong rgyu yod/ de tsho'i khang bzo'i rig rtsal la rnam pa mi 'dra ba gnyis mthong rgyu yod pa gcig ni rgya gar byang phyogs su lcog mkhar tshang ma gyen du thad kur mu mthud gnam du bslangs yod pa dper na snubarjeshwar la yod pa'i lir+sharāng ste rtags kyi lha khang zhes pa dang / udagapur gyi dbang phyug gi lha khang dang /ma65desha'i kha6rāto'i lha khang khag lta bu yin/ gnyis pa ni 〈khukya'i lugs srol de lcog mkhar rnams dum bu mang por btang ba'am rim pa mang por brtsegs yod/ dper na jon+tapār gyi nye 'gram yorig zer sar hi( dang rgyal ba pa'i lha khang mang po yod pa rnams las shes nus/ der ma zad mākhaṇ+ḍa.āḥ la yod pa'i rgyal ba pa'i lha khang kāmarlub dkar po'i tshom chen dang / thog kha zlum po bcas ha cang ya mtshan pa yod/ der ma
360 'phags yul 'a byung babarjod pa/zad rāngasprun gyi sa gnas citoragar dang / ra9thalhar dang / ṇ+ḍasbralagaṭa sogs gzi brjed che ba'i mkhar rdzong btsan po rnams dang / yul dbus ma65desha la man1 dang / gu yar dang / gsiragaṭa la yang mkhar rdzong btsan po khyad du 'phags pa mang po yod/ yang sgalegar gyi mānasiha pho brang dang / udayi5ra gyi mtsho yi pho brang bcas ni shin tu mdzes pa'i khang bzang gi dper 'os pa yin/rā46ta tsho ni ri mo'i lag rtsal la yang dga' po yod pas ri mo'i lag rtsal la gar rgyas chen po btang ba dang / de bzhin gar dang rol dbyangs gnyis la yang dang zhen chen po yod 'dug byang phyogs su brgya phrag 'ga' shas ring rgyal srid 'dzin thub mkhan rā46ta'i rgyal po tshos dpa' mdzangs stobs shugs gcig pus ma yin par sgyu rtsal rig gzhung la yar rgyas btang nas hoḥ'i shes rig gi rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs pa yin zhes rgya gar gyi byung rabs pa tshos bshad/ rgyal po 'di tsho sus kyang nang pa'i chos la zhabs tog byas pa'i lo rgyus ma mthong / rā46ta'i rgyal po tshos nyirdu'i chos dang / rig gzhung mi nyams gong 'phel du btang bar ma zad/ kha che'i dbang shugs las skyob thabs mu mthud rgyun ring byas pa red/ de lta na yang chos lugs mgo mkhregs can dang / dmag shugs che ba'i kha che las de tsho phag pa red/ rgyal po de tsho la gtso bor chig sgril med pa dang / rigs rus dbye 'byed la gzhi byas pa'i spyi tshogs kyi lugs srol ngan pa la brten nas de ltar byung ba red/de ltar rā46ta'i rgyal po tshos 'phags yul byang phyogs su dbang 'dzin byas tshul dang de tsho'i skabs gyi gnas stangs shin tu bsdus pa zhig bshad zin la/ da ni spyir btang shes dgos pa'i gnas stangs spyi mtshungs 'ga' shas shig 'bri bar bya ba gal che bar mthong /
le'u dang po/ sngon dus spre byung rabs/ 361rgya gar dang / rgya gar gyi phyi rol yul khag gi 'brel lam/phye lo brgya phrag bdun pa'i bar lho shar yeshilā'i yul khag dang mnyam rgya gar gyi 'brel lam gang 'tshams byung 'dug pa de tsho ni rgya gar gyi tshong pa khag gis rang rang gi dngos zog 'khyer nas lho shar yeshilā'i gling phran khag tu phyin nas yul de rnams nas dngos zog tshur 'khyer yong ba bcas las byung ba zhig yin zhing / tshong pa de tsho phyug por gyur nas 'ga' zhig gling phran de rnams kyi mtsho 'gram gru kha rnams la gzhis chaṇa shing / 'ga' shas gyis sa khul de tsho'i bud med tsho dang gnyen sgrig byas/ der brten sa khul de tshor rgya gar gyi lugs srol yang rim bzhin dar/ lho shar yeshilā'i yul mi tshos rgya gar gyi shes rig dang goms srol 'ga' shas dang len byas shing / grong khyer khag dang / mi drag tsho'i khyim du rgya gar gyi lugs srol mang ba dar zhing / grong gseb khag tu so so'i sngar srol bzung / rgya gar gyi tshong pa de tsho ni rgya gar gyi sa gnas sna tshogs dper na tamil(zhu dang / ārmās dang / bsgrul dang / sorā6 sogs las yong ba yin la/ de tshog so so'i mnyam du sa khul so so'i lugs srol goms gshis mnyam du khyer ba red/de yang thog mar rgya gar gyi 'brel lam de barmā dang / malāX dang /dkroṇ+ḍalā dang julha ste 'bru yi gling dang / gser gling sogs dang mnyam du byung / yul de tsho'i nang du rgya gar gyi lha khang rnams ltar lha khang gzi brjod dang ldan pa khag bzhings srol byung / de dang mnyam rgya gar gyi lugs srol sna tshogs byung ba dang / mchod gnas pa dang / rgyal po'i nang mi tshos saskrota skad la slob sbyong byas/ rgyal po dga' byed kyi rtogs brjod dang / mahā:rata'i lo rgyus sogs kyang dar/chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab spel byed mkhan chos kyi pho
362 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/nya khag lho phyogs dziha'i gling sogs dang / nub phyogs su 〈rān tshun btang gnang ba des rgya gar gyi chos dang shes rig phyi logs su dar khyab chen po byung / lho shar yeshilā'i yul khag tu nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de kun gyis dga' mos byas/ de ltar barmā dang / :i.iṇ+ḍa sogs tshang mas sangs rgyas kyu chos dang du blangs nas phal cher nang par gyur/ der ma zad rgya nag dang / nyi tong dang / koritsā bcas la yang sangs rgyas kyi chos shin tu dar/ yishu'i 'das lo brgya phrag bdun pa'i rjes rgya gar nas bod du yang sangs rgyas kyi chos dar ba bcas gling chen yeshilā yongs rdzogs su sangs rgyas kyi chos dar bas yul de tsho tshang mas rgya gar la 'phags pa'i yul de shin tu rtsa cher 'dzin zhing yul de tsho dang mnyam rgya gar gyi 'brel lam zab tu phyin/ yul de tsho'i lha khang gi rnam pa dang / sku brnyan bzhengs tshul gyi lag rtsal rnams rgya gar dang 'dra po yod/ de lta na yang yul so so'i khyad chos mi 'dra ba khag kyang gsal po yod/de ltar tshong pa rnams dang / chos spel mkhan rnams yeshilā'i yul khag tu bslebs shing / rgya nag sogs yul khag mang po dang mnyam chos spel mkhan dang /rgyal po'i pho nya phan tshun gtong res byas/ dus skabs der yeshilā'i sa khul tshang mar sangs rgyas kyi chos stobs shin tu chen por gyur te mthar ri bo gangs can brgal te bod du'ang rgya gar gyi shes rig dar rgyas su gyur/ de ltar tshong las sogs kyi sgo nas yul mang po dang mnyam du rgya gar gyi 'brel lam byung ba dang / rgya nag dang nub yeshilā'i bar du tshong lam zhig dbus oshilā brgyud phyes pa de la sngon dus kyi gos chen gyi lam zhes 'bod srol byung ste de skabs tshong lam de'i brgyud gos chen gyi tshong las gtso bo byed kyi yod pa red/ tshong las de la rgya gar ba'i tshong pa tshos 'dran gyi nub phyogs dang / arabiX dang / mis bcas kyi khrom ra la tshong las byas/ der ma
le'u dang po/ sngon dus kyu byung rabs/ 363zad de tsho agrika'i shar khul mtsho 'gram khul gyi grong khyer khag tu'ang tshong zog khyer nas 'gro bar byed/ de 'dra gcig la yeshilā'i nang 'gyur ba gsar pa zhig bslebs pa red/kha che'i chos/phyi lo brgya phrag bdun pa'i nang yeshilā dang / al+līkā'i nang myur mgyogs can gyi stobs shugs gsar pa zhig la gdong len byed dgos pa byung ba de ni thog mar arabiX la byung ba dang / de nas 'dzam gling 'di'i cha shas mang por khyab pa red/stobs shugs de ni kha che'i ring lugs kyi stobs shugs red/ kha che'i chos dar khyab byung ba las rgya gar la yang do phogs chen po byung zhing / rgya gar la kha che'i chos de thog mar arab kyi mi tsho las dar ba red/kha che'i ston pa sbrang ca'i blo gros/ yishu'i dus rabs drug pa'i mtha' mjug tu ara'iX'i yul du byis pa zhig skyes pa des rjes su aratraX tsam ma zad yeshig dang aswākā'i cha shas mang po'i lo rgyus gnas tshul bsgyur ba lta bu'i 'pho 'gyur btang ba red/ byis pa de'i ming muhamad yin la de nyid kha che'i chos kyi gzhi 'ding mkhan yin/ mutasmad yo byis pa'i gnas skabs de sdug bsngal chen po'i ngang gnas dgos byung zhing / kho ma skyes gong pha shi ba dang / chung dus skabs a ma yang shi bas/ kho rang gi a khus gso skyong byas pa red/ munyasmad zhes pa de legs sbyar skad kyi masnumati zhes pa de zur chags pa yin pa lta bu dang / de ltar yin na sbrang rtsi'i blo gros zhes pa de'i don yin dgos te dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od sogs su sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kla klo'i ston pa yin pa dang / kla klo'i chos lugs skor mang po gsungs
364 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjodapa/'dug pa de dag deng dus kyi kha che'i chos 'di 'khrul med yin 'dug pas/ kha che'i chos la kla klo'i chos dang / ston pa munyasmad la sbrang rtsi'i blo gros zhes bya ba yin/ston pa zhes pa'i go don nor mi rung ste/ rang re sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa ni rang nyid gang nas gshegs pa'i thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam de gdul bya gzhan la dzi lta ba bzhin ston par mdzad pa yin la/ 3 rol pa'i drang srong rnams ni thos bsam byas te bsam gtan sogs sgrub/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ci rig pa thob nas rig byed sogs kyi lta grub gzhan la ston par byed/ 'on kyang kha che'i ston pa ni de ltar min par dkon mchog gi bka' de 'gro ba mi rigs la skyel mkhan gyi pho nya yin pa las kho rang gis rang stobs kyis gang yang ston pa min zhes kho rang tshos 'dod/ der brten kha che kho rang tshos sbrang rtsi'i blo gros la tragapar zhes brjod pa de'i don pho nya zhes pa de yin/ de bzhin yishu tshos māshumar+sāgā de yang dkon mchog gi sras yin zhing / dkon mchog gi phrin skyel mkhan yin zhes 'dod/ de ltar min par khong rang nyid dkon mchog yin pa'am rang stobs kyis gdam ngag ston par mi 'dod/ kha che dang yishu gnyis kus dkon mchog ces pa de 'jig rten 'di'i byed pa po yin zhing gcig 5 yin par 'dod/ 'di dag gi skor mang du bshad rgyu yod kyang skabs ma yin pas 'god par mi bya'o//sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyi dus skabs de araba.ā'i yul de tshong gi sa gnas lte ba zhig yin pa dang / sa thog dang mtsho thog gnyis ka nas tshong zog mang po bslebs kyi yod pa red/ yul de'i grong khyer gtso che ba gnyis ni rma krā dang / mdīnā gnyis yin la der tshong pa phyug po khag sdod pa yin/ arabigā'i dpal 'byor de grong khyer de gnyis su gcig tu 'dus shing / de gnyis las gzhan pa'i bye thang khul gnas mkhan
le'u dang po/ sngonadus m+pi byung rabs/ 365mi mang tsho dbul po dang / mi tsho'i gnas stangs skyo po yod 'dug tshong pa phyug po tsho la rnga mong gi khyu mang po yod cing / sa gnas gcig nas gcig tu tshong zog dbor 'dren ched rnga mong la bed spyod byed/ rnga mong gi khyu de 'dra yod mkhan zhig gi sar sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis las rtsol byas te rang gi grod pa 'gengs par byed kyi yod pa red/bye thang la 'grul bzhud ring po byed dgos kyi yod stabs kho la bsam blo mang po gtong ba'i do skabs byung ba red/ srid don gyi thad nas byas na arab kyi mi tsho mi tshogs sde tshan du mar bgos yod pa las gcig gyur med pa dang / de tsho phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing byed kyi yod pa red/ sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis so so'i spyi tshogs nang gi mi 3 dang /chos kyi yid ches rnams 9 skor bsam blo rgya cher btang ba na/ kho'i bsam par gal te mi tshogs sde tshan 'di tsho gcig gyur du phyin pa yin na/ phan tshun/ 'khrug 'dzing dor nas dpal 'byor yar ldan dang / stobs chen zhig tu 'gyur ba gdon mi za zhes bsam pa red/chos lugs gsar pa/ sbrang rtsi'i blo gros de nyid de'i skabs kyi chos kyi yid ches rnams la blo 'dod khengs pa ma byung / gang lags zer na de dus garab kyi mi tshos lha mang po la mchod pa byed cing / rdo sgu sogs mang po la mchod pa byed srol yod pa red/ de skabs gyi arab kyi chos lugs de la ga re zer gyi yod med dang / ga nas byung ba yin min zhib gsal kho bos ma shes la dpyad pa bya rgyu lags/ sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis dkon mchog ni gcig rang yin pas rdo sogs gzhan la mchod pa dang /lha dang lha mo mang po la mchod pa don med yin par bsam/ dkon mchog gcig nyid yin pa 'di ni yishu dang / gnyirdu'i chos lugs pa rnams kyang 'dod pa yin/'di tsho'i dkon mchog zer ba 'di 'jig rten gyi byed pa po dbang phyug cha med gcig bu
366 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/'dod pa dang cung zad 'dra po yod/sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis 'di'i skor bsam blo zhib tu btang ba na/ dkon mchog gi bka' 'am phrin bzang de mi gzhan tshang ma la skyel ba'i ched du dkon mchog rang gis kho rang nyid bskos pa yin pa'i nyams snang byung / dkon mchog ni gcig 'ba' zhig yin la de la sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis anywaha zhes brjod/ kho rang nyid dkon mchog de'i phrin skyel pho nya ste skragasbrar yin zhes brjod/ khos bshad pa de khas len byed mkhan tsho la mu:ma ste kha che zhes ming thogs shing chos lugs de la osngam zhes bya/kha che'i chos kyi dpe deb rtsa chen ni kunān zer ba de yin la/ de ni kha che tshos dkon mchog gi gsung yin par 'dod/ dpe deb de'i nang du dgos pa ga dus byung na yang dkon mchog gis pho nya re gtong gi yod ces 'khod yod cing / pho nya de rnams kyi nang nas 'ga' shas kyi ming yang bkod 'dug pa ni/ yahādi'i pho nya gabāhim dang /musa'am modzengo dang / ishumathikā bcas red/sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis rang gi rjes 'brangs pa tsho la nyin ltar namadza zhes pa'i smon lam gsol 'debs thengs lnga re 'don dgos pa dang / ro: zhes pa'i lhung gnas lo ltar sdod dgos pa dang / maṅgā la gnas skor du 'gro dgos pa sogs chos kyi spyod lam mang po gsungs yod 'dug des dang po so so'i chung ma dang / nye 'brel rnams kha cher bzos pa red/ 'on kyang chos lugs gsar pa de gsang ba byed dgos byung smi/ arab pa tshos chos de ha go na sbrang rtsi'i blo gros la mi dga' ba yong gi yod pa red/ maklu'i mi dmangs tshos chos lugs gsar pa de'i skor shes skabs de tshos sbrang sna'i blo gros dmar gsod gtong rgyu yin tshul nyen brda btang ba red/ der brten khong mdīnā zer sar bros dgos byung ba red/ gnas tshul 'di phyi lo 622 lor
le'udang po/ sngon dus gyi byung rabs/ 367byung zhing / kha che'i dus rabs sam lo rabs nyingagrwa zer ba de lo de nas 'go tshugs pa red/ mthar maṅgā'i mi tsho yang kha che'i chos lugs su rim bzhin zhugs pa red/kha che'i chos dar khyab/ sbrang sna'i blo gros de phyi lo 632 lo che las 'das shing / kho che 'phos pa'i rjes su kho'i chos lugs de shin tu mgyogs por dar rgyas byung ba red/ brgya phrag gcig nang tshun garab kyi dpung dmag tshos sa yul rgya chen po zhig la dbang sgyur thub pa dang tshog sgril byed thub pa byung ste nub oshilā nas byang añdzakā dang / de'i yang pha rol sapen (89817) bar du arab kyi dpung dmag tshos kha che'i dar cha btsugs pa red/ sa yul de tshor khakaka zhes pa ste sbrang :'i blo gros kyi rgyal tshab lta bu zhig gis srid dbang bsgyur ba red/ skabs der lngarab pa tsho'i rgyal khams de shin tu nas rgya che zhing / nub yeshilā dang / parashiya'i gshis rig dang mi rigs rnying pa khag dang / nub gling yuropa kyi gshis rig bar gyi zam pa lta bur gyur yod pa red/ mi ring bar rgya gar yang kha che'i chos lugs kyi dbang shugs 'og tu tshud pa dang / arab kyi mi tshos kha che'i chos rgya gar du spel ba red/kha che zhes pa'i bod skad kyi ming tshog 'di'i 'byung khungs tshul bzhin ma shes kyang / 'di ni sngon dus 'phags yul gyi bye brag kushasmyur zhis pa'i tshog dod yin pa las sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyi chos dang 'brel ba gtan nas med par mngon/ dus 'khor nang na sbrang rtsi'i blo gros la kla klo'i ston pa dang / de'i chos la kla klo'i chos dang /de tsho'i rgyal khams la kla klo'i rgyal khams sogs gsungs pa ma gtogs kha che dang kha che'i chos zhes pa sogs med/ 'on kyang phyis su bod du kha che zhes pa'i tshog 'di gong du bshad pa ltar sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyi chos lugs dang 'brel ba ston byed du spyi khyab tu bed spyod byed srol byung / chos lugs de arab yul nas tu'istun dang / gaphaXnistun
368 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/brgyud de gshagrwar phyogs nas bod pa tshos mthong thos byung ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa yin srid/ gang ltar mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas dpyad par bya'o//gang ltar don go bar nus pas de bzhin bed spyod byed chog ste/ sgra ni brjod 'dod kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin pa'i phyir ro//garab kyi khra rnams kyis phyi lo 712 lor 'phags yul gyi byang nub phyogs sidha (deng sang 5gistun la yod )dbang 'og tu bsdus nas nub phyogs su btsan rgol byed rgyu'i 'jigs snang bskul/ 'on kyang deng dus m+pi rā4lhan mnga' sde'i rgyal po tshos arab kyi mi tsho mdun skyod byed ma btsug par bkag pa red/ 'on kyang sasnu la ni garab kyis dbang bsgyur byas 'dug thog mar rgya gar gyi sa khul 'di la kha che'i chos de gal chen por gyur/ garab kyi mi tsho sa khul der rgyal kha len mkhan tsam ma yin par nub phyogs kyi mtsho 'gram khul du tshong pa tsho'i gzhis chags khag mang po btsugs nas sa mtshams kyi mi tsho dang mnyam 'dres sdod kyis phan tshun gnyen yang byas/ der ma zad ekalā'i yul gzhan khag dang mnyam yod pa'i rgya gar gyi tshong las la yang mnyam 'brel byas/de ltar phyi lo brgya phrag brgyad pa'i bar rgya gar gyi ya rabs kyi sbyod tshul lam bzang spyod shes rig gar ldan ngang mi mang rnams skyid po yod/ rgya gar gyi shes rig de rgya gar tsam ma yin par yul gzhan gyi mi rnams la yang rgyus yod pa dang / skabs re gzhan dang 'brel lam dam zab byung 'dug des mi rigs gzhan gyi shes rig gis kyang rgya gar gyi shes rig la phan thogs byas yod pa red/ arab a+yau mi tshos rang dang mnyam du kha che'i chos rgya gar du spel bar shes rig gsar pa'i nus shugs shig bslebs pa des rjes kyi dus rabs mang por 'gyur ba chen po btang yod pa red/
le'udang po/ sngon dus spre byung rabs/ 369de bzhin du phyogs gcig nas rgya gar gyis rang gi gshis rig phyi rol du spel bzhin yod pa dang / phyogs gcig nas phroṃ rol gyi gshis rig gsar pa zhig nang du 'phel ba red/gal che shos gcig ni dus skabs 'di bar du rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs dang / chab srid 'dzin skyong dang / gshis rig la 'gyur ba mi 'dra ba mang po zhig phyin zin pa dang /'gyur ba de dag gi grub 'bras ni rjes kyi dus rabs rnams su gsal thon byung ba dang /'phags yul gyi byung rabs sam lo rgyus la shugs rkyen shin tu chen po zhig thebs yod pa red/ gnas tshul spyir btang bshad nas da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya'o//arab kyis sirnyu la btsan bzung dang / mnyalhad ganganabi dang munyasmad ṅgāsmida ni gong du bshad pa ltar kha che'i dbang shugs rgya gar la bslebs tshul dang /de'i rjes gnas tshul rim byung sna tshogs bshad par bya smi/ de yang kha che tsho'i nang nas rgya gar la thog mar bslebs mkhan ni arab kyi mi rigs rnams yin zhing / arab kyi kha che tsho'i drag po'i dpung gi bya ba lam lhong dang ldan pa des rgya gar gyi srid don lo rgyus la shugs rkyen phugs brtan po rang ma byung yang / rgya gar dang arab gnyis kyi 'brel ba byung ba de ga rang gal chen por gyur pa dang / des phyos kyai 'gyur ba sna tshogs zhig gi rgyu byas yod pa red/arab ) phyed gling de ni shar gling yeshilā'i phyed gling gtso che ba gsum gyi nang nas gcig yin zhing / de ni yeshilā'i gling chen gyi nub phyogs a+yau cha shas su yod/ches snga ba'i dus nas bzung garab pa rnams dang rgya gar bar zhi bde nying 'jag gi sgo nas tshong 'brel byung ba zhig red/ de lta na yang de tsho kha che'i chos lugs su gyur rjes
370 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/rgya gar dang mdza' 'brel byed pa'i kun slong de la 'gyur ba byung zhing / mi mang tsho la 'gyur ba chen po byung ba red/ dus tshod thung thung zhig gi nang arab pa tshos r+sāriX (37318) dang / perashilā (237318) dang / pheleXn (2lnga/ 3(1r+sā ) dang / gzhan yang sa khul mang por btsan bzung byas pa red/ sa yul de tsho btsan 'dzin byed thub pa des khong tsho la rang nyid stobs shugs yod pa'i khengs pa skyes shing kha che'i chos khyab spel byed thub pa'i nges shes chen po byung / rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor gyis yid 'phrogs te srid don dang / dpal 'byor gyi 'dod rngam dang / chos lugs kyi ngar sems bcas ni arab pa tshog rgya gar la btsan rgol byed dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin/thog ma'i btsan rgol/yig cha'i nang 'khod gsal ltar na arab pa tshos rgya gar la btsan rgol snga shos ni phyi lo 6364637 lor byung ba de ni balngazhwa nye 'gram sprun zer ba'i mnga' khul du byung 'dug 'on kyang btsan rgol de lam lhong ma byung bar arab pa tsho la pham nyes byung ba red/ lam lhong ma byung ba de las khong tsho'i re ba rtsa med du ma phyin par yang bskyar thabs shes byas te phyi lo 710 lor baphuḥstun btsan bzung byas pa red/ba5ciXn ni de dus rgya gar gyi sidha mnga' sde'i byang nub kyi sa gnas su yod pa red/sidha la btsan rgol byed mkhan ni arab pa'i dmag dpon mutasmad bin kāsem yin pa red/muhamad bin kār+sām/arab pa tshos rgya gar la btsan rgol dbang sgyur byed pa'i dus skabs legs po zhig 3 lo 708 tsam la byung ba red/ de skabs sidha la caca zer ba'i rgyal rgyud kyi
le'udang po/ sngonadus kyibyung rabs/ 371bram ze'i rgyal po dahor zer ba zhig gis srid dbang bzung yod pa red/ de ni spyir btang rgyal rigs nas ma yin par bram ze'i rigs yin pa dang / kho'i gzhung de la mi mang tshos dga' mos byed kyi med pa dang / gzhung de 'jon po yang med par ma zad mnga' sde'i srid skyong tsho phal cher rang dbang rang btsan lta bu red/ gnas stangs de 'dra'i gcig gi skabs arab kyi dmag dpon muhamad bin kāsem gyis sidha la btsan 'dzul byas pa red/de yang lho phyogs sihal nas log bzhin pa'i arab kyi gru gzing kha shas sidha'i thad kyi rgya mtsho'i nang rgya mtsho'i jag bcom pa tshos 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / kha che'i bud med dang phru sdu 'ga' shas kyang 'dzin bzung byas pa red/ gnas tshul de arāka gi srid skyong hanā4 zer ba des shes rtogs byung skabs des sin+d+ra'i dbang 'dzin pa dahor la 'phrog bcom pa khrims 'gal tsho la nyes chad gtong dgos pa'i dgos 'dun bton pa na ༷hor gyis las don de ni rgya mtsho'i jag pa tsho'i las don yin zhing /de tsho kho'i dbang 'og tu med tshul bshad nas ya ma byas pa red/ de la nya6ja shin tu khros nas kha che'i chos srid gnyis ku'i mnga' bdag khakaka zer ba de la dma' 'bebs yin par bsam nas/ drag po'i spyi khyab gsum gcig rjes gnyis 'thud btang ba na dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis dahor gyis pham par byas pa red/ drag po'i spyi khyab gsum pa de ni muhamad min kāsem zhes pa de yin la/ de ni ha(ja ye tsha bo yin par ma zad rang gi sras mo'i khyo ga yang yin/munyasmad bin kāsem de nyid rta dmag drug stong (6000) dang / rnga mong zhon pa drug stong dang / dos 'khyer rnga mong nyis stong (2000) bcas sirnyu'i sa gnas makarān zhes par 'byor ba dang / makarān la sa gnas de ga'i dbang 'dzin
